Remote Opportunity -- (US Citizenship required to obtain security clearance.)

jobs.title: STEM College Admissions Counselor
jobs.excerpt: About Empowerly Empowerly (Empowerly. com) is an education technology company that personalizes college and career counseling, with a mission to empower students to become the most successful version of themselves.
jobs.description:
About Empowerly

Empowerly (Empowerly.com) is an education technology company that personalizes college and career counseling, with a mission to empower students to become the most successful version of themselves.

We provide data-driven education technology, start-up and research internship programs, and personalized counseling led by former Admission Officers and experienced College Admissions Counselors. We are a rapidly growing, mission-driven, and venture-backed company. It takes a unified team committed to our core values (collaboration, data driven, and empowerment) to achieve this goal and a fast-moving team committed to serving the needs of our students and families.

Each student is holistically evaluated through our Empowerly Score™ — the only predictive technology that can also quantify subjective material. Each student is offered a three-pronged approach to evaluate academics, essays, and extracurricular activities, providing them with a 360-degree view of how to be competitive against other applicants.

We are a fully remote, global workforce focused on building world-class, college admissions advisory services and programs.

About the role

We are looking for a STEM College Admissions Counselors for high school students who help high school students through the college admissions process. We prefer STEM College Admissions Counselors with years of experience and/or former admissions officers at top colleges. We also prefer College Admissions Counselors who have graduated from top 50 colleges and have a STEM background (preferably in computer science, engineering, and/or medicine).

Many of our students live in the San Francisco Bay Area and apply for top 50 colleges, including the UCs and Ivy League schools. We particularly have many aspiring pre-med students (BS/MD programs) and computer science students.

College Admissions Counselors create academic and extracurricular road maps, provide college application structure and feedback, and assist with passion discovery and early career development.

Graduate School Counselors help students through graduate school admissions process. Requires knowledge and experience in specific graduate school admissions processes such as medical school, law school, MBA programs, PhD programs, and more.

Career Counselors provide career advice to get accepted to competitive internships and jobs, including passion discovery, resume and cover letter editing, interview prep, networking tips, and more.

**The typical weekly hours a College Admissions Counselor supplies is part-time equivalent.

Responsibilities

  • STEM expertise including depth of knowledge within pre-medicine, engineering, computer science, etc.
  • Keep up to date with current college admission changes.
  • Available for 20-25 students with flexibility based on schedule and bandwidth.
  • Advise students about extracurriculars that expand interests and may potentially present leadership opportunities.
  • Help students with meaningful summer plans by applying to internships, explore competitions, research opportunities, and community service options.
  • Create a plan for standardized testing that includes strategies for improving scores and help decide which tests are appropriate.
  • Help create college lists, rate colleges for students (reach, target, and safety), and offer tips for college visits.
  • Guidance through the entire application process: personal statement, activities, resume, recommendation letters, essay review and edits, utilizing research when necessary, reviewing entire application materials before submitting.
  • Strategizing plan for early action, early decision, regular decision as well as waitlisted strategies and college choice guidance.
  • Discuss financial aid resources and guidance as well as merit scholarship resources.
  • Prepare for sessions in advance, be on time, log sessions in a timely manner, stay in touch with students, maintain a healthy relationship with parents, and include parents in all communications.
  • Support a wide range of students, including; transfer, undergrad, post graduate, and international.
  • Attend monthly team meetings.
  • Utilize resources available within Empowerly to provide optimal advice for all students.
  • Monitor Empowerly email account and Slack account for up-to-date Empowerly communications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate from a top 50 national university (advanced degrees like MD, PhD, MBA, JD, or Masters are a plus)
  • Experience as a college counselor for high school students, with a track record of acceptances into a top 50 national university
  • Have consistent availability in the afternoons (after 3:00 p.m.) and/or on weekends to meet with students.
  • Possess passion for education, talent for teaching, essay writing, and essay editing.
  • Possess exceptional oral and written communication skills
  • Able to plan around and meet deadlines
  • Possess dedication to client service
  • Able to commit to students for multi-year packages

Preferred Qualifications

  • Former admissions officers at top 50 colleges
  • Experienced independent college counselors (NACAC, WACAC, IECA, etc)

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Safety AI
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Safety AI team builds end-to-end computer vision and machine learning for Samsara’s AI dash cameras – delivering real-time driver safety insights and in-cab alerts.

As a Sr. Manager of Machine Learning, you will lead teams that fuse on-device computer vision with IMU, GPS, and vehicle diagnostic data to detect, interpret, and surface actionable safety events and continuous risk signals.

You’ll own the model lifecycle across edge and cloud – data curation, training, evaluation (including shadow/online experiments), deployment, monitoring, and iteration—and develop the core AI platform that powers these capabilities at fleet scale. You’ll partner closely with firmware, full-stack, and Platform teams to ship reliable, low-latency features, grounding detections in the “rules of the road” (e.g., stop signs and speed limits) to maximize precision and customer impact.

Your success will be measured by real outcomes: safety events caught, accident rates reduced, model reliability at production scale, and the velocity at which your team can move from research idea to deployed feature on real vehicles driven by real people.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.

This position requires travel up to 5% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together.

In this role, you will:

Drive the Safety AI Platform Architecture

  • Own the technical direction for Samsara's on-device and cloud safety AI systems — making architectural decisions about what runs on constrained edge hardware vs. cloud, how models are packaged and deployed across more than 2M dashcams, and how the data flywheel is built to drive continuous improvement.
  • Lead the transition from individual model deployments to a coherent, system-level platform — one that fuses camera, IMU, GPS, and vehicle telemetry data to detect, interpret, and surface safety events with high precision and low latency.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI capabilities (e.g. VLMs, foundation models, multi-task architectures) and determine when they are ready to move from research to production at fleet scale.

Ship Safety AI Features with Measurable Customer Impact

  • Partner with product and full-stack teams to define, scope, and ship safety features that reduce accident rates, improve driver coaching outcomes, and deliver quantifiable value to fleet operators.
  • Lead experiment design, offline/online evaluation, and go/no-go decisions for new ML-powered features — grounding every launch in real safety metrics, not just model performance benchmarks.
  • Own the full model lifecycle: data curation, training, evaluation (shadow and online experiments), deployment, monitoring, and iteration on a continuous improvement loop.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

  • Lead and grow a team of applied scientists and engineers across CV, sensor fusion, edge ML, maintaining a culture of high technical standards and strong delivery.
  • Hire, coach, and develop senior ICs and early-career talent; create growth paths across both technical and leadership tracks.
  • Operate as a tech lead manager: setting the architectural direction while staying hands-on enough to review modeling approaches, unblock technical decisions, and maintain credibility with your most senior engineers.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in applied ML or computer vision, with a strong track record of shipping models to production in real-world systems.
  • 5+ years leading technical teams of scientists and engineers, including senior ICs — with demonstrated ability to set technical direction, not just manage delivery.
  • Experience shipping CV and/or sensor fusion systems that fuse multiple data streams (e.g. camera, IMU, GPS, telemetry) in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate science-engineering tension: you know when to hold the platform line and when to adapt for research velocity, and you can communicate trade-offs clearly to both sides.
  • Experience building and deploying large-scale machine learning systems with feedback loops for continuous improvement.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Customer orientation and intensive focus on improving the customer experience.
  • Experience building, deploying, and optimizing AI systems than span edge devices and the cloud.
  • Experience with VLMs, foundation models, or multi-task architectures in production settings — particularly in constrained compute environments.
  • Background in AV, robotics, or fleet telematics domains where safety and reliability are first-class requirements.
  • Contributions to or deep familiarity with the academic research literature in CV and perception and the ability to evaluate what's worth bringing in from research and what isn't.
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$178,640—$287,100 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Video Producer | Presenter-Led Content
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. A producer role developing and producing exceptional journalist-led content with a globally traveling on-camera presenter, across short, medium and long formats.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

A producer role developing and producing exceptional journalist-led content with a globally traveling on-camera presenter, across short, medium and long formats.

Organization:Confidential client in the media sector
Location:Fully remote – open to candidates anywhere in the world
Role Type:Full-time | Consultant-contractor

The opportunity

Our client's co-founder is an on-camera journalist and presenter who is constantly moving between countries, communities and stories. The client is looking for a producer to develop and produce exceptional content with him as the presenter.

He is the talent. You will work closely with him behind the scenes to shape the strategy, find the stories, develop the angles, research the facts and write the scripts that bring his journalism to life. As co-founder of a media company that helps people tell the stories traditional media overlooks, he is building a presenter-led output across short, medium and long formats: everything from one-minute reactions and recurring explainer series to podcasts, interviews and documentaries.

You will help decide what he should cover, why it matters and how he should tell the story on camera.

About the organization

Our client is a media company that helps the 99% be seen by empowering people to tell their own stories, because traditional media focuses on the 1%. Its co-founder presents the journalism this role will build.

What you will do

  • Build a strategy for presenter-led content around his voice, interests, travel and access.
  • Proactively pitch original stories, timely reactions and unexpected angles, particularly around social justice.
  • Research subjects thoroughly, find credible sources and identify the details that make a story compelling.
  • Write scripts for on-camera delivery, with natural spoken language, strong hooks and clear storytelling.
  • Develop distinctive shows and repeatable formats the presenter hosts, including explainers, podcasts and documentaries.
  • Identify contributors, interview opportunities and stories in the places the presenter is visiting.
  • Prepare presenter briefs, interview questions, filming plans and story outlines so he arrives ready to shoot.
  • Produce his on-camera delivery, whether remotely or on location, with feedback on clarity, pacing and performance.
  • Work with editors to shape his footage into strong finished stories, including supporting footage, graphics and sound.
  • Develop titles, thumbnails and social copy that make people want to watch.
  • Study performance and audience retention, then apply what you learn to the next piece.
  • Protect factual accuracy and editorial integrity from the first pitch through to publication.

What you bring

  • A proven track record in digital journalism, video production or documentary storytelling.
  • Experience producing presenter-led content and working directly with on-camera talent.
  • Published work that has generated millions of views, with a clear explanation of your contribution.
  • Excellent research, scripting and storytelling skills.
  • A strong understanding of how audiences behave across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook.
  • The ability to write both a sharp short-form hook and a sustained narrative for a longer film.
  • The initiative and organization to keep projects moving around a demanding travel schedule.
  • A deep commitment to social justice and a decolonial understanding of power, politics and representation: you question whose perspective is treated as authoritative, whose experiences are overlooked and who benefits from the way a story is told, while keeping the journalistic discipline to interrogate your own assumptions, check every claim and follow the evidence.

How the engagement works

  • You will contract directly with Apricot, which manages contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support.
  • Contracting arrangements, monthly compensation, time-zone overlap and the exact start date will be confirmed before an offer.
  • Your work will be based on the agreed scope and deliverables.
  • You are expected to provide your own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity and a secure working environment, and follow required security controls, including two-factor authentication.
  • You will collaborate with the client's distributed production and editorial teams.
  • We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and lived experiences, and selection is based on the requirements of the role; if you need a reasonable adjustment during the hiring process, please let us know.

About Apricot

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a social-impact mission with high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

Muttdata is a dynamic startup committed to crafting innovative systems using cutting-edge Big Data and AI technologies. If you consider yourself a data nerd like us, we'd love to connect!

We are looking for a strategic, results-driven Head of Marketing to lead Marketing into its next stage as a strategic function with a measurable contribution to revenue. This is a senior leadership role for someone with sharp business judgment. You'll decide where the budget goes and why, make Marketing's impact visible and trusted by Sales and leadership, and lead a senior team of specialists who work with AI every day.

  • Astronomer

    6 months
    Build the engine

    Marketing pipeline on plan and trusted by leadership; growing brand awareness in the US; an AI-enabled team that grows impact faster than headcount

Nice to have

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

jobs.title: College Admissions Counselor
jobs.excerpt: About Empowerly Empowerly (Empowerly. com) is an education technology company that personalizes college and career counseling, with a mission to empower students to become the most successful version of themselves.
jobs.description:
About Empowerly

Empowerly (Empowerly.com) is an education technology company that personalizes college and career counseling, with a mission to empower students to become the most successful version of themselves.

We provide data-driven education technology, start-up and research internship programs, and personalized counseling led by former Admission Officers and experienced College Admissions Counselors. We are a rapidly growing, mission-driven, and venture-backed company. It takes a unified team committed to our core values (collaboration, data driven, and empowerment) to achieve this goal and a fast-moving team committed to serving the needs of our students and families.

Each student is holistically evaluated through our Empowerly Score™ — the only predictive technology that can also quantify subjective material. Each student is offered a three-pronged approach to evaluate academics, essays, and extracurricular activities, providing them with a 360-degree view of how to be competitive against other applicants.

We are a fully remote, global workforce focused on building world-class, college admissions advisory services and programs.

About the role

We are looking for College Admissions Counselors for high school students who help high school students through the college admissions process. We prefer College Admissions Counselors with years of experience and/or former admissions officers at top colleges. We also prefer College Admissions Counselors who have graduated from top 50 colleges and have a STEM background (preferably in computer science, engineering, and/or medicine).

Many of our students live in the San Francisco Bay Area and apply for top 50 colleges, including the UCs and Ivy League schools. We particularly have many aspiring pre-med students (BS/MD programs) and computer science students.

College Admissions Counselors create academic and extracurricular road maps, provide college application structure and feedback, and assist with passion discovery and early career development.

Graduate School Counselors help students through graduate school admissions process. Requires knowledge and experience in specific graduate school admissions processes such as medical school, law school, MBA programs, PhD programs, and more.

Career Counselors provide career advice to get accepted to competitive internships and jobs, including passion discovery, resume and cover letter editing, interview prep, networking tips, and more.

**The typical weekly hours a College Admissions Counselor supplies is part-time equivalent.

Responsibilities

  • Keep up to date with current college admission changes.
  • Available for 20-25 students with flexibility based on schedule and bandwidth.
  • Advise students about extracurriculars that expand interests and may potentially present leadership opportunities.
  • Help students with meaningful summer plans by applying to internships, explore competitions, research opportunities, and community service options.
  • Create a plan for standardized testing that includes strategies for improving scores and help decide which tests are appropriate.
  • Help create college lists, rate colleges for students (reach, target, and safety), and offer tips for college visits.
  • Guidance through the entire application process: personal statement, activities, resume, recommendation letters, essay review and edits, utilizing research when necessary, reviewing entire application materials before submitting.
  • Strategizing plan for early action, early decision, regular decision as well as waitlisted strategies and college choice guidance.
  • Discuss financial aid resources and guidance as well as merit scholarship resources.
  • Prepare for sessions in advance, be on time, log sessions in a timely manner, stay in touch with students, maintain a healthy relationship with parents, and include parents in all communications.
  • Support a wide range of students, including; transfer, undergrad, post graduate, and international.
  • Attend monthly team meetings.
  • Utilize resources available within Empowerly to provide optimal advice for all students.
  • Monitor Empowerly email account and Slack account for up-to-date Empowerly communications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate from a top 50 national university (advanced degrees like MD, PhD, MBA, JD, or Masters are a plus)
  • Experience as a college counselor for high school students, with a track record of acceptances into a top 50 national university
  • Have consistent availability in the afternoons (after 3:00 p.m.) and/or on weekends to meet with students.
  • Possess passion for education, talent for teaching, essay writing, and essay editing.
  • Possess exceptional oral and written communication skills
  • Able to plan around and meet deadlines
  • Possess dedication to client service
  • Able to commit to students for multi-year packages

Preferred Qualifications

  • Former admissions officers at top 50 colleges
  • Experienced independent college counselors (NACAC, WACAC, IECA, etc)

jobs.excerpt: This job posting is available in English and Canadian French.
jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.

Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

  • $60K USD (U.S.-based candidates)
  • $60K CAD (Canada-based candidates)

Description

We’re not looking for someone to “set up campaigns.”

We’re looking for someone to own them, from the first tag to the final recap.

Level Agency is hiring a hands-on, detail-obsessed Media Analytics & AdOps Manager to build, traffic, track, and trade campaigns end to end, then turn the data into recommendations clients act on.

This is a hybrid seat. It combines a traditional Ad Ops role (setup, QA, tracking, trafficking) with a programmatic Trader role (pacing, in-platform optimization, PMP activation, audience builds). You’ll work across DV360 and other DSPs, YouTube, Meta, and TikTok, and report to the VP of Programmatic.

If a broken Floodlight bothers you until it’s fixed, you’ll fit right in.

This Isn’t for Everyone.

We’re building something rare: a place where precision, performance, and ownership all show up, every day.

You’ll thrive here if:

✅ You treat every launch as zero-error and own QA before anything goes live

✅ You verify tracking with data instead of assuming it’s firing

✅ You enjoy being in-platform, adjusting bids, inventory, and frequency to move performance

✅ You troubleshoot tracking issues and disapprovals without waiting to be told how

✅ You can juggle multiple clients and launches without dropping details

And you’ll struggle here if:

❌ You’d rather hand off setup and QA to someone else

❌ You’re comfortable launching without checking the data

❌ You see pacing as a month-end task instead of a daily habit

❌ You avoid digging into pixels, tags, and broken conversions

❌ You prefer reporting numbers over explaining what they mean

About Level

Good enough isn’t.

Level Agency is an AI-powered performance marketing agency built for brands ready to shatter yesterday’s wins.

We help complex, high-consideration brands outperform their last result using AI, data science, creativity, and relentless iteration.

We specialize in markets where the stakes are high and the journeys are complex — education, B2B technology, financial services, healthcare, CPG, ecommerce, and more. Our work spans the full performance ecosystem: media planning & buying, performance creative, SEO & AI search, CRM & automation, and advanced analytics.

In 2025, Level acquired BAM Strategy — expanding our capabilities into digital experience, CRM strategy, personalization, and loyalty. The result is a fully integrated growth engine that connects acquisition to retention, media to lifecycle, and performance to long-term customer value.

Today, our 250-person team operates fully remote across the U.S. and Canada, supporting 150+ ambitious brands.

Your Role (and Impact)

As a Media Analytics & AdOps Manager on Level’s Programmatic team, you’ll own campaigns end to end: clean setups, reliable tracking, smart in-platform trading, and reporting that drives client decisions.

You will:

Own Campaign Setup, QA & Trafficking

  • Independently set up, launch, and monitor campaigns across DV360 and other DSPs, YouTube, Meta (Facebook / Instagram), and TikTok
  • Populate and submit the QA checklist for every launch, and own launch QA so nothing goes live with errors
  • Traffic creative and tags to the media plan, set up CM360 placements, and confirm everything is trafficked correctly before launch

Keep Tracking Clean

  • Manage ad tracking, pixel implementations, and conversion setup
  • Implement and audit CM360 Floodlights, and troubleshoot tracking issues and creative disapprovals quickly
  • Within 24 hours of launch, pull the reports that confirm tracking is firing correctly in CM360, DV360, and DoubleVerify

Trade & Optimize in the DSP

  • Build campaigns end to end in DV360 following Level’s account structure, and launch them independently with minimal checks
  • Run daily pacing and performance checks so campaigns deliver against goals and stay on budget across multiple clients and lines of business
  • Make optimizations that shift auction dynamics: bids, time of day, publisher, device, frequency, and inventory
  • Use DoubleVerify data to improve viewability, brand safety, and fraud metrics

Activate Deals & Audiences

  • Activate off-the-shelf DSP deals and know when they make sense
  • Reach out to publishers to negotiate, set up, and troubleshoot custom PMPs for display, native, and video
  • Build Google audiences in DV360 (Affinity, In-Market, Custom Affinity, Custom Intent) and activate first-party segments

Own Reporting, Testing & Measurement

  • Pull and automate performance reports, analyze data with pivot tables, and deliver client reporting accurately and on cadence
  • Build proposals, post-buy recaps, and data-driven reports that give clients clear, actionable insights
  • Design and run A/B, audience segmentation, and creative tests that keep pushing performance
  • Integrate CM360 and DV360 for targeting, attribution, and optimization, and explain to clients why click-through and view-through conversions need to be measured together

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with account leads, analytics/BI, sales, and external partners so campaigns launch cleanly and data flows reliably between platforms

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: Build campaigns end to end, submit QA for every launch, run daily pacing checks, verify tracking within 24 hours of launch, implement Floodlights, and make auction-level optimizations with support
  • 60 days: Launch independently with minimal errors, optimize with little to no supervision, set up custom PMPs, build DV360 audiences, audit Floodlight setups, and own the client reporting cadence
  • 90 days: Own QA across all launches, manage pacing across multiple clients, advise clients on objectives, budgets, and forecasts, lead weekly and monthly reporting with clear recommendations, and support junior team members

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years in ad operations, programmatic trading, or digital media, at an agency or in-house
  • Hands-on DV360 experience: campaign builds, pacing, optimization, and deal activation
  • Working knowledge of CM360 (placements, trafficking, Floodlights) and DoubleVerify or IAS
  • Experience setting up and running campaigns in YouTube, Meta Ads Manager, and TikTok Ads Manager
  • Comfort with pixels, conversion APIs, tag managers, and troubleshooting broken tracking
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups) and the ability to turn data into a clear story
  • Detail-oriented and organized, able to manage multiple clients and launches at once
  • Clear written and verbal communication with internal teams and clients

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Yahoo DSP, or StackAdapt
  • Google Marketing Platform or DV360 certification
  • Experience with CTV, DOOH, audio, or high-impact formats
  • GA4 familiarity for measurement and optimization conversations
  • Exposure to reporting automation (Supermetrics, Looker Studio, SQL, or scripting)
  • Experience negotiating custom deals directly with publishers

AI Expectations

At Level, AI is a core skill — not an afterthought.

In this role, you will:

  • Constantly experiment with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and platform-native AI capabilities
  • Use AI to speed up QA prep, such as checking a media plan against platform setups before launch
  • Automate repetitive reporting pulls and use AI to spot pacing and performance anomalies sooner
  • Draft first-pass recaps and insights with AI, then sharpen them with your own analysis and judgment
  • Document and share prompts, workflows, and learnings with your team
  • Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut — you own every number that goes to a client

Our Core Values

  • No Ego, All In We don’t do “that’s not my job.” We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
  • Better Every Day We want the feedback, even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
  • Relentless for Results Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
  • Driven by Truth We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear, not just what is easy to say.

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be required for company events and team working sessions. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We celebrate what makes you, you. Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.

Ready to Apply?

Click below to submit your resume. You’ll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.

We care more about what you can do than whether your career path was perfectly linear.

Let’s build something together.

AI HIRING DISCLAIMER

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level’s hiring team.

Nous ne cherchons pas quelqu’un pour « configurer des campagnes ».

Level Agency recrute une personne pratique et minutieuse pour occuper le poste de gestionnaire, analytique média et AdOps. À propos de Level

Le « assez bon », ce n’est pas suffisant.

Level Agency est une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA, conçue pour les marques prêtes à faire voler en éclats les succès d’hier.

Votre rôle (et votre impact)

Rapports, tests et mesure

  • Extraire et automatiser des rapports de performance, analyser les données avec des tableaux croisés dynamiques et livrer les rapports clients avec exactitude et selon la cadence prévue
  • Préparer des propositions, des bilans post-campagne et des rapports basés sur les données qui donnent aux clients des recommandations claires et concrètes
  • Concevoir et mener des tests A/B, de segmentation d’audience et de créations qui font progresser la performance
  • Intégrer CM360 et DV360 pour le ciblage, l’attribution et l’optimisation, et expliquer aux clients pourquoi les conversions après clic et après visionnement doivent être mesurées ensemble

Collaboration

  • Travailler avec les responsables de comptes, l’équipe analytique/BI, les ventes et les partenaires externes pour que les campagnes se lancent sans accroc et que les données circulent de façon fiable entre les plateformes

À quoi ressemble le succès

  • Premiers 30 jours : Bâtir des campagnes de bout en bout, soumettre le QA pour chaque lancement, effectuer des vérifications quotidiennes du rythme de diffusion, vérifier le suivi dans les 24 heures suivant chaque lancement, implanter des Floodlights et faire des optimisations au niveau des enchères avec du soutien
  • 60 jours : Lancer de façon autonome avec un minimum d’erreurs, optimiser avec peu ou pas de supervision, configurer des PMP sur mesure, créer des audiences DV360, auditer les configurations Floodlight et prendre en charge la cadence des rapports clients
  • 90 jours : Prendre en charge le QA de tous les lancements, gérer le rythme de diffusion pour plusieurs clients, conseiller les clients sur leurs objectifs, budgets et prévisions, diriger les rapports hebdomadaires et mensuels avec des recommandations claires et soutenir les membres juniors de l’équipe

Exigences

Profil recherché

  • De 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en opérations publicitaires, en trading programmatique ou en média numérique, en agence ou à l’interne
  • Expérience pratique de DV360 : création de campagnes, rythme de diffusion, optimisation et activation d’ententes
  • Connaissance pratique de CM360 (placements, trafficking, Floodlights) et de DoubleVerify ou IAS
  • Expérience de la configuration et de la gestion de campagnes dans YouTube, Meta Ads Manager et TikTok Ads Manager
  • Aisance avec les pixels, les API de conversion, les gestionnaires de balises et le dépannage du suivi défectueux
  • Solides compétences dans Excel / Google Sheets (tableaux croisés dynamiques, fonctions de recherche) et capacité à transformer les données en un récit clair
  • Souci du détail et sens de l’organisation, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs clients et lancements à la fois
  • Communication claire, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, avec les équipes internes et les clients

Atouts

  • Expérience dans The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Yahoo DSP ou StackAdapt
  • Certification Google Marketing Platform ou DV360
  • Expérience en télé connectée (CTV), affichage numérique extérieur (DOOH), audio ou formats à fort impact
  • Connaissance de GA4 pour les discussions sur la mesure et l’optimisation
  • Exposition à l’automatisation des rapports (Supermetrics, Looker Studio, SQL ou scripts)
  • Expérience de la négociation d’ententes sur mesure directement avec les éditeurs

Attentes en matière d’IA

Chez Level, l’IA est une compétence clé — pas un bonus.

Dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

  • Expérimenter constamment avec des outils comme ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity et les fonctionnalités IA des plateformes
  • Utiliser l’IA pour accélérer la préparation du QA, par exemple en comparant un plan média aux configurations dans les plateformes avant le lancement
  • Automatiser les extractions de rapports répétitives et utiliser l’IA pour repérer plus tôt les anomalies de rythme de diffusion et de performance
  • Rédiger une première version des bilans et des constats avec l’IA, puis les peaufiner avec votre propre analyse et votre jugement
  • Documenter et partager vos prompts, vos flux de travail et vos apprentissages avec l’équipe
  • Voir l’IA comme un amplificateur, pas un raccourci — vous êtes responsable de chaque chiffre transmis à un client

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • Sans ego, tous engagés Chez nous, « ce n’est pas ma job » n’existe pas. Nous gagnons ensemble, nous donnons un coup de main là où c’est nécessaire et nous accordons plus d’importance au résultat qu’à l’organigramme.
  • Meilleurs chaque jour Nous voulons la rétroaction, même quand elle dérange. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons de placer la barre plus haut.
  • Implacables face aux résultats L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Nous nous concentrons sur le travail qui fait avancer les affaires.
  • Guidés par la vérité Nous remettons en question les suppositions, nous suivons les données et nous disons aux clients ce qu’ils ont besoin d’entendre, pas seulement ce qui est facile à dire.

Avantages sociaux

Chez Level, nous soutenons les membres de notre équipe aux États-Unis et au Canada avec des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

  • Télétravail complet aux États-Unis et au Canada, avec allocation mensuelle pour le travail à domicile et vendredis d’été
  • Congés généreux, incluant vacances illimitées (É.-U.), vacances concurrentielles (Canada) et congés parentaux/familiaux

Télétravail d’abord

Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des événements d’entreprise et des séances de travail en équipe. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer des visas pour le moment.

Our Values:

  • We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

The Position:

The Genomic Specialist (GS) is the front line of Veracyte’s customer interaction. The GS identifies and closes new business while maintaining and growing existing business. The GS’s primary focus is to clinically reinforce the value of our diagnostic tests (Afirma plus Xpression Atlas) with new and existing customers to support implementation of routine collection and ordering protocols and procedures.   • Analyze territory data to develop strategic plans and execute daily

  • Aptitude to sell clinically in-person or virtually in an office or hospital environment

  • Capacity to totally immerse into an account to assess stability and growth opportunity
  • Ideally have sold and functioned in procedure environment

  • Strong communication skills: written, oral and presentation. Has an attention to detail
  • Keeps the organization's vision and values at the forefront of daily actions

Position Title:Category Manager

Department:Business Development

Location: Remote

Reports To:Senior Director – Business Development

Installation Made Easy (“IME”) provides software and process management that enable retailers and contractors to offer installed home improvements to homeowners in a convenient, consistent, and affordable manner. IME senior management has over 100 years of retail management and home improvement industry experience.

The Category Manager’s primary responsibility is to develop and execute strategies for assigned home improvement categories that generate new leads, increase sales and revenue, enhance competitiveness, and improve customer satisfaction across partner networks. The Category Manager serves as the subject matter expert for each assigned category and is accountable for measurable category performance and continuous improvement.

To achieve these goals, the Category Manager analyzes category metrics, market trends, customer behavior, and competitor performance; develops coordinated promotional strategies with IME, retailers, manufacturers, distributors, and service providers; and conducts regular business reviews. The role also owns category-specific initiatives, including Wizards, Spec Sheets, and program improvements, ensuring projects advance on schedule and deliver meaningful business results. This position is highly visible within the company and will have frequent interaction with senior leadership and other departments.

An ideal candidate will be results-driven, proactive, and highly organized, with the ability to use IME technology and operational data to improve category performance. This individual will build productive internal and external relationships, clear obstacles, communicate next steps, and drive multiple initiatives forward in a collaborative environment without direct internal reports.

Essential Functions:

  • Own and manage strategic direction for assigned product categories to drive sales growth, competitiveness, and customer satisfaction across partner networks.
  • Develop and execute category plans with measurable leads, sales, and revenue goals; routinely review results, identify gaps, and take corrective action.
  • Own category-specific projects and improvements, including Wizards, Spec Sheets, and related technology or process initiatives; maintain project plans, milestones, deadlines, and action items.
  • Be a subject matter expert for assigned categories with a large emphasis on performance.
  • Use knowledge of IME systems and workflows to identify opportunities to improve category programs, partner experience, and operational efficiency.
  • Proactively engage manufacturers, distributors, and dealer networks; document partner feedback, communicate next steps, and resolve or escalate barriers to progress.
  • Maintain and execute category promotional calendars, evaluate promotion effectiveness, and adjust quarterly promotional strategies based on performance.
  • Analyze key category reports, including leads, sales, revenue, recruitment or assignment needs, ZIP-code coverage, work order cycle time, customer surveys, and promotions, to guide decisions.
  • Conduct monthly internal and external business reviews, including documented feedback and follow-up actions; regularly research industry trends and outside factors affecting assigned categories.
  • Complete periodic competitor reviews and category content audits to keep Spec Sheets, Wizards, and Knowledge Vault materials accurate, current, and aligned with program requirements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives, proactively share category knowledge, track outstanding actions, and ensure commitments and project deadlines are met.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent category information across all partner-facing and consumer-facing platforms.
  • Work with marketing teams to influence promotional strategy, visual merchandising, and creative campaigns.
  • Stay active in the industry through trade shows, factory visits, and customer-facing events to maintain category expertise and identify new business opportunities.
  • Perform other duties as required

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • 4+ years of proven experience in Kitchen and Bath, Flooring, Exteriors, MEP or other home improvement categories, with a strong understanding of product lines, installation processes, and vendor/contractor coordination in these areas.
  • 4+ years of retail experience
  • Professional demeanor.
  • Sound judgment and strong problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to interact effectively with all levels of an organization, including executive and C-level
  • Exceptional organization skills.
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects at a time, while maintaining efficiency and sharp attention to detail.
  • Ability to adapt to changing or multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of the home improvement industry

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.

The Category Manager position may require some travel but will be very limited and less than 10%. The CM may be asked to perform additional tasks that are not listed above. In addition, the list of primary responsibilities may change over time.

Benefits to working with IME:

  • 100% remote work environment
  • Employer provided equipment.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • Health savings plan includes employer contribution to health savings account.
  • Medical and dental flexible spending accounts
  • Company paid basic life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance.
  • 401K plan with employer match
    • Company matches 100% of the first 4% of salary deferrals.
    • All contributions, including employer contributions, are 100% vested immediately.

  • Employee assistance program
  • Pay on demand.
  • Critical illness, hospital indemnity, group accident, and legal insurance

  • And more!

📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans le cadre d'un programme wallon de reconstruction résiliente, un PMO est mis en place afin d'intégrer le pilotage des aménagements, des infrastructures, des marchés publics et des investissements. La fonction vise à renforcer la coordination des parties prenantes, la visibilité sur les risques, les délais et les moyens mobilisés, ainsi que la qualité du reporting.

Mission générale

Le PMO assure la gouvernance, la coordination, le contrôle et le reporting d'un programme de reconstruction résiliente afin de garantir l'atteinte des objectifs stratégiques, techniques, financiers et calendaires définis par les autorités compétentes et les partenaires du projet. Il assure le pilotage transversal du portefeuille, coordonne les parties prenantes et fournit aux instances de décision une information fiable et exploitable.

Responsabilités principales

1. Gouvernance du programme

  • Structurer et animer le dispositif de gouvernance.
  • Préparer les comités stratégiques et les comités d'accompagnement.
  • Préparer les dossiers nécessaires à la prise de décision.
  • Centraliser les décisions et suivre leur mise en œuvre.
  • Assurer la cohérence entre les autorités publiques, les communes, les bureaux d'études et les autres partenaires.
  • Veiller à l'application uniforme des méthodologies validées.

Les livrables comprennent notamment les tableaux de bord stratégiques, les registres de décisions, la cartographie des parties prenantes et le plan de gouvernance.

2. Pilotage du portefeuille de projets

  • Maintenir une vision consolidée de l'ensemble des opérations.
  • Identifier les interdépendances entre les études, les acquisitions foncières, les autorisations et les travaux.
  • Prioriser les interventions selon les objectifs du programme.
  • Veiller à l'atteinte des jalons stratégiques.
  • Faciliter l'arbitrage des conflits de priorités entre projets.

Le portefeuille couvre notamment les études hydrauliques, les projets de renaturation, les aménagements de berges, les ouvrages hydrauliques, les acquisitions foncières et les projets communaux liés à la reconstruction. Le PMO produit le portefeuille de projets, le planning directeur et la cartographie des interfaces.

3. Gestion des délais et du planning

  • Élaborer et mettre à jour le planning directeur du programme.
  • Consolider les calendriers des études, des marchés et des chantiers.
  • Identifier les dérives et leurs impacts.
  • Proposer et suivre les plans de rattrapage.
  • Produire les indicateurs d'avancement et les analyses des chemins critiques.

La fonction s'exerce dans un contexte impliquant plusieurs communes et de nombreux chantiers menés en parallèle.

4. Gestion budgétaire et financière

  • Assurer le suivi consolidé des budgets de fonctionnement et d'investissement.
  • Suivre les engagements, les liquidations et les prévisions budgétaires.
  • Mesurer les écarts et assurer la traçabilité des dépenses.
  • Produire les reportings financiers destinés aux autorités de tutelle.
  • Suivre les financements régionaux et européens ainsi que le plan de trésorerie.
  • Veiller à la bonne utilisation des crédits du programme.

5. Gestion des risques

  • Mettre à jour un registre centralisé des risques.
  • Évaluer les impacts potentiels sur les coûts, les délais et les objectifs.
  • Animer les plans d'action associés et suivre les mesures correctrices.
  • Préparer les arbitrages nécessaires.

Les risques peuvent notamment concerner les recours liés aux marchés publics, les contraintes foncières, l'acceptabilité locale, les autorisations administratives, les contraintes environnementales et les aléas techniques de chantier.

6. Coordination des marchés publics

  • Assurer la cohérence du portefeuille de marchés.
  • Veiller à l'alignement entre les besoins techniques et les procédures d'achat.
  • Anticiper les échéances critiques.
  • Suivre l'état d'avancement contractuel.
  • Faciliter les interfaces entre les bureaux d'études, les entreprises et les maîtres d'ouvrage.

7. Coordination technique et territoriale

  • Veiller à la cohérence entre la modélisation hydraulique, la conception des aménagements, les exigences environnementales, les contraintes urbanistiques et les solutions fondées sur la nature.
  • Organiser la concertation avec les communes et maintenir le dialogue avec les acteurs locaux.
  • Coordonner les échanges avec les riverains, les gestionnaires de réseaux, les contrats de rivière et les partenaires institutionnels.
  • Assurer la cohérence entre les projets de reconstruction et les projets territoriaux connexes.
  • Faciliter la résolution des points de blocage.

8. Reporting et communication

  • Centraliser l'information relative au programme.
  • Produire les reportings mensuels, tableaux de bord exécutifs, rapports d'avancement, indicateurs de performance et synthèses destinées aux instances de décision.
  • Préparer les supports de communication nécessaires au suivi du programme.
  • Fournir une information fiable, actualisée et exploitable.

9. Capitalisation et amélioration continue

  • Documenter les bonnes pratiques et les retours d'expérience.
  • Capitaliser les enseignements tirés des actions menées.
  • Développer et standardiser les méthodes et outils de gestion de programme.
  • Assurer la traçabilité des décisions et des connaissances acquises.

Le PMO agit comme le garant de la cohérence entre la gouvernance, les finances, les études hydrauliques, les acquisitions foncières, les marchés publics, les chantiers et la concertation territoriale d'un portefeuille d'investissements de plus de 250 millions d'euros.

jobs.description:
About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it. You will design the processes, controls, and intelligent workflows that keep data accurate, enriched, and trusted at scale, so Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance can give executive leadership reliable metrics. You will decide where AI agents and automation take over repetitive data work and where human judgment still matters, and partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate system changes that affect our data programs.

Who you are

  • Data obsessed and just as obsessed with removing manual work, with a habit of automating any process that relies on fixing records by hand
  • Curious about AI and a daily user, with experience shipping workflows with LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted tooling, and able to tell a useful application from a demo
  • Eager to build and shape a program rather than only maintain one, and able to create systems that hold up at global scale
  • Highly analytical, able to see the big picture and spot trends and gaps, then zoom in with practical, specific recommendations
  • Steady when juggling multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment
  • A good teammate, dedicated to the mission, who likes to have fun along the way

What you will do

  • Set the data governance strategy, standards, ownership model, and source-of-truth hierarchy for GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems
  • Establish policies, access controls, and field-level definitions, including record creation and deprecation rules, and monitor adherence
  • Ensure compliance and security of our data, and flag risks to IT, security, and leadership
  • Replace high-volume manual tasks (deduplication, enrichment, account matching, hierarchy mapping, routing, anomaly review) with automated and AI-assisted workflows
  • Design and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows that classify, enrich, validate, and remediate data, with guardrails, human review points, and accuracy measurement
  • Build automated data quality monitoring that detects issues early, alerts the right owner, and fixes them without human intervention where appropriate
  • Evaluate and select AI, enrichment, and automation tooling, run pilots, and measure impact through time saved, accuracy gains, and coverage
  • Own the enrichment strategy and keep account firmographics accurate: hierarchies, employee count, location, industry, and Fortune ranking
  • Act as the subject matter expert for Business Ops, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and Finance, run a defined feedback intake process, and support consistent reporting and dashboards
  • Manage a portfolio of data quality and automation projects with clear priorities, owners, and outcomes

Must Haves

  • 5+ years in Sales Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical or systems role
  • Hands-on experience building automation with AI or LLM tools (agents, prompt-driven workflows, AI-assisted enrichment), with shipped examples you can easily share
  • Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data modeling, master data management, and requirements gathering
  • Demonstrated understanding of Salesforce automation, including Flow and validation rules, and experience working closely with admins
  • Experience implementing and managing data and enrichment tools, including AI-native tools such as Clay, Kernel, Starbridge, and Onfire
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Track record of leading data management projects from idea to result
  • Sound judgment about where AI is reliable and where it needs controls for privacy, security, and accuracy
  • Detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, and quick to learn new tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non-technical partners
  • Preferred: experience with workflow automation or integration platforms (such as Workato or Zapier), modern data stack tools (such as Snowflake or dbt), SQL, and a high-growth SaaS or security company

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$107,100—$154,000 USD

Description

Location: Fully Remote (United States)

Visana Health is a virtual women’s clinic providing compassionate, evidence-based care for complex and historically overlooked conditions, including endometriosis, fibroids, chronic pelvic pain, and heavy menstrual bleeding. We are seeking mission-driven Nurse Practitioners (NP, FNP, or CNM) to deliver high-touch virtual care and collaborate with an expert clinical team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide comprehensive, compassionate virtual care visits using evidence-based care and treatment plans.
  • Deliver timely follow-up via messaging, phone calls, and lab/test result reviews.
  • Complete accurate clinical documentation and billing within 24 hours of each encounter.

  • Experience: 4+ years of NP experience in women’s health (via clinical practice, specialty certification, or both).
  • Licensure: Active, unencumbered NP/CNM licenses and prescriptive authority with independent practice eligibility where applicable.
  • Multistate Coverage: Active licenses in at least 3 states, including:
  • Group A (at least 1): CA, NY, IN, GA, OH, TN, MN, AZ, or PA.
  • Group B (at least 1): VA, MO, KY, CO, FL, TX, MS, AL, NC, AR, CT, or NJ.
  • Certification: Board-certified in Family Practice, Adult Health, Women’s Health, or Nurse-Midwifery; active DEA registration.
  • Availability: Consistent Friday coverage and minimum 15 direct patient hours/week (shifts available between 6:30 AM – 10:00 PM local time).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Dual background in primary care and women’s health.
  • Prior experience with Athenahealth EMR and telehealth platforms.
  • Multilingual skills.

What We Offer

  • Malpractice Insurance: Full comprehensive coverage provided.

Overview

We are seeking a Manager, Product Operations & Delivery to drive the execution of our product roadmap across ViaPath’s enterprise Offender Management System (OMS) platform. This role serves as the operational backbone of the product organization—ensuring that strategy is translated into clear, actionable, and high-quality delivery work.

You will lead the Product Analyst function and oversee the systems, processes, and standards that enable effective backlog management, requirements quality, and cross-functional alignment. This is a highly collaborative role that partners closely with Product, UX, Engineering, QA, Implementation, and Support teams to ensure product initiatives are well-defined, development-ready, and successfully delivered.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product operations, delivery execution, and team leadership, and who enjoys bringing structure and clarity to complex software environments.

This is a remote based position based anywhere in the contiguous US. Must be located near an airport to meet the travel requirement for the position.

Responsibilities

Product Delivery & Backlog Management

  • Translate approved product roadmap initiatives into structured, trackable delivery work (epics, features, user stories) within Jira
  • Maintain a well-organized, transparent backlog aligned to roadmap themes and priorities
  • Ensure end-to-end traceability between roadmap initiatives and delivery artifacts in Jira and Confluence

Requirements Quality & Readiness

  • Establish and enforce standards for high-quality requirements, including clarity, completeness, testability, and dependency management
  • Lead backlog refinement sessions to ensure all work meets “ready for development” criteria
  • Partner with UX, Engineering, and QA to clarify functional intent and resolve gaps early in the delivery lifecycle

Team Leadership & Enablement

  • Manage and mentor a team of Product Analysts responsible for functional design, user stories, and documentation
  • Provide coaching, workload planning, and performance management to ensure high-quality output and team growth
  • Foster consistency in documentation practices, tooling usage, and delivery standards
  • Feedback Synthesis & Continuous Improvement
  • Aggregate and analyze feedback from Support, Implementation, and other customer-facing teams
  • Identify trends, root causes, and opportunities, translating insights into actionable backlog items
  • Recommend priorities, scope tradeoffs, and improvements to product leadership based on operational data

Release Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate release readiness activities, ensuring scope completion and stakeholder alignment
  • Support release validation and ensure delivered functionality meets defined acceptance criteria
  • Draft and publish clear, accurate release notes and supporting product communications
  • Develop internal enablement materials such as feature summaries and user guidance

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain organized, accessible documentation in Confluence, including requirements, workflows, and decision logs
  • Track and escalate risks, gaps, and cross-team dependencies to maintain delivery momentum
  • Continuously improve processes related to backlog management, documentation, feedback intake, and release communication

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business Analysis, Product Operations, Software Delivery, Information Systems, or related fields
  • 8+ years of experience in product analysis, functional analysis, business analysis, or software delivery support within enterprise software environments with a minimum of 2 years of experience directly managing analysts or leading a requirements-focused function, including coaching, performance management, and workload planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business needs into structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation suitable for software delivery.
  • Strong experience managing backlogs and work tracking in tools such as Jira and maintaining structured documentation in Confluence (or comparable platforms).
  • Proven ability to synthesize feedback from Support, Implementation, and other customer-facing teams and convert it into actionable product work with clear recommendations.
  • Excellent writing, documentation, and organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience collaborating closely with UX, Engineering, and QA to ensure functional intent is understood, testable, and delivered as expected.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive clarity across teams, maintain consistent follow-through, and operate confidently in a decision-support role to product leadership.
  • Experience with corrections or justice-related software workflows preferred but not required.
  • Must be able and willing to travel up to 10% of the time.

ViaPath is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals and to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. In accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, ViaPath does not discriminate or permit harassment against any employee or applicant based on any characteristic protected by law. ViaPath’s commitment applies to the fullest extent required by federal, state, and local laws applicable to its contracts and operations.

Online Communications Manager

About American Rivers

American Rivers is championing a national effort to protect and restore all rivers, from remote mountain streams to urban waterways. Healthy rivers provide people and nature with clean, abundant water and natural habitat. For 50 years, American Rivers staff, supporters, and partners have shared a common belief:

Life Depends on Rivers℠.

The beauty of rivers is that they connect all people and communities – including within our organization. The life experiences, knowledge, innovation, and talent that different people bring to our work provides perspectives, experiences, and competencies which are critical to our effectiveness in protecting wild rivers, restoring damaged rivers, and conserving clean water for people and nature.

The Digital Communications Intern will support the American Rivers Digital Team’s day-to-day communications initiatives, with a primary focus on social media and digital engagement. This internship offers hands-on experience creating content for a national environmental nonprofit, including assisting with graphics, video editing, blogs, and social media engagement across American Rivers’ digital platforms. The role is ideal for a student interested in nonprofit communications, digital storytelling, and environmental advocacy who is eager to develop professional skills in content creation, audience engagement, and multimedia communications.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Support the creation of graphics, short-form videos, and other engagement-focused digital content.
  • Assist with video editing for social media campaigns, storytelling initiatives, and organizational communications.
  • Help draft and edit blogs, captions, and other digital communications materials.
  • Monitor social media channels for comments, messages, and engagement opportunities, escalating questions or concerns as needed.
  • Support the Digital Team with analytics tracking.
  • Attend and participate in greater marketing and communications team meetings.
  • Support additional communications and digital engagement projects as assigned.
  • Assist with email and website content quality assurance, including proofreading copy and checking links, formatting, and functionality
  • Provide support around digital asset management and graphics/videos/photo organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current college student pursuing a degree, preferably in communications, marketing, digital media, earth science, environmental science/studies, public relations, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated interest in digital communications, social media, and environmental advocacy.
  • Experience with video editing software and creating short-form digital content for social media platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and digital tools such as Zoom, Slack, Sprout, WordPress, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite.

Candidates who are unsure if they meet all minimum qualifications or who have transferrable skills and experience beyond the conservation sector are encouraged to apply.

Location

Remote (United States-based).

Compensation

This unpaid internship includes a modest subsidy (up to $500/year). The role is part-time (approximately 10-15 hours per week) and runs approx. from January 11, 2027 – May 7, 2027
with an opportunity to start earlier and end later if applicable.

💼 Operations Manager
🌎 Open to Latin America: This role is open to candidates based in Latin America.
