About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing consumer goods brand with distribution across DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail. US production, inventory, fulfilment, and logistics run through an outsourced 3PL and co-manufacturing partner, with an Australia-based team and a US Operations Director overseeing the overall plan.

About the Role

We're looking for an Operations Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of US production, inventory, fulfilment, and logistics through the 3PL and co-manufacturing partners. You'll set daily priorities, hold partners accountable to their commitments, resolve operational issues end to end, and give the Operations Director accurate reporting and practical recommendations.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You are not coordinating from a distance: you're the main day-to-day point of accountability for the 3PL and co-manufacturer relationships, multi-channel fulfilment, inventory accuracy, and financial controls.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day relationship with the 3PL and co-manufacturer, aligning priorities, confirming commitments and deadlines, and holding partners accountable for delivery
  • Report on dispatches, aged orders, production, stock, and risks, including sales run rates against forecasts with variances flagged
  • Investigate missed commitments with evidence, drive recovery actions, and escalate capacity gaps and stockout risks before commitments are missed
  • Turn the approved production plan into agreed daily and weekly schedules, tracking actual units by SKU and component availability
  • Keep production jobs, purchase orders, receipts, and records accurate in Cin7, and document and resolve quality complaints with corrective actions
  • Manage DTC, wholesale, Faire, Amazon, and retail fulfilment, keeping PO versions, routing, BOL, ASN, and EDI records current
  • Resolve overdue, partial, replacement, and unscanned orders, and track domestic freight through to customer delivery
  • Coordinate stock counts and month-end reconciliations, and resolve discrepancies across Cin7, the 3PL's warehouse system, Shopify, Faire, and Amazon
  • Check 3PL, co-manufacturing, and freight charges against approved rates, document errors and losses, and give Finance accurate shipment costs and invoice follow-up
  • Improve recurring workflows to reduce manual effort and errors, document procedures, and verify AI-assisted outputs
  • Analyse fulfilment and freight costs by channel and check packaging and shipping assumptions for new products and bundles

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in fulfilment, logistics, inventory, or production, including experience managing US operations with US-based 3PLs, co-manufacturers, domestic carriers, and US retail and Amazon requirements
  • At least 2 to 3 years at manager level as the main day-to-day owner of an outsourced 3PL relationship, covering priorities, SLAs, stock accuracy, invoice checks, and partner accountability
  • At least 2 to 3 years at manager level as the main day-to-day owner of a co-manufacturer relationship, covering production scheduling, packaging, quality checks, and corrective actions
  • Evidence of independent ownership, such as a partner transition or turnaround you led, KPIs you were accountable for, disputes and credits you recovered, or escalations you brought with a recommendation
  • Confident with Cin7 or a comparable inventory system, Shopify, and 3PL warehouse management systems
  • Multi-channel fulfilment experience across DTC, wholesale, Amazon, and US retail, including routing guides, BOL, ASN, and EDI
  • Strong reconciliation and reporting skills with excellent Excel or Google Sheets
  • Clear, confident written and spoken English

Nice to Have

  • Experience in consumer products manufactured, warehoused, and shipped across multiple channels
  • Background in organic, health, or beauty consumer goods
  • Experience with month-end operations reviews and presenting KPI results and recommendations to senior leadership

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US Eastern Time business hours, plus regular calls with an Australia-based team during US late afternoon and evening

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your 3PL and co-manufacturer management experience, and walking through a specific operational problem you owned and resolved end to end with evidence

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: AI Integration & Automation Developer
jobs.excerpt: Summary The AI Integration & Automation Developer designs, builds, tests, and supports AI-enabled integrations and automation solutions that improve the efficiency, scalability, and quality of Managed Services operations.
jobs.description:
Summary


The AI Integration & Automation Developer designs, builds, tests, and supports AI-enabled integrations and automation solutions that improve the efficiency, scalability, and quality of Managed Services operations. This role is delivery-focused and hands-on, translating operational problems into practical automation and AI workflow solutions that reduce manual effort, improve service consistency, and create measurable business value.

This position requires strong critical thinking, curiosity about emerging AI automation capabilities, and the ability to evaluate where AI, orchestration, scripting, workflow automation, or traditional process improvement will drive the best outcome. The developer will work closely with technical and operational stakeholders and may receive dotted-line technical guidance from the AI Integration & Automation Engineer.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Integration & Automation Development

  • Designs, develops, and maintains AI-enabled automations, integrations, and workflow solutions supporting Managed Services.
  • Builds practical AI orchestration patterns that connect systems, data, prompts, APIs, scripts, and operational workflows.
  • Develops automation solutions that reduce manual work, improve service delivery speed, increase consistency, or create measurable cost avoidance.
  • Creates reusable components, connectors, scripts, and workflow patterns that can be leveraged across multiple use cases.
  • Supports implementation of internal AI Orchestration capabilities and related automation services as part of the Managed Services automation portfolio.

Critical Thinking & Operational Problem Solving

  • Analyzes operational pain points and determines whether AI, automation, integration, process improvement, or a combination of approaches is the best solution.
  • Identifies automation opportunities that address systemic problems, not only isolated manual tasks.
  • Balances experimentation with production stability, supportability, security, and operational readiness.
  • Uses data, outcome measures, and stakeholder feedback to validate whether automation work is creating efficiency gains or business value.

AI Automation Delivery & Support

  • Develops LLM-enabled workflows, agentic automation patterns, and AI-assisted operational processes with appropriate guardrails and fallback logic.
  • Integrates with enterprise tools, monitoring platforms, ITSM systems, cloud services, and internal applications as needed.
  • Troubleshoots automation defects, integration failures, and AI workflow issues, driving durable fixes and continuous improvement.
  • Documents solution design, configuration, support steps, ownership, and knowledge articles to reduce key-person dependency.
  • Participates in testing, UAT, release readiness, change control, and production support activities for automation solutions.

Managed Services, ITIL & Collaboration

  • Applies awareness of Managed Services delivery models, ITIL processes, and operational impact when designing automation solutions.
  • Collaborates with engineers, service owners, process owners, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and validate outcomes.
  • Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stays current on emerging AI automation development practices, AI orchestration patterns, LLM tooling, integration frameworks, and service operations trends.

General

  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through behaviors consistent with the organization's values.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical, and professional behaviors.
  • Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities


This job has no supervisory responsibilities. The role may receive dotted-line technical guidance from senior AI automation resources and may collaborate with other developers, engineers, and process owners.

Qualifications


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications


Equivalent combination accepted.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience / Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing automations, integrations, scripts, workflows, or application solutions in enterprise or services environments.
  • Hands-on experience with automation development using tools or languages such as Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, APIs, workflow platforms, or low-code/no-code automation tools.
  • Experience designing or supporting AI-enabled workflows, LLM-driven processes, AI agents, orchestration patterns, or intelligent automation solutions.
  • Understanding of prompt design, structured outputs, human-in-the-loop patterns, guardrails, fallback logic, and practical considerations for production AI use cases.
  • Experience integrating with operational platforms such as ITSM tools, monitoring/observability tools, cloud platforms, ticketing systems, knowledge bases, or internal business applications.
  • Ability to analyze business or operational processes and convert requirements into working automation solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Managed Services operations, ITIL practices, or service management processes is preferred.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is preferred.
  • Experience with data pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, event-driven workflows, or containerized environments is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and operational teams.

Certifications

  • Certifications related to AI, automation, cloud platforms, ITIL, or service management are preferred but not required.

(Examples may include Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Administrator Associate, AWS certifications, ITIL Foundation, or relevant automation/platform certifications.)

Other Skills and Abilities

  • Critical thinker with the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Curious and current on emerging AI automation development practices, orchestration frameworks, and service operations technology trends.
  • Outcome-oriented mindset focused on measurable efficiency gains, cost avoidance, quality improvement, and operational scalability.
  • Ability to operate as a hands-on developer while collaborating effectively with senior technical resources and business stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including solution design, support procedures, ownership details, release notes, and knowledge articles.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and production stability.
  • Comfortable experimenting, learning quickly, failing fast, and iterating toward durable solutions.

Physical Demands


The physical demands described here are representative of those that should be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

We value inclusion and belonging at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, marital status, age, height, weight, disability, veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal or state laws.

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build a strong sales pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting and lead qualification. You’ll connect with potential customers through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn, identify qualified opportunities, and book meetings for the sales team.

The ideal candidate is an independent, organized, and coachable sales professional who takes ownership of their outreach targets, communicates confidently with prospects, and continuously improves their approach based on results and feedback.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Identify and engage potential customers through cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach.
  • Research prospects to ensure they align with the company's ideal customer profile.
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of potential sales opportunities.
  • Prioritize daily outreach activities and follow-ups to maximize prospect engagement.

Lead Qualification & Meeting Booking

  • Conduct discovery conversations with inbound and outbound prospects to understand their needs, assess fit, and determine readiness to move forward.
  • Ask relevant questions to identify qualified opportunities and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Schedule and confirm meetings for account executives or senior sales team members.
  • Provide clear notes and context to ensure smooth handoffs to the sales team.

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Record outreach activities, update contact information, and maintain accurate CRM records.
  • Track pipeline progress, prospect responses, and follow-up requirements.
  • Ensure all interactions and next steps are documented consistently.
  • Manage daily outreach and follow-up sequences without close supervision.

Sales Messaging & Optimization

  • Test and refine outreach messages and sequences based on response rates and prospect feedback.
  • Share insights from sales conversations to help improve messaging and targeting.
  • Incorporate feedback from the sales team to strengthen outreach effectiveness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve engagement and meeting-booking rates.

Market & Prospect Research

  • Research target customer profiles, industry trends, and the competitive landscape.
  • Use relevant prospect insights to personalize outreach and make conversations more meaningful.
  • Develop a clear understanding of the target market to support effective prospect qualification.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in sales development, business development, or outbound prospecting.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding outreach activity and pipeline targets.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Experience with cold calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and sales pipeline management.
  • Ability to manage daily outreach volume, prioritize tasks, and work independently.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-up habits.
  • Coachable mindset and willingness to refine sales techniques based on feedback and performance.

Perfect Fit / Culture

  • You take ownership of your targets and consistently follow through on commitments.
  • You are curious about prospects, ask thoughtful questions, and can recognize when an opportunity is not a good fit.
  • You communicate proactively and flag blockers before they affect results.
  • You treat rejection as an opportunity to learn and improve.
  • You are comfortable working remotely in an independent, primarily asynchronous environment.

Typical Day

You’ll start by reviewing your prospect list and prioritizing follow-ups. Throughout the day, you’ll conduct cold calls, send personalized emails and LinkedIn messages, and research potential customers. You’ll keep CRM records updated, qualify interested prospects, and book meetings for the sales team. You may also join brief team check-ins to share prospect feedback, refine messaging, and improve outreach strategies.

  2. Client Interview

jobs.excerpt: We’re VaynerMedia!  We are a contemporary global creative and media agency built for the now.
jobs.description:
We’re VaynerMedia! We are a contemporary global creative and media agency built for the now. Born in social, our work is now full service, simply loving big ideas that connect and create real change for our clients business. We are independently owned, founded in 2009 with offices in London, Amsterdam, New York, Los Angeles, Singapore, Tokyo, Sydney, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Mexico City. We are recognized for our work in Cannes Lions, the Clios, D&AD and The Webbies to name a few.

Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it. VaynerMedia EMEA is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time – PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In EMEA, we are proudly 250+, servicing multi-brands across the region.

The PITCH.

We are creators, creative industry rogues and stars. We are not just on the internet; we are creating the stuff the internet and the world wants to see. We’re curious, hungry and passionate about what we do - and the people we do it with. We move so fast and make so much good stuff it's tough to keep up with. And we need more folks just like us, the unconventional, less-obvious, unseasoned (or over seasoned) creative pros. But above all - passionate makers and culture shakers.

Want in? We love subversive artists, obsessive makers, dedicated creators and we don’t care if you're a baby fresh to the workforce or working on your third act. What’s your hustle? Documentarian? DJ? Sports junkie? Fashionista? Blogger? Vlogger? Retired logger? Are you an Insta-fiend? An unabashed TikTokker? Or both? We’re down with all of that. Just as long as you love making and are really good at it.

Here’s where you come in…

  • Ideate and conceptualise high-engaging thinking that reflects brand's aesthetic and style guidelines; maintaining aesthetic, tone, and brand consistency across all deliverables across a variety of clients and industries
  • Manage multiple projects with varying deadlines simultaneously.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (creative, client services, and strategy) to develop the best possible creative ideas that hits all criteria (client briefs, feedback, client KPIs)
  • Write and edit copy for social content and campaigns, including, but not limited to Campaign Ideas, Campaign Manifestos, TVC & Video Scripts, Brand Identity Decks (Social Voice), Brand Manifestos
  • Consistently produce ideas and campaigns with impact on brief, on time and across any media without constant oversight
  • Collaborate cross-departmentally to develop a high variety of ideas that meets creative and strategic criteria (client briefs, feedback, client KPIs)
  • Gather learnings and insights to make relevant recommendations to keep improving and making better work.
  • Able to present with growing confidence to your team, senior clients, new biz, to agency and creative leaders
  • Mentors juniors as a proficient doer when working within our dynamic brand team structure
  • Working with Lead Creator and with support of Project management and Client partners

We treasure Personality and Experience yet we do know that these qualifications lead to what WE KNOW as a success:

  • 4-6 years professional creative experience, with a demonstrable passion for making creative content.
  • Significant advertising experience in agency or similar environments, developing and creating TTL, digital and platform specific social campaigns.
  • Impressive portfolio exemplifying previous success with proven ability to develop creative concepts, copy and design from social to TVC.
  • Advanced experience in adobe packages and able to execute, as well as conceptualize (ideation and creation)
  • Proficiency in deck creation (ideally in the Google suite) with the ability to convey ideas in the best way possible.
  • Strong passion to all things social, digital and creative, with a keen interest in new platforms, technologies and innovation across our industry and the creative landscape
  • Advanced interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with the wider team during pitches and presentations
  • A knack for picking up different editorial voices, understanding why they work, and switching between them quickly
  • Ability to produce work to a high standard quickly and professionally with attention to detail
  • Strong sense of responsibility and ownership, and a commitment to delivering best practice and value
  • Deep vocabulary, working knowledge of slang terms and colloquial expressions
  • Cool, calm and collaborative when working under pressure along with the ability to anticipate and solve problems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German

Here’s how we support you…

  • Unlimited Holiday + 1 Day Birthday Leave
  • Journey EAP - proactive and crisis support with life concierge services
  • Once you reach 2 years round the Vayner sun, you’re eligible for an annual €150 budget to spend on anything that you’re curious about
  • A flexible co-working space for any remote employees wanting to access an office space, and / or for team collaboration days
  • €200 towards a home working allowance (ADD THIS IF ROLE IS REMOTE)
  • Kick start your mental & physical fitness with 15% extra credits and €30 off a monthly membership with ClassPass.

What you SHOULD KNOW about VaynerMedia

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

We believe 100% that brands can be built on digital platforms and part of our model is built bottom up, flipping the traditional advertising model and process on its head. We don’t play to agency/industry norms and our culture and energy reflects that.

Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.description:
We Do Consulting Differently


Job Summary


The Cybersecurity Analyst supports BRG’s daily security operations across cloud, identity, email, data, and endpoint environments. The analyst monitors and investigates security events, supports security platform and policy administration, coordinates remediation, and contributes to security baselines and control improvements. The analyst works closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Network, Service Desk, Risk and Compliance, and external security partners to protect BRG resources and support a Zero Trust approach. This position does not own or administer corporate firewalls.


Key Contacts and Working Relationships

  • Partner with IT Leadership and technical teams to ensure new technologies, configurations, and changes align with BRG security standards and roadmaps.
  • Work with Infrastructure, Network, Service Desk, Expert Solutions, and Corporate Information Services teams to investigate issues and apply security controls across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Compliance on incident response, audit evidence, security awareness, and control validation.
  • Work with BRG’s managed security and technology vendors to investigate alerts, track remediation, and improve platform effectiveness.

Major Responsibilities / Job Functions

  • Monitor, triage, investigate, document, and coordinate response to security alerts, incidents, tickets, and suspicious activity across Microsoft and third-party security platforms.
  • Work with BRG’s managed security provider to investigate alerts, validate activity, track remediation, and improve alert quality and operational workflows.
  • Administer and support Microsoft security capabilities across Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft Defender, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, and Microsoft Purview within approved role and change-control boundaries.
  • Review Azure security recommendations, policies, and configuration findings; help test, document, and implement Azure Policy initiatives, security baselines, and control exceptions.
  • Support identity security operations, including Conditional Access, privileged access and PIM reviews, role lifecycle activities, stale-account cleanup, authentication controls, service accounts, guest access, and privileged-group monitoring.
  • Support Proofpoint email security, phishing-reporting workflows, Threat Response capabilities, account-takeover protections, security-awareness integrations, and email-policy tuning.
  • Use Tenable Cloud Security and related vulnerability-management capabilities to review cloud exposure, attack paths, asset coverage, security findings, and remediation status.
  • Support Netskope cloud-app and traffic-steering policies, including application discovery, policy testing, AI-application controls, exception handling, and validation of user impact.
  • Assess security risks associated with generative AI and other AI-enabled services; support AI application inventory, usage monitoring, access controls, policy testing, and governance reviews.
  • Investigate email, identity, endpoint, cloud, and application activity using available logs and evidence; escalate confirmed or potentially significant events through the incident-response process.
  • Track vulnerabilities and security recommendations, identify the appropriate technical owner, validate remediation evidence, document accepted risks or exceptions, and report status to stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain operating procedures, configuration records, support documentation, security metrics, dashboards, and evidence needed for audits and control reviews.
  • Participate in change reviews and validate that cybersecurity-owned changes include appropriate testing, implementation, rollback, communication, and post-change evidence.
  • Evaluate security tools and features, perform structured testing, document findings, and recommend practical improvements to security controls and operations.
  • Participate in periodic risk assessments, tabletop exercises, incident-response activities, cross-training, and an on-call or escalation rotation as required.

Knowledge, Skills and Behaviors

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, cloud security, identity security, security engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure security, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Policy, Conditional Access, PIM, Defender, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, and Purview.
  • Experience interpreting and applying security baselines such as Microsoft security baselines and CIS Benchmarks, including testing, exception documentation, and remediation tracking.
  • Hands-on familiarity with email security and phishing-response workflows; Proofpoint experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with cloud security posture management or CNAPP capabilities; Tenable Cloud Security experience is preferred.
  • Experience with secure web gateway, cloud access security broker, or SaaS application-control platforms; Netskope policy and traffic-steering experience is preferred.
  • General knowledge of AI security risks, including sensitive-data exposure, unapproved AI services, prompt and response monitoring limitations, application categorization, access control, and governance.
  • Understanding of common identity and authentication concepts, including MFA, passwordless authentication, OAuth, SAML, Kerberos, privileged access, and least privilege.
  • Ability to analyze alerts and logs, distinguish expected administration from suspicious activity, develop a defensible timeline, and clearly document conclusions and follow-up actions.
  • Experience working with a SOC, MDR provider, or other outsourced monitoring partner.
  • Familiarity with Windows, macOS, cloud platforms, enterprise SaaS, and hybrid identity environments.
  • Knowledge of common security and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC 2, ISO 27001/27002, HIPAA, or HITRUST.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain risk, evidence, and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Organized, curious, and able to manage multiple investigations and workstreams while maintaining accurate records and following change-management requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting security operations in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment.
  • Experience creating KQL queries, workbooks, metrics, or dashboards for security monitoring and reporting.
  • Experience testing security controls in pilot groups before broader rollout and documenting expected impact, exceptions, and rollback considerations.
  • Relevant security certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200), CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, GIAC certifications, or comparable credentials are preferred. Equivalent hands-on security operations experience will also be considered.

Salary Range: $90,000-$120,000


Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the U.S., without company sponsorship.




About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

Job Title: Director, Channel Partner Sales

About Genea

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including 401k matching, PTO, 100% paid parental leave, remote work options, and development/training opportunities.

Job Overview

Genea is creating this role to bring our enterprise security channel sales and partner organization under a single leader. The Director, Channel Partner Sales owns revenue delivered through the channel and leads a team of approximately twelve, including senior regional sales managers, regional sales managers, and sales engineers.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and serving on the go-to-market leadership team, this role sets channel strategy and builds the systems, metrics, and talent to execute it. The work is programmatic: designing repeatable motions, deepening partner relationships, and using data and AI to make the team more effective.

Because the role is new, the person in this seat will continue to define and refine how Genea sells through partners, working closely with the CEO and with real influence over company strategy.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own new business revenue delivered through the enterprise security channel, including pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and quarterly attainment.
  • Lead senior regional sales managers, regional sales managers, and sales engineers against a single channel strategy and set of priorities.
  • Recruit, enable, and grow channel partners, building the partner base into a durable and predictable source of revenue.
  • Design repeatable sales motions, including segmentation, territory design, playbooks, and stage definitions, that scale beyond individual performers.
  • Establish the metrics, dashboards, and forecast discipline the go-to-market leadership team relies on to make decisions.
  • Define how sales engineering supports the channel, from partner technical enablement through opportunity-level support.
  • Apply AI tools to research, prospecting, partner planning, and forecasting, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
  • Hire, develop, and retain sales talent; set performance expectations and coach managers and individual contributors against them.
  • Partner with marketing, product, and customer success to align messaging, pricing, and roadmap input with what partners and end customers need.
  • Represent Genea with senior stakeholders at partner firms and end customers, including at industry events.

Qualifications

Experience — Required

  • 8–10+ years in B2B sales or business development, including at least three years leading and developing sales teams.
  • Channel or partner sales experience: recruiting, enabling, and managing external partners as a durable source of revenue.
  • Demonstrated record of building repeatable, programmatic sales processes rather than relying on individual performance.
  • Experience carrying and delivering against a revenue number, with accountability for forecast accuracy.
  • Experience building or scaling a sales function, including hiring and developing employees.

Experience — Preferred

  • Selling physical security or property technology through a partner channel.
  • Leading or working alongside sales engineering in a technical, solution-based sales environment.

Technical Skills — Required

  • Proficiency with CRM and reporting tools; able to build and interpret pipeline and forecast dashboards without support.
  • Practical experience applying AI tools to go-to-market work, and judgment about where they help and where they do not.
  • Strong quantitative skills; comfortable working directly with data to diagnose performance and set targets.

Additional Skills — Required

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present credibly to executive and partner audiences.
  • Willing and able to travel for customer, partner, and industry events.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation: $200,000 annual base salary / $275,000 OTE

On-target earnings reflect base salary plus variable sales compensation.

This range reflects what Genea reasonably expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer falls within the range depends on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills, and on internal equity.

Eligibility is subject to plan terms and conditions.

jobs.description:
At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to add life to a lifetime of learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world’s leading learning company, serving customers in nearly 200 countries with digital content, assessments, qualifications, and data. For us, learning isn’t just what we do. It’s who we are.

Clinical Assessments has a long-standing reputation for gold-standard assessment solutions spanning cognition, memory, neuropsychology, behavior, occupational therapy, speech and language, early childhood, personality and academic achievement.

We are seeking an innovative Lead Specialist, Learning Scientist (Clinical) to lead research across portfolio domains, including academic achievement, speech and language, cognition, and/or early childhood assessment. The ideal candidate will combine expertise in academic or applied research with clinical experience administering, interpreting, or working directly with standardized assessments within speech-language pathology, literacy, academic achievement, and/or early childhood.

This individual will provide subject-matter expertise and research leadership, translating business strategy into clear research and product priorities. They will model positive leadership behaviors, foster a collaborative and inclusive culture, and bring a strong digital mindset, including the ability to apply AI and emerging technologies to advance research, product development, and innovation.

This position will report to the Lead Learning Scientist and can be remote or based in our San Antonio, TX, or Bloomington, MN offices.

This role aligns to industry-level titles such as Research Director, Clinical Assessment Design Manager, Clinical Assessment Manager or Clinical Research Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Learning Scientist (Research Director) provides scientific, clinical, and research leadership throughout the development and ongoing evolution of assessment products. Working across Content, Product, Psychometrics, Design, Editorial, and Digital Development, this role helps translate scientific evidence, clinical needs, customer needs, and business strategy into innovative, high-quality assessment solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and lead research plans supporting new product development, product revisions, and portfolio priorities.
  • Provide subject-matter expertise and scientific leadership in speech-language pathology, literacy, achievement, and/or early childhood assessment.
  • Help define product scope and assessment design, ensuring solutions are scientifically sound, clinically meaningful, and aligned with customer and business needs.
  • Lead and contribute to item development, review, and evaluation, applying research, clinical expertise, and assessment-development best practices.
  • Partner with psychometricians and research colleagues to review and interpret data and psychometric findings
  • Identify opportunities to responsibly apply AI and emerging technologies to assessment development, research practices, workflows, and product innovation.
  • Provide oversight of assessment materials, including digital interfaces, record forms, stimulus materials, manuals, administration and scoring resources, and visual and auditory stimuli.
  • Support product commercialization and adoption by contributing scientific and clinical expertise to training, product support resources, presentations, and other customer-facing materials.
  • Represent Pearson and contribute to its scientific leadership through conference presentations, technical papers, research publications, and other scholarly activities.
  • Maintain flexibility in work hours, as needed, to collaborate with international colleagues, approximately 10% of the time.
  • Travel approximately 10%.

ESSENTIAL BEHAVIORS

The successful candidate will be expected to provide leadership beyond their individual area of expertise and demonstrate behaviors that strengthen both the business and the broader team.

  • Think strategically: Connect research and scientific priorities to portfolio and business strategy, anticipate future needs, and identify opportunities to evolve assessment solutions.
  • Lead through influence: Build credibility as a trusted scientific and clinical expert, bring clarity to complex issues, and influence decisions across functions and levels.
  • Collaborate and build trust: Foster an inclusive, respectful, and accountable environment, seek diverse perspectives, communicate openly, and build strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Drive results and accountability: Take ownership of outcomes, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage competing priorities, and help teams move complex work forward.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement: Challenge established approaches when appropriate and explore new research methods, digital capabilities, AI, and emerging technologies that can improve products and ways of working.

EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE

  • Ph.D. in Speech-Language Pathology, Communication Sciences and Disorders, Early Childhood Development, School or Clinical Psychology, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • 5+ years professional experience in speech and language, literacy, academic achievement, school or clinical psychology, and/or early childhood.
  • Clinical experience administering, interpreting, or working directly with standardized assessments, with a strong understanding of their use in real-world clinical or educational settings.
  • Strong knowledge of test development, measurement principles, research methodology, data analysis, and psychometric principles, with the ability to apply these concepts to research and product decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate scientific and clinical evidence into strategic recommendations that balance scientific rigor, clinical relevance, customer needs, product priorities, and business objectives.
  • Strong digital fluency and curiosity, including the ability to evaluate and appropriately apply AI and emerging technologies to research, assessment development, and evolving ways of working.
  • A record of professional or scholarly contribution through activities such as conference presentations, peer-reviewed publications, technical papers, professional training, or related work.

About Arlo:

At Arlo, we're passionate about creating innovative and reliable solutions that help people protect what matters most to them. Our team is dedicated to delivering products that exceed our customers' expectations, while always pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the world of protection technology. Arlo is looking for a Senior Partner Release and Operations Engineer to make partner releases predictable, well communicated, and operationally reliable. This role combines technical release management, customer-facing coordination, escalation leadership, and hands-on development of the tools and documentation systems that support the Arlo Partner Platform. You will work across Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and external partners to turn complex release activity into a clear, repeatable operating model.

This role will work with both UK and US time zones, so preference is to be located in the Eastern Time Zone.

We recognize that no candidate meets 100% of the qualifications. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align with every requirement.

What You Will Do


Partner Release Planning and Change Management

  • Own release schedules for partner-facing APIs, events, device capabilities, integrations, and related platform changes.
  • Coordinate release readiness across engineering, QA, security, operations, product, and partner teams, making dependencies and decision points visible.
  • Define practical change-management processes covering versioning, compatibility, deprecation, partner communications, sandbox validation, and production rollout.
  • Create release notes, changelogs, readiness checklists, migration guidance, and other communications that help partners adopt changes successfully.
  • Manage partner testing and readiness activities before production deployment, including validation of sample applications, integration paths, and operational runbooks.

Escalation and Production Operations

  • Serve as a senior point of coordination for partner-impacting incidents, release blockers, and complex escalations.
  • Bring together the right technical owners, establish clear next actions, and communicate status, mitigations, and expected timelines to partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor release execution and partner-impacting platform health, escalating risks early and helping drive post-release reviews and corrective actions.
  • Identify recurring operational friction and work with engineering teams to improve reliability, observability, documentation, and support processes.

Release Tools, Documentation, and AI Enablement

  • Define and build tools, dashboards, workflows, and internal services that improve release visibility, partner readiness, and operational coordination.
  • Develop documentation and communication tooling that helps teams produce consistent, versioned, searchable partner content.
  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to release analysis, change-impact assessment, release-note generation, incident summaries, and partner communications while preserving review and approval controls.
  • Use structured data, APIs, tool calling, and auditable workflows to connect release systems, issue trackers, documentation, monitoring, and partner-facing surfaces.
  • Measure the effectiveness of release processes and tools, using partner feedback and operational data to guide continuous improvement.

Qualifications


Required

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, technical release management, platform operations, technical program management, or a closely related discipline.
  • Experience coordinating software or API releases across multiple engineering teams and external customers, partners, or developers.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, release controls, incident response, versioning, and backward compatibility.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues across APIs, cloud services, integrations, environments, and deployment workflows well enough to coordinate effective resolution.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, release notes, readiness plans, change communications, or operational runbooks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical changes and risk clearly to different audiences.
  • Experience using scripting, APIs, dashboards, workflow automation, or similar tools to reduce manual release and operations work.
  • Ability to work independently in an environment with changing priorities and multiple concurrent releases.

Preferred

  • Experience with B2B SaaS platforms, developer platforms, partner ecosystems, connected devices, or IoT integrations.
  • Experience with release dashboards, status pages, service-management systems, or deployment and observability tooling
  • Experience supporting firmware, mobile, streaming, or event-driven platform releases.
  • Experience building lightweight web applications, internal tools, or automation services.
  • Practical experience applying AI or LLM-based tools to documentation, issue triage, operational analysis, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI, REST APIs, event notifications, queues, and common integration patterns.
  • ITIL, PMP, Scrum, or other relevant training or certification.

Key Competencies

  • Partner advocacy: Keeps partner impact visible and turns partner needs into concrete internal actions.
  • Operational judgment: Recognizes release risk early and balances speed, reliability, and communication quality.
  • Technical translation: Makes complex platform behavior understandable and actionable for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Builder mindset: Improves processes by building durable tools and automation, not only by coordinating manual steps.
  • Calm escalation leadership: Creates clarity and momentum during incidents, blockers, and high-visibility releases.

jobs.description:
About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager to join our Accounting team at a fast-growing global software company. This role will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and compliant revenue recognition while helping scale the revenue accounting function through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

The Senior Revenue Accountant will own key aspects of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, serve as a technical accounting resource for complex customer arrangements under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations and other stakeholders throughout the quote-to-cash lifecycle.

This is both an operational and advisory role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting judgment with a practical business mindset, is comfortable evaluating complex and non-standard deal structures, and proactively identifies opportunities to use technology, data, automation, and AI to improve the quality, speed, and scalability of revenue accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Accounting & Technical Expertise

  • Own key components of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Evaluate executed and proposed customer contracts under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including complex and non-standard arrangements.
  • Perform technical accounting assessments involving standalone selling price (SSP), multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, material rights, early renewals, future purchase options, SLA credits, swaps, termination provisions, and other complex contract terms.
  • Prepare clear, well-supported technical accounting analyses and memos documenting significant judgments and conclusions.
  • Maintain contract review procedures and documentation to support consistent application of company revenue recognition policies.
  • Stay current on relevant U.S. GAAP, IFRS, FASB, SEC, and financial reporting developments and assess their impact on company policies and practices.

Revenue Close & Financial Reporting

  • Prepare and/or review revenue-related journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations and fluctuation analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled accounts receivable, and other revenue-related accounts.
  • Investigate unusual trends, discrepancies, and accounting issues and drive timely resolution.
  • Develop and monitor relevant revenue accounting KPIs to improve visibility into process performance, data quality, and close execution.
  • Support management reporting, financial statement preparation, and ad hoc revenue analyses as required.

Systems, Automation & AI

  • Manage and review revenue accounting activities within NetSuite ARM or similar revenue recognition systems, including sales order approval, revenue arrangements, allocation and schedule adjustments, order activation, and revenue schedule maintenance.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive work across the revenue accounting and quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  • Design, prototype, implement, or help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, scalability, analytical capability, and control.
  • Apply a clean-sheet mindset to existing processes, challenging legacy workflows and identifying opportunities to simplify or redesign them using generative AI, advanced automation.
  • Leverage automation to enhance areas such as contract review, reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, large-dataset analysis, audit support, and management reporting.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

  • Partner proactively with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A, Product, Engineering, and IT to evaluate the accounting implications of proposed transactions.
  • Provide accounting guidance before deal execution to help the business structure arrangements in a manner that supports commercial objectives while maintaining accounting compliance.
  • Advise on the revenue implications of new products, pricing models, go-to-market initiatives, and changes to commercial practices.
  • Translate complex accounting conclusions into clear, actionable guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.
  • Identify and resolve contract, system, or process discrepancies and escalate significant matters to revenue accounting leadership as appropriate.
  • Consider global implications of accounting conclusions and process changes and support consistent policies and practices across regions.

Controls, Audit & Process Excellence

  • Maintain high-quality, audit-ready documentation supporting revenue accounting judgments, reconciliations, and controls.
  • Own or support key revenue-related internal controls and update control procedures as systems, business processes, products, and policies evolve.
  • Perform risk assessments associated with revenue process and system changes and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
  • Coordinate with internal and external auditors during interim and annual audits, including preparation and ownership of PBC schedules and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Lead or participate in high-impact revenue accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA or equivalent preferred.
  • Approximately 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful experience in revenue accounting; Big Four or other public accounting experience is preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606, including demonstrated experience evaluating complex customer contracts and revenue recognition judgments.
  • Experience with SaaS, software, subscription, or other recurring revenue business models, including multi-element or multiple-performance-obligation arrangements.
  • Experience with ERP, billing, and revenue recognition systems; experience with NetSuite and NetSuite ARM is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to own revenue close activities and deliver accurate results under tight monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical accounting matters effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-functional initiatives with limited supervision.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

Bring strong technical judgment to complex revenue recognition matters.

  • Execute a high-quality, timely, and increasingly automated revenue close.
  • Become a trusted advisor to commercial and finance stakeholders on complex transactions and new business models.
  • Reduce manual work and improve scalability through thoughtful use of systems, automation, data, and AI.
  • Strengthen revenue accounting documentation, controls, and audit readiness as the company grows.
  • Take ownership, move with urgency, operate effectively through ambiguity, and continuously raise the standard for the revenue accounting function.

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.
  • Reaching the right decision makers through relationships, referrals, events, and outbound.
  • Partner conversations from first outreach through pitch, deal negotiation, contracting, and launch.
  • A clear read on each partner's growth goals, economics, products, and target customers.

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: you're learning the book side by side with the Head of Partnerships and running operations on the partners you'll own.
  • By about day 120: you run your partners independently.
  • By month 6: you're directing internal traffic and connecting partner activity to media opportunity.
  • Year one: larger budgets and stronger economics across existing partners, new banks and investing advertisers live, and the Head of Partnerships focused on our largest, most strategic deals.

THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT SEAT IF YOU

  • Want to hunt, close, and hand the account to someone else.
  • Want someone else to own the operations.
  • Need a playbook handed to you before you move.
  • Would rather service an account than grow it.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

Why Join Planview?

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn,Instagram, and X.


The Opportunity

Planview is looking for a Business Development Representative to join our Sales Development team. This is the fully qualified, experienced BDR role at Planview: you will drive net-new pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts, using firmographic and intent data to identify the right personas and buying groups. You'll execute high-volume, phone-first outreach supported by email and LinkedIn, conduct discovery conversations to assess fit and buying stage, and convert qualified conversations into Sales Qualified Leads that meet Account Executive acceptance criteria. You'll make informed decisions with input from management on projects that are often complex and not clearly defined, build cross-functional relationships with Marketing, Sales Ops, and RevOps, and use AI-powered sales intelligence to continuously sharpen your targeting, personalization, and outbound efficiency.


What You'll Do

  • Drive net-new pipeline creation across new-logo enterprise accounts through proactive, outbound prospecting.

  • Identify and engage target personas and buying groups using firmographic data, account context, and sales intelligence tools.

  • Execute high-volume, phone-first outbound outreach, supported by email and LinkedIn messaging, to generate qualified conversations.

  • Use AI to build dynamic prospecting lists and personalize outbound messaging with AI-driven content suggestions and templates.

  • Conduct discovery conversations to assess business challenges, solution fit, buying stage, timeline, and stakeholder involvement.

  • Convert qualified outbound conversations into Sales Qualified Leads that meet Account Executive acceptance criteria.

  • Monitor AI-driven dashboards to prioritize accounts based on response likelihood and engagement signals.

  • Build and manage outbound sequences and cadences, partnering with Account Executives on account planning and handoff.

  • Capture all prospecting activity, qualification details, and outcomes in Salesforce and Outreach with accurate notes and dispositions.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Ops, and RevOps to share feedback on messaging, personas, and objection trends, and contribute to continuous improvement of outbound workflows.


What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in outbound sales development, prospecting, or a similar new-business role, ideally in SaaS or B2B technology.

  • Proven track record of generating qualified pipeline through high-volume outbound prospecting (calls, email, LinkedIn).

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to translate complex product capabilities into compelling business value for prospects.

  • Experience using CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach) and comfort adopting AI-powered prospecting and intelligence tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational and time-management abilities.

  • Self-motivated and resilient, with a demonstrated ability to prioritize work independently and exercise good judgment on complex, evolving projects.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


Benefits at Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

  • Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
  • Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
  • Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
  • Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
  • Employee Referral bonus program.
  • Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
  • Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!


AI Use in Recruitment

Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. OZ - Principal Consultant - Databricks

We believe work should be innately rewarding and a team-building venture. Working with our teammates and clients should be an enjoyable journey where we can learn, grow as professionals, and achieve amazing results. Our core values revolve around this philosophy. What We're Looking For:

We're seeking a highly experienced Principal Consultant - Databricks to serve as the senior technical authority for complex enterprise data-platform engagements. The ideal candidate combines deep Azure Databricks and Lakehouse expertise with strong consulting, architecture, delivery leadership, and executive communication skills.

Position Overview:

As a Principal Consultant - Databricks, you will own the technical vision, target-state architecture, standards, and roadmaps for Azure Databricks engagements from discovery through production delivery. You will shape secure, scalable Lakehouse solutions, guide multidisciplinary teams, support pre-sales and delivery planning, and ensure that platform decisions align with customer outcomes, operational requirements, security, performance, reliability, and cost goals. This is a remote U.S.-based role working primarily in the Eastern Time Zone.

  • Lead Discovery and Architecture Workshops: Translate business priorities, security needs, operational constraints, and success measures into actionable solution designs.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to work in a fast-growing market, surrounded by talented, motivated, and global colleagues who thrive on helping clients meet their most pressing business goals, we are the company for you. If you’re driven, passionate, and want to be a ’key player’ in a company’s growth, we invite you to make a difference with a company that its employees define. We want you to be bold, take risks, and imagine a better way to work. We should talk if we just described you!

About Us:

With more than 25 years of experience, OZ brings trusted, deep expertise in Azure Cloud Solutions, Power Apps Application Development, Intelligent Automation, Enterprise Application Integration, Azure Data Strategy, and Artificial Intelligence to deliver rapid, effective results.

As a Microsoft Partner, our teams act as trusted advisors, combining technical depth with strong business acumen to solve complex challenges and drive measurable results.

OZ is dedicated to creating a seamless blend between work and life, offering our team the flexibility to work hybrid and/or remotely. We provide competitive pay and a well-rounded benefits package, including full health coverage, a 401K, and unlimited PTO. Our culture is built on collaboration, growth, and balance - you’ll have the tools and support you need to thrive. Join a team that truly lives its values and invests in your success.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise data and analytics consulting, including:
    • 5+ years architecting and delivering production Databricks or Lakehouse solutions

  • Demonstrated experience as the senior technical authority for complex enterprise data-platform engagements, with accountability from discovery through production delivery.
