jobs.excerpt: About KOSSAKOSSA is building a future where life outcomes are driven by talent and determination, not circumstance or gender.
jobs.description:
About KOSSA

KOSSA is building a future where life outcomes are driven by talent and determination, not circumstance or gender. We aim to level the playing field by creating opportunities in sport for youth across Africa to grow as athletes and human beings – empowered, educated, and ascendant on the global stage.

As KOSSA grows, preserving the history, development, and progression of every player becomes increasingly important. We are therefore seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented individual to become the custodian of KOSSA's player documentation and visual archive.

Overview

The Documentation, Logging & Archive Officer will be responsible for creating and maintaining KOSSA's central media and content archive.

This individual will ensure that every player within the KOSSA ecosystem has a documented history, including footage, photographs, interviews, and related content – as part of a broader archive that also covers the KOSSA project and programme: events, tournaments, the development of clubhouses, the design story of academies, community back stories, and sponsorship and marketing material.

The role combines elements of digital archiving, media management, content rating, keywording and logging, digital library and catalogue curation, and editorial and storytelling support.

The successful candidate will build and maintain a structured, searchable repository of player journeys that primarily serves storytelling, audience building, and IP value creation, which can in turn be used for scouting, player development, recruitment, marketing, fundraising, partnerships, and historical preservation.

This role is critical to ensure that KOSSA never loses the story of a player.

Core Purpose of the Role

To build and maintain a comprehensive, searchable, and continuously updated archive of every player and the KOSSA journey – and the lives, communities, and issues that journey touches.

The successful candidate will know who every player is, where they came from, what content exists about them, their development history, their performance milestones, and their progression through the KOSSA pathway. They will also know about every KOSSA tournament, event, and location that is important to the KOSSA story.

At any point in time, KOSSA should be able to retrieve the complete story of any player within minutes. Producers should be able to identify footage by theme, character, location, programme/event type, graphic and compositional characteristics, and technical specifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and log all incoming visual content, producing for each media card or piece of footage: a 10-line synopsis (location, event, scene/s, characters, and the big idea/main action); file name; drive; shot date; shot description; dialogue notes; audio notes; duration; video format; codec; camera; concept/story notes; editor’s notes; general notes; and a good/bad take rating.
  • Develop and maintain a standardized metadata framework. Tag content based on player, age group, country, clubhouse, academy, competition, position, event, date, and development stage. Ensure content can be located within minutes, even years later.
  • Review and catalogue footage from matches, training sessions, tournaments, assessments, and showcase events. Maintain references to full match footage and highlight clips, ensuring each piece is properly logged and findable within the wider content archive.
  • Build and maintain KOSSA's media and content digital asset library. Responsibilities include folder architecture design, naming conventions, version control, backup management, storage optimization, and cloud archive maintenance for media content. Ensure media archives remain secure, organized, and scalable.
  • Implement modern systems for managing media-related content. Leverage AI-powered transcription and tagging tools, and search and retrieval technologies. Continuously improve media archive efficiency and accessibility.
  • Work closely with KOSSA's media team, providing editorial and storytelling support for sponsorship presentations, player profiles, social media campaigns, investor communications, and historical projects. Identify important stories and ensure critical footage is preserved.

Candidate Requirements

Essential

The successful candidate must have exceptional organizational skills, strong process orientation, and the ability to manage large volumes of information with attention to detail. Excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities are required, along with comfort working across technology platforms and strong written communication skills.

Essential skills include the ability to write clear content synopses; the capacity to describe shots clearly and concisely; the capacity to assess and rate shots according to aesthetic, narrative, and thematic criteria; the capacity to identify and catalogue themes, characters, and locations; the capacity to identify and document emerging storylines; the capacity to maintain flawless spreadsheets and detailed, well-structured notes; and proficiency in, or the capacity to learn, digital media library and media management tools. The ability to work independently is also essential.

Preferred

Preferred candidates will have experience in media logging or production management, documentary filmmaking workflows, and managing archives or digital libraries. Familiarity with sports operations environments, Google Sheets, and AI-assisted cataloguing tools are a plus. A background in journalism, filmmaking, information management, sports administration, or archival sciences is advantageous. An interest in football and athlete development is a bonus.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate thinks systematically, notices detail others miss, and loves organizing information. They have strong visual memory, understand storytelling, and appreciate the importance of preserving history. They are excited by technology and workflow optimization and can create order from large amounts of content and data.

They are equally comfortable discussing football talent development, documentary footage, metadata structures, and archive systems.

Why This Role Matters

Many football organizations track players. Very few preserve their stories.

At KOSSA, every child represents a journey, a family, a community, and a future opportunity. This role exists to ensure that no important moment, achievement, or story is ever lost.

The Documentation, Logging & Archive Officer will become the custodian of KOSSA's institutional memory and the architect of one of the most valuable assets KOSSA will ever build: the documented history of its players.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager / Client Operations Lead (Paid Ads)
jobs.excerpt: About Us:IMPACT provides digital marketing services to help small to mid-sized businesses implement Endless Customers (formerly They Ask, You Answer), inspired by the popular book by Marcus Sheridan.
jobs.description:
About Us:

IMPACT provides digital marketing services to help small to mid-sized businesses implement Endless Customers (formerly They Ask, You Answer), inspired by the popular book by Marcus Sheridan. We empower clients to build in-house marketing operations that drive growth — eliminating reliance on outside agencies and positioning their companies as the most trusted brands in their markets.

Swell is IMPACT's paid media agency, partnering with clients to plan, build, and manage advertising programs across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms — turning paid spend into a measurable pipeline.

Why This Role Exists:

Swell runs paid media programs across a portfolio of clients. Campaigns are always in motion. Accounts are always at different stages. Someone has to hold the whole thing together. We’re looking for that someone.

This role owns Swell’s operating system end-to-end. Campaigns hit deadlines because this person makes them. Designs go to clients cleared for approval because this person catches what would have gone out otherwise. Capacity stays manageable week to week because this person grooms the sprint, not because everyone tries harder.

This is the seat that decides whether Swell scales smoothly or burns out trying.

What you'll own

Campaign lifecycle across every active account

  • Run the full ClickUp campaign workflow per account, from planning to strategy to client approval to launch.
  • Confirm receipt of campaign details and assets at kickoff; identify gaps before they become launch delays
  • Own the internal review checkpoint — assets do not go to clients until they are cleared by you

Client communication and approvals

  • Support during recurring client calls; update the agenda, capture decisions, schedule next steps
  • Manage the approval cycle: submit design direction, surface revisions, get sign-off, route final proof, confirm launch
  • Set and re-set client expectations when timelines slip — early, in writing, with the new plan attached

Sprint and team capacity

  • Groom the sprint to protect billable hours; account for each team member's typical unplanned load when planning capacity
  • Flag capacity risk before it becomes a missed deadline or a burnout signal
  • Surface friction patterns (scope creep, late assets, ambiguous briefs) and design the process change that fixes them

Process and systems

  • Maintain and extend templates: new client setup, conference backlogs, campaign details forms, design feedback checklists
  • Own ClickUp workflow integrity — stage-triggered automations, accurate status, no orphan tasks
  • Document the client communication model so it's transferable, not stored in your head

Team rituals and operations

  • Run Swell huddles; contribute to the Agency Services All-Hands
  • Onboard new team members (employees and freelancers)
  • Partner with the Ads Team Lead on team-level decisions; partner with the Director of Agency Services on cross-team operations (Web, HubSpot, and Coaching teams)

How we operate

IMPACT (Swell’s parent company) runs on EOS. You'll own a scorecard, set quarterly Rocks, run a Level 10 meeting for Swell, and work the Issues List. If that vocabulary is familiar, you'll be productive faster. If it's not, we'll teach it but you should already be the kind of operator who would have built something like it on your own.

We're also building toward an AI-forward operating model. The team uses Claude and other tools daily. You don't need to be an AI expert but you need to be the kind of person who looks at a repeatable workflow and asks where the automation belongs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years running multi-account project or operations management inside an agency, ideally paid media or digital marketing
  • Working understanding of how paid campaigns get built and launched (you don't need to run ads, you need to know what a launch readiness checklist looks like)
  • Strong ClickUp proficiency, or equivalent fluency in Asana / Basecamp / Trello with willingness to switch
  • Comfort maintaining quality and deadlines with both internal teammates and external clients
  • Track record of building or rebuilding processes (via templates, automations, documented workflows), not just executing existing ones
  • Direct, clear written communication; you can deliver a status update or a hard "no" in three sentences
  • Pattern-recognition for capacity risk — you notice when a teammate is overloaded before they say so

Bonus

  • Experience inside an EOS, Traction, or ScalingUp company
  • Familiarity with Looker Studio, Swydo, or other reporting tools
  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) inside daily ops workflows
  • Experience onboarding clients or team members into a structured operating system

Tools you'll use daily

ClickUp, Basecamp, Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Claude, Zapier, Swydo, Vidyard

What this role is not

  • Not a coordinator role. You will be expected to make decisions, not pass messages
  • Not a launching pad into ad strategy or design; those are separate seats
  • Not a 9–5 with predictable volume. Agency cadence means surge weeks and quiet weeks


Growth path

This role is positioned to expand into broader agency operations as the business grows.

Benefits

This position offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 to $115,000, based on experience.

IMPACT provides a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, vision, and dental coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and a flexible work schedule
  • Paid parental leave to support your growing family

We are committed to supporting our team members with a combination of financial rewards, work-life balance, and the flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Work Environment

At IMPACT, our culture is built on our core values of being proactive, accountable, caring, and team-oriented. We are a group of driven professionals who are passionate about growing in our careers, delivering exceptional results for our clients, and supporting one another every step of the way. Mediocrity isn't an option — we show up every day committed to being our best and getting better. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do, and we foster an environment free of egos, drama, or excuses. We're a supportive, no-nonsense team united by a shared mission: to create heroes, grow businesses, and change lives.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates anywhere in the United States. We expect a professional, distraction-free workspace equipped with strong internet, good lighting, and an environment conducive to client-facing work.

Working hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time to align with client schedules and internal team operations. We offer flexibility for independent work outside of client meetings and team rituals.

Travel is minimal but may include occasional trips to visit clients, typically no more than a few times per quarter. Additionally, travel will be required to attend IMPACT's conferences, held twice a year. These events are a great opportunity to connect with clients, colleagues, and the broader community we serve. Travel requirements will be discussed in advance, and accommodations will be provided as needed.

IMPACT is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

IMPACT provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in the hiring process and throughout employment, as required by law.

About the role

The Performance Marketing Manager drives player acquisition and retention across the Team17 portfolio by planning, executing and optimising performance marketing campaigns.

  • Launch set-up and execution – Ensure precise set-up through hands-on management and checking of campaigns delivered through agencies / partners.

  • Legal & Data Compliance – Partner with Legal and relevant teams to ensure advertising, tracking, cookies, CRM and other activity meets privacy and compliance requirements.
  • Reporting – Develop comprehensive reporting suite for internal teams and external studios. Connect campaign data, analytics and commercial performance to develop recommendations.

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience of running PC and console (mobile a bonus) campaigns across major platforms including Meta, Google, Reddit, TikTok, X, Snapchat and Amazon.
  • Videogaming ecosystem - Strong knowledge of PC/console games marketing, including endemic media, platform/stores, and the specific attribution challenges of the sector.
  • Optimisation - Advanced campaign optimisation and performance analysis skills.
  • Tools - Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, event mapping/tagging and digital analytics; Adobe Analytics desirable.

  • Privacy - Strong understanding of digital privacy and compliance requirements across advertising, tracking, cookies and CRM.

People Skills

  • Project management skills and ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Relationship and stakeholder management across internal & external partners (games studios a bonus).
  • Analytical and commercial, with the ability to turn data into recommendations.
  • Comfortable with assumptions & problem solving – accepting incomplete data, and making informed assumptions, testing hypotheses and building greater predictability over time.
  • Clear communicator, able to brief partners effectively and champion the function.
  • Adaptable and able to work across different games, audiences, budgets and campaign objectives.
  • Adept at negotiation in the media space.
  • Strong knowledge of the games market and trends.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD101016

Job Title:SOX IT Compliance Analyst [P4]

Location:Canada

Company:Autodesk

Job Type:Full-Time


Job Summary

Autodesk is seeking an experienced Compliance Analyst to lead key aspects of its Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) IT General Controls (ITGC) program. This individual contributor role combines deep technical expertise, independent judgment, and business understanding to strengthen the effectiveness, scalability, and sustainability of the IT control environment supporting financial reporting.

A successful candidate will take end-to-end ownership of significant ITGC workstreams and initiatives, including onboarding new systems into SOX scope, evaluating controls for systems within SOX scope and improving evidence collection and testing through automation. They will interpret complex technical and regulatory requirements, evaluate business and compliance risks, and recommend practical solutions with minimal supervision.

Working closely with control owners, Engineering, IT, Security, Audit & Advisory Services, and external auditors, this individual will influence technical and control decisions, drive cross-functional outcomes, and help shape the ongoing improvement of Autodesk’s SOX ITGC program. The ability to assess IT controls in financial reporting environments and communicate effectively with technical stakeholders and management is essential.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead key aspects of the SOX ITGC program, with end-to-end accountability for assigned control domains, management testing, audit readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Independently assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT controls supporting financial reporting across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on SOX ITGC requirements, evaluating complex control issues, assessing technical and business risks, and recommending risk-based improvements to strengthen SOX compliance.
  • Assess control deficiencies and their business impact, recommend risk-based remediation priorities, and partner with control owners to drive timely and sustainable resolution.
  • Partner with Engineering, IT, Security, and Audit & Advisory Services to onboard new systems into SOX scope, translating compliance requirements into effective and scalable controls and operational practices.
  • Identify and lead automation and standardization initiatives to reduce redundant activities and improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of SOX control execution, evidence collection, monitoring, testing, and documentation.
  • Lead assigned internal and external audit activities, coordinating evidence requests and testing discussions, providing technical guidance, and resolving complex audit inquiries.
  • Independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives from requirements definition and planning through execution, stakeholder adoption, and delivery of measurable outcomes.
  • Promote best practices through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, training, and mentorship of less experienced colleagues and control owners.

Minimum Qualifications

• 4–5 years of experience in SOX 404 ITGC auditing, IT assurance, security compliance, information security, or a related discipline, including substantial hands-on technical work.

• Strong understanding of SOX 404, IT general controls, financial systems audit requirements, and control design in on-premises and cloud environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently evaluate complex control issues, exercise sound judgment, and drive significant initiatives or workstreams with limited oversight.

• Experience assessing security controls, explaining requirements to technical control owners, and influencing decisions across cross-functional stakeholder groups.

• Experience with evidence collection or testing automation and evaluating the sufficiency of evidence for access management, change management, segregation of duties, and configuration management controls.

• Practical understanding of ITGC risks and controls in enterprise applications and systems supporting financial reporting.

• Strong written and verbal communication, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder management, and complex-project delivery skills.


Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or related field.

• Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CPA.

• Experience applying frameworks and standards such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS to IT control environments.

• Experience with audit and compliance platforms and tools used for control management, automated evidence collection, or continuous monitoring.

• Experience improving compliance processes, leading stakeholder adoption, or reducing duplication in SOX ITGC activities.

• Knowledge of and experience working with SAP, particularly in relation to IT general controls and financial reporting systems.

• Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

• Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.

• Collaborative and innovative work environment.

• Flexible work arrangements.

¿Te interesa?

Estamos buscando un Application Support Engineer L2 (IT Operations & Technical Triage) con una sólida capacidad analítica, experiencia en diagnóstico de incidentes y conocimientos de aplicaciones, infraestructura, bases de datos y monitoreo de servicios tecnológicos.

En este rol, serás responsable de realizar el triage técnico de incidentes, identificar causas potenciales de fallas y ejecutar procedimientos operativos para restaurar la disponibilidad de los servicios, minimizando el impacto en el negocio.

Trabajarás con herramientas de observabilidad como Datadog, bases de datos SQL, servidores Windows/Linux y plataformas de gestión de incidentes, colaborando con equipos de infraestructura, operaciones y desarrollo L3.

Buscamos un perfil orientado a la resolución de problemas, con capacidad para investigar incidentes de manera estructurada, ejecutar acciones correctivas previamente autorizadas y documentar hallazgos técnicos para facilitar la mejora continua.

Esta posición está enfocada en soporte técnico de segundo nivel, diagnóstico y operaciones de TI, sin requerir desarrollo de software.

Requirements

  • Realizar triage técnico de incidentes L2, evaluando su impacto, criticidad, prioridad y posible origen en aplicaciones, infraestructura, redes, bases de datos o componentes de seguridad.
  • Monitorear aplicaciones y servicios mediante Datadog, interpretando dashboards, métricas de infraestructura, logs, trazas APM y alertas de desempeño.
  • Identificar patrones de errores, degradaciones de rendimiento, problemas de conectividad y posibles causas de indisponibilidad de servicios.
  • Ejecutar procedimientos operativos previamente aprobados para restaurar servicios, incluyendo reinicios controlados de aplicaciones, AppPools en IIS y servicios Linux.
  • Validar el estado de servidores, certificados SSL, balanceadores de carga y componentes de infraestructura.
  • Realizar consultas SQL de diagnóstico en bases de datos relacionales como SQL Server y PostgreSQL para investigar errores, bloqueos, inconsistencias transaccionales y registros de auditoría.
  • Ejecutar scripts correctivos previamente autorizados, siguiendo procedimientos de control de cambios y seguridad.
  • Diagnosticar problemas básicos de conectividad, DNS, HTTPS, APIs REST y códigos de respuesta HTTP mediante herramientas como Postman.
  • Gestionar solicitudes relacionadas con accesos, usuarios, roles y permisos en plataformas como Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) u Okta.
  • Revisar el estado de colas de mensajería y componentes middleware para detectar fallas de procesamiento o integración.
  • Gestionar y dar seguimiento a incidentes y solicitudes mediante plataformas como Jira Service Management o InvGate, siguiendo buenas prácticas ITIL.
  • Escalar incidentes complejos a equipos L3, proporcionando evidencia técnica, logs, trazas, pruebas realizadas e hipótesis de diagnóstico.
  • Documentar hallazgos, análisis preliminares de causa raíz, procedimientos de resolución y artículos de conocimiento para mejorar los procesos de soporte y alimentar herramientas de asistencia basadas en IA.
  • Colaborar con equipos técnicos y responsables de incidentes para mantener una comunicación clara sobre el estado de los servicios y las acciones de recuperación.

About Pragma & FirstLook

Pragma & FirstLook are building the modern operating system for game development, trusted by over 2,000 game studios, including Square Enix, Sony, EA, Krafton, Scopely, Brain Jar Games, and more.

FirstLook (including creators.gg and player.gg) is the industry leading Player CRM that helps studios and publishers onboard, understand, and retain their players throughout a game's entire lifecycle - from first playtest to live operations. We've onboarded millions of players and power community growth for 2,000+ studios.

Pragma Engine is the game industry leading backend - cross-platform authentication, social, commerce, player data, matchmaking, telemetry, and more. Works as your backend or with your existing backend.

You'll be joining a deeply experienced team who have scaled some of the largest games in the world, including League of Legends and Destiny 2. Our team also brings platform experience from Google, Twitch, Amazon, and Microsoft.

We are a Series B company backed by globally renowned technology investors, including Greylock, Insight Partners, and Upfront Ventures.

Location: Remote, based in Europe or North America

Coverage: Strategic accounts across North America and Europe, with APAC support during overlapping hours

Employment: Full time

About the Role

This is a commercial role for someone who knows games and can sell custom solutions to studios and publishers. You'll learn FirstLook inside out, run the demos yourself, build the proposals, and help close and grow our biggest accounts.

As a Strategic Account Manager, you'll work with our largest and most strategic studio and publisher partners across North America and Europe. This is a hybrid role. Half of it is pre-sale: partnering with our sales team on in-depth demos, discovery, proposals, and custom solutions for strategic deals. The other half is post-sale: owning a portfolio of enterprise accounts, making sure they get real value from FirstLook, and growing those relationships through new licenses, add-ons, and campaigns.

Our enterprise customers rarely buy something off the shelf. They run white label playtests, managed creator programs, paid player acquisition campaigns, and custom setups. You'll be the person who figures out what a studio actually needs, designs a solution that fits, helps close it, and then makes sure it delivers. This is a high-ownership role on a small team, with a direct line to leadership and product.

This isn't an engineering role. Some technical comfort helps, but the core of the job is relationships, demos, proposals, and closing.

What You'll Do

Solutions & Strategic Deals

  • Partner with sales on strategic opportunities, leading in-depth demos, discovery, and solution design
  • Scope and build proposals for custom solutions, including white label playtests, managed creator programs, player acquisition campaigns, and integrations
  • Translate studio goals into practical plans with clear deliverables, timelines, and success metrics
  • Act as the product expert in deal cycles, answering complex questions and handling objections
  • Ensure a smooth handoff from sale to onboarding so nothing gets lost between the deal and delivery

Customer Success & Account Growth

  • Own relationships with a portfolio of strategic enterprise studios and publishers
  • Lead onboarding, success planning, and regular business reviews tied to measurable outcomes
  • Drive expansion through additional licenses, add-ons, and campaigns, and own renewals for your accounts
  • Identify opportunities to grow within studios and publishers, working with sales to reach new teams and titles
  • Monitor account health and usage, flag risks early, and own the follow-through
  • Bring structured customer feedback and product needs to Product and Engineering

Team & Scale

  • Help shape how we deliver custom solutions as the business grows, turning repeat work into repeatable playbooks
  • Support and backstop teammates on strategic accounts, and help support APAC accounts during overlapping hours
  • Keep account plans, opportunities, and next steps current in our CRM

Requirements

Experience

  • 6+ years in account management, solutions engineering, partnerships, or business development, ideally at a platform or SaaS company serving game studios or publishers
  • Track record of managing large, complex accounts and growing them commercially
  • Experience designing and selling custom or consultative solutions, not just standard packages
  • Experience owning commercial conversations, including proposals, pricing, renewals, and expansion

Skills

  • You can learn software deeply and demo it confidently. You don't need an engineering background.
  • Equally comfortable in a technical deep dive with a studio's engineering team and in a commercial conversation with their head of marketing or publishing
  • Organized and self-directed: you can juggle several strategic accounts and live deals at once without dropping either
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships with game studios and publishers in North America or Europe
  • Background in player acquisition, playtesting, creator or influencer programs, community platforms, payments, or e-commerce for games

Location & Logistics

Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. Being a Conga Senior Pre-Sales Architect is an exciting opportunity to help drive growth for an innovative, rapidly growing enterprise software company. Each day for a Senior Pre-Sales Architect involves a variety of technical work: leading discovery on a customer's integration and security requirements, mapping their CRM/ERP and API landscape to a Conga solution design, and building the credibility needed to support detailed architecture conversations and executive presentations alike. Technology and integration fluency. Communicator across altitudes.   • Follow our change management and system validation procedures, and keep technical documentation current

  • Git branching, pull requests, and code review; CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps)
  • Azure fundamentals — App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity
  • Secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP Top 10) and care for personal and sensitive data

· Fluent in English, written and spoken

Nice to Have

  • .NET 8 / C# — REST API development (Entity Framework or Dapper)

Freelance Talent Acquisition Specialist – EMEA

Freelance Engagement | Remote

Location: Remote, with flexibility to work across US, Latin American, and Asian time zones as required.

Engagement: Full-time freelance contract for an initial period of four months, with the possibility of extension depending on business needs. Any extension is subject to mutual agreement and is not guaranteed.

Not Your Typical Workplace…

Imagine a world without borders, where opportunities are endless. That’s the future of work, and it’s exactly what we’re building at WorkMotion!

Our remote-first team spans the globe, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage international talent through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than an Engagement

We’re looking for an experienced Freelance Talent Acquisition Specialist to support WorkMotion during an exciting period of growth.

This is an opportunity for an independent recruitment professional who enjoys taking ownership, moving quickly, and delivering results. You'll manage full-cycle recruitment across both technical and non-technical roles, helping us attract and secure exceptional talent across EMEA and other international markets.

You'll work closely with Hiring Managers, People Operations, and Department Leads, acting as a trusted recruitment partner and ensuring an efficient, consistent, and positive candidate experience.

Where You’ll Make an Impact…

  • Drive Full-Cycle Recruitment: Own end-to-end recruitment for a variety of technical roles (Engineering, Product) and non-technical roles (Sales, Operations, Marketing, and other business functions).
  • Source Exceptional Talent: Use creative sourcing strategies, AI-powered search tools, and direct outreach to identify and engage high-quality talent, including passive candidates, across international markets.
  • Deliver an Excellent Candidate Experience: Manage candidates throughout the recruitment journey, ensuring timely communication, transparency, and a positive experience.
  • Partner with Hiring Managers: Advise hiring managers on talent availability, salary benchmarks, market trends, and effective sourcing strategies.
  • Manage Recruitment Priorities: Take ownership of multiple requisitions, balance competing priorities, and maintain momentum across hiring processes.
  • Drive Recruitment Performance: Monitor recruitment data and conversion metrics, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve hiring efficiency.
  • Champion Inclusive Hiring: Promote diverse sourcing strategies and fair, consistent evaluation practices throughout the recruitment process.

What You’ll Bring…

  • 3+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, with hands-on responsibility for recruiting across both technical and non-technical roles, ideally within EMEA.
  • Proven experience managing full-cycle recruitment independently, from sourcing and screening through to offer management.
  • Strong organisation, prioritisation, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority vacancies simultaneously.
  • Practical experience using ATS platforms, ideally Workable, and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive).
  • Proficiency in AI-powered recruitment tools (e.g. ChatGPT or Claude) to enhance sourcing, productivity, and candidate communication.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence and guide hiring managers towards timely hiring decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and stakeholders across different cultures and markets.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accurate candidate records, consistent follow-up, and a well-managed recruitment process.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Bonus Points If You Bring…

  • Experience recruiting within HR-tech, SaaS, or Employer of Record (EOR) sectors.
  • Good knowledge of EMEA labour market dynamics, compensation standards, and remote-first talent markets.
  • Experience with employer branding initiatives or virtual recruitment events.

Not Your Typical Team…

You'll be working closely with our Talent Acquisition and People Operations teams, based across Germany, Spain, Italy, and Egypt.

We're a motivated, fully distributed team that believes remote doesn't mean disconnected. We value ownership, open communication, collaboration, and people who bring energy and fresh ideas to the way we work.

Why WorkMotion?

  • Global exposure: Work with an international team and recruit talent across different markets.
  • Remote working: Work remotely while supporting a globally distributed organisation.
  • Meaningful impact: Make a direct contribution to our hiring efforts during an exciting period of growth.
  • A collaborative environment: Work alongside a passionate team that values initiative, ideas, and results.

Interested?

If you're an experienced recruitment professional who enjoys working independently, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can help us find exceptional talent across borders, we'd love to hear from you.

Engagement details: Full-time freelance engagement for an initial four-month period, with potential extension subject to business needs and mutual agreement.

jobs.title: Product Analytics Lead
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: Clearwave Corporation is an innovative healthcare technology company based in Atlanta, Georgia that provides a complete patient-engagement platform for specialty practices.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Clearwave Corporation is an innovative healthcare technology company based in Atlanta, Georgia that provides a complete patient-engagement platform for specialty practices. Our solutions simplify patient experiences and help practices grow and scale in our ever-changing healthcare environment, all to create a better all-around healthcare experience. With proven ROI, Clearwave improves practice revenues, reduces staff workload, and enhances the patient experience. Through self-service scheduling and check-in, patient communication, and insurance verification, Clearwave helps practices provide a digital-first, convenient, compliant, and safe experience that patients have come to expect from healthcare providers. With 95% client retention, we understand that we’re stronger when we support our customers. Clearwave is committed to superior client onboarding and ongoing client success with an unsurpassed client-partner relationship.

About the Role

The Product Analytics Lead will be the analytical backbone for active product initiatives around Eligibility AI, Revenue Analysis and Client Outcomes. You will also support the broader Product team's move toward outcome-based measurement across Scheduling, Registration, Intake and Payments.

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare operations and data. Strong SQL and BI skills are essential, but so is a working understanding of how patients actually move through scheduling, eligibility, intake and payments — and how that journey drives revenue, staff time and patient satisfaction for our clients. We are looking for someone who can speak both languages: query the data and explain what it means for a practice's front desk, billing team and bottom line.

Clearwave's Product Management team operates under a Product Operating Model, which means every product manager is expected to lead with continuous discovery, define success metrics before building and report on business outcomes rather than just features shipped. This Data Analyst role supports turning scattered exports, portal reports and Salesforce data into the metrics, dashboards and analysis our business needs to prove value and make evidence-based prioritization calls.

Key Responsibilities

Eligibility AI

  • Analyze insurance eligibility and coverage data across the scheduling, pre-registration and visit stages of the patient journey to track active coverage rate, plan identification accuracy and eligibility flag clearance.
  • Monitor accuracy and performance of AI-driven eligibility checks (e.g., Code 42 non-response, flag resolution), and surface trends by payer, location and client.
  • Partner with the Eligibility AI product manager to define and track success metrics before development begins, and report on outcomes (clean-claim impact, staff time saved, denial reduction) after launch.

Revenue Analysis

  • Support revenue and opportunity modeling for initiatives, including attach-rate assumptions, unit economics and renewal risk analysis.
  • Pull and validate Salesforce data (strategic renewals, new-logo run-rate) feeding the opportunity model, flagging data-mapping issues before they reach leadership reporting.
  • Help quantify and track initiative adoption and revenue contribution against goals set by the product and revenue teams.

Client Outcomes Data

  • Build and maintain recurring client-facing and internal outcome reporting (usage, adoption, satisfaction, business impact) across product areas, in the spirit of the outcome-measurement goals every PM on this team is held to.
  • Consolidate exports from the Clearwave Provider Portal and other internal sources into consistent, reusable data models so reporting doesn't have to be rebuilt from scratch each cycle.
  • Help Product Managers document ROI for completed initiatives (e.g., Payment at Pre-Reg, Voice AI, Reschedule Assist) using adoption rates, transaction/revenue volume and customer satisfaction data.
  • Occasionally present outcome data directly in client business reviews or renewal conversations, alongside CS/Sales

Cross-Team Analytics Support

  • Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting that let Product Managers track their product area's P&L, feature usage and client adoption without a one-off analysis request each time.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Product, CS and leadership into clean data pulls, clear visualizations and a defensible recommendation — grounded in how the finding affects patients, staff workflow or revenue, not just the numbers themselves.
  • Maintain data quality and documentation for the metrics and definitions this team relies on, so numbers stay consistent across PMs and reporting cycles.
  • Participate in discovery and prioritization conversations to make sure decisions are grounded in usage and outcome data, not just anecdote.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

  • Eligibility AI, Revenue Analysis and Client Outcomes each have a standing set of metrics, defined with their product owners, that are tracked and reported on a regular cadence rather than assembled ad hoc.
  • Product Managers can pull adoption, usage and revenue-impact data for their product area without waiting on a custom analysis.
  • Initiatives have a documented before/after outcome story (e.g., ROI, time saved, adoption growth) built from your reporting — written so both a PM and a client's billing or front-desk lead can follow it.

Technical Environment

This role works hands-on across our modern data stack and product platform. Familiarity with the following technologies, or the ability to ramp quickly, is central to success in this position.

Data & Analytics

  • Snowflake (medallion architecture) – enterprise data platform and system of record for analytics.
  • AWS Glue and Kafka – data ingestion and pipeline infrastructure feeding the warehouse.
  • Legacy SQL Server EDW (15TB+)
  • Tableau
  • Power BI

Required Qualifications

Healthcare & Business Acumen

  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare, health-tech or another patient-facing industry, with hands-on exposure to patient engagement, eligibility, scheduling, registration or revenue cycle workflows.
  • Practical understanding of how patients move through the scheduling, eligibility, intake and payment journey, and how that journey affects collections, denials and patient satisfaction.
  • Business acumen: the ability to connect a data finding to its operational or financial impact, and explain that connection in plain language to product, revenue cycle and clinical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to present findings to non-technical, client-facing, or executive audiences (not just internal PM stakeholders)
  • Comfort working with EHR, PM System or patient-scheduling data, and familiarity with payer/provider dynamics such as eligibility, claims and denials.

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or product analyst role, ideally supporting a product or SaaS organization.
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly with relational databases or a data warehouse.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports in a BI/visualization tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau or Looker) or in spreadsheet-based tooling at scale.
  • Working knowledge of data structures, indexing, querying and data retrieval concepts.
  • Ability to turn a loosely defined business question into a structured analysis and communicate the findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate and present CRM data; Salesforce reporting experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Big Data tools and languages (Python, R, Go or Spark) for data cleaning and analysis at scale.
  • Exposure to product analytics concepts (adoption funnels, cohort analysis, activation/retention metrics) and to empowered product-team operating models.
  • Exposure to streaming and batch data pipeline tooling (Kafka, AWS Glue or similar) and to large-scale transactional datasets (millions of records per day).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-driven analytics – evaluating model or rules-engine output (e.g., Drools), monitoring accuracy and drift, and translating AI performance into business metrics.
  • Experience supporting a platform migration (e.g., SQL Server to Snowflake, Power BI to Tableau) while maintaining reporting continuity.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to own Tailscale's Identity ecosystem — the bridge between our "Zero Trust" networking philosophy and the existing identity infrastructure our customers already rely on. Identity is the foundation of access control in Tailscale; if a user cannot authenticate or authorize correctly, the network cannot be secure. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex security protocols (OIDC, SAML, SCIM) and a seamless, "it just works" user experience.

The Identity portfolio covers the end-to-end lifecycle of a user and device within the tailnet:

  • Authentication: Integrating with external Identity Providers (IdPs) so users can log in using the credentials they already have (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.).
  • Authorization: Defining how roles, groups, and attributes translate into granular network access policies.
  • Lifecycle Management: Automating the onboarding, offboarding, and synchronization (SCIM) of users and devices as they change roles or leave organizations.

These capabilities are where Tailscale meets the customer's existing security stack. Nearly every enterprise deployment begins with an identity integration, grows through complex multi-IdP setups, and increasingly depends on automated lifecycle management for production security.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Tailscale's Identity portfolio: workload and agent identity, SSO integrations, Directory Sync (SCIM), access controls and policy, user management.
  • Own the operator experience for admins: How IT and security teams configure identity providers, audit authentication events, and manage user, workload, and agent access policies at scale, across the admin console, API, and clients.
  • Build a best-in-class authentication experience for end-users: Save our users time and money by making every auth flow fast, secure, and intuitive.
  • Partner closely across engineering, product, and design org to ensure Tailscale’s identity service meets the needs of the broader organization and integrates tightly with other platform components.
  • Build systematic customer insight across the full spread of Tailscale users, from a homelab operator exposing a media server through Funnel to a regulated enterprise routing traffic across multi-region datacenters.
  • Turn customer signal, support patterns, cross-product requests, and competitive dynamics into roadmap priorities

What We Are Looking For

  • 4–7 years in product management, with direct ownership of an identity product or platform.
  • Strong technical fluency in identity protocols: Comfortable engaging engineers as a peer on OIDC, SAML, SCIM, WebAuthn, and OAuth flows.
  • Experience shipping products for developer or security-focused audiences: You understand the friction points of modern IAM and know how to build tools that admins and developers actually enjoy using.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end: Strategy, roadmap, execution, and the customer relationships that keep you honest.
  • Operational mindset: You understand that for an identity product, downtime or misconfiguration isn't just a bug—it’s a security event.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Tailscale at work or home.
  • Background working with specific Identity Providers (Okta, Azure Entra ID/Active Directory, Google Workspace) or Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) architectures.
  • Experience with cloud-native identity concepts: service mesh, workload identity federation
  • Public technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions in the security or identity space.

Head of Engineering

System Crew Group

United Kingdom, Florida, North Carolina or South Carolina. Full-time, remote with regular travel.

About System Crew

System Crew is a managed IT services group operating from eight countries across North, Central and South America, the Caribbean and Europe: the United States, Costa Rica, Brazil, the British Virgin Islands, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland and Poland. Its own engineers work alongside a network of specialist contractors, associates and delivery partners, and the group holds partner status with around 40 technology vendors. System Crew designs, builds and runs IT infrastructure for organisations with demanding requirements and supports client operations in more than 70 locations worldwide. Clients include international organisations, government bodies, global logistics and supply chain companies and regulated financial services firms, with work delivered across the Americas and Europe. Recent work includes complete IT separations of business units from their former parent companies, new-site build-outs and long-term managed service contracts. The group is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001.

The Role

The Group Head of Engineering leads the group’s engineering function: in-house engineers and specialist contractors who deliver projects, run client environments and staff the service desk, spread across seven hours of time difference from Central Europe to Central America. The role carries full responsibility for how engineering work is planned, delegated, delivered and documented, and for raising the technical standard of the team.

The group is growing, and the role is expected to build an engineering organisation that scales with it: one that delivers on time, runs on clear ownership, and uses AI and automation as a normal part of daily work. The role reports to the Group Managing Director and works closely with sales and pre-sales on solution design and bids. The role suits someone who genuinely enjoys infrastructure engineering, keeps up with technology out of interest, is still comfortable opening a console to understand a problem, and takes pride in environments that run quietly and well.

Responsibilities

Leadership and management

  • Lead, organise and develop the engineering team across all locations, with clear ownership, delegation and accountability for every project and client environment.
  • Plan resourcing and workload so that projects and client commitments are delivered on time, and report progress, risks and slippage early and honestly.
  • Run a working rhythm suited to a distributed team: clean handovers across time zones, written documentation as the default, regular one-to-ones and team reviews.
  • Hire, onboard and develop engineers in several countries, manage performance, and build a layer of team leads who can run work without constant escalation.
  • Travel to team locations and client sites as needed, including the United States, Costa Rica, Brazil, the British Virgin Islands, the United Kingdom, Germany and Switzerland.

Engineering and service delivery

  • Set and enforce engineering standards: reference architectures, build standards, change and release management, patching, backup and recovery testing, and security baselines.
  • Act as the senior technical authority and final escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
  • Lead the technical delivery of transformation projects, including IT separations (carve-outs), data centre and cloud migrations, and new-site build-outs.
  • Own service quality against SLAs for the service desk and managed services.
  • Own the engineering side of the group’s management systems and their audits, currently ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001.

AI and automation

  • Use AI assistants and agents daily for scripting, automation, documentation, troubleshooting and analysis, and make this the normal way the team works.
  • Replace repetitive manual work with automation and measure the effect on delivery time and margin.
  • Set rules for AI use that keep client data protected and consistent with ISO/IEC 27001 and client contracts.

Partners, clients and commercial

  • Own the technical side of vendor partnerships, including the certification plan that keeps the group qualified for Microsoft Solutions Partner designations and other vendor programmes.
  • Support pre-sales and tender work with solution designs, effort estimates and technical responses.
  • Serve as senior technical contact for key clients, including regulated financial services firms and public-sector bodies.
  • Keep engineering effort within budget and contribute to service pricing and margins.

Requirements

  • At least 10 years in IT infrastructure and systems engineering, including substantial time at a managed service provider or in a complex multi-site environment.
  • A track record of leading engineering teams spread across countries and time zones, and of delivering projects on time through delegation rather than by doing the work personally.
  • Deep expertise in the Microsoft platform (Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server), backed by current Microsoft role-based certifications at Associate level or above. Azure Solutions Architect Expert is expected within the first year if not already held.
  • Broad, vendor-neutral command of the rest of the infrastructure stack: virtualisation, backup and recovery, virtual desktops, identity and endpoint security. Working knowledge of networking is sufficient.
  • Regular, practical use of AI tools in engineering work.
  • Full professional fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Resident in the United Kingdom, Florida, North Carolina or South Carolina, with existing right to work there.

Advantages

  • 15 years or more of experience.
  • Spanish language skills.
  • Experience in regulated environments, especially financial services.
  • Experience with IT separations (carve-outs) and data centre or cloud migrations.
  • Experience working within ITIL practice and ISO/IEC 27001 or ISO 9001 management systems.
  • Further certifications in cloud, virtualisation, backup or security from any major vendor.

Terms

  • Full-time, permanent. Remote, with regular travel.
  • Competitive salary and generous annual performance bonus, plus funded certifications and training.

If you'relooking to take your career to the next level and thrive in a dynamic, customer-centric organization, apply today and join the System Crew team.

Cloud and Kubernetes Security

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive

  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Lead Developer to take technical ownership of the engineering delivery of an enterprise Sitecore-to-Contentful migration, covering both content and application migration.

You will lead the development team, establish engineering standards and ensure successful delivery of a scalable, maintainable Contentful-based solution.

Ideally you are also an AI-first technical leader who can embed AI-native and spec-driven development practices into everyday engineering, using emerging tooling to improve delivery efficiency while maintaining technical quality, security and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Migration Delivery

  • Lead the technical implementation of the Sitecore-to-Contentful migration across content, applications and integrations.
  • Work with architects to shape migration options, Contentful implementation patterns and technical decisions.
  • Guide the migration and modernisation of existing applications, including React frontends and supporting services.
  • Define approaches for content modelling, transformation, migration automation and validation.
  • Coordinate engineering activities, resolve complex technical challenges and manage dependencies and delivery risks.
  • Remain hands-on where required, particularly for complex implementation, technical spikes and critical problem-solving.

AI-First Engineering Leadership

  • Champion an AI-first engineering mindset, encouraging the team to proactively use AI to improve software delivery.
  • Establish practical spec-driven development approaches, ensuring clear, testable specifications guide implementation and validation.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI to Sitecore analysis, content mapping, migration automation, code modernisation and testing.
  • Guide developers in the effective use of AI coding assistants and automated engineering workflows.
  • Establish appropriate review, security and quality practices for AI-generated code and migration outputs.
  • Drive experimentation, knowledge sharing and measurable improvements in team productivity through AI adoption.

Engineering Quality and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Own engineering quality, implementation consistency and technical delivery outcomes.
  • Establish standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, migration validation and release readiness.
  • Lead technical planning for migration, cutover, rollback and post-migration support.
  • Provide technical direction, mentoring and coaching to developers.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Significant engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex digital platform deliveries.
  • Proven experience with enterprise CMS migrations, replatforming or major headless CMS implementations.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Contentful, Sitecore and associated migration and integration challenges.
  • Strong understanding of React, TypeScript, API-driven architectures and application modernisation.
  • Experience leading engineering teams, making technical decisions and assuring delivery quality.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development and the ability to drive adoption of AI-native, spec-driven engineering practices.
  • Strong knowledge of automated testing, CI/CD, release processes and technical risk management.
  • Strong stakeholder communication, consultancy and technical leadership skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Previous technical leadership of a Sitecore-to-Contentful migration.
  • Experience with Next.js, Sitecore JSS and composable architecture.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate complex migrations, legacy application modernisation or engineering workflows.
  • Experience with multilingual, multisite or enterprise content platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successfully leads delivery of the Contentful migration across content and applications.
  • Establishes clear technical direction, engineering standards and accountability within the team.
  • Embeds AI-native development practices that demonstrably improve delivery efficiency and quality.
  • Proactively manages technical risks and builds confidence with stakeholders.
  • Develops team capability through technical leadership, coaching and continuous improvement.

C5 Expectation: A technical leader accountable for engineering delivery, technical quality and team effectiveness, working closely with Architects while driving implementation and technical decisions across the development team.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

jobs.description:
Event Operations Coordinator – Events, Logistics & Scheduling | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Central Standard Time (CST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Event Operations Coordinator to manage event logistics, field team scheduling, travel coordination, expenses, and day-to-day operations across multiple active event campaigns.

This is not a basic administrative or assistant role. You’ll take ownership of the operational details required to move events from planning through execution, ensuring representatives, venues, schedules, travel, equipment, expenses, and deadlines remain coordinated.

You’ll serve as a central point of operational coordination, making sure teams have the right information, resources, and coverage before each event.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, can manage multiple events simultaneously, and stay organized when plans change, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Event & Logistics Coordination

  • Manage the event pipeline across multiple active campaigns
  • Coordinate events from initial planning through execution
  • Source, negotiate, and confirm event logistics
  • Coordinate:
    • Booth requirements
    • Load-in and load-out schedules
    • Equipment
    • Venue requirements
    • On-site logistics
  • Communicate event details clearly to field representatives and internal stakeholders
  • Track event deadlines, requirements, and dependencies
  • Proactively identify and resolve logistical issues
  • Ensure teams have the information and resources needed before each event
  • Maintain clear visibility into the status of upcoming and active events

Scheduling & Field Team Coordination

  • Build and maintain representative schedules using Sling or similar scheduling tools
  • Collect and track representative availability
  • Publish and manage weekly schedules across campaigns
  • Handle:
    • Schedule changes
    • Coverage needs
    • Conflicts
    • Last-minute adjustments
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for field representatives regarding scheduling and logistics
  • Coordinate closely with leadership to maintain appropriate operational coverage
  • Ensure representatives receive accurate event details and schedule updates on time

Travel & Expense Management

  • Coordinate travel arrangements for field representatives
  • Manage:
    • Flights
    • Hotels
    • Ground transportation
    • Travel itineraries
  • Track event and travel-related expenses
  • Maintain organized receipts and supporting documentation
  • Reconcile expenses accurately
  • Monitor spending against established budgets
  • Flag potential budget issues before they escalate
  • Ensure travel information is clearly communicated to representatives

Reporting & Operational Support

  • Prepare weekly operations and performance reports
  • Maintain accurate trackers for:
    • Upcoming events
    • Event status
    • Representative schedules
    • Travel
    • Expenses
    • Operational deadlines
  • Keep event documentation organized and current
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into active campaigns
  • Track outstanding action items through completion
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and other operational initiatives when required

Requirements

  • Previous experience in:
    • Event Coordination
    • Logistics Coordination
    • Operations
    • Scheduling
    • Administrative Operations Support
  • Experience managing multiple events, schedules, or operational workflows simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, including:
    • Google Sheets
    • Google Docs
    • Google Drive
    • Google Calendar
    • Gmail
  • Ability to work during U.S. CST business hours
  • Comfortable operating under tight deadlines and changing priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Ability to independently coordinate multiple stakeholders and operational priorities
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Sling, TravelPerk, or similar scheduling and travel platforms
  • Experience supporting field sales representatives or event-based teams
  • Experience coordinating booths, venues, or event equipment
  • Experience tracking operational expenses and budgets
  • Startup or high-growth company experience
  • Experience supporting multiple simultaneous event campaigns

Tools & Technology

Google Workspace | Google Sheets | Google Docs | Google Drive | Google Calendar | Gmail | Sling | TravelPerk | Scheduling Tools | Travel Management Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and rarely let details fall through the cracks
  • Can manage multiple events and priorities simultaneously
  • Proactively identify problems before they disrupt operations
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams and external partners
  • Remain organized when schedules or event details change unexpectedly
  • Take ownership from initial planning through final execution
  • Are comfortable being the person others rely on for accurate operational information
  • Follow up consistently without needing repeated reminders
  • Stay calm and execution-focused when last-minute changes occur

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start your day by reviewing upcoming events, checking representative coverage, and confirming venue, booth, and travel logistics.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate with field representatives, venues, and internal teams; make travel arrangements; update schedules; respond to operational questions; and manage last-minute changes.

You’ll also track expenses, maintain event documentation, monitor deadlines, and prepare updates so leadership has clear visibility into every active campaign.

In short: you keep events, people, schedules, travel, and logistics organized so campaigns execute smoothly and on time.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate and timely event coordination
  • Consistent schedule coverage across campaigns
  • On-time communication with representatives and stakeholders
  • Minimal scheduling conflicts and operational disruptions
  • Accurate travel and expense tracking
  • Events executed according to timelines and requirements
  • Clean and up-to-date operational documentation
  • Fast and reliable response to operational changes
  • Leadership visibility into event and campaign status

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across event operations and logistics
  • Direct responsibility for multiple active campaigns
  • Exposure to scheduling, travel, budgeting, and field operations
  • Fast-paced environment with measurable operational impact
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Event Operations Management
    • Operations Management
    • Field Operations
    • Project Coordination

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Final Interview with Client
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, thrive in fast-moving environments, and know how to keep events, schedules, travel, logistics, and people coordinated without missing critical details, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of the operational details that help ensure every event campaign runs smoothly from planning through execution.

jobs.description:
Why join Nextech?

We are a leader in specialty healthcare technology solutions.
We’re committed to hiring and retaining talent, which is why we invest in our employees through competitive pay, a generous bonus structure, great healthcare, a comprehensive wellness program, and many other benefits.
If you are a software engineer, finance or accounting professional, customer support specialist, or a business development expert with a passion for healthcare technology (just to name a few), we want to hear from you.
We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics are encouraged to apply. If you are a candidate in need of assistance or an accommodation in the application process, please contact .

Job Summary

The Senior Data Engineer will be part of a six-person Data Services team supporting mission-critical healthcare applications, including real-time clinical workflows, patient data analytics, and regulatory reporting. The team has deep SQL Server expertise, and this position represents an intentional step toward expanding its capabilities in modern data engineering, lakehouse architecture, and agentic AI.

This individual will help build and enhance the enterprise lakehouse, curate the semantic layer needed to make AI-driven analytics reliable, and partner closely with Product Engineering, FP&A, and other teams that depend on accurate and accessible data. During the first year, the Senior Data Engineer is expected to drive meaningful technical debt reduction within the enterprise lakehouse, become a trusted technical partner across product roadmaps, and strengthen the capabilities of junior engineers through active mentorship.

This role is well suited for a data engineer who is energized by the intersection of lakehouse architecture and emerging agentic AI patterns and wants to develop these capabilities within a healthcare environment where data quality has meaningful consequences.

All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA, and other regulations, as appropriate.

Essential Functions:

  • In addition to working in accordance with appropriate conduct and behavioral standards, specific responsibilities of this role include:
  • Design and build robust data pipelines and lakehouse solutions using Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, PySpark, and Python.
  • Design AI-ready schemas, semantic layers, and metadata structures that allow AI agents to query data accurately and reliably.
  • Build automated validation processes for agent-generated queries.
  • Pilot agentic automation for data quality and reconciliation workflows while measuring accuracy and maintaining clear rollback plans.
  • Curate and maintain the semantic layer that grounds AI agents and reduces incorrect responses caused by ambiguous or poorly defined data.
  • Catalog and steward enterprise data assets to support internal analytics, financial planning, and product engineering needs.
  • Partner proactively with Product Engineering, FP&A, and other stakeholders to identify and understand data requirements.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues and support SQL Server and Azure SQL environments while continuing to develop operational expertise.
  • Mentor junior engineers on data engineering best practices, architecture patterns, and technical standards.
  • Contribute to data protection, security, and compliance reviews to ensure that tools and processes meet applicable standards, including HIPAA requirements where relevant.
  • Carry out additional responsibilities assigned based on business needs.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 7+ years of production experience in data engineering roles, including hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines at scale.
  • Advanced proficiency with Python and PySpark or Apache Spark in production data engineering environments.
  • Hands-on production experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable modern data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and operating lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Parquet, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience designing AI-ready schemas, semantic layers, or metadata structures with downstream AI or machine learning query patterns in mind, or experience building automated validation for programmatically generated queries.
  • Experience with agentic or automation-driven data quality workflows, such as AI-assisted reconciliation, agent-grounded semantic layers, or comparable applied solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner directly with product, analytics, finance, or business stakeholders to understand and shape data requirements proactively.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud concepts, including platform as a service, infrastructure as a service, Azure SQL, and hybrid cloud models.
  • Willingness and ability to develop deeper operational expertise within Azure SQL and SQL Server environments.
  • Meaningful experience mentoring junior or mid-level engineers on technical standards, architecture patterns, and data engineering best practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on production experience with Azure SQL, SQL Server, or Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Proficiency with T-SQL and PowerShell for automation and operational support.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or Azure Resource Manager templates.
  • Familiarity with streaming data architectures and technologies such as Azure Event Hubs or Apache Kafka.
  • Understanding of data mesh principles and distributed data ownership.
  • Experience working within healthcare or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements or healthcare data standards such as FHIR and HL7.

We are growing quickly, and we build and run a growing portfolio of internal software: custom web applications, AI-assisted operational tools, agentic workflows, and integrations with a modern Azure-based Lakehouse.
