Our software handles protected health information (PHI) and sits in workflows where accuracy and compliance are non-negotiable. We need a senior software engineer to turn that energy into well-designed, secure, maintainable applications.

About the Role

    This is a senior, hands-on software engineering role. You will design, build, ship, and maintain the internal applications and services that Mosaic runs on, and set the engineering standards for how software gets built here.

    About 70% of the role is software development such as application architecture, building features end to end, APIs and integrations, testing, code review, and production support. The other 30% covers the data and platform work those applications depend on, such as data pipelines into our Azure Fabric Lakehouse, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and monitoring.

    We are a Microsoft shop (Azure, Fabric, SQL Server, Microsoft 365). We care more about strong engineering fundamentals than any specific language or framework, and we want to put your expertise to work.

    The role is highly cross-functional. You will work directly with the VP of Data Science, the Director of IT, and operational leaders across the business. You will also mentor internal builders who use AI-assisted development tools, helping them produce software that is safe, tested, and maintainable.

What You'll Do

    Design and build internal applications. Own internal software end to end, from requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Build web applications, services, APIs, and integrations with third-party systems such as our EHR, billing, and HR platforms.

    Set and raise the engineering bar. Establish standards for source control, branching, code review, testing, modular design, documentation, and secure coding. Lead by example through high-quality code and thoughtful pull request reviews.

    Ship AI-enabled software. Build and maintain applications and agentic workflows that use LLMs and AI services. Help internal builders using Claude Code and similar tools turn prototypes into production-grade software.

    Own production reliability. Put deployment pipelines, environment management, monitoring, alerting, and incident response in place across internal systems. Debug production issues and run blameless post-incident reviews.

    Support the data and platform layer. Build and maintain the pipelines that move application data into and out of our Azure Fabric Lakehouse. Contribute to cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, and data models that serve both applications and reporting.

    Partner with the business. Work directly with clinical, billing, credentialing, and operations leaders to turn workflow problems into well-scoped software solutions.

What We're Looking For

    Required

    • 4+ years of professional software development, building and shipping production applications
    • High proficiency in at least one modern programming language, and comfort picking up others
    • Strong software engineering fundamentals: object-oriented or functional design, modular architecture, testing (unit, integration, end to end), debugging, and Git-based workflows
    • Experience designing and building APIs, services, and web applications
    • Track record of owning software end to end, from design through production support
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
    • Experience building on a major cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP considered)
    • Solid SQL and relational database design skills
    • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar
    • Understanding of secure coding practices and of handling sensitive or regulated data
    • Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with non-technical stakeholders
    • Experience mentoring other developers or leading code review

      • Nice to Have

      • Experience in the Microsoft ecosystem: Azure, .NET, SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, or Power Platform
      • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines or working in Lakehouse or data warehouse environments
      • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or ARM)
      • Experience building applications on top of LLMs or agentic frameworks
      • Experience in healthcare, ABA, EHR/EMR, claims, or other regulated environments
      • Exposure to HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, SOC 2, or related compliance frameworks

Why This Role Matters

    This role is foundational to how Mosaic builds software over the next several years. You will shape the architecture, standards, and engineering culture behind the next generation of internal applications and AI-enabled systems. Instead of owning one narrow slice, you will set the direction for how software gets built and maintained across the company.

    Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive salary based on experience
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k)
    • PTO and paid holidays
    • Remote-first flexibility
    • Equipment and tooling support

That means tracking projects across the team, running the regular team meetings, making sure decisions turn into action, and keeping leadership informed.

This is an operations and project management role for someone with real marketing know-how. You won't set strategy or run channels. You will need to understand how campaigns, launches, webinars and events come together, so you can spot what's missing, what's late and what needs a decision.

You'll report to our Head of Marketing and work closely with campaign, content, creative, events, lifecycle and sales colleagues across our consumer and B2B businesses.

Keep the department's work moving
  • Keep a clear view of projects running at the same time across the team: their deadlines, dependencies and risks.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is building an AI/ML team inside its Operations team to make our supply chain AI native. You would be one of its first AI/ML engineers.

We design connected hardware (cameras, vehicle gateways, sensors), build it with joint development manufacturing partners, and deliver it to tens of thousands of customers in industries that keep the economy running. Every link in that chain often runs on emails, flat files and manual reconciliations. We are moving our internal operations into the future with modern AI capabilities.

We expect you to work across the supply chain including fulfillment, inventory, returns, cash, planning, components, suppliers and cost management. You will partner directly with Planning, Procurement, Fulfillment, Finance, Sales, and the hardware, firmware and quality engineering teams.

You'll design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning and statistical models that optimize our global supply chain. From forecasting demand to modeling supply risk using real-time IoT signals, you'll apply cutting-edge techniques to solve complex problems with direct business impact.

What makes this unique:

  • 11 years of untapped operational data: ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, e2open, Propel), IoT sensor streams, Salesforce, Slack, Gong call insights, and real-world hardware telemetry
  • Own the full stack: Modeling, MLOps, deployment, monitoring—build production systems that drive real business decisions
  • Real hardware supply chain: Complex multi-tier supplier networks, lead times, high-stakes NPI ramps
  • Direct executive partnership: Collaborating cross-functionally with teams in Product, Engineering, Procurement, and Finance

You'll shape the team's roadmap, scientific agenda, and modeling standards. Ideal for a deeply technical IC who thrives in ambiguity, thinks strategically, and enjoys end-to-end ownership.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US or Canada.

Why this role matters:

Real-world impact at massive scale:

  • Your models will help prevent supply shortages for customers in construction, utilities, transportation, and public safety—industries that literally keep the world running.
  • Optimize inventory for hardware deployed across 98% of US roads and 70+ billion miles driven annually.
  • Drive sustainability initiatives by reducing waste and improving supply chain efficiency across global operations.

Unique technical challenges:

  • Build demand, inventory and cost forecasting systems for highly variable, seasonal SKUs with intermittent patterns and long lead times.
  • Model supplier risk using real-time IoT telemetry, geopolitical signals, and market data—not just historical sales.
  • Design cost optimization algorithms balancing inventory carrying costs, expedite fees, and revenue risk across multiple regions.
  • Create anomaly detection systems for cellular connectivity spend and supply chain disruptions using multimodal data.

A data playground unlike any other:

  • Access to 10+ trillion data points annually from connected operations.
  • Work with ERP data, IoT sensor streams, third-party market intelligence, and operational metrics.
  • Build features from unique real-world signals—vehicle diagnostics, utilization patterns, failure modes.

You should apply if:

  • You are motivated by impact: Your work will drive smarter, faster, more sustainable supply chain decisions across Samsara's operations.
  • You combine scientific rigor with real-world pragmatism: You're skilled at navigating trade-offs between model complexity, performance, and maintainability.
  • You want to work on hard problems: You'll tackle forecasting volatility, cost optimization, anomaly detection, and more using large, noisy, high-dimensional datasets.
  • You are a self-directed leader: You identify analytical white space, set multi-quarter plans, and mentor others through influence.
  • You enjoy building models that matter: Your solutions will be deployed in production, drive decisions, and be regularly evaluated against business KPIs.
  • You seed AI/ML capabilities and enable the broader organization: You establish foundations, set standards, and empower cross-functional teams to adopt data-driven decision making.

In this role you will:

  • Define the end-to-end AI transformation roadmap for supply chain alongside the Senior Director of Supply Chain AI Transformation, aligning with company OKRs and executive stakeholders
  • Design, train, validate, and deploy ML models to production (demand forecasting, inventory optimization, supplier risk scoring, cellular spend prediction, HW cash flow), ensuring robust MLOps practices and measurable ROI
  • Build predictive models to forecast demand, inventory, lead times, and spend across Samsara's global supply network
  • Create novel features using large-scale ERP, IoT, and third-party datasets; build pipelines and ETL jobs to serve models and stakeholders
  • Deliver production-grade code that supports both batch and real-time inference with MLOps best practices
  • Act as the AI liaison to Product, Engineering, Procurement, and Finance—ensuring alignment on data requirements, integration, and change management
  • Drive enhancements to our data infrastructure and analytics platform to support real-time model training, monitoring, and inference at scale
  • Mentor junior scientists through code reviews and collaborative project work
  • Act as a key scientific voice in roadmap planning, experimentation frameworks, and modeling strategy discussions
  • Identify gaps in data, tools, and processes—and lead initiatives to close them
  • Establish governance frameworks, documentation standards, and quality controls for model development, validation, and lifecycle management
  • Partner with Ops management to drive adoption of AI tools, define new processes, and train supply chain teams on insights-driven workflows
  • Champion Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally

Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience & Education:

  • 8+ years in applied data science or ML, ideally in supply chain, operations research, logistics, or manufacturing
  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, EE, OR, or related technical field

Core ML & Technical Skills:

  • Expert in statistical modeling and ML: time series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, causal inference
  • Strong Python coding skills and fluency in SQL; proven experience developing and deploying production ML systems
  • Proficiency in MLOps practices: automated testing, CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring, performance tracking
  • Experience building real-time inference pipelines and managing GPU/TPU resources for training at scale
  • Familiar with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

Mindset & Collaboration:

  • Passion for operational excellence, cost efficiency, and scalable solutions
  • Builder mindset, with a track record of taking products or systems from 0 to 1.
  • Exceptional problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills—able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Track record of collaborating cross-functionally and driving adoption of data-driven solutions

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Deep Statistical Expertise: Able to design and validate experiments (A/B, multi-armed bandits) and apply Bayesian methods for uncertainty quantification.
  • Time-Series Mastery: Proven track record building advanced forecasting models (e.g., Prophet, LSTMs, Transformer-based) for intermittent demand and seasonal patterns.
  • Cost Optimization Mindset: Skilled in profiling ML workloads and driving down cloud/GPU spend through model compression (quantization, pruning) and serverless architectures.
  • Cross-Region Scaling: Demonstrated ability to deploy low-latency inference across multiple geographic regions with fail-over and disaster-recovery strategies.
  • Vendor & Open-Source Savvy: Experience evaluating and integrating third-party ML platforms and contributing to or leveraging relevant open-source projects.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of supply chain concepts (S&OP, IBP, safety stock, EOQ), ERP systems (SAP, NetSuite, E2DP, Propel), and inventory optimization theory. Ideal background in consumer electronics or B2B hardware manufacturing.

This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$178,640—$319,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. jobs.description:
About Namecheap

Namecheap is in the business of opening doors to online success. We make it easy for anyone to build a winning digital presence, with simple domain registration, affordable hosting, trusted security and privacy products, and an award-winning customer service team available 24/7. As proud advocates for online privacy and net neutrality, we put clients first, which is why we’re one of the web’s largest registrars, with millions of happy customers and over 35 million domains under management (and counting).

As a true technology company with a global focus, we inspire and enable innovators, entrepreneurs, and small businesses to build, grow, and succeed through exceptional products and extraordinary experiences.

Our North Star is clear: to be the most loved brand for creators, entrepreneurs, and small businesses, where value meets experience.

The Product Team

Led by our Chief Product Officer,Zeeshan Qamruddin, the Product team drives our company’s product strategy and brings together all business functions around it. This includes Technology, Growth/Marketing, Design, User Experience, Operations & Customer Support, and Cloud.

About The Challenge

As we enter an ambitious new stage of growth, we’re looking beyond our core products to find what our customers will need next. To lead this next chapter, we’re looking for a VP of Incubation Hub, reporting directly to the CPO.

In a nutshell, you’ll build and lead a new team whose job is to find, test, and develop new product opportunities for our customer base of millions, with more than 35 million domains under management. While our core teams grow and strengthen today’s products, you’ll explore what comes next.

Think of the link between owning a domain and a social media presence, commerce and payments, or AI personal agents. You’ll start with a small team of product managers, and grow it from there. Working AI-first, you’ll move quickly across product, design and technology. Success won’t be measured by how many things you launch. We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own a core part of how our clients market themselves: the websites, content, and campaigns that get them found, keep them top of mind, and turn attention into business. Our clients are real estate professionals, many of them top producers in luxury markets, and they count on us for the marketing they don't have time to do themselves.

Generating marketing content is easy now. Generating content a top agent is proud to put their name on is not. That bar, across every channel our clients use, is the game we're in. jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're hiring a Product Manager to own Tailscale's Workload Connectivity product area — making it effortless for applications, services, and infrastructure to securely connect to the resources they depend on.

Networks are increasingly made up of machines talking to machines. CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes workloads, AI agents, and cloud services all need secure connectivity, often across environments and without human intervention. Tailscale provides the building blocks for these connections. Your job is to turn them into a cohesive product experience and a standalone line of business.

You'll own the product strategy across several key areas:

  • Kubernetes operator: Making Tailscale a natural part of Kubernetes infrastructure, enabling secure connectivity to and from clusters.
  • Ephemeral workloads: Enabling CI/CD runners, containers, and automated jobs to securely connect at scale.
  • Agent connectivity: Enabling AI agents to securely connect to the tools, services, and private infrastructure they need to operate.
  • Cloud and infrastructure integrations: Making Tailscale easy to deploy and operate within the cloud platforms and infrastructure tools developers already use.
  • Workload Connectivity as a business: Defining how machine-to-machine connectivity is packaged, measured, and monetized independently of traditional user-based VPN subscriptions.

You'll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to make Tailscale the obvious choice for workload connectivity, from a developer's first integration to production deployments at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Workload Connectivity, including Kubernetes, ephemeral workloads, agent connectivity, and cloud integrations.
  • Define the end-to-end developer experience for connecting workloads, from authentication and deployment through monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Drive the Kubernetes operator roadmap and establish reference architectures and integrations for common cloud-native connectivity patterns.
  • Partner with product, engineering, operations, and go-to-market teams to develop workload connectivity pricing and packaging, driving adoption and revenue growth.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer Sênior (ML em Tempo Real)
jobs.excerpt: Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!
jobs.description:
Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!


Para compor nosso time de MLOps, buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a construção da nossaplataforma de ML em tempo real. Ela é a base para que modelos de machine learning, agentes de IA e aplicações tomem decisões em milissegundos, a partir de eventos que acabaram de acontecer em nossos produtos.


O desafio édesenhar e construir essa plataforma na AWSe entregá-la como serviço aos times de ciência de dados e de produto. Ela reúne feature store, registro de modelos, inferência em tempo real e monitoramento, para que esses times coloquem modelos em produção com autonomia.


Você vai fazer parte da estrutura de plataforma e trabalhar com os times de engenharia de software, de dados e de cloud, do desenho da arquitetura até a entrada em produção.


Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

  • Liderar o desenho da arquitetura da plataforma de ML em tempo real, avaliando alternativas e conduzindo as decisões técnicas com os times envolvidos;
  • Entregar a plataforma como serviço, com padrões, interfaces e documentação que permitam aos times de ciência de dados e de produto definir, publicar e consumir features e modelos sem depender do time de plataforma;
  • Construir e evoluir os componentes da plataforma: a feature store (online e offline, com metadados catalogados), o registro e versionamento de modelos, a inferência em tempo real e o monitoramento dos modelos em produção;
  • Garantir que as features usadas no treinamento e na inferência sejam as mesmas, com a mesma lógica em batch e em streaming, definindo os requisitos com os times de engenharia que constroem os fluxos de eventos;
  • Integrar a plataforma aos serviços de ML da AWS, com o Amazon SageMaker como base para o armazenamento de features, o registro de modelos e a inferência em tempo real;
  • Estruturar a operação da plataforma e dos modelos em produção com os times de Cloud e de Plataforma de Dados, usando infraestrutura como código, padrões e runbooks;
  • Garantir a latência, a disponibilidade e a escalabilidade da plataforma, com SLOs e observabilidade;
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, padrões e procedimentos operacionais, facilitando o crescimento do time e a evolução da stack.
  • Modelos em Tempo Real (Real-Time): Experiência em produção com modelos de machine learning em tempo real, com inferência acionada a cada evento e requisitos de baixa latência.
  • Arquitetura Self-Service:Vivência na entrega de plataforma como serviço, com padrões de arquitetura self-service, documentação e interfaces que deem autonomia aos times de ciência e produto.
  • Feature Store e Consistência de Dados:Experiência na construção de Feature Store (online e offline, com metadados catalogados) e garantia de consistência entre treinamento e inferência.
  • Registro e Monitoramento de Modelos:Prática na estruturação de registro e versionamento de modelos (Model Registry, ex.: MLflow) e monitoramento de modelos em produção.
  • Ecossistema AWS:Experiência na construção de plataformas de dados e ML na AWS, preferencialmente com Amazon SageMaker (Endpoints, Feature Store, Model Registry, Pipelines) ou serviços equivalentes.
  • Linguagens de Programação: Domínio avançado de Python e SQL para desenvolvimento de rotinas de dados e serviços de ML.
  • Engenharia de Software e IaC:Domínio de Terraform (IaC), automação de deploys via CI/CD e observabilidade em produção.

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais:

  • Produtos Financeiros e Negócio: Experiência com tomada de decisão em tempo real em produtos financeiros (como risco, crédito ou prevenção a fraudes).
  • Arquiteturas de Streaming: Entendimento da construção e consumo de fluxos de streaming (ex.: Kafka, Kinesis, CDC, AWS DMS, MSK) para dialogar com os times de engenharia.
  • Ecossistema Databricks: Vivência no ecossistema Databricks para apoiar e se comunicar com cientistas e analistas de dados.
  • Regulações do Setor Financeiro:Conhecimento das principais regulações do setor (como LGPD, normas do Banco Central/BACEN e SOX).

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Carga horária de 8h por dia (segunda a sexta-feira);
  • Contratação CLT.

jobs.title: Member Care Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT US Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Member Care Coordinator sits at the intersection of Member Experience and Clinical Operations. The role of a Member Care Coordinator is to ensure that members receive timely, coordinated, and high quality care; acting as the “glue” between the Clinical, Coaching, and Operational teams. They ensure smooth handoffs between teams, including but not limited to, tracking lab results, medication approvals, and any necessary clinical follow up to ensure members proceed through their journey seamlessly.

This is a full-time, hourly role with a hourly rate of $20-22 per hour. We are offering three different shifts:

  • 8:00am - 4:30pm ET
  • 9:30am - 6:00pm ET
  • 11:30am - 8:00pm ET

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute critical clinical administrative workflows focusing on resolving readiness barriers to accelerate members toward provider review and medication access.
  • Facilitate provider workflow efficiency by preparing clinical documents and proactively triaging member needs for specialty support.
  • Facilitate structured handoffs of critical information to Clinical and Coaching teams to ensure timely follow-up regarding changes in medication, denials, or approved exception paths.
  • Engage in cross-functional meetings and work collaboratively with others departments to improve and maintain a high level of member care.
  • Identify and formally report recurring systemic issues, submission errors, or trends that contribute to operational friction.
  • Manage the end-to-end medication access workflow with complete ownership, including the proactive gathering of relevant clinical data, coordinating with clinicians for additional necessary information, complex Prior Authorization (PA) submission, denial investigation, appeal documentation, final determination and overrides when applicable.
  • Proactively contact members via phone and secure message to request necessary information (e.g., previous prescription history, documentation) and deliver clarity regarding complex PA status changes or delays.
  • Conduct outbound calls to insurance carriers, PBMs, and pharmacies to obtain specific case statuses, track documentation, and secure approvals.
  • Ensure all communication, investigation notes, and PA statuses are accurately logged in the case management system (e.g., Zendesk, MJD) to maintain a complete and auditable member record.
  • Initiate and resolve pharmacy-level rejections (e.g., refill too soon, insurance coding errors, wrong dose dispensed) by conducting outbound calls to dispensing pharmacies and PBM help desks.
  • Troubleshoot technical or administrative insurance issues that prevent successful claims processing.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Completion of a formal medical assisting program is highly valued. Preference will be given to candidates who hold a national certification, such as Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) awarded by the AAMA or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) awarded by the AMT.
  • Familiarity with case management systems (e.g., Zendesk), Electronic Health Records (EHR), and PA/e-prescribing platforms is highly desirable.
  • 2+ years of high-volume customer service, call center, or patient advocacy experience, preferably in a healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM setting.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi-step processes where follow-up and persistence are critical to success (i.e., comfortable making multiple calls to solve a single problem).
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to handle challenging, escalated calls/messages with professionalism and empathy.

BENEFITS

At Calibrate, we’re committed to putting our team members in control of their health. In 2026, we are proudly offering the following benefits:

  • Enjoy a generous paid time off policy, including multiple paid company holidays, wellness days, and floating holidays to support your work-life blend.
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefit options to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Calibrate-funded disability and basic life insurance, ensuring peace of mind during unforeseen events.
  • Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
  • Remote-first ways of working, with the flexibility to work from any state.
  • Competitive paid parental leave program to support new parents.

OUR VALUES

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

Outcomes That Matter.

We measure success through sustained weight loss and meaningful improvements in cardiometabolic health.

Integrated Care Wins.

Obesity care requires more than medication alone. We combine clinical care, behavior change, and technology into one coordinated care model.

Relentless Improvement.

We continuously learn from outcomes, data, and our experience to refine our care model and raise the standard of obesity treatment.

Great Partners.

We strive to be easy to work with and trusted by patients, employers, clinicians, partners, and our fellow Calibraters.

Calibrate is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all team members. At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Accountant to manage accounts receivable, invoicing, payment tracking, cash flow reporting, and day-to-day financial operations.

This is a hands-on accounting role with a strong focus on Accounts Receivable (AR), QuickBooks, invoicing, collections, financial reporting, and process improvement.

You’ll be responsible for keeping financial records accurate, ensuring invoices and payments stay on track, providing leadership with clear cash flow visibility, and improving accounting workflows through better systems and automation.

This is ideal for someone who enjoys both accounting execution and improving how financial operations work.

What You’ll Own

Accounts Receivable & Invoicing

  • Prepare and issue accurate, timely client invoices

  • Monitor AR aging reports, outstanding balances, payment statuses, and collections

QuickBooks | Microsoft Excel | Google Sheets | Digital Banking Platforms | Payment Processing Systems | Automation & AI Tools

The Full-Stack Developer will design, build, and maintain the internal platforms, applications, and integrations that run Milestone One’s business. You will work in a small team alongside AI coding agents, with security, data protection, and documented testing built into how we deliver.

  • Build integrations between internal systems and third-party services (APIs, webhooks, data imports)
  • Work in GitHub: pull requests, code reviews, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and automated code and secret scanning
  • Define infrastructure as code with OpenTofu, using Managed Identity and Key Vault instead of stored secrets
  • Write automated tests with Playwright and support business users during acceptance testing
  • Use AI coding agents productively and safely, reviewing, testing, and taking ownership of all generated code
  • Follow our change management and system validation procedures, and keep technical documentation current
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to shape requirements and turn them into working solutions
  • Professional experience building web applications with React/TypeScript and a backend language such as C# / .NET (we welcome both experienced and early-career developers)
  • SQL — schema design, data modelling, and writing efficient queries
  • REST API design, authentication and authorization (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect)
  • Git branching, pull requests, and code review; CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps)
  • Azure fundamentals — App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity
  • Secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP Top 10) and care for personal and sensitive data
  • Willingness to work in a regulated environment: change control, testing evidence, audit trails, and data integrity

· Fluent in English, written and spoken

  • Infrastructure as code with OpenTofu or Terraform
  • Automated testing with Playwright or similar tools
  • Professional experience working with AI coding agents or assistants
  • Azure Functions, Static Web Apps, API Management, Front Door / WAF v2
  • Star schema / dimensional modelling (staging → dimension → fact ETL)
  • Microsoft Graph API and Microsoft 365 integration
  • Clinical trial domain knowledge (sites, studies, patients, financial events)

The Sr Director – Technology and Delivery is accountable for delivery performance, engineering and support practices, resource management, vendor execution, operational stability, and the development of high-performing technical teams.

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a mid-to-senior level Designer who thrives at the intersection of creativity, technology, and emerging AI-driven workflows. This role goes beyond traditional design execution. You’ll be working in an AI-first environment where tools accelerate output—but taste, judgment, and human insight still define great work. We need someone who understands how to leverage modern design tools like Figma and the Adobe Suite, while also embracing AI as a collaborator, not a crutch. You should bring a strong foundation in branding and visual systems, ideally with experience in tech, banking, fintech, or similarly complex industries. Your skill set spans web design, graphic design, social media, and email design—creating cohesive, high-quality experiences across touchpoints. Bonus if you’re comfortable with motion or video work. We value designers who can clearly articulate their thinking. You’re able to present your work, explain decisions, and engage in thoughtful dialogue with stakeholders. Transparency, strong communication, and a collaborative mindset are essential. At the same time, we’re not looking for someone who simply follows guidelines. You know how to push creative boundaries while respecting brand systems. You’re adaptable, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and motivated by continuous learning—especially as design evolves alongside AI. Most importantly, you care about the craft and the people behind it. You want to create meaningful, compelling work for both clients and in-house initiatives, and you bring curiosity, ownership, and a sense of pride to everything you build.

A strong remote culture requires intentional effort from everyone. jobs.description:
Summary

Wikipedia and its sister projects are among the most popular media properties in the world, visited by over 1 billion people a month across over 300 different languages. These sites generate a tremendous amount of data on how people learn and collaborate. The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a group product manager to guide the development and evolution of our data platforms, the collection of technologies we use to understand how Wikipedia works, improve its experiences, and spread free knowledge.

The group product manager is a leader in the strategic decision-making and tactical execution for the Data Engineering, Experimentation, Search, and Data Platform Site Reliability teams. This role shares leadership responsibility with the Director of Engineering for Data Platform Engineering, and works in collaboration with data analysts, researchers, and product teams building user-facing features for reading and editing Wikipedia on the web and mobile apps. This is a people management role, managing two individually-contributing product managers.

In this role, you and your group of product managers will guide the evolution of our data pipelines, data lake, experiment platform, and analytics tools. This includes ingestion, orchestration, computation, and serving data using a variety of technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Iceberg, Kubernetes, Superset, dbt, and OpenSearch. A strong candidate will have deep experience building a data platform to serve product analytics and production needs, and be technically conversant in the relevant technologies.

This position will report to the Senior Director of Product, Core Experiences.

Candidates must be available for critical meetings and synchronous work between 15:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC, and open to traveling internationally up to four times per year.

This role is accountable for:

  • Ensuring the accuracy, usefulness, reliability, and accessibility of our data products
  • Defining and setting priorities and roadmaps for Data Platform Engineering teams across four domains: data engineering, search, experimentation, and site reliability
  • Product lifecycle management of the products, services, and tools of the Data Platform Engineering teams
  • Co-developing product strategy, providing leadership, and making and facilitating sound decisions
  • Managing and developing a team of product managers
  • Partnering with user-facing product teams to use the data platform to guide product decisions and build derived-data products

Expected skills and experience include:

  • Minimum of 5 years of product management experience with data or infrastructure products
  • Experience hiring and managing product managers
  • Success delivering data and analytical products and services depended on by multiple product teams
  • Expertise in data analytics, A/B testing, search, and data architecture
  • Strong understanding of modern techniques for handling high-scale data
  • Knowledge of search technologies
  • Experience navigating privacy issues around data collection, retention, and distribution
  • Ability to work with multiple stakeholder teams to deliver results through lateral influence and collaboration

Qualities that are important to us:

  • Commitment to the mission and values of the Wikimedia Foundation
  • Effective at asynchronous communication in a distributed workplace
  • Able to navigate and make decisions in circumstances with limited, incomplete, and conflicting information
  • Focus on iterative delivery and minimum viability to provide value to customer teams
  • Effective at clear, written communication for strategy, plans, roadmaps, and decisions, for a wide range of audiences including individual contributor engineers, volunteer contributors, and department leadership

Additionally, we would love it if you have:

  • Experience with open source, open data, or open knowledge communities
  • Experience building products for multiple languages and geographies.
  • Experience with the integration of machine learning or artificial intelligence into web products.
  • Experience editing Wikipedia or with the Wikipedia, Wikidata, or Wikimedia Commons communities or other collaborative enterprises
  • Open source software development experience
  • Familiarity with MediaWiki

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$131,926 to US$206,302 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:
US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)

Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (*citizens/permanent residents only)

We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885.

jobs.title: International Recruiter – European Customer Service Roles – Gqeberha
jobs.excerpt: Same time zone as Europe.  If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
Same time zone as Europe. If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Gqeberha and across South Africa.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Investigator - Fraud Incident Management & Partner Response
jobs.excerpt: About the TeamMercury* is building a complete financial stack for startups, and Risk is how we protect our customers, Mercury, and the broader financial ecosystem.
jobs.description:
About the Team

Mercury* is building a complete financial stack for startups, and Risk is how we protect our customers, Mercury, and the broader financial ecosystem. You'll join Fraud Operations, part of the Fraud & Disputes organization. The team investigates and prevents fraud across every Mercury product, and works hand in hand with Risk Strategy, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and our bank partners. Our investigators, Fraud Enablement team, and BPO partners handle the volume. This role makes sure that when something goes wrong, or when a regulator or bank partner asks hard questions, we respond quickly, consistently, and with evidence.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Role Summary

This is a senior individual contributor role for an investigator who thrives in the hardest, least defined problems in fraud. You will own fraud incident response from detection to postmortem across first-party and third-party fraud, write the memos and responses that our partners and auditors rely on, and be the operational voice of Fraud Operations in partner-bank conversations. You will lead Fraud Operations' response to audit and regulatory observations, and you will help Mercury get ready to operate as a bank, translating what examiners and partner banks expect into the processes, evidence, and documentation our teams need every day.

You don't need to be the deepest domain expert in every fraud typology. You need to be able to hold your own in an incident, ask the right questions, bring the right people in, and turn a messy channel full of data into a clear, defensible, and actionable narrative. You'll work closely with Fraud Investigations and Enablement, Risk Strategy, Compliance, Legal, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering.

What You'll Do

Lead fraud incident management

  • Act as incident lead or operational DRI for fraud incidents across all Mercury products, including account takeover, card testing and BIN attacks, mule and ring activity, spikes in fraud behavior, and first-party fraud trends.
  • Mobilize incident response, size impact, pull the right people from Fraud Investigations, Enablement, Strategy, Product, and Engineering, and keep everyone aligned on what we know, what we don't, and who owns what.
  • Make or tee up decisions with a recommendation attached: containment, customer communication, reimbursement and credit decisions, account actions, and when to escalate.
  • Run postmortems and retros for first-party and third-party fraud incidents: root cause, control gaps, remediation owners and dates, and track statuses of each.
  • Spot patterns across incidents and turn them into durable fixes in alerts, rules, SOPs, product or tooling change requests, and training instead of one-off responses.

Write the memos and responses partners and auditors rely on

  • Draft incident and retro memos for bank partners and internal risk governance: what happened, impact, root cause, controls in place, remediation plan, and timelines.
  • Use AI tools to get from raw incident data to a strong first draft quickly, then verify every number and claim against source data before it leaves the team.
  • Prepare accurate, concise responses to partner-bank questions, suspicious activity and investigation inquiries, and requests for information.

Coordinate with bank partners

  • Be a day-to-day operational point of contact for partner-bank risk, AML, and investigations teams, working alongside Partnerships and Compliance.
  • Track open partner requests, commitments, and change-management items, and make sure Fraud Operations responds consistently and on time.
  • Bring partner feedback and expectations back to Fraud Operations, Strategy, and Product so controls and processes are built with the partner in mind.

Supportaudit and exam response for the Fraud domain

  • Be Fraud Operations support for audit and regulatory observations: validate accuracy, provide program context, push back where ratings or facts are off, and agree action plans with realistic dates and owners.
  • Keep evidence, SOPs, and decision records current so that an audit or exam never becomes a scramble.
  • Track issues through governance systems in partnership with Enablement until closure, and confirm the fix worked.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor teammates on how to escalate: bring a recommendation and the facts, not just a question.
  • Work with Enablement and QC to feed incident learnings into training, scorecards, and playbooks.
  • Partner with Strategy and Engineering on tooling and reporting that make incident response faster.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in fraud investigations, risk operations, or financial crimes at a bank, fintech, or other regulated financial services company, including hands-on investigation of both first-party and third-party fraud.
  • Experience leading or serving as a key operator in fraud incidents or similar high-severity events: sizing impact, driving cross-functional response, making decisions with incomplete information, and running the postmortem.
  • Strong writing. A track record of producing incident reports, regulatory or partner-bank memos, or audit responses that were precise, defensible, and read by executives or examiners.
  • Working knowledge of how a regulated institution runs, with direct experience working with sponsor or partner banks, regulators, examiners, or auditors.
  • Solid understanding of US payment rails and fraud typologies, such as ACH, wires, checks, cards, account takeover, mule accounts, and synthetic or first-party fraud.
  • Comfort with data: you can pull and interpret volume, loss, and rate data (SQL or dashboard tools), and explain what the numbers mean and where they could mislead.
  • Proven ability to influence people who don't report to you and to drive decisions to closure across Operations, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal.
  • Good judgment on escalation: you bring a recommendation with the facts and make the next decision easier for leaders.
  • Experience using AI and automation to synthesize evidence, draft documents, summarize incidents, and keep status reporting current.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with the sponsor-bank or bank-partner side of fraud, such as UAR/SAR support, Reg E error resolution, or card network and NACHA rules.
  • Experience with BPO or outsourced operations.
  • Familiarity with incident management tooling and practices (severity levels, incident command, written postmortems).
  • Continuous improvement or project management background.
  • Experience in a high-growth fintech environment.

Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
