About the Company

Rockstar is recruiting for a mission-driven company that is solving the affordable housing crisis by providing quality, affordable rooms to rent. They're a fast-growing marketplace platform that connects members seeking affordable housing with hosts offering rooms. They are on a trajectory to scale from $50M to $500M+ in ARR and are looking for a VP of Marketing to lead their full-funnel marketing engine.

The Role We Need

They're looking for a VP of Marketing to lead and scale their full-funnel marketing engine as they work toward growing from $50M to $500M+ in ARR. This role will primarily focus on member growth, driving acquisition, activation, and engagement while supporting host growth to ensure a healthy, balanced marketplace. They need a marketing leader who can translate ambitious growth targets into measurable results, diversify their acquisition channels, and build a scalable marketing engine that supports the company's mission of solving the affordable housing crisis.

The Person We Are Looking For

They're looking for a high-slope, hands-on marketing leader who has scaled consumer or marketplace businesses through performance marketing, data-driven decision-making, and disciplined experimentation. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in paid acquisition and marketing unit economics, but also understands how organic, lifecycle, social, referral, and brand marketing work together to drive growth. They are equally comfortable setting direction, managing a team, and getting into the weeds of campaigns, dashboards, and channel performance.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

  • Full-Funnel Growth: Own the marketing strategy across awareness, consideration, engagement, and conversion, translating company growth targets into channel-level goals, budgets, forecasts, and measurable outcomes.
  • Paid Acquisition: Lead the strategy and hands-on execution of paid marketing across search, local bidding, paid social, display, video, and emerging channels, optimizing budget allocation, creative, and landing pages against CAC and payback targets.
  • Channel Diversification: Build and scale organic, SEO, content, social, referral, and brand programs that increase demand and reduce reliance on any single paid acquisition channel.
  • Lifecycle Marketing: Own email, SMS, push, and in-app marketing across the member journey, identifying conversion and engagement opportunities from lead through application, booking, move-in, and retention.
  • Growth Experimentation: Develop and execute structured marketing tests, evaluate results, scale successful programs, and quickly stop campaigns and tactics that are not delivering.
  • Performance Analytics: Own marketing KPIs, including funnel conversion, CAC, LTV, payback, channel mix, and organic growth, partnering with Data, Product, and Finance to improve measurement and capital allocation.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, develop, and scale a multidisciplinary marketing team, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and an operating rhythm that balances execution speed with quality.
  • Cross-Functional Growth: Partner with Product, Operations, Sales, Supply, and Member/Host Success to align marketing strategy with marketplace needs, improve customer experiences, and support both member and host growth.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

  • Marketing Leadership: 10+ years of consumer or marketplace marketing experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning a multi-channel marketing function and its results.
  • Paid Acquisition Expertise: Demonstrated experience scaling paid acquisition across diversified channels, including search, local bidding, paid social, display, video, and affiliate, with direct ownership of a multi-million-dollar budget and CAC and payback targets.
  • Marketplace Experience: Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, consumer subscription, or transaction-based business where demand and supply must grow together. Experience in housing, rentals, real estate, e-commerce marketplaces, or travel-based intent search is particularly valuable.
  • Growth Scaling: A track record of helping a company navigate a significant growth phase, with the ability to explain how the marketing engine, channel mix, and operating model evolved as the business scaled.
  • Data & Analytics: Strong fluency in attribution, incrementality testing, marginal CAC, LTV, payback, forecasting, and channel-level business cases. Ability to make informed decisions based on evidence while clearly identifying assumptions and risks.
  • Hands-On Execution: Experience working directly in marketing campaigns, ad platforms, creative testing, landing-page optimization, analytics, and reporting. Comfortable balancing strategic leadership with tactical execution.
  • Team Development: Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary marketing teams spanning paid, organic/content, social, lifecycle, and brand, including hiring and developing leaders as the organization grows.
  • Growth Mindset: A builder-operator mentality, strong cross-functional collaboration skills, comfort with AI tools and marketing technology, and a genuine commitment to the company's mission of helping more people find a comfortable place to call home.

The Interview Process

  1. Application Review: Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
  2. PeopleOps Call: If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  3. Chief Growth Officer Interview: If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with the Chief Growth Officer for one (1) hour.
  4. Leadership Panel Interview: If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with members of the leadership team for one (1) hour.
  5. Panel Assessment: The panel interview will require a candidate to work on an assessment where you will showcase your market launch skills to the panel for discussion.
  6. CEO Interview: If warranted, the final interview would be with the CEO.
  7. Offer: If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

$175,000 - $200,000 a year

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to the business goals. In addition to base compensation, there is potential for up to a $100,000 bonus based on performance targets.

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity
  • Healthcare: National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
  • Life Insurance: Company provided life insurance policy
  • Additional Coverage: Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
  • Time Off: Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan
  • Parental Leave: Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
  • Mission: The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

Use of AI in Hiring

The company may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. In this role, you will lead a team of two direct reports and own both sides of the business: sustaining and optimizing our current retail footprint, and executing flawless new retailer launches. You will own the retail logistics scorecard, drive cost-down strategy, and be the bridge between retail operations, our 3PL partners, and our internal Trade and Logistics teams.You will report to the Director of North Americas Logistics and work daily with Sales, Account Management, Planning, Finance, Trade Compliance, Global Logistics, and our 3PL and carrier partners.Sustaining & Launch Operations

WDG serves window and door manufacturers, flat glass fabricators, and distributors across NAM, EMEA, and APAC — and has built strong commercial momentum in all three regions. The growth agenda is clear: deepen penetration of the core install base, activate new growth vectors, and accelerate new logo acquisition across target markets.

The Demand Manager is the person who translates that growth agenda into pipeline. You own the demand strategy for WDG, partner with Growth Marketing to execute it at scale, and hold yourself accountable to the pipeline numbers that the bookings plan requires.

The Demand Manager sits inside WDG's Industry Marketing team — not inside Growth Marketing. You own the demand strategy: the growth levers, the target account logic, the ABM programme architecture, and the pipeline targets. Growth Marketing — our shared marketing engine for scaling demand across channels — is your execution partner across paid, email, events, ABM, and field marketing. You set the direction. They deliver at scale.

You are measured against marketing's contribution to WDG's bookings target — not on campaign volume or activity. The north star is qualified pipeline and bookings contribution.

Key Responsibilities

Own WDG's demand strategy and pipeline contribution

  • Translate WDG's three growth levers — defend and grow the core install base, activate new growth vectors (cross-sell, web solutions, payments), new logo acquisition — into a demand programme plan with clear pipeline targets
  • Own WDG's two ABM programmes: Enterprise ABM (a target account list of 50 named accounts) and MM+ Whitespace ABM (900 target accounts) — architecture, account selection, and programme logic
  • Set marketing's pipeline contribution targets by segment and growth lever, and be measured against them on a quarterly basis

Partner with Growth Marketing for execution at scale

  • Brief Growth Marketing on demand priorities, segment targets, campaign objectives, and success metrics before every programme — every campaign starts with a brief stored in the agentic marketing platform
  • Own the integrated WDG demand plan as the input to Growth Marketing's execution across paid, email, events, ABM, and field marketing channels — aligning channel mix to where WDG's pipeline gaps are largest
  • Partner on CAC targets and conversion expectations across segments; be the point of accountability for what Growth Marketing delivers against the WDG bookings plan

Own WDG's event and conference strategy

  • Lead WDG's industry event strategy and presence — Fensterbau, GlassTec, KBIS, GlassBuild, and DHI — from objectives and target account activation through to pipeline follow-through
  • Own the Cyncly Connect WDG regional conference programme (NAM, EMEA, LATAM) as a demand and pipeline engine, not a cost centre
  • Ensure every event investment is tied to pipeline targets and measured against them in the weekly rhythm of business

Drive cyncly.com as WDG's digital demand engine

  • Partner with Growth Marketing to build on the WDG customer journey on cyncly.com — continuous test & learn, content and UX optimization, and AI-driven pre-qualification to increase engagement and conversion from target accounts
  • Ensure WDG's digital presence reflects the BU's positioning and drives the right segment mix into pipeline

Operate in an agentic marketing model

  • Work within Cyncly's agentic marketing platform to plan, brief, and track demand programmes — using AI agents to accelerate research, content production, and campaign optimization
  • Direct agents to synthesize market signals, target account intent data, and campaign performance into actionable programme decisions; apply human judgement to prioritize and act
  • Report on pipeline creation, ABM account progression, and demand programme performance on the weekly rhythm of business cadence — all tracked and reported through the agentic marketing platform
  • Use performance data — CAC, conversion rates, programme ROI — to continuously optimize the programme mix and bring a clear point of view on what to shift
  • 5+ years in demand generation, growth marketing, or pipeline marketing in B2B technology or SaaS — with a track record of pipeline contribution, not just programme delivery
  • Proven ABM experience: building and managing enterprise and/or mid-market target account programmes across multiple channels
  • Experience working in a partnered model — briefs a centralized execution team rather than owning execution directly
  • Comfortable with event strategy and management as a pipeline driver, not just a brand exercise
  • Analytical fluency: pipeline data, CAC, conversion metrics, and programme ROI are natural working tools
  • B2B or industrial software domain experience — manufacturing, distribution, or adjacent verticals a meaningful advantage

Skills & Competencies

  • Pipeline accountability — connects demand programmes to bookings contribution; measures success in pipeline and conversion, not activity
  • ABM fluency — designs and manages a two-tier ABM programme across enterprise and whitespace accounts with precision
  • Partner mindset — builds Growth Marketing into a true execution partner through clear briefs, aligned targets, and shared accountability
  • Data discipline — uses pipeline and performance data to prioritize investment and report with clarity on the weekly cadence
  • Executional rigour — writes briefs and plans that are complete and clear enough to execute without handholding
  • Agentic marketing fluency — comfortable working with and directing AI agents within an agentic marketing platform to plan, brief, and optimize programmes; uses the platform as a working tool, not a reporting layer

Working for us

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

Step into a pivotal, high-impact leadership role on a 12-month contract where you hold the compass for our global growth. As GM of Commercial Strategy & Insight, you won't just analyse the market—you’ll actively shape where we win, how we price, and how we turn deep consumer understanding into commercial momentum that moves the needle on revenue and gross margin globally.

This is the ultimate strategic engine room position. You will empower a brilliant team across Commercial Strategy and Consumer Insight to answer our biggest questions early, steer multi-million dollar portfolio decisions, and protect space for visionary, exploratory research. Whether defining global pricing guardrails, optimising Pack Price Architecture, or navigating complex trade-offs, your work will directly fuel our long-term 5-year strategy and amplify our social impact worldwide.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Aligning global category direction: Unifying regional and global teams around a single, cohesive strategic view across our core product categories in alignment with our 5-year growth roadmap.
  • Driving global pricing and portfolio strategy: Refining global pricing and promotional guardrails, Pack Price Architecture, and commercial thresholds to balance local market needs with overall global portfolio coherence.
  • Weaving insight into action: Connecting commercial questions directly with exploratory research through the Director of Consumer Insight, ensuring forward-looking consumer context shapes our biggest commercial choices early on.
  • Facilitating executive-level trade-offs: Co-facilitating "Cal Pals" (our global cross-functional prioritization forum) to guide clear trade-off decisions in resourcing across Retail, DTC, Supply Chain, and Brand teams.
  • Coaching and developing top talent: Mentoring a global team, elevating team capabilities around complex pricing/promotional analysis and commercial rigor while maintaining clear prioritization boundaries.

Let’s talk about you

  • You are a visionary commercial strategist and systems thinker: You excel at stepping back to map the whole ecosystem—connecting category, consumer, portfolio, pricing, and channel dynamics into one clear, compelling picture. You instinctively understand how a single pricing shift or portfolio move in one market ripples across the global business, and you bring the critical thinking needed to translate complex data into decisive, margin-accretive action.
  • You are the ultimate cross-functional glue: You thrive at the intersection where strategy meets execution. As a natural connector, you comfortably bridge gaps between functions—bringing Retail, DTC, Supply Chain, and Brand together around shared commercial goals. You know how to align competing priorities, ask the right questions to unlock operational blockers, and build trust across all levels of the business.
  • You lead with clarity, empathy, and conviction: You lead through ambiguity and change with complete transparency—naming clearly what will and will not get done so your team can focus on what matters most. You hold a high bar for analytical rigor while fiercely protecting your team's remit and engagement. You take pride in coaching others, building commercial capability, and influencing senior stakeholders with objectivity and poise.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

Are you passionate about water resources and environmental science? RTI’s Water, Agriculture, Natural Resources, and Energy Solutions (WARES) Group is seeking a motivated Research Environmental Scientist to join our hydromet and flood risk team. We develop innovative tools and analytical methods that support hydropower owners, dam safety programs, and the broader water resources community.

Our team is recognized for expertise in precipitation frequency analysis and probable flood hazard assessments (PFHA). As a nonprofit research institute, RTI also supports internal R&D to drive innovation and create real-world impact.

As part of the team, you will contribute to a broad range of meteorological frequency analyses and extreme storm analyses. Candidates should be able to demonstrate experience or exposure in several of the areas listed below (not all are required).

Why Join Us?

  • Work on impactful domestic and international water resources projects.
  • Apply state-of-the-art computational tools to complex water management challenges.
  • Help advance modeling technologies and analytical methods.
  • Collaborate with leading experts in a supportive, multidisciplinary environment.
  • This position can be either based in RTI’s U.S. office in Research Triangle Park, NC, or it can be fully remote. Teleworking is permitted within the United States only.

What You'll Do

You will support project teams requiring meteorological expertise to support hydrologic hazards, flood forecasting, and other analyses. You will work daily using scripts, tools, and techniques to efficiently prepare and analyze meteorological data including addressing climate change impacts using GCM data. You will also support project management and grow project portfolios.

Essential Duties:

  • Collaborate with the Hydromet team to implement and enhance RTI’s hydrometeorological analysis tools.
  • Perform data processing, quality control, and automation using scripts and tools.
  • Collect, process, quality control, and statistically analyze large datasets of meteorological information.
  • Develop code to improve existing hydrometeorological analysis tools and link to other existing hydrologic modeling or forecasting tools.
  • Contribute to precipitation frequency and probable maximum precipitation analyses in support of dam safety projects.
  • Lead small projects or task orders of moderate complexity.
  • Contribute to proposal development.
  • Share work internally and externally through presentations and conference papers.
  • Make informed decisions based on data, best practices, and team input.
  • Support business development by identifying opportunities to expand or enhance existing projects and developing research ideas or white papers.

What You'll Need

Minimum Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree [DM1] and 8 years of relevant experience, master’s degree and 6 years of relevant experience, or a PhD and 1 year of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Relevant fields include Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Hydrology, Climate Studies, or a related discipline.

Minimum Required Qualifications:

  • Experience in the following areas:
    • Statistical analysis of hydrometeorological time series, precipitation frequency, and probable maximum precipitation.
    • Collection, QA/QC, and interpretation of hydrometeorological data.
    • Technical documentation and report writing.
    • Experience working with meteorological GIS datasets.
    • Proficiency with open-source programming languages (Python, R, C#, VB.NET) for data management, transformation, QC, and statistical analysis.
    • Basic geospatial processing and mapping using ArcGIS or QGIS.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and familiarity with relational databases (SQL).
  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.). 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with GCM datasets.
  • Experience with extreme storm analyses.
  • Familiarity with probabilistic or stochastic modeling concepts.

The DRG Dispute Reviewer is responsible for evaluating provider appeals and original audit findings to determine the correct DRG assignment and payment outcome. Total Rewards

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

jobs.excerpt: Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI.
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Enterprises run AI agents across many platforms and vendors, and they need one independent place to see, manage, and control them. Agent Management gives them that. It is a product Dataiku just launched, in a category that is just forming. Dataiku is used by 25% of the Fortune 500, which gives Agent Management a route to market no startup in the category has. And because Dataiku is independent of any cloud, model, or application vendor, it can manage agents across all of them.

How you’ll make an impact

You will be the single-threaded owner of Agent Management: from first customers to $100M, with the mandate to get product, engineering, marketing, sales, services, and partners working to one plan. The category is new, and you will write the playbook for it.

You will report to the CEO and co-founder and work with the CTO and co-founder. You will have one direct report, the Head of Growth, Agent Management. Owners in Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Services stay in their teams, are accountable to you for this business, and meet in one recurring forum you run to review pipeline, launches, and blockers and leave with decisions.

You own the strategy for Agent Management (product priorities, packaging, pricing model, positioning), and you co-own the revenue number with the sales team.

In your first year, you will:

  • Win the first paying customers, learn which problem makes them buy and who owns that problem, and turn it into a motion the field can repeat.
  • Set the route to market across the installed base, new logos, partners, and OEM, with the CRO, the CMO, and Partnerships.
  • Make the first win land fast: every new customer sees all their agents in one place within weeks of signing, and that win becomes their reason to expand.
  • Agree release priorities with Product and Engineering for what your first customers need to expand.
  • Position the category with Marketing and Analyst Relations.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • You know how to build a plan to scale a business from zero to $100M, and you have carried the revenue number for one: a product line, a business unit, a new market, or a company you founded.
  • You love pitching to technical buyers: platform, security, and AI governance teams.
  • You get teams working toward one business goal, and you have results to show for it.
  • You build the financial model yourself and can explain the product to a CIO.
  • You decide fast on incomplete information, argue in the open (including with the CEO), and change your position when the data calls for it.
  • You work AI-native. You run agents in your own work, so you know the problems our buyers face when their teams run agents on many platforms.
  • You are US-based (or willing to relocate), and ready to travel to customers, partners, and Dataiku offices worldwide.

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.
Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Zenrows is the web data infrastructure for AI. Founded in 2021, we give developers, AI agents and businesses one reliable way to access, extract and structure data from any website, at any scale, however hard the site tries to block them.

Whether it’s an agent that needs fresh web context mid-task, an LLM application grounded in live data, or an enterprise pipeline pulling millions of pages a day, Zenrows handles the rendering, the anti-bot defences and the parsing behind a single API, 10B+ requests a month. As we continue our rapid expansion, we are now looking for our first Developer Relations Engineer to join us on a permanent basis, make an instant impact and build our DevRel function from the ground up.

The Role

Nobody has ever done this job at Zenrows and that’s the exciting part! You’ll be our founding DevRel, which means there’s no playbook or legacy processes to inherit, and nobody telling you how it should be done. You get a blank canvas, real ownership and the freedom to build and scale the function from scratch the way you think it should be built.


What You’ll do

  • Working alongside our GTM team, you’ll combine your technical advocacy and community skills to build credibility and help developers discover, experiment with, and integrate Zenrows. Ultimately adoption is the goal and success will be measured on that. We want Zenrows to be a name everyone recognises.
  • As the face of Zenrows, you’ll be out there in the real world. You’ll give talks, run technical workshops, and collaborate with relevant developer communities. You’ll also own our hackathon programme. Which ones we sponsor, where we speak, and being there on the day, talking to the people building cool things with our tools.
  • Engaging with the online community is equally as important. When you’re back at your desk, you’ll drive discussions where developers already hang out, such as Reddit, X and Discord. You’ll create videos, demo content, templates and sample apps, plus open-source projects, GitHub contributions, starter kits and developer integrations. You’ll show developers what’s possible with Zenrows and get them experimenting.
  • This role is as much about listening as it is about telling. Taking what you’ve learned, you’ll also handle the feedback loop between the community and the product and engineering teams.
  • Zenrows already integrates with hundreds of tools that developers love. Our goal is simple and ambitious: make Zenrows part of every agentic developer’s stack.

What We’re Looking For

Nobody is equally brilliant at everything. We’ll lean into your strengths and grow the function from there.

  • You’re technical, first and foremost. You don’t need to be a hard core developer but you can write Python, JavaScript or similar. You’re comfortable with APIs/SDK, AI agents and can build demos, apps and integrations with the product yourself.
  • You’ve got demonstrable technical and community-building experience. You’re confident on camera and the stage, and have a public body of work you’re proud of. We’d love to see your videos, talks, demos, repos or posts.
  • You have a track record of running events, talks or community initiatives. We want someone whose passion is clear and is active in AI/agent developer ecosystems such as GitHub, Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, Stack Overflow.
  • You’ve built developer ecosystems, open-source initiatives or technical communities from scratch, and you know how to get noticed without a big brand or logo behind you.
  • You measure success in impact, not just reach. You’re driven by API integrations, open-source adoption, and community engagement converting into active customers
  • Being the only person in the function excites you rather than scares you! In the end, this is yours to own and you’ll need to be comfortable making big decisions and running with them.
  • You’re a skilled technical writer. Documentation is mainly owned by engineering but you’ll also be expected to contribute in time

Bonus points if:

  • You already have an audience of your own. Perhaps a newsletter, a YouTube channel or a strong following on X.
  • You've done real web scraping and can talk about proxies, browser automation and anti-bots.
  • You’ve organised a hackathon (or won one!).

Why You Will Love Working Here

  • Our people crave ownership and opportunity over everything else. We offer responsibility and scope to do things in your role that you can only dream of in similar roles in larger companies.
  • We have a CEO who values world class talent over everything else. Trust and respect is earned and with it comes reward and recognition like nowhere else.
  • In a world where it feels like everyone is being called back being in an office, we operate a truly 100% remote approach that allows you to work from anywhere you choose.
  • Forget Agile, Scrum, Lean... or whatever development methodology is trendy this week. We give you a horizontal view that enables you to identify where you think you can contribute the most.
  • We have fun! The above may sound like we are all about work but we put a lot of focus on ensuring our culture is one that our people enjoy, lets you build lasting friendships and grow both personally and professionally.

Why You Might Not Fit

  • We are a small yet efficient team of 20, and our competitors are 10x our size. We manage to outperform them because everyone takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable and focuses on delivering meaningful outcomes. If you’re just looking for a job rather than a mission then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • We are an agentic company, and agents are an essential part of how every team works. If you aren’t excited to build, delegate to and take ownership of AI agents in your day to day, then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • We work 100% remotely and give our people the freedom to work wherever they choose. To offset this there is naturally more need to document and update workflows than in other companies. If you hate documenting then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • Feedback is how we better ourselves every day and we foster a culture that encourages everyone to have a voice. If you don’t like being surrounded by world class talent that will always express strong opinions then you probably shouldn’t apply
  • We are a start-up and know the growth journey holds plenty of lessons to learn. If you are looking for the perfect organization, flawless processes and predictability in your day to day then you probably shouldn’t apply.

Our Rewards and Benefits

  • 100% remote work: We are a company that offers true freedom. Work wherever life takes you.
  • The salary you are worth: We never ask people what they are earning but instead what you are looking for. If your ability and experience justifies it and we think you are going to help us succeed then we will match your expectations.
  • The equipment you want: We believe in giving our people the tools they need to succeed and don’t have a default machine to give you.
  • Generous Learning & Development budget: We believe in always adding value to our top performers and helping them grow their skills in a direction that is beneficial both to them and the business
  • All Star Awards: We recognize achievements in many ways within the business but the bi-annual All star rewards allows the CEO to tailor reward packages to the person. Whether this is a holiday destination of choice, a learning course that adds value or something else.. We believe in getting to know every employee personally.
  • Charity Initiatives: We are a business that believes in giving back to the community and every year allows our employees the opportunity to give back.
  • Annual Kick-Off: We want our employees to see where Zenrows was born and enjoy all the Pintxos they can handle.
  • Share in Our Success: We want our top performers to be part of the company's success and offer opportunities for stock option allocation when people show their value.
  • Deel Benefits: As a fully remote organization we employ our people via Deel. This not only brings freedom of location but also a host of other benefits including discounts on VPNs, memberships and services.

Values

We are proud of our uniquely agile, fast paced, and autonomous environment. Our core values of Ownership, Dedication, Impact, Transparency and Agility run through everyone who works for us, and everything we do.

We are a sociable company and don’t let a fully remote model stop us from feeling connected to the place we work and the people that we work with. The atmosphere across the business is friendly and supportive, with a constant desire to improve in everything we do!

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Here at Zenrows we are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion but recognise that we can always do more. Every job description is subject to scrutiny through a gender bias decoder ensuring our roles are as inclusive and attractive as possible. Our culture is one that aims to nurture a welcoming and safe working environment for everyone with initiatives that embrace our globally diverse family. We are committed to protecting the mental health of our employees and aim to create a great place to work, whoever you are and wherever in the world you work from.

Privacy and Your Data

At Zenrows, we prioritize the privacy and security of data entrusted to us. We are committed to complying with all applicable data protection regulations and industry best practices. As part of our team, you will contribute to creating and maintaining systems that uphold the highest standards of data integrity, confidentiality, and transparency. Your role will help ensure that we continue to protect sensitive information, foster trust with our customers, and support a privacy-first culture across our organization.

Any job offer that we may make to you will be subject to you successfully passing background checks.

jobs.excerpt: About UsHealth is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience.
jobs.description:
About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

As a Provider Recruiting Associate, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the journey for Registered Dietitians (RDs) looking to join Nourish. The Provider Recruiting Associate is the gateway into Nourish, and is more often than not the first person an RD will interact with from Nourish in their journey. This role is centered around creating an amazing hiring experience - vetting candidates, setting up offers, developing timely and encouraging candidate communication plans, and answering complex questions needed to help RDs decide if Nourish is the right place for them.

You’ll take full ownership of our applicants (a large and growing group each month) and shape their hiring experience from end to end. You’ll help refine and evolve our hiring strategy, taking initiative to improve processes as we grow. And you’ll get to interact every day with Providers making meaningful decisions for their careers, and extend them the opportunity to join Nourish’s mission and community.

This person will report into our Director of Provider Acquisition- you’ll be joining a collaborative and passionate team that’s dedicated to improving lives through better nutrition, and you’ll be a pivotal player in our vision to help one hundred million people live healthier, longer lives using Nourish.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for applicants, building a deep knowledge of Nourish’s value prop, policies, and processes to effectively communicate with RDs
  • Drive applicant engagement through proactive outreach and timely follow-ups that increase offer acceptance
  • Lead outbound recruiting efforts to our highest priority prospects, via personalized emails and calls
  • Manage the recruiting inbox and respond to applicant questions in a timely, professional manner
  • Track and analyze key recruiting metrics to improve funnel conversion and inform hiring strategy
  • Collaborate with Provider Onboarding, Provider Marketing, Provider Strategy, and Product teams to create feedback loops that improve candidate experience
  • Make process improvements based on feedback from providers and internal stakeholders to improve the overall recruiting experience, both qualitatively and quantitatively

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • You have 2+ years of experience in recruiting or outbound sales development.
  • You are hyper-organized and skilled at managing a high-volume process, handling multiple interactions at once while ensuring no detail is overlooked.
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and gain energy from engaging with providers across phone, video, email, and chat.
  • You can learn new processes and assume ownership quickly, understanding a detailed process right after having it explained.
  • You’re a strong problem-solver who can think on your feet and offer creative solutions to optimize processes.
  • You’re passionate about nutritionand wellness, and you’re motivated to help others improve their health by expanding access to high-quality care.
  • You’ve excelled in fast-paced start-ups, particularly in healthcare operations, telehealth, SaaS, or tech, where quick thinking and adaptability are key.

jobs.description:
Kimbrell Agency

Remote (Detroit, MI area)

Employment Type: Contractor

Compensation $50,000 to $100,000 per year (plus commission)

If you're reading this and thinking, "Insurance? Really?" I get it. I've thought that too—and I still do. The truth is, I'm not passionate about insurance. I'm passionate about people. We don’t just build careers; we build people who, in turn, build businesses. The result? Success and fulfillment.

We look forward to discovering what success means to you and, if we find that this is the right fit, we are fully committed to providing you with the tools, training, and support to make it happen.

The Problem with Most Insurance Jobs:

Let’s be real—most agencies are desperate to hire anyone with a pulse, offer minimal support, and if you're lucky, they might invest in you six months down the line. We think that's unacceptable.

At The Kimbrell Agency, we do things differently. We invest heavily from the start to ensure you're the right fit for this career. That means we pour everything into your long-term success. No leader can give everything it takes to help an agent succeed when they’re bringing on anyone who applies. Unfortunately, most agencies make empty promises: "Be in business for yourself, but not by yourself," or "We offer hands-on support and training."

Here, we actually mean it. And we have a proven track record of success to back it up.

What We Offer:

A Proven Lead System: Say goodbye to cold calling. Our streamlined lead generation system puts you in front of qualified buyers who have requested coverage. You’ll call these clients, set appointments, and meet virtually to help them find the best insurance plan for their needs and budget. Some agents even start part-time and transition to full-time.

A Real Opportunity for Growth: This role is perfect for self-disciplined sales professionals who are ready to put in the work. If you need someone looking over your shoulder or a time clock to punch, this isn't the right fit. But if you're driven, gritty and ready to build something meaningful, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

Present and sell insurance products to new and existing customers.

Reach out to potential clients who have requested coverage.

Handle customer inquiries and resolve complaints.

Participate in regular Zoom training sessions.

Who We're Looking For:

Previous experience in sales, customer service, or a related field is a plus.

Familiarity with CRM platforms is helpful.

You know how to build rapport and trust with clients.

You’re deadline-driven, detail-oriented, and dedicated to delivering results.

Integrity and a strong work ethic are a must.

We’re seeking individuals who are ambitious, coachable, passionate about helping others, and driven to achieve greatness. If you’re ready to take control of your future and create a career you can be proud of, we’d love to connect.

Why Choose Us?

True Agency Ownership: Here, you’ll have the chance to own your business—contractually protect what you build.

Game-Changing Lead Program: We provide the industry’s best leads, generated in-house and heavily subsidized to help you succeed.

Comprehensive Training & Support: From day one, we offer hands-on training, including daily coaching calls, weekly one-on-ones, and group sessions. You’ll have a system to follow at every step of the way.

Industry-Leading Compensation: Our compensation plan is designed to deliver real profit, with vested rights from day one.

Dedicated Conservation Team: Our team ensures your business stays protected from chargebacks, giving you one of the highest persistency rates in the industry.

World-Class Travel & Incentives: Have the ability to earn 3-4 fully-paid trips per year, all expenses covered.

Unlimited Earning Potential: This is a commission and bonus-based position, with no cap on how much you can earn. Your income potential is truly unlimited.

A Few More Details:

This role does require a Life and Health Insurance License, but don’t worry—we’ll help you obtain it through a streamlined online course that takes just 7-10 days.

Please note: Success in this role varies. Your level of success will depend on several factors, including the effort you put in, your ability to follow and implement our proven system, and the specific insurance needs in your geographic area. Not all agents achieve the same results, and earnings are based on individual performance.

Ready to Build Your Future with Us?

If you're ready to make a difference—not just in your own life, but in the lives of others—apply today. We can’t wait to see how you define success.

Kyle & Lisa Kimbrell are financial service industry veterans with over 50 years experience combined in sales, marketing and leadership. Since founding their Symmetry Financial Group business in July of 2016 their national agency has sold over 55,000 life, health, annuity, disability and retirement policies with over $85 million in sales. jobs.description:
NetDocuments is committed to providing an excellent candidate experience and will never ask you to engage in recruitment activity without phone, video, and in person meetings and communications from emails using the @netdocuments.com domain. If you have any concerns or questions about communications you have received, please send them to  so our team members can review.

About NetDocuments

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
  • Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for building and delivering shared AI capabilities across our platform. In this role, you will drive engineering execution, guide technical direction, and lead the development of scalable, secure, and reliable AI-powered solutions that enhance how legal professionals work.

You will partner closely with Product, Architecture, and senior engineering leaders to translate emerging AI technologies into meaningful product capabilities. This is a technical leadership role focused on driving delivery, developing engineering talent, and ensuring our AI solutions meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and enterprise readiness.

You will:

Drive Engineering Delivery & Execution

  • Lead the planning and execution of engineering initiatives, ensuring predictable delivery of high-quality AI capabilities.
  • Partner with Product and Architecture to translate customer needs and emerging AI technologies into scalable, secure solutions.
  • Balance feature development with system reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, communicating recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Establish clear priorities, accountability, and engineering practices that support consistent delivery.

Guide AI Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers to guide architectural decisions, technical direction, and implementation strategies for AI-powered solutions.
  • Evaluate AI model selection and technical tradeoffs, including response quality, latency, scalability, and cost.
  • Guide the development of prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches to deliver accurate, contextually relevant AI experiences.
  • Establish expectations for AI evaluation, testing, and monitoring, including regression testing for model and prompt changes.
  • Ensure AI capabilities meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, compliance, and reliability.
  • Leverage technical knowledge of C#/.NET, microservices, containerization, and AWS or Azure to evaluate designs, remove blockers, and support engineering decisions.

Lead, Mentor & Develop Engineering Talent

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers, supporting performance, career growth, and technical development.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive hiring and talent development efforts to build a high-performing engineering team.
  • Encourage the adoption of modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality.
  • Create an environment where engineers collaborate effectively, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve technical solutions.

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration & Alignment

  • Partner with Product, Design, Architecture, and other AI engineering teams to align technical priorities and shared platform capabilities.
  • Communicate engineering progress, technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships that support efficient decision-making and successful product delivery.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and recommendations.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing engineering teams.
  • Experience delivering production-grade AI or LLM-powered features within an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of large language models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context limitations, latency, cost considerations, and common failure modes.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation methodologies, retrieval systems, and approaches for measuring model accuracy, reliability, and performance.
  • Understanding of AI agent architectures, tool-calling patterns, and emerging integration standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Strong technical foundation in modern software engineering, including distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and modern engineering practices including CI/CD, containerization, and observability.
  • Working knowledge of C#/.NET or similar backend development technologies, with the ability to evaluate technical designs and guide engineering decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver complex technical initiatives.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager, Banking & Investing
jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.
  • Reaching the right decision makers through relationships, referrals, events, and outbound.
  • Partner conversations from first outreach through pitch, deal negotiation, contracting, and launch.
  • A clear read on each partner's growth goals, economics, products, and target customers.

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: you're learning the book side by side with the Head of Partnerships and running operations on the partners you'll own.
  • By about day 120: you run your partners independently.
  • By month 6: you're directing internal traffic and connecting partner activity to media opportunity.
  • Year one: larger budgets and stronger economics across existing partners, new banks and investing advertisers live, and the Head of Partnerships focused on our largest, most strategic deals.

THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT SEAT IF YOU

  • Want to hunt, close, and hand the account to someone else.
  • Want someone else to own the operations.
  • Need a playbook handed to you before you move.
  • Would rather service an account than grow it.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

jobs.title: Senior Site Merchandiser
jobs.excerpt: SwimOutlet. com | Reimagine the Future of E-Commerce We're not looking for someone to follow the playbook.
jobs.description:
SwimOutlet.com | Reimagine the Future of E-Commerce

We're not looking for someone to follow the playbook. We're looking for someone who's ready to rewrite it.

At SwimOutlet, we're doing things a little differently.

We believe the future of e-commerce isn't about showing customers more products. It's about understanding them so well that shopping feels effortless, personal, inspiring, and maybe even a little magical.

And we believe AI is about to change everything. Not just how quickly we work, but what's possible.

We're looking for someone who blends the instincts of a merchant, the imagination of a creator, the curiosity of an inventor, and the analytical mind of a strategist.

A creative rebel. A builder. An experimenter. Someone who sees what could be, not just what is.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity: Build What Comes Next

SwimOutlet is the largest online specialty retailer for swimming and water sports in the United States.

We serve competitive swimmers, parents, coaches, teams, fitness enthusiasts, and everyone who loves being in the water.

We have incredible brands, passionate customers, and an opportunity to rethink how people discover, explore, and shop.

That's where you come in.

As our Senior Site Merchandiser, you'll shape the shopping experience across SwimOutlet.com.

But we're not asking you to maintain what exists.

We're inviting you to imagine what doesn't exist yet.

What if a swim parent could find the perfect goggles for their child without knowing anything about goggles?

What if a competitive swimmer discovered the ideal gear before knowing they needed it?

What if AI agents could anticipate customer needs, personalize product discovery, and continuously improve the shopping experience?

What if shopping stopped feeling like searching and started feeling like discovery?

These are the experiences we want you to help create.

Your Superpower: Imagination Meets Execution

We love big ideas. But we love turning them into reality even more. That’s part of the opportunity.

We're looking for someone who wants to discover what's next, build it, learn from it, and make it better.

Someone who believes shopping can be more intelligent, more human, more personal, and a whole lot more inspiring.

Someone who doesn't just see the future of e-commerce. Someone who wants to create it.

  • Reinvent product discovery. Rethink navigation, search, filters, recommendations, and the customer journey. Eliminate friction customers have learned to tolerate.
  • Make personalization feel personal. Create experiences that understand the difference between a competitive swimmer, a coach, a swim parent, and someone planning a beach vacation.
  • Put AI and agents to work. Build intelligent workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and imagine entirely new merchandising capabilities.
  • Turn data into discoveries. Uncover insights in customer behavior, shopping patterns, and product performance, then transform those insights into action.
  • Experiment relentlessly. Challenge assumptions, test bold ideas, learn quickly, and continuously improve through A/B testing.
  • Connect creativity with commerce. Collaborate with Buying, Planning, Marketing, Creative, Product, and Technology to inspire customers and drive results.
  • Create loyalty through experience. Make SwimOutlet a destination customers love returning to because shopping feels remarkably easy.

You'll have the freedom to question, explore, create, and build, and the responsibility to turn imagination into results.

We want you to help us imagine more.

What Success Looks Like

A year from now, we want more than a better-merchandised website.

We want intuitive, personalized shopping journeys. Customers discovering the right products with less effort and greater confidence.

AI agents eliminating repetitive work. Bold ideas becoming reality.

Stronger conversion. Greater customer loyalty. And innovations we couldn't have imagined before you joined us.

What You'll Have: The Freedom to Create What's Next

This isn't a role where you'll be handed a playbook and asked to follow it.

You'll have:

  • Direct access to leadership. Report directly to our President and Chief Product Officer, with the opportunity to influence the future of SwimOutlet's digital shopping experience.
  • No politics. No unnecessary layers. We value great ideas, open conversations, and people who challenge conventional thinking. The best idea wins, regardless of where it comes from.
  • Intense collaboration. Work shoulder to shoulder with Buying, Planning, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Creative, and Technology. Big ideas don't happen in silos.
  • The freedom to experiment. Challenge assumptions, test bold ideas, learn quickly, and help us discover better ways of doing things.
  • AI as your creative accelerator. Explore agents, automation, intelligent personalization, and emerging technologies to build shopping experiences that haven't existed before.
  • A meaningful opportunity to make an impact. Help reinvent the shopping journey for one of the largest specialty e-commerce destinations in swimming and water sports.
  • Compensation up to $200,000 annually. We're looking for exceptional creativity, intellect, merchandising expertise, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into measurable results.

What we won't have?

Endless meetings about meetings. Innovation that never gets beyond a presentation. Or a culture where "that's how we've always done it" is considered a good answer.

We believe extraordinary things happen when curious minds, bold ideas, emerging technology, and talented people come together.

Bring your imagination. Bring your intellect. Bring your willingness to challenge what's possible.

We'll bring the opportunity to build something extraordinary.

One Last Thing...

If you've ever looked at an e-commerce website and thought, "There has to be a better way," we want to hear from you.

If you've built something unconventional that worked, we want to see it.

And if AI has changed how you think about what's possible, we're especially interested.

You might be exactly who we're looking for.

How to Apply: Show Us How You Think.

No resume. No cover letter. Just you, your ideas, and a glimpse into how your mind works.

We believe the most interesting people don't always fit neatly onto a resume.

We'd rather see your imagination, curiosity, creativity, and ability to turn ideas into something remarkable.

So we're doing things a little differently.

Record two short videos (3–5 minutes each). Use Loom, Zoom, your phone, or whatever works best for you. No fancy production necessary. We're interested in your thinking, not your video-editing skills.

Video 1: Reimagine the Shopping Experience

Show us something in e-commerce you believe could be dramatically better.

Visit SwimOutlet.com or choose another e-commerce website that inspires you to think differently.

Imagine you have the freedom to reinvent part of the customer shopping journey.

Walk us through:

  • What do you see that others might miss? Identify a friction point, missed opportunity, or customer experience that could be reimagined.
  • What's your big idea? Show us how you would transform that experience into something more intuitive, personalized, engaging, or even a little magical.
  • Why would customers love it? Help us understand how your idea makes shopping easier, more enjoyable, or more meaningful.
  • How would you bring it to life? Tell us how you might use AI, personalization, data, or emerging technology to make your vision possible.

You can share a sketch, prototype, screen recording, mockup, or simply walk us through your thinking.

Surprise us. Challenge conventional thinking. Show us something we haven't considered.

We're not looking for the perfect answer. We're looking for an original perspective and the imagination to see what's possible.

Video 2: Show Us Your AI Superpower

Show us something you've created, improved, or reimagined using AI.

We want to see how you use technology to think bigger, work smarter, and solve problems in ways that weren't possible before.

Choose a real example from your work, a personal project, or something you've built through experimentation.

Walk us through:

  • The challenge: What problem or opportunity inspired you?
  • Your creation: What did you build or improve? Perhaps an AI agent, automated workflow, customer insight tool, personalized experience, or something entirely unexpected.
  • How it works: What information goes in? What happens behind the scenes? What comes out?
  • Your creative contribution: What decisions, insights, or original thinking did you bring that AI couldn't provide on its own?
  • The impact: What changed? What did you learn? What would you improve next?

Don't have a finished AI system to show us? That's okay. Demonstrate a concept, experiment, or prototype that illustrates how you would use AI to create something meaningful.

We want to see how you think with AI, not simply what AI can generate for you.

A Few Things to Know

We're not judging your presentation skills, video quality, or whether you've mastered every AI tool.

We're looking for people who are curious enough to ask better questions, creative enough to imagine new possibilities, and resourceful enough to bring those ideas to life.

You don't need permission to think differently here.

You don't need to have every answer.

And you definitely don't need to tell us what you think we want to hear.

Show us what excites you. Show us what you've built. Show us what you believe could be possible.

We're ready to be inspired.

Come make some waves with us.

SwimOutlet.com | Part of Spiraledge, Inc.
