jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Security Operations Engineer at Samsara, you will join a global team dedicated to protecting our people, systems, and information. You will triage and investigate security alerts, run incident response efforts, and help improve the tools, runbooks, and automated workflows we use to detect and respond to threats.

This role is an ideal next step if you have built foundational experience in a SOC or hands-on security environment and want to develop your technical craft. At Samsara, we view this level as a collaborative apprenticeship: you will develop independent execution skills on discrete investigations, break down incoming alerts into actionable steps, partner with incident stakeholders to remediate findings, and work alongside experienced responders during complex security incidents. You will also explore modern AI tools and insights to simplify routine tasks and optimize your day-to-day workflow.

We are looking for someone who follows the evidence, communicates with intellectual honesty, asks thoughtful questions, and brings a collaborative, pragmatic approach to security operations.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor, triage and investigate security alerts across identity, endpoint, email, SaaS and cloud environments, using our tools, runbooks and escalation procedures.
  • Own routine investigations and incidents through to a documented outcome: gather evidence, establish a timeline, assess the activity and explain your conclusions.
  • Support experienced responders during major security incidents through evidence collection, technical analysis, and agreed containment and recovery actions.
  • Maintain clear investigation records and provide useful updates and handovers to teammates across regions.
  • Improve runbooks, help tune detections, and contribute small scripts or automated workflows with guidance and review from teammates.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements.
  • Champion Samsara’s cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Hands-on experience triaging and investigating security alerts in a security operations, incident response or similar role.
  • Experience using security tools such as a SIEM, endpoint detection and response platform, or email security platform to investigate suspicious activity.
  • An understanding of common threats, such as phishing, account compromise and suspicious endpoint activity, and the networking, operating system and identity concepts needed to investigate them.
  • Ability to query and interpret logs, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and recognise when further investigation or escalation is needed.
  • Some scripting experience: you can read, adapt and write small scripts in Python or another language to support an investigation or simplify repetitive work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting findings, explaining uncertainty and providing effective handovers.
  • A careful approach to sensitive information, willingness to ask for help, and openness to feedback.

We welcome different routes into security. A particular degree or certification is not required; we’re interested in what you can do, how you approach problems, and what you’re ready to learn next.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience investigating activity in cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, SaaS applications, or identity systems.
  • Exposure to writing or tuning detections, threat hunting, or investigating activity across multiple data sources.
  • Experience using Python, APIs or automation platforms to improve a security workflow.
  • Familiarity with evidence collection or forensic analysis on macOS, Windows or Linux.

You do not need experience in every area above. Bring a solid operational foundation, curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About Get Covered LLC

We provide cost-effective coverage with just a few clicks — satisfying residents, property managers, agencies, and distribution partners with a process that is as simple and touchless as possible.

About the role

Get Covered is looking for a P&C Insurance Product Specialis who is ready to become our resident subject matter expert. If you are someone who genuinely geeks out over policy forms, analyzes real-world liability for fun, and loves turning insurance complexity into elegant coverage solutions, you’ll fit right in.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical insurance mechanics and operational delivery. You will work across policy documentation, claims analysis, underwriting workflows, and cross-functional initiatives to ensure our coverage programs remain competitive, compliant, and seamless for our clients.

What you'll do

  • Coverage & Policy Operations: Review policy documentation, support quoting workflows, and ensure accurate enrollment verifications and coverage determinations across all active programs.
  • Claims & Technical Support: Serve as an internal escalation point for complex coverage questions, claims reviews, and nuanced loss scenarios, ensuring fast, fair, and accurate resolutions.
  • Product Insights & Gap Analysis: Dive into loss runs, claims data, and client inquiries to spot coverage gaps, emerging risk trends, and opportunities to enhance existing products or launch new ones.
  • Client & Partner Touchpoints: Deliver high-touch, consultative support for insureds, claimants, and distribution partners on technical policy matters.
  • Process & Workflow Optimization: Partner with Product, Operations, and Customer Support teams to streamline information flow, automate recurring checks, and refine documentation.

jobs.title: Commission-Based Recruiter – Multilingual Roles in Europe – Chennai
jobs.excerpt: If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Chennai and across India.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • A direct line to us for any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary

Responsible for leading the strategy, governance, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of the organization’s Payment Integrity post-pay data mining program.

The Director serves as a key liaison between Health Plans and Executive Leadership teams. This position oversees a high-volume, fast-paced environment supporting concept lifecycle management, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Essential Job Duties

  • Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for the post-pay payment integrity concept portfolio, ensuring alignment with organizational financial, operational, and regulatory objectives.
  • Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of payment integrity concepts and ensures consistent governance, methodology, and performance management across markets.
  • Provide technical oversight of concept development and maintenance, including SQL-based analytical logic, Databricks solutions, and Azure DevOps work management.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, reimbursement policies, coding standards, and organizational governance practices.
  • Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging payment integrity opportunities to inform strategic direction and concept development priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 8 years of experience supporting health care operations, including 5 years payment integrity/claims experience, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

Title: Website & Marketing Content Manager (Marketing Asset Manager)
Location: Remote (eastern or central US time zone-based)

Position Summary:
MOCA is seeking a Website & Marketing Content Manager (Marketing Asset Manager) to improve how prospective and current customers find information, understand our software and services, and take the next step across our corporate, Touchplan, and MOCA Services websites. This hands-on role combines website design, WordPress and Elementor expertise, and making data-informed improvements to the customer journey.

You will turn business goals and audience needs into clear navigation, effective page layouts, and useful content experiences. Working with marketing colleagues and external developers, you will own day-to-day website execution and maintain a prioritized plan for improving usability and conversion performance. You will also manage and maintain our marketing and brand assets, ensuring materials remain current, organized, and consistent with approved branding and messaging. While this is a remote position, the company is seeking applicant located in either the eastern or central time zone of the United States.

Essential Functions:

Customer Journey and Website Design

  • Map key visitor journeys, from initial discovery through evaluation, inquiry, and access to customer resources. Identify confusing navigation, missing information, and barriers to taking action.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to site structure, navigation, page hierarchy, internal links, and calls to action based on audience needs and business priorities.
  • Design and build pages and landing pages in WordPress using Elementor. Apply strong visual judgment to typography, spacing, imagery, and content hierarchy across desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
  • Create reusable page templates and components that support consistent branding and efficient updates across the websites.

Website Performance and Conversion

  • Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity/heatmap tools, user feedback, and behavior analysis tools to identify where visitors struggle and prioritize improvements.
  • Improve inquiry and demo request journeys, including forms and confirmation experiences. Coordinate with marketing operations to verify tracking, CRM connections, and lead routing.
  • Develop testable recommendations for page layouts, messaging, and calls to action. Use A/B testing where traffic supports meaningful results and usability testing to inform other changes.
  • Report on website performance with clear recommendations, tracking priority actions and qualified inquiries alongside traffic and engagement.
WordPress Management and Website Quality
  • Manage routine WordPress content updates and publishing, including page edits, announcements, and job postings. Coordinate hosting, plugin and theme updates, backups, and troubleshooting with hosting and development providers.
  • Test pages, navigation, links, and forms across browsers and devices. Apply accessibility practices for headings, contrast, alternative text, keyboard access, and form labels, and coordinate remediation with developers.
  • Monitor page speed and site health, optimize images and page assets, and collaborate regularly with developers to identify, prioritize, and resolve performance and technical issues.

Search Visibility and Content

  • Apply on-page SEO practices, including descriptive page titles, meta descriptions, logical headings, and internal links. Monitor indexing and crawl issues and coordinate technical fixes with developers as needed.
  • Work with content and marketing colleagues to organize and adapt product, service, industry, and customer content for website visitors. Keep claims, statistics, client logos, and resource links current.

Digital Asset Management and Brand Support

  • Maintain website design standards and document reusable templates and publishing practices. Apply approved brand guidelines consistently across digital content.
  • Support the organization and upkeep of marketing assets, ensuring teams can find current, approved versions.
  • Package emails and newsletters using approved copy and assets. Build and format email layouts, apply brand standards, and test mobile display, links, and calls to action. Coordinate with marketing operations on audience targeting and sending.

Qualifications/Experience - Required:
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, web design, graphic design, digital media, communications, or a related field preferred.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in website management, digital design, or digital marketing, with direct responsibility for improving business websites.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building and maintaining WordPress websites with Elementor, including responsive layouts, reusable templates, and routine troubleshooting.
  • A portfolio showing strong web design judgment and examples of customer journey, usability, or conversion improvements.
  • Practical understanding of user experience, website navigation, accessibility, on-page SEO, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Experience interpreting Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console data and using findings to recommend website changes.
  • Strong editing, quality assurance, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing requests and collaborate with marketing, sales, and development teams.
  • Strong attention to detail, practical problem-solving abilities, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Qualifications/Experience - Preferred:
Experience with B2B software, professional services, and/or the AEC industry; Elementor; basic HTML and CSS; Pardot/MCAE, Figma or Adobe design tools; behavior analysis or usability testing tools; and marketing automation or CRM integrations. Familiarity with Flywheel hosting and SEO tools such as Yoast or Semrush is helpful.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:

As a Lead Product Designer at Samsara, you'll own design for strategic initiatives within one of our product areas, building software that runs in the cab, the yard, the job site, and the dispatch floor, built with the people who use it. You'll frame the problem, design and build the experience across web and mobile, and carry it through launch and iteration with your product and engineering partners. You'll also engage directly with customers, bringing their feedback into your process throughout.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact: helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead large, ambiguous initiatives, from problem framing through launch and iteration.
  • Demonstrate good judgement and taste in your deliverables
  • Regularly meet and engage with our most strategic customers to bring the customer voice alongside product data into product decisions.
  • Leverage AI tools through every step of the process, defining new ways of working.
  • Stay well informed on the emerging trends, tools, and technology
  • Ship code to production across our design system, web products, and mobile apps
  • Lead through building, not politics.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of product design experience designing UX/UI for web and mobile applications.
  • A portfolio with case studies that show how you approached an ambiguous, multi-part problem and what happened after you shipped. We cannot consider applications without a portfolio at this time.
  • Deep interaction and visual design skills, with the judgment to know when to use an established pattern and when to invent one.
  • AI tools in your regular design practice (e.g., Cursor, Figma Make), with shipped work you can attribute to them.
  • Experience mentoring designers, formally or informally.
  • Direct customer research experience, and comfort using it to make product decisions.
  • Experience shipping with cross-functional teams on short cycles.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$151,300—$195,800 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or AWS Cloud Practitioner certification.
  • Exposure to VMware monitoring and cloud dashboards.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You enjoy working at high velocity:
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

The Cybersecurity Staff Analyst is the team lead and most senior individual-contributor role on the Training and Awareness Team — the primary driver behind evolving our program from a traditional security awareness model, built around simulation pass/fail metrics and annual compliance training, into a mature Human Risk Management program that continuously adapts to real behavioral risk. This person operates with minimal oversight, exercises independent and sound judgment on ambiguous problems, and serves as a strong team lead and thought partner to the Manager — helping propel the team's strategy and key initiatives forward, without formal people-management authority or direct reports.


This person applies deep cyber threat intelligence (CTI) expertise to close the gap between what simulations measure and what actually drives real-world compromise — independently collecting, analyzing, and translating threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), social engineering trends, and MITRE ATT&CK-mapped behavior into the timely, actionable input that shapes Simulation scenario design and Awareness campaign content, and into the case for adopting more adaptive, risk-based program capabilities.

Process and operational improvement, training advisory work, and team mentoring are responsibilities this person grows into within roughly the first six months, although demonstrated experience is required upon hire.


Key Responsibilities

  • 100% Deliver Execution, Plans & Aligns, Develop Others - Oversee multiple projects simultaneously; Strategic partner to align solutions to customers expectations Communicate to various levels of business partners; Collaborate with stakeholders, business partners, colleagues, developers and others to deliver high quality solutions; Partner cross-functionally to define assess, communicate, implement, train and change management of projects; Lead, mentor and provide guidance to team members and partners; Serve as SME and perform research/analysis within assigned projects

Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as team lead for the Training and Awareness Team — providing day-to-day direction, prioritization, and technical leadership across Training, Simulation, and Awareness pillars, and acting as an informal technical resource and thought partner to analysts across all three when cross-pillar input is useful.
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to the Cybersecurity Manager, helping translate strategy into concrete, prioritized initiatives and ensuring key workstreams keep moving forward.
  • Champion and help drive forward the team's highest-priority strategic initiatives — including the Human Risk Management transformation, platform roadmap adoption, and new capability rollouts — partnering across pillars to clear blockers and keep momentum.
  • Serve as acting manager on an as-needed basis, providing interim leadership and direction to the team when the Manager is unavailable.

Human Risk Management Program Evolution

  • Supports the shift from traditional security awareness to an adaptive, targeted, and intelligence-driven Human Risk Management program — championing adaptive training pathways, real-time behavioral triggers, and risk-based targeting in place of generic, scheduled content.
  • Uses simulated and real-world behavioral signals to identify true high-risk populations — including repeat simulation failures, real-world malicious email clicks, and DLP-flagged policy violations such as unauthorized data handling, PII/PCI exposure, and gift card fraud indicators.
  • Builds the data-backed cases for new capabilities like adaptive learning, real-time triggers, and deepfake/vishing capabilities — partnering with the Manager and leadership to prioritize the roadmap accordingly.
  • Owns applied threat intelligence, turning raw intel into simulation themes, awareness content, and training recommendations.

Threat Intelligence & Landscape Analysis

  • · Collect, evaluate, and track cyber threat intelligence from open-source (OSINT), internal, vendor, commercial, and technical channels; analyze threat actor behavior and social engineering TTPs (e.g., spear-phishing, pretexting, MFA fatigue, vishing, AI-driven impersonation, deepfakes) mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • A proactive mindset and an interest in identifying opportunities to improve processes, reduce risks, and prevent recurring issues.

Job Summary

Lead Medical Record Technician – Coder (Inpatient/Outpatient)

Client: VA Northeast Ohio Healthcare System (Cleveland, OH)Type: Full-time, W2 contractSchedule: Monday–Friday, within the facility’s 6:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Eastern coverage windowLocation: Remote (U.S.-based) through a secure VA VPN connection

About the Role

Aptive Resources is hiring a Lead Medical Coder Coder to lead our medical coding team supporting the VA Northeast Ohio Healthcare System. It is a large, Joint Commission-accredited tertiary care and teaching facility with an academic medical school affiliation. You’ll help supervise a 14-person team: Inpatient Facility, Outpatient Professional and Ambulatory Surgery coders, plus a Coding Lead. You’ll own the team’s productivity, accuracy and compliance results with VA Health Information Management (HIM) leadership. All coding is done in Oracle Health with the Solventum CRS encoder.

Primary Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry a coding workload in your specialty (inpatient or outpatient) while leading a team of coders.
  • Coordinate daily workflow for the team:
    • distribute assignments and balance workloads
    • monitor work queues and backlogs
    • escalate staffing gaps, performance concerns and employee issues to the Supervisor/Project Lead
  • Serve as the team’s technical resource: answer coding questions, interpret official guidelines, and help resolve complex or unclear cases.
  • Help the team meet performance standards:
    • ≥95% accuracy in ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS and E/M
    • initial coding finished within 5 calendar days of assignment
    • daily productivity targets per coder
  • Perform internal quality reviews of coded records, track error trends by coder, and give one-on-one feedback and refresher training.
  • Help resolve claim edits, coding-related rejections and uncoded or outstanding encounters.
  • Guide coders on the VHA Provider Query Process so queries are compliant and non-leading. Track open queries to closure within 30 days.
  • Collect quality, productivity and training data for the Supervisor’s monthly reports and corrective action plans.
  • Attend meetings with the VA COR and HIM staff as requested, and help respond to coding issues within 48 hours.
  • Help the Supervisor onboard and train new coders, and update training materials.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active credential: RHIT, RHIA, CCS, CCS-P or CPC. You must hold it at hire and keep it current.
  • AHIMA credential holders must have completed the required ICD-10-CM/PCS baseline CEUs. AAPC credential holders must have passed the ICD-10 Proficiency Assessment.
  • At least 2 years of continuous coding experience at a VA medical center of comparable size and complexity (level 1A), or at an equivalent large tertiary or teaching hospital.
  • Must meet all qualifications of the Coder roles.
  • Proficient in ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, DRGs, CPT, HCPCS and E/M across inpatient, outpatient, professional and surgical settings.
  • Experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) coding workflows.
  • Formal training in anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology and reimbursement methodologies.
  • U.S. citizenship and strong written and spoken English.
  • Able to pass a VA background investigation (NACI) and complete VA Privacy and Information Security training.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous lead experience which includes help manage a coding team.
  • Familiarity with legacy VA systems (VistA, CPRS, VIRR).
  • Experience with Solventum (3M) CRS encoder and 360 Encompass.
  • Inpatient credential (CCS) with DRG validation or audit experience.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

About Aptive

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). We provide staffing solutions to address critical shortages in VHA medical facilities caused by turnover, recruitment issues, seasonal needs, surges or emergencies.

Arrow is a certified Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business joint venture between Artemis ARC and Aptive Resources, two award-winning companies that share an agile, mission-focused, results driven approach in the federal sector.​ Arrow provides management consulting services and specializes in working with federal government agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs and Office of Personnel Management.​

EEO Statement

Aptive is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, parental status, veteran status, age, disability, or any other protected class.

Veterans, members of the Reserve and National Guard, and transitioning active-duty service members are highly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Staff Innovation Engineer, Marketplace
jobs.excerpt: Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.
jobs.description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.

Built is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, managing over $300 billion in annual capital for more than 340 lenders — including 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks. The software Built engineers build governs how capital moves through construction projects: the AI Draw Agent that automates construction loan draw management for institutions like Fifth Third and Ameris, the lender portfolio risk tools that give banks real-time visibility into construction exposure, the compliance and document workflows that protect both borrowers and financial institutions, and the APIs that connect Built to core banking systems across the country. In a domain where precision, reliability, and performance have direct financial consequences, the engineering bar at Built is correspondingly high.

This role sits on Marketplace, expanding Built beyond workflow software into the services that surround every construction project, like inspections, appraisals, insurance, and materials sourcing. The team moves fast: standing up new products with real customers, building the durable platform underneath them, and sharpening the ones already in market.

As a Staff Innovation Engineer, you'll flex across all three of those - architecting core systems, taking new product ideas from concept to pilot, and improving products already in the hands of customers. This is a hands-on building role, not a people-management one, though at the staff level you're expected to drive system design on major initiatives and mentor other engineers on the team.

Our Guiding Principles

  • Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don't hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.
  • Help Customers Win. We learn our customers' businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.
  • Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.
  • Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don't wait to be asked.
  • Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

The Team

Marketplace is a tight-knit, tenured team that recently became its own business unit at Built. It's a collaborative group with a strong culture of mentorship and code review.

What You'll Do

  • Platform & primitives: Design and build the durable, reusable services that every Marketplace product depends on — things like purchase orders, contract terms, invoicing rails, and workflow/status state machines — using fine-grained microservices and asynchronous workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal). This work is judged on quality attributes: maintainability, scalability, reliability, and flexibility.
  • New product bets: Partner directly with customers to scope a problem, ship a working (not perfect) version of a new marketplace product within about 30 days, and iterate weekly based on direct customer feedback. Form and test hypotheses with discipline — know when to keep pushing, when to pivot, and when to walk away.
  • Adoption & optimization: For products that have already launched, focus on quality, craftsmanship, and driving adoption and usage — optimizing workflows and click paths and making the product the best version of itself for customers already using it.
  • AI-native development: Build and refine agent harnesses and layered prompting systems (system, policy, and steering prompts) that automate real workflows — for example, extracting and reasoning over unstructured documents (loan covenants, plans and specs, appraisals) using a mix of AWS Textract, GCP Document AI, and direct calls to models like Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI, choosing the right tool for the document and cost profile. Build and use internal eval tooling to test and improve these systems before and after they ship.
  • Partner with product, design, sales, and the General Manager to understand customer problems and give input on pricing, GTM, and scale/pivot/kill calls for the bets you're closest to — final commercial decisions rest with the GM and PM, not the engineer.
  • Mentor other engineers on the team through code review and pairing, and contribute to system design and architecture decisions even on bets you aren't personally driving.
  • Maintain the team's service and product-API boundaries (services don't call services; product APIs stay one-to-one with the user journeys they serve) as the team scales its footprint.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong backend/distributed-systems fundamentals — designing services and APIs that need to be reliable and maintainable, not just prototypes.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping 0-to-1 products or features in a fast-iteration environment with real customers, ideally using design-partner or similar validation approaches.
  • Experience building with or integrating multiple LLM providers (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) and document-extraction tooling (e.g., AWS Textract, GCP Document AI), including knowing when to fall back from a structured extraction tool to an LLM.
  • Experience building agent harnesses, RAG pipelines, or other AI/LLM-integrated workflows, along with the evals or testing practices needed to trust and improve them.
  • Data engineering, ML, or heavy document-processing background is a strong plus — a meaningful share of this team's work is reasoning over unstructured, non-standardized documents (legal terms, covenants, inspection reports).
  • Comfort working across the stack as needed — this is a full-stack-capable engineering role, not a narrowly scoped frontend or backend specialization — plus genuine curiosity about the customer problem, low ego, and a preference for working closely with product rather than in a handoff model.
  • Experience in financial services, construction, real estate, payments, lending, insurance, or other complex B2B environments is a meaningful differentiator, though not required.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

  • You've made a substantial, visible contribution in at least one of the team's three workstreams — a platform primitive that other bets now build on, a new product taken from hypothesis to a validated pilot with real customers, or a measurable adoption/usage improvement on a live product.
  • You've built or meaningfully improved at least one agent-driven or AI-integrated system that's in production use.
  • Engineers and cross-functional partners on the team would describe you as a strong collaborator who raises the bar on system design and is genuinely curious about the customer problem, not just the code.
  • If you mentored the team's newer engineer(s), they're visibly applying stronger patterns in their own work.

AI & Technology Expectations

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.
  • Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.
  • Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen technical and product insights.
  • Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

Built’s salary range for this position is $180,000-$240,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role; therefore, it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.

Travel Requirement: Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs.

Perks:

  • The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1.5T industry
  • Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation [US ONLY], medical, dental & vision insurance
  • Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options
  • Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development

jobs.description:
Asset Integrity Engineer | Energy & Resources

Philippines | Remote Delivery Supporting Australian Project Teams

  • Build specialist capability in storage tank integrity and fitness-for-service assessment
  • Deliver finite element models, calculations and technical reports for degraded API 650 storage tanks
  • Learn directly from senior engineers while contributing to high-quality Australian project delivery

The Opportunity

Fyfe is strengthening its offshore asset integrity delivery capability, and we're looking for an Asset Integrity Engineer to support our growing portfolio of storage tank assessment work.

Reporting to the Section Manager, you'll work remotely from the Philippines as part of Fyfe's offshore delivery team, collaborating closely with Australian-based engineers and project managers. You'll undertake engineering calculations, finite element analysis, data reviews and technical reporting, with a particular focus on degraded above-ground metal storage tanks.

This is an opportunity to develop specialist expertise while contributing to real project outcomes. With guidance and technical review from senior engineers, you'll build your capability in tank integrity engineering, Strand7 modelling and the application of API standards, taking on greater autonomy as your experience grows.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Deliver asset integrity, fitness-for-service and remaining-life assessments for above-ground storage tanks and related infrastructure.
  • Develop axisymmetric finite element models in Strand7, applying approved inputs, modelling methods and acceptance criteria.
  • Turn design, inspection, operating and condition data into clear, traceable calculations, models and technical reports.
  • Support the assessment of corrosion, cracking, fatigue, distortion and other service-related degradation.
  • Strengthen technical quality by identifying data gaps, documenting assumptions and uncertainties, completing self-checks and incorporating review feedback accurately.
  • Work with Australian-based project teams and other engineering disciplines to deliver coordinated outcomes within agreed scope, quality, budget and schedule requirements.

What You'll Bring

You'll bring a strong foundation in mechanical engineering and the curiosity to develop specialist capability in storage tank integrity assessment.

  • A tertiary qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • Foundation knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, stress analysis and the behaviour of metallic structures and equipment.
  • The ability to develop accurate and traceable engineering calculations and finite element models under appropriate technical supervision.
  • Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, supported by a methodical approach and close attention to detail.
  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, inspection data, material information and operating conditions, and identify missing or inconsistent inputs.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare calculation sheets, technical reports and engineering documentation.
  • The organisation, accountability and adaptability to manage assigned work, collaborate across locations and meet project deadlines in a structured remote delivery environment.

It would be great if you also have graduate or early-career experience in mechanical engineering, asset integrity, stress analysis, inspection, design or industrial project delivery. Experience with Strand7 or similar finite element analysis software, together with developing knowledge of API 650, API 653, API 579 and relevant ASME and Australian Standards, would also be valuable.

Why Fyfe?

Fyfe is an Australian multidisciplinary consultancy specialising in engineering, environment, planning and surveying. We partner with clients across Energy & Resources, Renewables, Infrastructure and Property, delivering practical solutions that support the energy transition and critical infrastructure projects shaping Australia's future.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Build specialist capability in storage tank integrity and finite element analysis through practical project experience.
  • Learn from senior and principal engineers through technical guidance, coaching and structured review.
  • Contribute to meaningful engineering assessments supporting Australian project teams.
  • Help improve calculation sheets, modelling templates, standardised workflows and technical delivery practices.
  • Grow your autonomy and engineering judgement as your technical competence and experience develop.

Interested?

If you're ready to build specialist asset integrity expertise and apply your engineering skills to complex storage tank assessments, we'd like to hear from you.

Join Fyfe and help deliver reliable, accurate and high-quality asset integrity solutions while shaping your capability in a specialised area of engineering.

Only candidates who are Australian Citizens, Permanent Residents or hold full Australian working rights will be considered.

Agency applications will not be accepted.

You’ll work as a partner, not a solo decision-maker. The Product lead owns the roadmap, and you help set priorities with them. You assess technology and architecture options and bring clear recommendations to the VP, who makes the final call. This role is for an experienced manager who does their best work inside a team and a structure.

What you’ll own

  • Coaching the team: regular 1:1s, feedback, performance reviews and growth plans for 7–10 developers.
  • Prioritization with Product: turn the roadmap into realistic sprint plans, and flag trade-offs and risks early.
  • Delivery: sprint execution and release management, so the team ships predictably and with quality.
  • Production reliability: lead incident response, run post-mortems and make sure the same problem doesn’t happen twice.
  • Technical recommendations: evaluate options and recommend architecture and technology decisions to the VP, with clear pros, cons and costs.
  • Hands-on code: regular backend and frontend contributions, code reviews, quality standards and CI/CD discipline.
  • AI-first development: drive the team’s use of AI coding tools and agents to ship faster, with clear quality standards.

What success looks like in your first year

  • The team ships on a predictable release schedule.
  • Every developer has regular 1:1s and a clear growth plan.
  • Incidents have clear ownership, and repeat issues are rare.
  • The VP and Product lead trust your estimates and your recommendations.

This role isn’t for you if

  • Your leadership experience is only in a company you founded or owned.
  • You haven’t shipped production code in the last year.
  • You want the final say on the roadmap or architecture. Here, Product owns the roadmap and you recommend technical direction to the VP.

jobs.description:
At 5:00 a.m. on September 3, 1967, every driver in Sweden moved from the left side of the road to the right. The switch took a morning. Getting ready took four years of public education, and road signs across the country were swapped in one coordinated push. And the roads got safer.

The hard part of a big change is the getting ready: helping people trust something new, then making it feel obvious afterward. That's the heart of recruiting operations at Mercury.

Mercury is building the financial stack for ambitious companies: banking,* payments, credit, and the workflows around them. Our recruiting team hires the people who build it, across engineering, sales, risk, operations, and everything in between. We run on an ATS, sourcing and scheduling tools, interview intelligence, our headcount planning system, Workday, and a growing library of AI workflows we've built ourselves.

In this role, you'll report to our Director of Recruiting and work day to day with our Staff Recruiting Operations Lead. You'll be the accountable owner of the systems our recruiters depend on. You'll lead big changes to how we work, including choosing and moving to new tools when the old ones hold us back. And you'll take our AI work from a set of useful skills to something the whole team runs on. This is a builder role with real autonomy, and what you ship will show up in every hire Mercury makes.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you'll do on the job:

  • Own our recruiting systems end to end: the ATS, sourcing and scheduling tools, interview intelligence, and the integrations that connect them to Workday and our headcount planning tool.
  • Lead large systems changes as the accountable owner, from vendor evaluation through data mapping, the HRIS integration, cutover, and training.
  • Manage our recruiting vendors: contracts, renewals, costs, and whether each tool still earns its place.
  • Keep the day-to-day running: permissions, offer workflows and approvals, troubleshooting, and the steady stream of "how do I..." questions from recruiters and People Ops. No question is too small.
  • Build AI workflows the team relies on, and make them dependable: tested against real examples, documented, and running on schedules or triggers instead of someone's open laptop.
  • Build and maintain the recruiting context layer, a clean, current home for process docs, role documents, and playbooks that people and AI agents can both find answers in.
  • Work with IT, People Ops, Finance, and our AI team to get changes made, and help the recruiting team absorb a lot of change without losing speed.
  • Answer questions about our hiring data with AI tools and little guidance, and turn what you find into changes in how we work.

You should:

  • Have 5+ years in recruiting or talent operations at a tech company, including admin-level ownership of an ATS (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, or similar): permissions, offer workflows, and integrations.

  • Build the simplest thing that works. You'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it with feedback than present a perfect plan next month.

  • Know recruiting from the inside. Full-cycle recruiting experience is a strong plus. At a minimum, you've worked shoulder to shoulder with recruiters and see your job as helping them win.

The role has two jobs. First, brand discovery. Grow how many new people discover SocialPilot every month, on Google, in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI answers, on Reddit and YouTube, and in the lists and review sites buyers trust. You have built an organic forecast and owned a quarterly number. You can walk us through a drop you diagnosed and recovered, or growth you built, and what it was worth.

At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation.

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who can operate at the intersection of data engineering and business strategy. This is not a traditional CSM role where you send check-in emails and track NPS scores. You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers, helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and making sure they renew and grow. The "technical" in the title is real: our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders who talk in SQL and think in data models, and they evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. This role reports to the Head of Customer Success.

What you will do:

  • Own customer outcomes. Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts end to end, from onboarding through renewal, accountable for implementation, retention, adoption, and expansion.
  • Run strategic QBRs that go beyond usage dashboards: analyze deployment health, surface adoption gaps, build ROI narratives, and give customers a clear roadmap for getting more value from Cube.
  • Get technical: understand how customers have modeled their data in Cube, diagnose performance issues (pre-aggregation strategy, query optimization, caching behavior), and advise on best practices.
  • Be the voice of the customer internally, translating feedback into product insights and working with engineering, product, and solutions architecture to resolve issues.
  • Drive adoption of new capabilities such as Analytics Chat, embedded agentic analytics, MCP integration, workbooks, and dashboards.
  • Manage renewals and identify expansion opportunities, owning the commercial relationship alongside our sales team.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a data, analytics, or developer-tools company (CSM, technical account manager, solutions consultant, or similar).
  • Strong SQL skills: you can write queries with window functions, CTEs, and cohort logic, and read someone else's SQL and spot what's wrong.
  • Experience working with technical stakeholders (data engineers, analytics engineers, engineering managers) and executive stakeholders (VP/Head of Data, CTO) in the same account.
  • A track record of managing renewals and driving account growth in a SaaS environment.
  • Ability to run a QBR that a data leader would actually find valuable: business narrative, not just metrics.
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), transformation tools (dbt), and BI/analytics tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain a pre-aggregation strategy to a data engineer and explain ROI to a VP in the same meeting.
  • Based in the US with availability for overlap with US business hours.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with Cube or semantic layer concepts (metrics layers, governed data models, headless BI).
  • Background in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, having been on the practitioner side.
  • Familiarity with embedded analytics use cases and multi-tenant architectures.
  • Experience with API-first or developer-tool products where the buyer is technical.
  • Understanding of AI/LLM integrations in the data stack (MCP, text-to-SQL, agentic workflows).
  • Comfort with light data modeling, YAML/code-based configuration, or git workflows.

This role is customer-facing and involves occasional travel to customer sites and company events.

We're a fully remote company based in San Francisco, hiring for this role in the United States. You can work from anywhere in the US and join our highly collaborative team.

The Senior Director leads the integration of acquired and partner site networks into Precision's investigator grants operating model and is accountable for the overall integration of the site payment process within the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS). As a partner to Clinical Operations, Project Management, Site Contracts, Finance, Information Technology, and sponsors, the role builds scalable processes, strong financial controls, and a sponsor experience grounded in transparency, predictability, and audit readiness.

  • Lead the Global Investigator Grants organization across all regions, setting the strategic vision, operating model, and multi-year roadmap in alignment with Operational Finance and Clinical Solutions objectives.
  • Lead, develop, and retain a global team of an Associate Director, managers, financial analysts – grants and investigator grants associates, including workforce planning and resource allocation to support portfolio growth.
  • Lead the integration of acquired and partner site networks into Precision's investigator grants model, including assessment of existing site payment practices, harmonization of processes, systems, and controls, transition of open site payment obligations and prepaid balances, and post-integration performance monitoring.

  • Partner with Business Development, Proposals, and Contracts to shape investigator grant and site payment strategy within proposals, bid defenses, and contract terms, including advance and prepaid funding structures and fair market value approach.
  • Define and monitor global KPIs, service levels, and executive dashboards (e.g., payment cycle times, prepaid fund coverage, forecast accuracy, site satisfaction), and drive continuous improvement, automation, and organizational change management.

Minimum Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 18 years of progressive experience in investigator grants, site payments, or clinical trial finance within a CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environment, including at least 10 years leading global teams through managers and directors.
  • Demonstrated experience leading a clinical systems implementation (CTMS or site payment platform) and/or the integration of acquired operations.

Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Executive Leadership and Vision – Sets strategy and leads a global function through managers and directors, aligning investigator grants operations with Operational Finance, Clinical Solutions, and corporate growth objectives.

  • Clinical Systems Transformation – Deep expertise leading CTMS and site payment system implementations, including requirements, configuration, data migration, validation, and adoption.
  • Global Investigator Grants Expertise – Expert knowledge of CTAs, site budgets, fair market value, payment triggers, prepaid funds, multi-currency payments, and country-specific tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Financial Acumen – Strong command of forecasting, accruals, pass-through cost management, change order impacts, and cash management across a global portfolio.
  • Governance, Compliance and Risk Management – Builds and sustains robust financial controls, SOPs, and audit-ready processes, including aggregate spend and transparency reporting obligations.
  • People Leadership and Talent Development – Develops leaders, builds succession, and fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence across geographies.

Communicates clearly and concisely with executive leadership, sponsors, and global teams, translating complex financial and operational information into decision-ready insights.
