The Role

LINQ is looking for a senior Program Manager to lead our most complex, highest-visibility engagements — statewide rollouts and other strategic account implementations that span multiple products, teams, and stakeholders. This is a role for someone who has run large-scale programs before and knows what it takes to keep them on track: clear governance, tight cross-functional coordination, and the judgment to know when to escalate and when to solve it themselves.

You’ll own the delivery of these programs end to end, working closely with Services leadership, Sales, Product, and Engineering to make sure strategic customers get the outcomes they signed up for — on time, on budget, and without surprises.

  • Build and manage program plans that span multiple concurrent projects, workstreams, and internal teams

  • Experience managing statewide, enterprise, or multi-site rollouts specifically, not just single-site or single-product projects

  • Experience directly managing or mentoring other project managers or implementation staff

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity; strategic accounts rarely follow the standard playbook

jobs.excerpt: ServiceNow is seeking a Partner Technology Architect — Autonomous Workforce to drive partner growth across the AI-powered workflows that run the modern enterprise — IT service and operations management, employee experience, and strategic portfolio execution.
jobs.description:
ServiceNow is seeking a Partner Technology Architect — Autonomous Workforce to drive partner growth across the AI-powered workflows that run the modern enterprise — IT service and operations management, employee experience, and strategic portfolio execution. This is a senior technical strategist role that combines deep technical expertise in ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, HR Service Delivery (HRSD), and Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) with business acumen, partner activation at scale, and the ability to translate complex service-operations and employee-experience requirements into commercially viable solutions. As a Practice-aligned Partner Technology Architect within the Autonomous Workforce Practice, you will be engaged where deep IT, operations, and employee workflow expertise is required — working alongside partner-aligned Partner Technology Architects and Partner Solution Engineers.

The Autonomous Workforce Practice sits at the core of ServiceNow’s platform — the workflows where AI agents, automation, and human teams operate together to run IT and serve employees at scale. This role helps partners move beyond traditional, ticket-driven service models to an AI-native operating model where work is detected, routed, and resolved autonomously, ensuring partners can confidently position, build, and deliver differentiated solutions that displace legacy platforms and drive measurable operational outcomes.

What You’ll Do

As a Partner Technology Architect — Autonomous Workforce, you will serve as the go-to IT, operations, and employee workflow expert across the partner ecosystem, driving technical excellence, competitive differentiation, and commercial success for autonomous-workforce partner solutions.

Autonomous Workforce Co-Innovation & Technology Strategy

  • Co-create autonomous-operations architectures with partners, developing reference architectures for IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), and industry-specific operational workflows.
  • Drive collaborative adoption of AI-enhanced capabilities including AI Agents for employee and IT self-service, autonomous incident resolution, predictive operations and AIOps analytics, and automated change and remediation.
  • Build reusable co-innovation assets including solution templates, industry-specific accelerators, demo environments, and operational workflow blueprints.
  • Provide specialized expertise in employee experience architectures, including Employee Center design, virtual agent configuration, and cross-workflow orchestration across IT, HR, and operations.
  • Influence ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, and SPM product architecture and roadmap based on partner ecosystem needs; represent partner voice in internal Autonomous Workforce strategy forums.

Pipeline & Revenue Growth

  • Lead technical workshops with partners and engage directly with CIO, VP of IT Operations, and CHRO stakeholders to co-design autonomous-workforce solutions.
  • Execute strategic proofs of concept demonstrating incident and ticket reduction, deflection, operational cost reduction, and employee productivity acceleration.
  • Guide partners on competitive positioning against legacy ITSM and ITOM platforms (BMC Helix, Atlassian Jira Service Management, Ivanti, Microsoft) and articulate ServiceNow’s AI-native, single-platform differentiation.
  • Present ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, and SPM architecture and industry-specific operational strategies to executive audiences.

Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Scale

  • Design and deliver comprehensive Autonomous Workforce architecture training programs, workshops, and executive briefings that build lasting partner capability.
  • Mentor partner architects and pre-sales teams on ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, and SPM solution positioning, competitive differentiation, and industry-specific operational patterns.
  • Assess partner technical capabilities across IT and employee workflows and identify gaps; develop practice-specific capability maturation plans and certification pathways.
  • Represent ServiceNow Autonomous Workforce innovation at industry events and IT and HR transformation forums; contribute to thought leadership content.

Business Growth & Value Realization

  • Collaborate with partner-aligned Partner Technology Architects on Autonomous Workforce joint business planning.
  • Guide partners from concept to validated solution to scalable commercialization with clear monetization pathways.
  • Connect operational architecture to measurable business outcomes (mean time to resolution, deflection rate, operational cost reduction, employee productivity).

Autonomous Workforce Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy

  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of the ITSM, ITOM, and employee-service landscape including BMC Helix, Atlassian Jira Service Management, Ivanti, Microsoft, Freshservice, and emerging platforms.
  • Advise partners on coexistence and migration strategies for customers transitioning from legacy ITSM and ITOM platforms.
  • Monitor industry-specific adoption patterns across IT and employee workflows and translate market intelligence into partner-relevant insights.

To be successful in this role you have:

Required:

  • 8+ years pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting experience with proven success in ITSM, ITOM, employee experience, or enterprise service management solutions.
  • 5+ years deep domain expertise in IT service management, IT operations, HR service delivery, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.
  • Expert-level knowledge of service and operations architectures including incident, problem, and change management, CMDB/CSDM, event management and AIOps, knowledge management, and employee self-service.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the competitive landscape including BMC, Atlassian, Ivanti, Microsoft, and emerging enterprise service management platforms.
  • Deep expertise in IT or employee experience transformation for at least two industry verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Telecommunications, Public Sector).
  • Proven experience engaging with CIO, IT operations, and CHRO executives and articulating operational transformation strategies to diverse audiences.
  • Experience working with partner ecosystems (GSIs, SIs, ISVs) and understanding partner business models and co-selling dynamics.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled operations use cases including virtual agents, autonomous incident resolution, predictive analytics, AIOps, and automated remediation workflows.
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.
  • Travel for partner, customer, and organizational activities up to 25%.

What This Role Does Not Do

Perform platform configuration, development, or solution delivery. Own commercial contracts, pricing, or financial program management. Replace partner-aligned Partner Technology Architects for holistic partner strategy (works in partnership as a domain specialist). Manage day-to-day partner relationships (coordinates with Partner Management). Own product management or roadmap decisions for ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, or SPM (provides field and partner input to product teams).

Preferred & Standout Experience:

Experience with ServiceNow IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, HR Service Delivery, and/or Strategic Portfolio Management. ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CIS-ITSM, CIS-Discovery, CIS-Event Management, CIS-HR, CSA) or equivalent platform certifications. Experience with competitive platforms (BMC Helix, Jira Service Management, Ivanti) enabling credible competitive positioning. Background in IT operations strategy consulting, service management transformation, or employee experience design. Industry experience in Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Telecommunications, or Public Sector.

Position Overview

HCO Behavioral Health Services and Elevate Healthcare Group are seeking compassionate, professionally trained Board Certified Christian Counselors (BCCC) to provide high-quality, Christ-centered counseling services through our growing faith-based counseling program.

This opportunity is designed for counselors who are passionate about integrating Biblical truth with sound counseling principles to help individuals, couples, families, and adolescents navigate life's emotional, relational, and spiritual challenges.

Providers have the flexibility to create their own schedules while delivering counseling services through our secure telehealth platform.

IMPORTANT – Certification Requirement

Please read before applying.

This position requires current Board Certification in Christian Counseling through a nationally recognized certifying organization.

Examples include, but are not limited to:

  • National Christian Counselors Association (NCCA)
  • American Association of Christian Counselors (AACC) Board Certification Program
  • Other nationally recognized Christian counseling certification organizations

This certification is required.

Pastoral experience, ministry leadership, seminary education, discipleship, mentoring, coaching, or church counseling does not substitute for Board Certification and does not satisfy the minimum qualifications for this position.

Applicants must be prepared to provide verification of their Board Certification during the hiring process.

HCO Behavioral Health Services and Elevate Healthcare Group are committed to expanding access to compassionate, high-quality behavioral healthcare that addresses the emotional, relational, and spiritual needs of those we serve.

Our faith-based counseling program provides clients with the opportunity to receive counseling that thoughtfully integrates Christian faith, Biblical principles, and professional counseling techniques while respecting each client's individual beliefs and preferences.

  • Assist clients with emotional, relational, marital, family, grief, anxiety, depression, life transition, and spiritual concerns.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans and counseling goals.
  • Maintain timely, accurate, and professional clinical documentation.
  • Collaborate with other providers and referral sources as appropriate.
  • Uphold ethical, professional, and Biblical standards of practice.
  • Participate in team meetings and ongoing professional development opportunities as requested.

  • Individual Counseling
  • Marriage Counseling
  • Premarital Counseling
  • Family Counseling
  • Parenting Support
  • Grief & Loss Counseling
  • Men's Counseling
  • Women's Counseling
  • Spiritual Growth & Life Direction
  • Anxiety & Stress Management
  • Depression Support
  • Life Transitions
  • Faith & Identity
  • Other faith-based counseling services

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants must possess:

  • Current Board Certification in Christian Counseling from a nationally recognized certifying organization
  • Excellent understanding of Biblical principles and their ethical integration into counseling
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Experience providing counseling, coaching, ministry care, or related helping services
  • Ability to provide services professionally through a telehealth platform
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills
  • Reliable internet connection and private workspace for virtual counseling

Preferred Qualifications

Preference may be given to candidates with:

  • Previous telehealth counseling experience
  • Experience working with couples and families

  • Graduate education in Counseling, Psychology, Theology, Divinity, Marriage & Family Therapy, Social Work, Pastoral Counseling, or related disciplines

Desired Characteristics

We're looking for professionals who are:

  • Deeply committed to Christian faith and Biblical truth
  • Compassionate and servant-hearted
  • Professional and ethically grounded
  • Excellent listeners
  • Strong communicators
  • Organized and dependable
  • Passionate about helping others experience emotional, relational, and spiritual healing

Why Join HCO & Elevate?

  • Meaningful opportunity to help individuals and families experience hope, healing, and transformation.

If you're a Board Certified Christian Counselor who is passionate about integrating Biblical truth with compassionate care, we'd love to hear from you.

Onwelo jest partnerem technologicznym, który dostarcza kompleksowe usługi, od strategii i architektury, przez wdrożenia, po utrzymanie, w obszarach transformacji cyfrowej, danych i automatyzacji. O projekcie

Poszukujemy Senior Agentic AI Engineera pod kątem klienta z branży healthcare. Celem jest stworzenie zaawansowanego, wieloagentowego rozwiązania AI, które będzie automatyzować proces analizy i wyjaśniania potencjału leadów biznesowych na podstawie danych pochodzących z wielu źródeł.

  • Projektowanie i budowa od podstaw wieloagentowego systemu AI (Agentic AI)

  • Tworzenie i orkiestracja agentów odpowiedzialnych za poszczególne etapy procesu analitycznego

  • Automatyzacja ekstrakcji, przetwarzania i integracji danych pochodzących z różnych źródeł zewnętrznych, . danych demograficznych, firmograficznych oraz informacji o zachowaniach użytkowników w sieci

  • Współpraca przy podejmowaniu decyzji architektonicznych dotyczących orkiestracji agentów, . z wykorzystaniem LangGraph lub AWS Step Functions

  • Znasz Python, HuggingFace, LangChain lub LlamaIndex, REST API i rozwiązania chmurowe (Azure, AWSAWS Bedrock i usługach chmurowych AWS lub GCP)

  • Pracujesz z dokumentami – potrafisz je czyścić, klasyfikować, wyciągać z nich kluczowe dane oraz automatyzować ich przetwarzanie

    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead Clinical Risk & Insights as a capability focused on Root Cause Analysis (RCA), systemic investigation, and clinical execution risk intelligence. Ensure significant, complex, recurring, and cross-portfolio issues generate clear executive insight, informed decisions, and sustained improvement. Set the GDO wide RCA approach and integrate systemic learning with portfolio risk intelligence, and the strategic direction of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM).


Responsibilities:

  • Set RCA methodology, investigation standards, guidance, and capability materials; lead complex investigations and coach teams to identify systemic causes and prevent recurrence.
  • Own triage and executive escalation of significant, complex, recurring, and cross-portfolio clinical execution issues; prioritize and direct RCA support.
  • Provide clinical risk insight, systemic learning, trend reports, and decision briefs to Management Review, the Clinical Trial Compliance Committee (CTCC), and CPSO leadership forums.
  • Challenge superficial root causes and ineffective CAPAs; recommend CAPA effectiveness actions, control redesign, intervention, or senior sponsorship when systemic clinical execution risk is identified.
  • Sponsor cross-functional improvement when system or control failures extend beyond one study or function; influence sustained change and embed risk-informed execution.
  • Sponsor the RBQM strategy and maturity roadmap, connecting systemic learning and portfolio risk intelligence with prospective risk identification and future study execution.
  • Lead and develop the department; set strategy and priorities, manage resources, budget, talent, and external expertise, and build organizational RCA capability.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

  • Clinical risk management or RBQM experience, including study risk assessments, mitigation strategies, Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Quality Tolerance Limits (QTLs).

  • Experience analyzing quality event, audit, inspection, and readiness trends; operational excellence, continuous improvement, or quality intelligence.

  • Experience with analytics, automation, or knowledge-management tools; budget, resource, and organizational capacity management.


What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.description:
Multilingual recruiting for Europe, from home, paid in euros per placement. Open to recruiters based in Alexandria and across Egypt.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

This is NOT for you if

  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

Development Consultant – US Market

Reporting To: Managing Director

Design

Anticipated Start Date: January 2027
Our client is a specialist recruitment and executive search business supporting clients across the United States.
They partner with leading organisations across commercial real estate, construction, property development, hospitality development, and design, helping them secure exceptional talent for senior leadership and specialist positions. Their client base includes commercial and multifamily developers, general contractors, hospitality developers, and design consultancies. With an established reputation, strong client relationships, and a growing portfolio of high-value recruitment assignments, we are entering an exciting phase of growth.
We are now looking for an experienced, ambitious, and commercially minded recruitment professional based in South Africa to work directly alongside our Managing Director and help accelerate our expansion across the US market.
The Opportunity
This is not a traditional recruitment resourcing role or an entry-level sales position.
We are looking for a confident and proactive Recruitment Business Development
Consultant who understands the recruitment industry, thrives on winning new business, and knows how to build meaningful relationships with senior decision-makers.
Your primary responsibility will be to identify new business opportunities, generate qualified client meetings, and create a consistent pipeline of recruitment assignments.
You will work closely with the Managing Director, who will support with senior-level client conversations, commercial negotiations, and closing new business. For someone with strong 360 recruitment experience, this is an opportunity to focus primarily on the commercial side of recruitment while remaining involved in candidate-led business development and selected recruitment activities. You will have direct exposure to the growth of the business, significant autonomy, and the opportunity to earn uncapped commission based on the business you help generate.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & New Client Acquisition
  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients across the US construction, real estate development, hospitality development, and design sectors.
  • Generate new business opportunities through targeted cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and multichannel prospecting campaigns.
  • Consistently secure qualified meetings with hiring managers, business owners, directors, and senior executives.
  • Build relationships with decision-makers, including CEOs, Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, HR Directors, and Talent Acquisition leaders.
  • Identify live recruitment vacancies and upcoming hiring requirements.
  • Introduce Serenity Recruitment Group's executive search and recruitment solutions to prospective clients.
  • Maintain a consistent pipeline of new business opportunities, ensuring regular weekly meeting generation.
  • Partner closely with the Managing Director to convert qualified opportunities into active recruitment assignments.
2. Strategic Candidate-Led Business Development
  • Use your recruitment knowledge to identify commercial opportunities through conversations with senior-level candidates.
  • Proactively market high-calibre candidate profiles to relevant prospective clients.
  • Identify potential hiring requirements within companies represented by candidates in your network.
  • Build relationships with candidates who may also be hiring managers or senior decision-makers.
  • Support speculative candidate introductions to create opportunities for new recruitment assignments.
  • Recognise opportunities to develop both candidate and client relationships through the same conversation.
3. Outbound Prospecting & Campaign Management
  • Execute structured outbound business development campaigns targeting relevant US companies.
  • Use LinkedIn Recruiter, Bullhorn, Apollo, and AI-assisted tools to identify prospects, decision-makers, and live vacancies.
  • Research companies, hiring trends, and recruitment opportunities within target industries.
  • Build and manage targeted prospect lists.
  • Personalise outreach through telephone calls, email, LinkedIn, and other appropriate channels.
  • Work with established AI-supported prospecting workflows to improve outreach efficiency.
  • Maintain a high level of daily outbound activity, with an indicative target of 100+ calls per day.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects to turn initial conversations into qualified meetings.\
4. CRM & Pipeline Management
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospecting activity, client interactions, and new business opportunities within Bullhorn.
  • Support the organisation and improvement of existing CRM data and workflows.
  • Track outreach campaigns, follow-ups, client meetings, and potential recruitment assignments.
  • Ensure a structured approach to pipeline management and business development reporting.
  • Provide regular updates to the Managing Director on activity, progress, opportunities, and results.
5. Commercial Collaboration & Business Growth
  • Work directly with the Managing Director to identify priority accounts and growth opportunities.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations to strengthen business development strategies.
  • Take ownership of your daily activity, prospecting pipeline, and follow-up processes.
  • Support candidate introductions and recruitment delivery where commercially valuable.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the US executive recruitment market and the industries served.
  • Become a trusted commercial partner who can contribute meaningfully to the long-term growth of Serenity Recruitment Group.
Highly Desirable
  • Experience recruiting within construction, commercial real estate, property development, architecture, engineering, or design.
  • Previous exposure to executive search, retained search, or senior-level permanent recruitment.
  • Experience engaging US-based C-suite executives, senior hiring managers, and business owners.
  • Hands-on experience using Bullhorn, LinkedIn Recruiter, Apollo, or similar recruitment and prospecting platforms.
  • Experience using AI-assisted research, prospecting, and outreach tools.
  • A track record of independently generating new recruitment clients and securing recruitment assignments.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role will be measured by both consistent commercial activity and the quality of business opportunities generated.
Key performance indicators will include:
  • Consistent daily outbound prospecting activity, targeting approximately 100+ calls per day.
  • Qualified new business meetings booked with relevant US decision-makers each week.
  • New recruitment vacancies and assignments generated.
  • Quality and growth of the prospective client pipeline.
  • Effective follow-up and conversion of leads into meaningful commercial conversations.
  • Accurate and consistent CRM management.
  • Contribution to new client wins and successful recruitment placements.
We understand that building strong commercial relationships takes time. We value consistent effort, quality engagement, accountability, and a proactive approach to generating results.
The Person We're Looking For
We are looking for someone who brings energy, confidence, and genuine commercial ambition to their work.
You are comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with people you have never spoken to before, and finding opportunities where others might not see them. You don't need to be micromanaged. You take ownership of your responsibilities, manage your time effectively, and understand the importance of consistent activity in building a successful recruitment business. You are resilient when conversations don't go your way, persistent in your follow-ups, and confident enough to challenge ideas, ask questions, and contribute your own. Most importantly, you are excited about the opportunity to work closely with an entrepreneurial Managing Director, make a measurable impact on business growth, and be rewarded for your contribution.
If you're an experienced recruitment professional who enjoys winning business, building relationships, and turning conversations into commercial opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

Requirements

Experience & Requirements
Essential
  • Proven experience within agency recruitment, ideally in a 360 Recruitment
Consultant, Recruitment Business Development, or Senior Recruitment Consultant capacity.
  • Demonstrable experience in outbound business development, cold calling, lead generation, and client acquisition.
  • Experience working with the US recruitment market, including communicating with US clients and decision-makers.
  • Confidence engaging senior stakeholders and conducting professional, commercially focused conversations.
  • A strong understanding of recruitment processes, client development, candidate marketing, and vacancy generation.
  • Ability to work independently, manage a busy pipeline, and consistently deliver against activity targets.

This includes building systems that allow our donors to experience personalized causes that they can champion and help them become more consistent in their giving journey. You will also work on AI-based fraud detection and risk-scoring systems to protect our giving community. You’ll own problems end-to-end, framing them mathematically, working with large-scale donor and transaction data, training and evaluating models, and deploying them as reliable, low-latency production services.   • Help donors become the best version of themselves by helping them realize their desire to become more consistent in their giving.
  • Own the production reliability and quality of our models.

To be successful in this role, you’ll also:

  • Research and prototype computational, statistical, and AI models on real-world donor datasets for various real-world problems.
  • Productize machine learning systems that can generate personalized recommendations for our Donors and help champion their giving journey.
  • Build AI systems that can consume vast amounts of real-time data to a diverse class of problems from Engineering Reliability to Fraud Prevention.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to own Tailscale's networking features — the layer that decides how traffic finds its destination by name on top of Tailscale’s seamless mesh connectivity solution. Concretely, you will own four feature sets: App Connectors, DNS, Funnel, and Tailscale Serve & Services.

A tailnet gives every device an identity and an address. Networking features are what turn addresses into something a person, a script, or an AI agent can actually use — a name, a service, an app, a URL.

  • App Connectors route traffic to specific SaaS and private applications by name, so access follows the app rather than the IP.
  • DNS — MagicDNS, split DNS, custom name servers, search domains
  • Tailscale Serve & Services make a workload — not a machine — the unit of connectivity and access: addressable, load-balanced, and durable across the instances behind it. This is the wedge that lets customers replace a service registry, and eventually much of what they use a service mesh for, with Tailscale.
  • Funnel is Tailscale's ingress story: securely exposing a Service running inside the tailnet to the public internet, from a hobbyist sharing a dev server to production webhooks and public endpoints.

This is the most user-visible role in Tailscale's Dataplane Platform, and the work is as much product design as it is networking. DNS settings, connector topologies, and service definitions are configured by network engineers and IT admins in the admin console, API, and CLI, and the distance between "magical" and "unusable" is the object model, the defaults, and the error messages.

See How Tailscale Works, Tailscale Funnel, and Four ways to Tailscale a service to learn more.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Tailscale's networking features: App Connectors, DNS, Funnel, and Tailscale Services
  • Own the operator experience across these surfaces: how network engineers and IT admins configure, segment, monitor, and troubleshoot them at scale, in both the admin console and the CLI
  • Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering on production commitments and strategic deals, and champion the migration path from reverse proxies, bastion hosts, cloud ingress, and service meshes to Tailscale
  • Build systematic customer insight across the full spread of Tailscale users, from a homelab operator exposing a media server through Funnel to a large enterprise replacing its service registry

Security Tooling Ownership

Administer, configure, and tune the organization's security platforms, including endpoint and cloud protection, SIEM and managed detection and response (MDR), vulnerability and attack surface management, application security, and email security. Maintain tool health and coverage: onboarding, agent and sensor deployment, tooling maintenance, licensing use, integrations, and gap reports against the asset inventory. Assist with the technical relationship with vendors, including the managed detection and response (MDR) provider, and keep escalation paths and playbooks current. Automate repetitive work to cut analyst toil and configuration drift.

Incident Response & Detection Engineering

Act as a lead incident responder during Priority 1–2 incidents. Support the security analyst(s) and the MDR provider's SOC with tickets during volume surges; tune alerts and write response playbooks and automation for common alert types. Measure detection quality: coverage by ATT&CK technique, false positive rate, and alert-to-incident ratio; run purple-team or atomic tests to validate rules. Turn post-incident findings into new detections within an agreed time of closing the incident.

Security Projects

Serve as technical lead for security roadmap initiatives across areas such as data protection, identity and access hardening, network and IT/OT segmentation, cloud security posture, and controls for emerging technologies, including AI tools. Write designs, build and test changes, and hand off operational runbooks; follow the Change Management Plan. Support PCI DSS technical controls with evidence the GRC Analyst can assess independently.

Other duties as assigned.

Hands-on production experience with enterprise XDR/EDR, identity and access management, and endpoint management platforms, and with SIEM/XDR query languages (e.g., KQL, SPL, or similar). Scripting or automation skills (PowerShell or Python); comfort with APIs. Practical incident response experience and working knowledge of NIST SP 800-61 and MITRE ATT&CK. Technical leadership and mentoring experience.

Preferred

Industry security certifications such as CompTIA CySA+, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA), or vendor credentials including AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Cisco CCNP Security, CrowdStrike CCFR, Microsoft SC-200/SC-500, Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Analyst, or equivalent. Experience with data loss prevention (DLP), vulnerability management programs, or application security tooling. Familiarity with PCI DSS technical requirements and with OT or ICS environments.

Soft Skills

Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset. Ability to communicate complex technical and security concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Composure and sound judgment under pressure during high-severity incidents. Collaborative and proactive attitude with a focus on continuous improvement. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). 5+ years in security engineering, security operations, or detection engineering.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment:

Remote position; work is performed primarily at a computer in a home-office setting with a reliable, secure internet connection. Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use. Must be available for after-hours and weekend response during Priority 1–2 security incidents and scheduled maintenance windows. Occasional travel to Herff Jones facilities may be required.

We're looking for a talented, motivated, smart individual with a passion for software engineering, a strong desire to learn and an interest in providing mentorship to junior level developers. Engagement Specialist

Role & Compensation Details

  • 💰 Salary: $1,800 USD base salary + commissions (Target OTE: $2,800 – $3,000 USD/month upon hitting targets)

  • 📍 Location:Remote from Latin America

  • 💵 Payment Schedule: Bi-weekly base payments

About Our Client

Latino Legends partners with innovative U.S. companies to connect top-tier Latin American talent with long-term, high-growth opportunities.

We are currently recruiting for an Engagement Specialist on behalf of our client—a vertically integrated U.S. real estate investment owner, operator, and prop-tech developer. Operating workforce apartment communities across the Southeast U.S., they build and implement proprietary AI-powered operational systems for their own portfolio as well as third-party real estate operators. They operate as an AI-first organization, leveraging technology and automation across every level of their business to maximize results. Their Mexico City office brings together investments, technology, and sales teams to work side by side.

Core Values

Our client hires, develops, and promotes based on these six core values:

  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen): Practice continuous improvement. Never settle, figure it out, and get 1% better every day.

  • High Integrity: Do what you say. Own your wins and your losses.

  • Discipline: Be purposeful, thoughtful, and diligent in everything you take on.

  • Build to Last: Take the long view—optimize decisions for 10–15 year outcomes.

  • Connection: Build genuine relationships that earn trust and respect with residents, investors, clients, and teammates.

  • All In, All Out: Work hard, play hard. Bring full energy and commitment every day.

Position Overview

As the Engagement Specialist, you serve as the first point of contact for every prospective partner and client. You own the complete initial funnel—from the moment a prospect notices the brand to the moment they are on the calendar for a qualification call.

Prospects engage through podcasts, webinars, social posts, live events, and direct outreach. Your mission is to reach out rapidly, spark genuine conversations, and book qualified prospects for portfolio analysis calls ("Punch List" reviews). Following meetings, you ensure NDAs and property data are collected promptly to keep operations moving on schedule. You will leverage scripts, workflows, and cutting-edge AI tools with urgency and discipline. This seat is built for growth—top performers routinely transition into direct sales roles.

Primary Relationships

  • Reports to: GTM & Partnerships Lead

  • Supports: Company Principals running portfolio analysis calls (prepares background briefs for every call).

  • Collaborates with: Content Manager (who logs social media engagement into HubSpot) and internal Investment/Technology teams.

  • External Engagement: Builds authentic relationships with property owners, operators, podcast guests, and their executive teams.

Essential Responsibilities

1. Speed to Lead & Engagement

  • Reply to every inbound lead, warm introduction, and positive response within one business hour.

  • Execute daily engagement outreach by messaging qualified ideal client profiles who like, comment on, or share content.

  • Run structured LinkedIn and email cadences; log all interactions in HubSpot the same day.

  • Follow up with webinar attendees fitting the target client profile within 48 hours.

  • Coordinate post-interview sharing kits for podcast guests while requesting referrals and reviews.

2. Meeting Generation & Qualification

  • Qualify each prospect against strict client profile standards prior to scheduling.

  • Book qualification calls, confirm appointments, and take ownership of meeting show rates.

  • Prepare brief briefing notes for call hosts prior to each scheduled meeting.

  • Nurture non-qualified leads by routing them to educational resources (podcasts, newsletters, webinars) for future follow-up.

3. Pipeline Management

  • Immediately issue NDAs and data requests once a prospect agrees to a portfolio analysis call.

  • Track document and data collection via persistent email and phone follow-up.

  • Escalate uncollected data to the GTM & Partnerships Lead if pending beyond 5 business days.

4. CRM Operations & Performance Tracking

  • Maintain total data hygiene in HubSpot: ensure every contact has an accurate source and open deals have documented next steps.

  • Record call outcomes and pipeline stage updates the same day they occur.

  • Review daily performance metrics (reply time, conversations started, meetings held, show rates, data collection turnarounds).

  • Participate in Call Lab (the internal training program), actively taking feedback within 24 hours to refine sales execution.

Who You Are

  • Fast & Relentless: You act with urgency—answering communications today, not tomorrow.

  • Accountable: You own your conversion numbers without making excuses.

  • Curious & Authentic: You build real human connections instead of relying on generic templates.

  • Disciplined Communicator: You possess excellent written and spoken English skills and feel comfortable communicating on phone/video with senior real estate executives.

  • Tech-Forward: You are eager to use AI tools to work smarter and view this role as a stepping stone into a long-term sales career.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 1–3 years in sales development (SDR), inside sales, client success, or outbound business-to-business (B2B) communications.

  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English required (Spanish fluency is a plus).

  • Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with CRMs (preferably HubSpot), LinkedIn, email automation, and scheduling platforms. Familiarity with AI tools is highly preferred.

  • Industry Interest: Interest in real estate, finance, or prop-tech (prior industry experience is a plus, but not required).

  • Equipment: Must have a personal laptop/computer (BYOD) for daily work.

  • Pre-Hire Assessment: All candidates complete a Culture Index survey prior to the first interview to evaluate role alignment.

  • Travel: Occasional travel to U.S. industry conferences or events may be required (1–2 times per year).

Onboarding & Performance Framework

Before your start date, you will receive a structured 30/60/90-Day Plan covering script mastery, system training in Call Lab, live call shadowing, and deep dives into core values. Performance is measured using clear metrics reviewed daily with your direct manager.

jobs.title: Commission-Based Recruiter – Multilingual Roles in Europe – Mexico City
jobs.excerpt: Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement.
jobs.description:
Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement. Your own hours, your own methods. Open to recruiters based in Mexico City and across Mexico.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • A direct line to us for any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.title: Freelance Recruiter – Commission Only (€400–2,400 per placement) – Noida
jobs.excerpt: If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Noida and across India.

Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

This is NOT for you if

  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
jobs.excerpt: Mozilla Foundationis a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.
jobs.description:
Mozilla Foundationis a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!

Team

Our CEO is increasingly focused outward on the Board, funders, partners, and public conversations that will shape the Foundation’s next chapter. This newly created Chief of Staff role exists to extend the CEO’s reach inside the organization and make that outward focus possible.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, internal proxy and trusted extension of their leadership. You’ll hold the CEO’s strategic agenda, translate the CEO’s priorities into organizational alignment, represent the CEO internally where needed, and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within clearly delegated authority. You’ll determine what reaches the CEO, prepare the CEO for consequential moments, and escalate only what requires the CEO’s judgment.

As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you’ll partner strategically with other members of the ELT and work closely with the CEO’s Executive Program Manager to make sure the CEO’s time, priorities, and commitments stay aligned and moving.

You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding.

Job responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the first 6 months:

  • Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority.
  • Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working.
  • Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities.
  • Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which decisions are approaching.
  • Defining with the CEO what truly requires their attention, and ensuring issues reach them decision-ready, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Getting up to speed with the Investment Committee and its advisors, and helping keep their focus on the right questions so decisions move efficiently from evaluation to funding.

As the Chief of Staff to Mozilla Foundation’s CEO, you will…

  • Serve as the CEO’s thought partner in developing, pressure-testing and refining strategic priorities, synthesizing executive insight and external developments to anticipate what will need to be known or decided in the next 30, 60 and 90 days.
  • Direct the CEO’s time toward strategy, external relationships, development, Board leadership and the Foundation’s highest-consequence decisions.
  • Filter rather than forward, so significant shifts in strategy, material risks, major budget decisions and Board-level matters reach the CEO early, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Maintain a current view of the CEO’s top priorities, identify where work is drifting from strategic intent, and surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention before they become emergencies.
  • Enable the Executive Leadership Team to operate as one team around the CEO’s priorities, so the right issues reach the ELT at the right level and decisions and commitments are followed through.
  • Partner with ELT members on cross-functional issues that need CEO-level alignment but not the CEO’s direct involvement.
  • Represent the CEO’s position in internal discussions and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within delegated authority, bringing anything beyond it back to the CEO promptly.
  • Ensure the CEO enters every Board meeting, funder and partner conversation, speech and public engagement fully prepared, with concise briefings, organizational context and answers to likely questions.
  • Identify external opportunities that warrant the CEO’s attention, and ensure commitments the CEO makes externally translate into clear internal follow-through.
  • Steward alignment between the Investment Committee’s work and the Foundation’s strategy: keep its technical and strategic advisors focused on the right questions, surface gaps, risks or competing views, and bring forward matters that need the CEO’s judgment.

What this role is not

This is a role of influence. It exists to ensure the CEO can lead effectively through the Executive Leadership Team.

  • The Chief of Staff does not manage the Executive Leadership Team or run the Foundation’s operations. Each executive leader owns execution and decisions within their area.
  • This role does not make decisions beyond the authority the CEO has delegated. Anything outside that authority returns to the CEO.
  • This role does not have any direct reports and also doesn’t manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling or administrative support.

Your Professional Profile

  • Significant, verifiable experience as a strategic partner at CEO or executive-team level, with a track record of leading high-stakes work and turning ambiguity into structure and action.
  • Experience working across multiple legal entities is a plus, including navigating differences, building influence, and coordinating work across entities where relevant.
  • A proven record of driving complex, cross-functional priorities from idea to execution by defining outcomes, ownership, milestones and decision points.
  • Exceptional judgment and discretion, including handling confidential information and navigating complex executive dynamics with integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and at the most senior levels, and give direct feedback with care.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, with experience distilling complex information into decision-ready briefs, recommendations, presentations and executive communications.
  • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills: you frame the right question, gather the right information, test assumptions and recommend a practical path forward.
  • Disciplined prioritization, with the agility to move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues without losing the thread.
  • Direct experience supporting Board governance, fundraising or other high-stakes external relationships at an executive level.
  • A track record of doing high-impact work out of the spotlight, measuring your success by the CEO’s and the team’s, and acting in the best interests of the CEO and the organization.
  • A demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation’s mission and to building an open, accessible and trustworthy internet.
  • The ability to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard working hours for Board meetings, major events or urgent organizational needs.
  • Comfortable traveling for Board meetings, leadership gatherings and major events.

We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With:

  • Senior roles in nonprofit, philanthropic, technology or public-interest organizations.
  • Supporting or advising investment, grantmaking or funding committees.

How We Work

A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role:

  • Move toward the hard thing: you surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention early, and give the CEO and executives direct, actionable input, including what they may not want to hear. You disagree constructively in the room, not afterward, and you don’t wait for someone else to raise it.
  • Stay curious and current: you stay close to what executives are seeing and what’s happening in our fields and communities, and turn it into the context the CEO needs. You pressure-test assumptions, including your own.
  • Work in the open: you document decisions and the reasoning behind them, so executives and teams can follow how and why priorities are set. You favor shared channels over side conversations wherever appropriate.
  • Focus and finish: you keep the CEO’s agenda focused on what matters most, make deliberate choices about what does and doesn’t need the CEO, and make sure decisions and commitments are seen through.
  • Flex with purpose: you move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues as context shifts, and adapt how you work with each executive. Flexibility isn’t about being agreeable; it’s staying responsive while holding to the mission and the CEO’s priorities.
  • Lead with care: you hold a high bar for the work while treating people as whole humans. You extend good faith to fellow executives, respect that each owns their area, and talk directly to the person who can solve the problem.

Salary and Benefits Information

Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.

The starting salary ranges for this role are listed below.

  • Germany: €206,448.00 – €232,253.22
  • UK: £181,764.00 – £204,483.81
  • Canada: $356,400.00 – $400,948.65
  • US: $264,000.00 – $296,999.00

We also offer the following benefits:

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Extended Sick Leave
  • Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement Plan contributions
  • Paid Time Off: 20 days annual leave + sick days and your birthday
  • Company Holidays + EOY Shutdown
  • Wellness budget
  • Professional Development budget
  • Top up program for Pregnancy and Parental leaves

Benefits are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Mozilla Foundation.

Mozilla Foundation Hiring Practices

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation at .

O projeto reúne frentes de negócio como fiscal, financeiro, qualidade e vendas sobre uma mesma fundação de dados.

Você fará parte de uma squad multidisciplinar, ao lado de arquitetura e ciência de dados, e será responsável por transformar dados de sistemas corporativos e planilhas em camadas confiáveis, prontas para análises, modelos de IA e painéis.

  • Construir e manter pipelines de ingestão de dados a partir de ERPs, sistemas de qualidade e produção, portais, planilhas e fontes externas.

  • Modelar entidades de negócio e cadastros compartilhados (como cliente, produto e terceiros) e apoiar a camada semântica que alimenta os painéis.

  • Versionar código e conduzir deploys entre os ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.
  • Monitorar a execução dos pipelines e corrigir falhas, buscando uma operação sem intervenção manual.
  • Documentar pipelines, modelos de dados e decisões técnicas, e apoiar a capacitação do time do cliente na entrega final.
  • Participar das revisões semanais e validar entregas com as áreas de negócio.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência de 3 anos ou mais com Google Cloud, em especial BigQuery e Cloud Storage.
  • Experiência de 3 anos ou mais com orquestração de pipelines em Apache Airflow.
  • Domínio de SQL e de modelagem de dados analítica, com 5 anos ou mais de experiência.
  • Programação em Python para construção de pipelines de dados, com 4 anos ou mais de experiência.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Medalhão (Bronze, Silver e Gold).
  • Experiência em integração de dados de múltiplas origens, como ERPs, APIs, arquivos e planilhas.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com extração de dados de ERPs corporativos.

  • Experiência em preparar dados para modelos de machine learning.

  • Colaboração e transparência no trabalho remoto.

  • Google Cloud (BigQuery e Cloud Storage)

jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Overview:

Forbes Health is looking for a content creator who lives and breathes the peptides, longevity and emerging science spaces for a hybrid role that encompasses writing, building science-based ratings and testing protocols, and creating video content.

Who you are: You have writing experience and have created videos for a health-based audience. You have experience testing health and wellness products and/or designing and overseeing product-testing protocols, including laboratory testing where appropriate. And you have deep firsthand knowledge of how consumers navigate longevity products and services from discovery and onboarding through testing, follow-up, refills and billing.

As Longevity Content Creator, you'll own the strategic vision, testing, ideation and execution for Forbes Health’s ranking and data products spanning longevity and wellness products. We’re looking for candidates who know the ins and outs of peptides, hormone replacement, TRT, supplements and other emerging sciences to create and write reviews and best ofs.

You’ve established yourself in the peptides, longevity or supplements space and know the industry players, communities and consumer pain points. You know what is worth a reader’s time -- and what isn’t -- and you can explain why using evidence, testing and transparent methodologies.

Who we are: The Forbes Health editorial team boasts decades of experience in the health and wellness space. We’re passionate about helping readers achieve optimal wellness through peace of mind, physical fitness, nutritional balance and healthy aging. We prioritize quality research, deep expertise and strict methodologies in the coverage, reviews and guidance we provide.

Responsibilities:

  • Pitch and create content, such as first-person stories, reviews, product rankings, videos, podcasts and newsletters, with the intention of informing readers about the best wellness products available to them
  • Follow the research, know the providers and communities, and pre-emptively spot and pitch useful articles, videos and social posts based on your own industry knowledge
  • Create defensible methodologies used to rate and rank wellness products, including peptides, TRT, HRT, hair loss supplements and more. You’ll define research and data collection requirements for longevity and wellness categories, including product testing, surveys, consumer research, scenario modeling and other proprietary data initiatives, then partner with product testing, data and research teams to ensure methodologies are supported by high-quality scientific evidence.
  • Work with stakeholders to determine content priorities
  • Create video content for social that shows and builds upon your expertise and passion in your areas of expertise
  • Serve as an internal and external expert on longevity and wellness topics
  • Utilize workflow processes to ensure other stakeholders are aware of projects and priorities.

Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of the wellness and supplements industries. The ideal candidate will know the major providers, compounds, controversies and online communities
  • Demonstrated passion for longevity products and emerging wellness industries: Tell readers what they need to know about this space and why it matters to the community
  • Experience testing or building testing protocols
  • Can separate beliefs from evidence and turn that knowledge into journalism
  • Meaningful, engaged social presence in the peptide, TRT, HRT or longevity space. You don't need to be an influencer, but you should demonstrate that you understand the conversation happening outside traditional health media
  • Ability to tackle a lengthy list of priorities on deadline but also be able to pivot when those priorities shift
  • You’re comfortable challenging provider claims, questioning the evidence behind popular interventions and changing your view when the evidence changes. In this role, you’ll be tasked with distinguishing between research, claims and personal experience, and you’ll need the ability to stand behind and explain your recommendations to an internal and external audience
  • You work well remotely. This is a full-time remote position

MZ Wallace is an independent, women-led company launched in New York City in 2000 by Monica Zwirner and Lucy Wallace Eustice.
