Le poste

2027 commence chez Ofelia par une vague de recrutements stratégiques. Avec le lancement d’Ofelia agentic, nous renforçons nos équipes sur des profils techs et non techs.

Dans le cadre d’un remplacement de congé maternité, tu prends en main le recrutement et le développement RH de l’entreprise.

Tu pilotes chaque recrutement de bout en bout, du brief avec le manager jusqu’à la signature du contrat. Tu mènes les entretiens professionnels, fais avancer le plan de développement des compétences et tu soignes l’intégration des nouvelles recrues. Tu coordonnes aussi nos engagements RSE, du questionnaire ESG au rapport annuel.

Les process sont en place. Ton rôle est de les faire vivre sans perdre le rythme et d’apporter ton regard là où nos pratiques méritent d’évoluer. Tu travailles avec tous les managers, sur des postes tech exigeants, dans une entreprise qui utilise l’IA au quotidien.

Chaque recrutement que tu signes façonne l’Ofelia de demain.

À propos d’Ofelia

Ofelia (anciennement Bonitasoft) réinvente la façon dont les organisations pilotent leurs processus métier. Notre plateforme d’orchestration native IA transforme chaque processus en une expérience fluide et conversationnelle, portée par des agents intelligents et gouvernés. Plutôt que de naviguer dans des outils complexes, les équipes métier et IT interagissent naturellement avec leurs processus, pendant que les agents se chargent de l’exécution, dans le cadre des règles fixées par l’organisation. L’innovation et l’IA sont au cœur de tout ce que nous construisons, pour que les équipes automatisent ce qui compte, sans complexité, sans friction.

Mode de travail

Tu travailles avec Erwan (DRH), qui porte la stratégie RH, et avec les managers et référents de chaque domaine (sécurité, finance, marketing). Chacun apporte son expertise, et c’est toi qui fais le lien.

  • Tu fais avancer tes dossiers en autonomie et organises ton planning en fonction des priorités de ton activité et de l’organisation.

  • Tu challenges les managers dès le brief et poses avec eux un besoin réaliste.

  • Tu t’appuies sur l’IA et sur nos outils pour produire vite sans rien sacrifier à la qualité.

Chez nous, la confiance vient avant le contrôle : l’autonomie est la règle et le soutien est là quand tu en as besoin.

Ton quotidien

  • Piloter les recrutements du job brief au contrat : paramétrage de l’ATS, publication des offres, sourcing, suivi du pipeline et conseil aux hiring managers jusqu’à la décision.

  • Sécuriser chaque embauche : rédaction des promesses d’embauche et des contrats, enregistrement et DPAE.

  • Construire avec les hiring managers les job descriptions, kits d’entretien et scorecards.

  • Faire vivre l’onboarding : lien avec les futures recrues avant leur arrivée, SIRH à jour, rapports d’étonnement, revues et entretiens de période d’essai.

  • Mener les entretiens professionnels arrivant à échéance et déployer le plan de développement des compétences 2027 : sessions, calendrier, communication, analyse des retours, dossiers OPCO Atlas et Action Collective.

  • Rédiger et publier le rapport RSE, coordonner la collecte de données ESG pour Fortino sur Apiday et tenir les reportings ISO et cybersécurité dans les délais.

  • Orchestrer les temps forts RH : performance reviews, publication de l’index Egapro, reporting cybersécurité trimestriel.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu as mené des recrutements de bout en bout dans une entreprise tech, principalement pour des contrats en CDI.

  • Tu as déjà mené des entretiens professionnels et piloté un plan de développement des compétences.

  • Tu avances en autonomie et organises ton planning dans un cadre remote, expérience en remote requise

  • Tu produis vite et bien grâce aux outils d’IA, que tu utilises déjà au quotidien.

  • Tu parles français couramment, et tu lis et rédiges l’anglais à un niveau professionnel.

Ce serait un plus

  • Une expérience dans le secteur de l’IA.

  • Une expérience du reporting RSE ou ESG.

Processus de recrutement

Un processus court et transparent, pensé pour respecter ton temps.

  1. Entretien de préqualification avec les RH (45 min)

  2. Entretien avec le DRH (1h)

  3. Prise de références

  4. Rencontre People Ops (30 min)

jobs.excerpt: The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications.
jobs.description:
The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications. As a part of this strategy, the FAM will provide on-going education to accounts regarding the Patient Services program, the regional payer landscape, and pharmacy channel access. The FAM will help coordinate pull-through efforts for patients who have been prescribed the product, irrespective of channel (HUB, specialty pharmacy, etc.), provided proper HIPAA consent has been secured from the patient. The FAM will be expected to be the primary face of the Patient Services platforms within designated HCP offices. The FAM is also responsible for partnering with internal and external stakeholders to optimize access to the product for patients.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Expand advocacy within HCP offices and equip the staff, through education, to navigate the access and payer approval process, identify access barriers that the HCP must act on to overcome, and highlight HCP actions that support patient access to therapy.
  • Offer educational resources to support the entire patient’s journey by optimizing processes for prior authorizations/appeals/specialty pharmacy and addressing access issues.
  • Coordinate utilization of the patient service platform to seamlessly support the customer and patient when office chooses the HUB or SP as their ideal path to approved therapy.
  • Coordinate annual pharmacy reauthorizations at designated accounts to ensure timely reauthorization and continuation of therapy is maintained.
  • Work cross functionally and collaboratively with partners in Sales, Market Access, Patient Services, Strategic Accounts and more to act as a process and payer expert. The FAM will help identify and address time sensitive market development and implementation efforts to remove access barriers to the product for appropriate patients, while optimizing adherence.
  • Build and execute a strategic business plan to meet the needs of top accounts and ensure successful implementation of market access initiatives.
  • Obtain and maintain knowledge and understanding of payer landscape, including specialty pharmacy and utilization management criteria, on a national, regional and local level so that you can act as a process and payer expert.
  • Continuously strive to understand the alignment of Payer/PBM/SP and how national/regional pharmacy drug formularies impact market access in their designated geography.
  • Assist in providing appropriate field insights to ensure support of all access and patient/payer support programs and resources offered by the company’s Patient Support Programs.
  • Anticipate, navigate and address individual account and patient access issues that arise by partnering with all appropriate stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • All other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements below represent the experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for this role.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Healthcare degree advantageous, including MS, RN, PA, PharmD, or similar advanced healthcare/scientific degree.
  • 10+ years in pharmaceutical industry with experience in payer policy and patient access.
  • 5+ years of experience in benefit verifications and/or prior-authorization requirements or equivalent experience in patient access.
  • Knowledge of Centers of Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) policies and processes with experience in Medicare Parts B & D.
  • Knowledge and understanding of specialty markets, HUB/reimbursement services and patient access programs.
  • Strong understanding of specialty product access/reimbursement processes including Patient Support Services programs.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess market dynamics, competitor activity, and continuous diabetes monitoring trends. Ability to gather and interpret data to guide regional strategy, including understanding the role of HUB and patient claims data.
  • Knowledge of Integrated Delivery Network/Integrated Health Systems.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft applications and the ability to conduct virtual engagements via Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills with a high level of initiative and independence.
  • Proven success in working in a cross functional environment.
  • Ability to conduct impactful educational presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of Veeva systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Advanced Degree preferred.
  • Pediatric Endocrinology and/or Endocrinology experience preferred.
  • Previous launch experience in Access/Reimbursement role
  • Previous experience in other functions within the biopharmaceutical industry a plus (e.g. product marketing, managed care, field sales, case management or large healthcare practice experience).

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded - I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight - I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action - I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Grow Talent - I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together - I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters - I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity - I create an environment of awareness and respect.

About Hipcamp

Every year, Hipcamp makes it possible for millions of people to spend the night under the stars, supporting rural economies and biodiversity along the way. Everything we do is guided by our belief that getting outside is good for the health of people and the environment. While we are best known for unlocking access to 5 million acres of private land for camping around the world, we have also emerged in the last couple years as the leader unifying our public and commercial campgrounds, creating the one app that has “everywhere you want to camp." We are backed by world class investors including A16Z, Benchmark, Bond Capital and Index Ventures.

About the role

Hipcamp is looking for two Senior Product Managers to join our product team across the two core areas of our marketplace: the camper experience, how millions of people discover and book trips outside, and the host experience, how landowners open their land to camping and earn from it. You'll lead a dedicated pod of engineering, design, and data, set the roadmap for your area, and be accountable for the results. This is a high-ownership role for a PM who stays close to users, makes decisions with data, and ships fast with AI as part of how they work.

What you'll do

  • Own the roadmap for your area of the marketplace: set priorities aligned with company strategy, make the tradeoffs and deliver results.
  • Lead a cross-functional pod of engineers, a designer and a data partner: run planning, set backlog priorities and keep the team focused and unblocked.
  • Build a deep understanding of campers or hosts through regular conversations, support tickets, reviews and research, and turn those insights into product decisions.
  • Set the goals and metrics for your area, and work with your data partner to run experiments, read the results and decide what to build next.
  • Work AI-first across everything you do: research, writing, data analysis, prototyping and improving how the team works. Bring the same thinking to the product, from trip discovery for campers to pricing and listing tools for hosts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Growth, Host Success, Supply Operations and Support to ship changes that move the business.
  • Collaborate with other product managers so changes on one side of the marketplace strengthen the other.

About you

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally at a consumer or marketplace company.
  • Experience at a startup or scale-up where you owned a product area end to end without a large PM organization around you.
  • Strong product sense and judgment: you turn user needs and data into clear decisions about what to build and why.
  • A track record of shipping with engineering and design and measuring the impact.
  • Fluency with experimentation and funnel metrics (conversion, activation, retention), and comfort pulling your own data
  • AI-native: tools like Claude and ChatGPT are part of how you research, write, analyze, prototype and get work done every day, and you keep finding new ways to use them.
  • Hungry to grow: you learn fast, take feedback well, stay steady when priorities shift and raise problems early.
  • A clear, concise communicator in writing and in person, comfortable working with a distributed team.
  • Passion for getting more people outside.

Nice to have

  • Experience with two-sided marketplaces: supply and demand dynamics, pricing, or trust and safety.
  • Background in travel, outdoor or hospitality products.

Compensation will be a mix of salary and stock options. It will be competitive compared to similar-stage companies and based on location.

Health is essential to happiness. In addition to full health insurance, all team members receive $1K in Hipcash because we believe getting outside is excellent preventative medicine in addition to increasing your creativity, lowering your stress, and making you an overall more awesome human.

We believe that clearly defined goals combined with great people, empowerment, and autonomy create the best results. We feel confident that inclusive and diverse teams working on an important cause can accomplish extraordinary things.

About the Role

Pearson is seeking an experienced Business Change Expert to join the Pearson Qualifications Transformation Programme. You will own the people side of change for one principal portfolio, working in lockstep with its Portfolio Lead and Product Manager to turn programme activity into a clear, practical and integrated change plan.

You will coordinate readiness, training and engagement, identify risks and barriers, monitor adoption and bring evidence back to the portfolio so the approach can be adjusted. Alongside delivery, you will help strengthen a thriving community of change practice by sharing best practice, challenging established approaches and supporting colleagues to improve.

This is an individual-contributor expert role. It does not include line management, but it requires credibility, influence and the ability to work through a complex matrix at pace.

  • Create practical mitigation plans and remove barriers that could affect delivery or adoption.

  • Strong experience as a change practitioner delivering complex, cross-functional transformation programmes.

  • Experience operating in a matrix and influencing senior and cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Director
jobs.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

The Director, Strategic Partnerships owns a vital piece of Human Interest's most important growth channel: expanding our ecosystem of partners who put our retirement platform in front of millions of small and medium-sized businesses. Reporting directly to the Head of Strategic Partnerships, you will source and land business partnerships across payroll providers, benefits brokers, accountants, financial institutions, PEOs, and embedded fintech distribution.

This is an individual-contributor role with a builder's mindset and a quota orientation. You will be responsible for signing complex, multi-year agreements with some of Human Interest’s largest and most important partners.

The role is equal parts strategist, dealmaker, and operator. You'll be just as comfortable modeling the economics of a new channel as you are in a room negotiating terms, and just as effective driving a deal across the finish line as you are shaping the partnership thesis with the CRO and the broader leadership team.

The person who thrives here is a natural hunter — energized by the pursuit of net-new relationships, comfortable opening doors cold, and relentless about carrying complex, multi-stakeholder deals through long sales cycles. You bring executive presence and the systems thinking to see how a single partnership fits into a broader distribution strategy. You read a term sheet and a partnership thesis with equal fluency, you make sharp prioritization calls about where to spend your time, and you carry deals with a sense of ownership. Above all, you are a builder: you're drawn to the ambiguity of standing up new channels from scratch, and you bring structure, pace, and judgment to a function that is still writing its own playbook.

About the team

The Partnerships organization is the engine behind Human Interest's reach, with over 95% of our business coming from our partner ecosystem. This team builds the relationships that let us scale access to retirement benefits far faster than we could one employer at a time. They think in systems and incentives: which partners share our mission, how we make those partners successful, and how we design programs that compound over time.
The team works shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Operations to establish and launch partnerships that are commercially sound, operationally clean, and genuinely good for the businesses we ultimately serve. As we continue to scale, we're looking for a leader who can take this function to its next level: bigger partners, deeper integrations, and a measurable line on the revenue plan.

What you get to do every day

  • Partnership Strategy: Shape and own the strategy for your portfolio of partnerships, prioritizing the channels, partner types, and deals that drive the highest-quality growth, in close partnership with the VP of Partnerships.
  • Sourcing & Closing: Identify, pursue, and close strategic partnerships across payroll, benefits brokers and advisors, financial institutions, PEOs, and embedded/distribution partners, personally leading the most complex negotiations.
  • Deal Structuring: Lead commercial negotiation and deal structuring end-to-end: economics, terms, integration scope, and go-to-market commitments, partnering with Legal and Finance to protect the business.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Product and Engineering to scope integrations; with Marketing to build co-marketing and enablement; and with Sales to operationalize partner-sourced demand.
  • Onboarding & Handoff to Partner Management: As the “hunter” who sources and closes the deal, own the partner relationship through signature and initial activation, then drive a clean, structured handoff to the Partner Management team. Equip them with the context, relationships, and commercial intent needed to nurture, grow, and steward the partnership over its lifecycle. A disciplined handoff keeps you focused on landing the next high-value relationship while ensuring nothing is lost in the transition from “hunting” to “farming.”
  • Executive Communication: Translate the partnership thesis, pipeline, and results into clear narratives for the VP of Partnerships and senior leadership, and represent Human Interest externally with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Market Intelligence: Maintain a sharp view of the retirement, payroll, fintech, and benefits landscape, surfacing competitive and regulatory shifts that should shape the partnership roadmap.
  • Other duties as needed.

What you bring to the role

  • Partnerships & Business Development Expertise: 10+ years in partnerships, business development, or channel sales, with a track record of personally owning and growing a book of strategic partnerships.
  • Proven Dealmaking: Demonstrated history of sourcing, structuring, and closing complex, high-value partnership and distribution agreements with measurable revenue impact.
  • Domain Fluency: Deep experience in fintech, retirement / wealth, payroll, benefits, or an adjacent financial-services ecosystem, with a working understanding of how these distribution channels actually buy and sell.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: A proven ability to mobilize Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Sales around a partnership without direct authority over those teams.
  • Executive Presence: Ability to negotiate with and present to senior executives, both internally and across partner organizations, with confidence and credibility.
  • Builder's Mindset: Thrives in a fast-paced, scaling environment; brings structure to ambiguity and is energized by standing up new motions from scratch.
  • Analytical Rigor: Strong commercial and financial instincts: able to model channel economics and make sharp prioritization calls about where to invest.
  • Values-Driven: A deep alignment with Human Interest's core principles, especially Customer Obsession, Long-Term Orientation, and Leading with Autonomy.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $195,000- $200,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. This position will also offer a variable target of $200,000. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits

  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)

Low-residency mentors work one-on-one with students on the intensive study of creative writing craft. Mentorships focus on helping the student writer develop and refine their understanding of craft elements such as structure, form, plot, setting, voice, imagery, figurative language and sound. Mentors may serve as thesis directors or second readers on low-res thesis projects and may be invited to participate in yearly residencies in Pittsburgh as program need dictates.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Sales Executive to support the continued growth of our client's Air and Ocean Freight forwarding business in Japan.

The position has a clear focus on developing new business, identifying prospective customers and building new commercial relationships. It would suit someone who enjoys meeting customers, understanding their supply chain requirements and developing solutions that create long-term value.

The successful candidate will be proactive and comfortable approaching new customers, while taking a consultative and relationship-oriented approach to sales.

  • Develop New Business: Identify, approach and develop prospective mid-to-large customers requiring international Air and Ocean Freight solutions.

  • Manage the Sales Process: Take ownership of opportunities from initial customer contact through needs analysis, proposal development, commercial negotiation and successful handover to operations.
  • Solution Selling: Understand customers' supply chains and logistics challenges and work with internal teams to develop appropriate Air, Ocean and multimodal solutions.

  • Internal Collaboration: Build effective relationships across operations, product and management teams to ensure that new customers receive a high standard of service following implementation.

Required Attributes & Competencies

  • Proactive Commercial Mindset: Comfortable identifying and approaching prospective customers rather than relying solely on inbound opportunities.
  • Relationship Building: Able to establish credibility and develop long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers.
  • Persistence: Comfortable with the realities of new-business development and able to maintain a consistent approach when opportunities take time to develop.

ABOUT DEFCON AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

About the Role

We're hiring a mid-level Product Designer to own end-to-end design on one or more product areas. You will work directly with engineers, product, and subject-matter experts to turn ambiguous operational problems into interfaces that are dense, fast, and legible. This is a hands-on role: you will be in Figma, in the design system, and in code review conversations, not just in strategy decks.

You will work in a small team with a short distance between design and shipped software and direct contact with the people who use what we build. Designers have meaningful ownership of their product areas and are expected to bring informed opinions to the work.

This is a 1099 contract opportunity, with expected 40 hours per week. A Secret Clearance is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the design of features from discovery through shipped implementation — problem framing, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and design QA.
  • Design for complexity: data-dense tables, map and timeline views, simulation outputs, and multi-role workflows where information hierarchy is the whole job.
  • Contribute to and extend our design system (@defcon/ui) — build components in Figma, define tokens and variants, and partner with engineering on the React/TypeScript implementation.
  • Run lightweight discovery with SMEs and end users, working within the access constraints of government environments. Translate what you learn into shared artifacts the team actually uses.
  • Design the unglamorous but critical parts of government software: authentication flows (CAC/PIV), role-based access control, permissions, empty and error states, and audit-friendly interactions.
  • Meet accessibility requirements as a baseline, not a cleanup pass — WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508 compliance.
  • Give and receive critique. Present work clearly to non-designers, including customers and program stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of product design experience shipping software, supported by a portfolio that demonstrates your process and decision-making, not just final screens.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto-layout, and variables.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system, including defining tokens and component APIs, documenting usage, communicating version changes, managing deprecations, and keeping the design library aligned with its coded implementation.
  • Experience designing complex, information-dense applications, such as enterprise, analytics, logistics, or operational tools. Portfolios focused exclusively on consumer products may be less aligned with this role.
  • Working knowledge of front-end concepts, including component structure, state, responsive behavior, and design tokens, with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and identify implementation drift.
  • Experience using discovery, user research, or competitive analysis to inform design decisions and solve product problems.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate business goals into functional design solutions, explain trade-offs, and respectfully challenge decisions when needed.
  • Ability to work independently through standard design challenges while recognizing when to seek guidance on complex architectural or system-scaling decisions.
  • Strong storytelling, presentation, written, and asynchronous communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and build alignment across teams, time zones, and security boundaries.
  • Active Secret clearance and U.S. citizenship required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A clearance above Secret (Top Secret or TS/SCI).
  • Prior work on defense, government, or other regulated or compliance-heavy products.
  • Experience contributing code to a design system or front-end codebase (React, TypeScript, CSS).
  • Familiarity with map-based interfaces, scheduling and timeline UI, or simulation and modeling tools.
  • Experience designing for classified or air-gapped environments, or working within FedRAMP and IL5 constraints.

Compensation: This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, scope of work, and anticipated level of effort.

jobs.excerpt: Swyfft writes homeowners and commercial package insurance, sold mostly through independent agents.
jobs.description:
Swyfft writes homeowners and commercial package insurance, sold mostly through independent agents. Our platform takes a property address, pulls in data about the building and its risks, and returns a bindable quote in seconds. Behind that is the full policy lifecycle: rating, underwriting rules, policy issuance, endorsements and renewals, and claims.

The stack is C#/.NET, TypeScript, and SQL Server, running largely on Azure. It’s a real production system with real history: some of it is modern, some of it is the kind of code you inherit when a company has been shipping for years, and part of the job is making it better without breaking things people depend on every day.

The technology team is about 30 people across development, support, IT, and QA. That’s small enough that your work is visible and you won’t spend months waiting on approvals, and large enough that you’re not the only person who knows how anything works. If you like hard domain problems, working close to the people who use what you build, and seeing your changes in production quickly, we’d like to talk.

About the Position:

Swyfft’s Partner API lets our partners create and manage Swyfft insurance quotes directly from their own software. We’re hiring a senior engineer to own it full time and make it a best-in-class developer experience: intuitive, consistent, well documented, and dependable as it evolves. You’ll design clean, stable resources on top of a rich insurance domain and work closely with our partners’ engineering teams. You’ll learn our codebase as you go; we’re hiring for your API experience.

*Please note that we are unable to provide sponsorship of any kind at this time.

*This position is a 100% U.S. based remote opportunity that can be based in one of the following states AL, AZ, FL, GA, KY, LA, MA, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

Some travel for team meetings and training may be required.

Key Responsibilities: (What you’ll be asked to do)

  • Own the Partner API contract end to end: resource design, versioning, deprecation, and backward compatibility across releases.
  • Design clear, consistent API resources, and build the translation layer that keeps the public contract stable as our internal systems evolve.
  • Work directly with our partners’ engineering teams to support their integrations, including partner-specific work on our side when an integration calls for it.
  • Design consistent error responses, idempotency, authentication, and rate limiting, along with the usage metrics that show how partners use the API.
  • Keep the OpenAPI spec and developer documentation accurate and current, with contract tests that catch breaking changes before partners do.
  • Write and review production C# code, partner with QA and product, and ship through our release process.

The Successful Candidate: (what we're looking for)

  • You’ve designed, shipped, and run a REST API used by external developers in production, and kept it backward compatible through versions. A few years on a well-known public API (payments, e-signature, communications) is exactly the kind of background we mean.
  • You think contract-first: OpenAPI, schema evolution, deprecation policies, and changelogs.
  • You know API security and multi-tenancy: API keys or OAuth 2.0 client credentials, scopes, tenant isolation, and quotas.
  • You’ve put a clean public contract in front of a complex internal domain and can explain the tradeoffs.
  • You like working with other companies’ developers, and you write clearly for them in docs and email.
  • You know how to get the most out of AI coding agents; our team uses them every day.

Some Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience as a backend developer, including 3+ years building or maintaining a partner-facing or public API.

Education:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent work experience is required.

Computer Skills:

  • Fluent in C#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server (MSSQL); experience with Azure.
  • We’re a MS Office environment.
  • Experience using video and chat technology (MSTeams & Slack).

Nice to Have:

  • Insurance or fintech industry experience, including ACORD standards.
  • API gateway experience (Azure API Management or similar), SDK generation, and webhooks.

Other:

  • Reliable high-speed internet connectivity required.
  • Designated quiet work from home space.

Actual compensation for this position will vary based on skills, qualifications, and experience. The range reflects annual compensation (as applicable) and does not include bonuses or other incentives that the company may choose to pay at its sole discretion.

jobs.title: Freelance Recruiter – Commission Only (€400–2,400 per placement) – Iloilo City
jobs.excerpt: European roles, your afternoon hours.  No night shift.
jobs.description:
European roles, your afternoon hours. No night shift. If you recruit for foreign clients from the Philippines, this is the same game, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Iloilo City and across the Philippines.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • A direct line to us for any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl is looking for a Principal Product Security Engineer to serve as a hands-on technical authority at the intersection of application, cloud, and FedRAMP environment security. You will help secure Cribl’s cloud-native, customer-managed, and hybrid products as they process high-volume data for some of the world’s largest organizations.

As a Principal engineer, impact is defined by reach. You will set long-term direction across teams, resolve critical and ambiguous security problems, advise Engineering and Product leaders, and turn security requirements into secure designs, production-ready patterns, automation, and verified outcomes. This is not a documentation-only compliance role: you will work with Engineering, SRE, Cloud Operations, Compliance, and Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) partners to make regulatory commitments real in product architecture and day-to-day operations.

This is a remote, hands-on individual-contributor role within Engineering. You will lead through expertise and influence, mentor engineers and security partners, and create durable systems that reduce risk while making the secure path easier.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Set long-term product and cloud security direction across multiple teams, shaping roadmaps, standards, secure-by-default patterns, and risk-informed design and release decisions.
  • Lead Product Security Reviews for distributed, multi-tenant SaaS and customer-managed products, including architecture and design review, threat modeling, abuse-case analysis, targeted secure code review, and security test planning.
  • Translate risk into concrete engineering requirements, mitigations, tests, and secure defaults; stay engaged through implementation and independently verify that the intended risk reduction was achieved.
  • Serve as a principal cloud security authority across IAM and workload identity, organization and account boundaries, network exposure, KMS and encryption, secrets, logging and detection, containers and Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure as code, hardening, and data isolation.
  • Lead the Product Security component of FedRAMP engineering. Translate FedRAMP Moderate and NIST SP 800-53 control intent into sustainable technical controls and defensible evidence, and partner on authorization-boundary and significant-change decisions, continuous monitoring, vulnerability and change management, POA&M and deviation remediation, incident response, vendor assessments, and 3PAO or assessor interactions.
  • Investigate ambiguous signals and vulnerabilities from bug bounty, application and supply-chain scanners, penetration tests, cloud detections, and internal reports; determine exploitability, exposure, and impact; coordinate remediation; validate fixes and bypasses; and hunt for variants and root causes.
  • Evolve scalable, risk-adaptive vulnerability management using exposure, exploitability, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities signals, asset criticality, customer impact, and regulatory timelines,not CVSS alone.
  • Build and operate durable security capabilities and developer paved roads across CI/CD, SAST, SCA, secrets, infrastructure as code, containers, cloud posture, and testing. Automate repeatable work while preserving explicit human judgment for consequential security decisions.
  • Scope and oversee external penetration tests, purple-team exercises, and relevant security vendors; ensure findings become owned, verified engineering outcomes; and provide evidence-based input to build, retain, replace, or retire decisions.
  • Lead multi-team work through uncertainty and high-stakes situations, making clear tradeoffs among security, reliability, delivery, customer impact, and compliance while acting with appropriate urgency.
  • Communicate complex risks, options, uncertainty, and recommendations in direct, audience-appropriate terms for engineers, senior leaders, customers, assessors, and external partners; represent Cribl credibly when needed.
  • Multiply the team by mentoring Product Security engineers, security champions, and engineering partners; create standards, runbooks, automation, and continuity plans that prevent critical capabilities from depending on one person.
  • Evaluate and responsibly apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted security engineering, with measurable outcomes, rigorous verification, secure operating boundaries, and clear human accountability.
  • This position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Typically 10+ years of relevant software security, security engineering, or software engineering experience,or equivalent demonstrated scope and impact,including substantial hands-on Application Security or Product Security and cloud security work.
  • Experience securing AI or agentic systems and applying AI responsibly to security engineering workflows.
  • A Principal-level track record of setting technical direction across teams, leading multi-quarter initiatives, resolving ambiguous critical problems, and influencing senior Engineering and Product leaders without direct authority.
  • Deep, hands-on AWS and Azure security experience in production SaaS or cloud-native systems, including identity and authorization, network controls, encryption and key management, secrets, logging and detection, containers or Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure as code, and multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Direct experience implementing or operating product and cloud security controls in a FedRAMP-authorized or FedRAMP-bound environment. You understand NIST SP 800-53 control intent and have supported technical control implementation and evidence, continuous monitoring, vulnerability and change management, POA&M or deviation remediation, and assessor interactions.
  • Expertise leading security design reviews and threat models for complex applications, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architectures, with the judgment to turn findings into practical countermeasures and risk-informed release recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of web and application vulnerabilities, exploit techniques, OWASP guidance, authentication and authorization protocols, cryptography, common network protocols, and secure cloud operating models.
  • Ability to read production code and build maintainable automation in JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, Go, or a comparable language; willingness to work directly with Engineering to implement and verify security improvements.
  • Hands-on vulnerability-response experience, including exploitability analysis, root-cause and variant analysis, remediation design, fix and bypass validation, stakeholder coordination, and incident support.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex risk and tradeoffs clear to engineers, executives, customers, assessors, and external partners.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
  • Preferred qualifications
    • Experience securing enterprise data platforms, observability systems, high-volume data pipelines, agents, or customer-managed and hybrid software.
    • Experience with AWS GovCloud, FedRAMP Moderate/High, NIST 800-53.
    • Experience building developer security platforms, secure-by-default libraries, policy-as-code, or automated guardrails across SAST, SCA, DAST, software supply chain, containers, and cloud posture.

Reports To:

Senior Manager, Strategic Enablement

Job Summary

Timeless Medical Systems® is looking for an Instructional Designer to join our team and create engaging, effective training materials for our software products. In this role, you'll manage the full training lifecycle, from initial needs analysis to final delivery and evaluation. You'll work with the training team and the subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop a variety of self-paced training resources, including job aids, instructional videos, and interactive simulations.

The incumbent will play a key role in shaping the strategic direction of the Strategic Enablement team by supporting the Senior Manager in identifying specific needs and ensuring we continue to deliver world-class training for both internal and external customers.

Your employment duties as an Instructional Designer will consist of the duties listed below as well as other duties as required by the Company. This list is not to be taken as fixed or exhaustive however, as you will be expected to perform any reasonable employment task assigned by a leader.

Competencies

  • Strategic mindset
  • Collaboration
  • Results orientation
  • Communication
  • Problem Solving
  • Emotional Intelligence

Job Duties

  • Design and Development: Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for instructional content. Design and create a range of learning materials, including e-learning modules, video tutorials, technical manuals, and quick-reference guides.
  • Needs Analysis: Collaborate with SMEs and stakeholders to identify training needs and gaps. Translate complex technical information and business processes into clear, concise, and engaging learning content.
  • Content Creation: Author and edit a variety of training materials, ensuring they're accurate and up-to-date. This includes writing scripts, storyboarding videos, and designing interactive exercises.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple instructional design projects simultaneously, from conception to completion. Ensure all training materials are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Evaluation and Improvement: Use feedback and data to evaluate the effectiveness of training programs. Continuously iterate and improve existing content to enhance the learning experience.

Job Requirements

  • Education in a related field is preferred.
  • Instructional Design Experience: Proven experience as an instructional designer, preferably in a software or technology-focused environment. A strong portfolio demonstrating a variety of instructional materials is a plus.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency with standard video and graphic editing tools, rapid e-learning authoring software, and productivity tools like Microsoft office and Google suites. Comfortable with AI usage for tasks such as content generation and research.
  • Understanding of Learning Theory: A solid understanding of adult learning theory and instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM).
  • Teamwork and Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to be consultative and build strong relationships with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members. You must be a team player who can collaborate effectively to achieve project goals.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills. A meticulous eye for detail and an ability to maintain accuracy in technical content.

Work Conditions

  • Operation of desktop computer and peripherals with possibility of extended periods of sitting
  • Flexible hours may occasionally include nights, weekends, and/or holidays
  • Working in a busy office environment with frequent interruptions

Timeless Medical Systems® strives to ensure that its employment practices are free from direct and indirect discrimination and is committed to upholding the human rights of those participating in the hiring process. In pursuit of this commitment, Timeless Medical Systems Inc. will not condone or tolerate any acts of discrimination or harassment under any of the grounds protected under human rights legislation. This commitment extends to the hiring process and throughout the course of employment.

Timeless Medical Systems® is prepared to modify or adjust the job application process or the job or work environment to make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of the applicant or employee to enable the applicant or employee to be considered for the position he or she desires, to perform the essential functions of the position in question, or to enjoy equal benefits and privileges of employment as are enjoyed by other similarly situated employees without disabilities, unless the accommodation will impose an undue hardship. If accommodation is needed, please indicate by answering yes to the corresponding application question.

jobs.description:
We are Local Infusion.

Local Infusion is the fastest growing infusion provider in the United States, with a mission to transform the specialty infusion industry, because patients deserve better. By providing both exceptional, patient-centered care and the proprietary, AI-driven technology powering it, Local Infusion accelerates access, simplifies workflows, and improves outcomes for everyone in the infusion journey — from patients and clinicians to health plans, health systems, employers, and pharma.

Clinicians can spend less time on paperwork and more time with patients, bringing comfort, connection, and community back to healthcare. With Local Infusion, every patient and every care team is fully supported, every step of the way.

The Role - Business Development Executive - Cleveland, OH (Greater Cleveland, Avon, Warrensville Heights)

We are seeking an experienced Business Development Executive to build relationships with referring physician offices (as well as other key stakeholders), driving referral volume and revenue to our Local Infusion centers. The Business Development Executive will be a key representative of the Local Infusion brand in the market, and be a trusted partner to external and internal stakeholders.

Estimated Total Comp is $200K - $235K+ (six-figure base + commision)

Key Accountabilities

  • Grow revenue for assigned locations by driving referrals from specialist physician offices prescribing infusion therapy.

  • Develop, maintain and build relationships with key stakeholders in your territory including specialist physician office staff, primary care providers, Pharmaceutical reps, payer case managers, benefits consultants and employers.

  • Work closely with providers, referral partners, and Local Infusion operations team to ensure positive outcomes for patients and physicians.

  • Increase brand recognition by attending networking events, conferences, local walks and other community functions.

  • Act as a liaison between referring practices and Local Infusion operations team to ensure physician practices are educated on referral processes and patients are captured timely.

  • Establish a positive and collaborative working relationship with pharmaceutical reps and other referral sources within territory.

  • Input timely and well-organized reports via CRM reporting, management tracking and expense platforms.

  • Meet & exceed sales quota.

  • Occasional night and weekend work required.

  • Must be located in the [City, ST] area.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in related field.

  • A history of meeting or exceeding sales goals.

  • Competitive spirit, with customer focused attitude.

  • Consistently positive attitude, with a commitment to ongoing self development.

  • Exceptional customer service, organizational and communication skills.

  • Excellent listening skills and ability to uncover pain points and identify opportunities.

  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Proficiency in using a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system and standard office software application.

  • Experience working directly with physicians, nurses, and clinical staff members preferred.

  • Prior experience selling or supporting infused medications, specialty biologics, IV therapies, IG therapies, specialty injectables, or related therapeutic products strongly preferred.

  • Experience building relationships directly with physician offices, infusion clinics, specialty practices, nurses, care coordinators, and clinical staff.

  • Background calling on specialties such as rheumatology, gastroenterology, neurology, immunology, dermatology, cardiology, or similar referral driven specialties strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to identify referral opportunities, uncover provider pain points, and identify opportunities that improve patient access, provider experience, and care coordination.

  • Travel requirements: Primarily day time travel within assigned territory, and occasional overnight travel.

  • Must be located in the [City, ST] area.

The Local Infusion Way

Local Infusion is a respectful, upbeat, and remote-first team united by our mission of shaping the way specialty infusion care is delivered. We are highly ambitious, but understand that in order to do a great job, we have to take care of ourselves; we expect that you will have time and energy devoted to your families, friends and hobbies.

As part of our team, full-time employees get:

  • Potential for performance bonuses

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance through our employer plan

  • Short and long-term disability coverage

  • 401(k) — as an early stage startup, and we match!

  • 15 Days PTO — and we want you to take it!

  • Competitive paid parental leave and flexible return to work policy.

  • We invest in your career. Our company is growing quickly, and we'll give you the opportunity to do the same. You'll have access to a number of professional development opportunities so that you can keep up with the company's evolving needs and grow your career along the way.

We don’t discriminate—Local Infusion is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We fundamentally believe that a more diverse and inclusive team leads to a stronger company more able to achieve our vision.

What It's Like to Work at Local Infusion - as a Business Development Executive

Accenture is a business reinvention and technology company. Our ambition is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. Our approximately 814,000 people bring deep insights across industries and functions, with capabilities spanning strategy, process, operating model, change management, talent, data, technology and AI. We deliver this expertise through consulting, managed services, proprietary assets and platforms, and increasingly, software. We bring innovation and new solutions informed by our experience across industries, enabling us to apply relevant insights, capabilities and leading practices from adjacent sectors to address emerging business challenges and opportunities. We serve more than 9,000 clients and generated revenues of approximately $74 billion in fiscal year 2026. Visit us at .


The Opportunity

Life and Annuity and Group and Voluntary Benefits carriers are at the same inflection point from different directions — both modernizing core platforms, evolving operating models, and deploying AI and intelligent agents to unlock capabilities that legacy architectures cannot support. For L&A carriers, the opportunity centers on policy administration transformation, digital core modernization, and the data foundations that enable intelligent operations at scale. For Group and Voluntary Benefits carriers, the opportunity concentrates in the value streams where agentic AI creates the most measurable impact — shielding complexity from the experience while driving speed, scale, and new performance outcomes across underwriting speed and win propensity, integrated absence and disability claims management, guided enrollment and onboarding, and data exchange across a complex broker and employer ecosystem.


Role Summary

Life Insurance and Group Benefits Consulting Managers lead defined workstreams across complex transformation programs. They translate business objectives into operating model designs, technology solutions, and delivery-ready plans — connecting the strategic vision set by senior leaders to the analytical work and implementation that makes it real. They manage day-to-day client relationships at the working level, develop junior team members, and maintain accountability for the quality and progress of their workstream.

In this role, you will lead workstreams that translate carrier transformation vision into working solutions — connecting business strategy to operating model design, technology delivery, and outcomes that show up in loss ratios, operational efficiency, growth, and the experience of customers and distribution partners across both markets.


Responsibilities

  • Lead business and technology workstreams from strategy through implementation and value realization
  • Define transformation objectives, future-state operating models, and modernization roadmaps
  • Redesign end-to-end workflows across the Life & Annuity and Group Benefits value chain
  • Design AI-enabled workflows, including orchestration, human decision points, controls, and value measures
  • Connect operations, digital core platforms, data, integration, and Agentic AI
  • Align stakeholders and manage scope, dependencies, risks, decisions, quality, and adoption
  • Develop business cases, executive recommendations, and client-ready deliverables
  • Contribute to proposals, solution shaping, thought leadership, and go-to-market offerings
  • Build client relationships, identify growth opportunities, and develop consulting team members
  • Travel up to 80% based on client and project requirements

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of management consulting, carrier, or business and technology transformation experience, including experience within Life Insurance or Annuities or Group Benefits
  • 3+ years of experience leading a business or technology workstream within a transformation, modernization, or platform implementation program
  • Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of the Life & Annuity or Group Benefits value chain across business and technology
  • For Life & Annuity, knowledge of policy administration and digital core modernization, including workflow, data, integration, and digital channels.
  • For Group and Voluntary benefits, knowledge of case underwriting, absence management, disability, and voluntary claims as areas of concentration
  • For Life, familiarity with platforms such as ALIP, OIPA, Sapiens, FAST, Fadata, EIS, Majesco, or comparable technologies
  • For Group, familiarity with platforms such as EIS, FINEOS, Majesco, Vitech, and rating platforms like FJA and Global IQX
  • Applied knowledge of AI-enabled or agentic workflows, where AI and underlying data products can drive meaningful value across the value chain
  • Strong problem-solving, client communication, team leadership, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior business and technology leaders
  • Commercial acumen demonstrated through solution shaping, proposals, and account growth
  • Ability to translate complex business objectives into clear plans and measurable outcomes

jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire an Account Executive, Large Enterprise (Regulated Industries) to the Sales & Customer Experience team.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?

At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.

What you’ll do

  • Prospect, develop and close sales opportunities with both new logos and existing customers in our Regulated Industries segment (Financial Services & Healthcare).
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals (prospecting and meetings completed) to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota retirement.
  • Establish deep relationships within your book of business through multi-threading, achieving both executive or VP level and end user engagement.

What you’ll bring

Sprout Social is looking for a highly driven and tech-savvy Account Executive with strong business acumen to join our expanding Large Enterprise sales team. Ideally, you will be equally driven by a customer-centric mentality as well as a desire to find and close new business.

These are the minimum qualifications that our hiring team is looking for in this role:

  • 5+ years of closing experience in B2B sales
  • Proven success selling/cross-selling to large enterprise organizations (5,000+ global employees)
  • Ability to manage a large number of prospective accounts and identify problems, opportunities and consultatively provide solutions for each of them

Additionally, these are the preferred qualifications that would indicate a particularly strong candidate:

  • Experience selling to Regulated Industries like Financial Services & Healthcare
  • Experience building relationships, presenting and selling to senior level decision makers across multiple functions
  • Experience working with internal partners and cross-functional stakeholders to increase deal momentum and exceed both prospects and customers expectations

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
  • Partner with the Director of Enterprise to define key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them.
  • Meet with current members of the Enterprise Sales team individually to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gather learnings to implement into your role.
  • Shadow Account Executives on calls live or through Gong to learn sales strategies and positioning.
  • Dive right into our platform to learn about what makes our platform unique, how our solution impacts business objectives and why customers love our solutions.
  • Learn Sprout’s go-to-market messaging, key differentiators, develop and personalize segment-specific value propositions.
  • Learn the relevant customer stories and case studies to justify your value propositions with real ROI examples from the field.
  • Complete a demo and written certification to ensure comprehension.
  • Learn Sprout’s existing customer sales process by shadowing your peers.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Meet with all your existing customers within the book of business and begin the process of building relationships with key strategic stakeholders.
  • Identifying the top 20-25% of new logo opportunities within your book of business to create focus and execution in your weekly prospecting activities.
  • Understand the language of all your customers and where we can expand our offerings by expansion into new business units or increasing utilization of our platform with existing customers.
  • Own your numbers - consistently meet and exceed your activity goals to build a fruitful pipeline that will provide consistent quota attainment after ramp.
  • Co-build account & territory plans with your BDR, Professional Services, Solutions Engineers & Customer Success teammates.
  • Regularly meet with your BDR to define a relationship that ensures seamless communication and coordination on all net new business generation and expansion opportunities.
  • Conduct active research leveraging all available tools and data sources to understand your customers’ brand, culture, KPIs, partners, and success metrics so you can add value throughout your interactions and become a trusted advisor.
  • Gain a solid understanding of your customer’s internal transitions and mitigate the risk of customer churn.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Have built solid relationships at the C-Level with existing customers within your “book of business".
  • Have built strong internal relationships with your peers, customer success, professional services, solutions engineering, our legal partners and others who will take part in your deal cycles. You will have a deep understanding of each team’s partnership expectations and service level agreement.
  • Have built 4X your monthly quota target of net new logo pipeline.
  • Travel locally or out of state to meet with high potential prospects and critical customers on a quarterly basis to speed up your deal cycles and increase win rates.
  • Become a Sprout Social and social media expert to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to help our customers realize their full potential and accomplish their goals.
  • Consistently achieve your monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Mentor and develop your BDR to become best in class at their respective functions and further advance their skill sets and career trajectory.
  • Step up as a peer leader to share best practices across the organization and help others grow from your experiences.
  • Consistently meet and exceed monthly activity, pipeline and new business metrics.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role.

We have two geographic pay zones in the United States:

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges.
