jobs.description:
SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. SpyCloud’s solutions thwart cyberattacks and protect more than 4 billion accounts worldwide. Cybersecurity is an exciting, evolving space, and being at the forefront of the fight to disrupt cybercrime makes SpyCloud a special place to work. If you’re driven to align your career with a fantastic mission, look no further!

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager, Platform Engineering to lead our core platform team. Our product engineering teams are stream-aligned, each owning a slice of SpyCloud’s products end to end, and they are your customers. Your team will build and run the internal platform they ship on, so they can focus on disrupting cybercrime instead of wrestling with infrastructure, pipelines, and tooling.

This is a product role as much as an engineering one. You’ll treat the platform as a product, earn adoption rather than mandate it, and measure success by how much cognitive load you remove from the teams you serve. We value collaboration, transparency, and a culture of continuous improvement, and most importantly, we believe in keeping work fun!

Our Tech Stack

  • Programming languages: Go, TypeScript, Python
  • Relational databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Databricks
  • NoSQL databases: ElasticSearch, DynamoDB
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Terraform
  • Operating systems: Linux

What You'll Do:

  • Lead, hire, and grow a team of platform engineers, coaching them toward product thinking and genuine empathy for the developers they serve.
  • Own the platform vision and roadmap as a product, prioritizing through direct discovery with stream-aligned teams and being explicit about what the platform won’t do.
  • Publish and maintain a team charter defining what the platform offers as a service, its SLOs, its support model, and how teams engage with you.
  • Measure success by pairing DORA metrics with developer satisfaction, golden path adoption, and self-service ratios, and use the results to drive priorities.
  • Run the platform as a dependable product with SLOs, versioning, and on-call, and lead platform-wide migrations so the platform team carries the burden instead of every product team.
  • Evaluate, roll out, and measure AI-assisted development tools across engineering.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on work in platform engineering.
  • 3-5 years of experience leading engineering teams (4+ individuals), ideally platform, engineering, or developer tooling teams.
  • A track record of running an internal platform as a product: you can explain who your internal customers were, what you chose not to build, and how adoption and satisfaction changed.
  • Experience operating highly available systems in AWS, with working knowledge of containers, infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD, and observability.
  • Strong technical judgment and a hands-on approach, you make sound architectural and build-vs-buy decisions and aren’t afraid to get into the code when needed.
  • Experience using DORA metrics, SLOs, and developer experience surveys to set priorities and communicate platform value.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without authority, including leading cross-team migrations with teams you don’t manage.

Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $195,000

The salary range reflects the expected base compensation for a fully qualified candidate at this level based on experience, qualifications, and market data at the time of posting.

U.S.-Based Benefits + Perks (for Full Time Employees):

At SpyCloud, we are committed to working alongside individuals who are equally passionate about preventing cybercrime, regardless of their department or role. Guided by our core values in all business decisions, we prioritize unity in our mission and ensure all SpyCloud employees have the support and benefits they need to stay focused on our goals. In addition to our engaging workspace in South Austin, flexible and remote-friendly work options, and competitive salary package, we offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

About SpyCloud:

SpyCloud transforms recaptured darknet data to disrupt cybercrime. Its automated identity threat protection solutions use advanced analytics and AI to accelerate investigations and protect workforce, consumer, and supplier identities from the threats that matter most: authentication bypass, session hijacking, malicious insiders, account takeover, ransomware, and fraud. Its data from malware-infected devices, successful phishes, combolists, and third-party breaches also powers many popular dark web monitoring and identity theft protection offerings. Customers include 7 of the Fortune 10, along with hundreds of global enterprises, mid-sized companies, and government agencies worldwide. Headquartered in Austin, TX, SpyCloud is home to more than 250 cybersecurity experts whose mission is to protect businesses and consumers from the stolen identity data criminals are using to target them now.

Our mission is to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. Together with our customers and partners, we aim to end criminals’ ability to profit from stolen information.

SpyCloud is a place for innovative, collaborative, and problem-solvers to thrive. Individually, we’re amazing, but together, we’re unstoppable. Are you ready to be a trusted advisor helping commercial organizations transform operations and realize measurable value from their technology investments?

At Naviant, our mission is to partner with organizations to reimagine how work gets done, combining deep industry expertise, intelligent technology, and a human-centered approach to deliver measurable outcomes.We serve as the Agentic Partner for the modern enterprise, leading deep business transformation by building autonomous, intelligent solutions that enable executive leaders to transform and optimize their entire operating model. Our vision is simple yet ambitious: Reimagine work through automation, AI, and data, freeing people to focus on what truly matters.

We’re seeking a Customer Success Advisor with a Commercial Industry focus, supporting clients in manufacturing, supply chain, and related operationally complex environments. This role is ideal for a relationship‑driven professional who understands how technology enables efficiency, scalability, and compliance, and who thrives at the intersection of customer advocacy, operational insight, and long‑term value creation.

As a Customer Success Advisor, you will build trusted partnerships with clients, serve as their internal champion, and guide them toward maximizing ROI through strong adoption, measurable outcomes, and strategic alignment. You’ll collaborate closely with internal delivery, support, and sales teams to ensure customers are successful today while positioned for future growth.

Performance Objectives – What You Will Accomplish

  • Establish initial relationships with customer stakeholders and internal cross‑functional teams.

  • Act as the customer advocate internally, coordinating with support, delivery, and sales teams to ensure timely issue resolution and proactive communication.

  • Begin documenting opportunities for value expansion aligned to client goals and industry needs.

At 90 Days and Beyond: Driving Impact

  • Partner with executive leaders at client organizations to align technology capabilities with business objectives such as efficiency, cost reduction, scalability, and compliance.

  • Identify and support account expansion opportunities through thoughtful alignment of solutions, best practices, and emerging capabilities.

  • Influence internal teams by championing the voice of the customer and contributing to continuous improvement.

Client Relationship & Strategic Advisory Skills
Proven ability to build and nurture long‑term, trust‑based customer relationships. Comfortable engaging both operational and executive stakeholders, asking thoughtful questions, and guiding strategic conversations. Able to challenge, encourage, and collaborate in ways that strengthen partnerships and deliver mutual value.

Commercial Industry Acumen
Understanding of commercial industry environments such as manufacturing or supply chain, including operational workflows, efficiency drivers, compliance pressures, and scalability challenges. Able to translate industry context into meaningful recommendations that support customer growth and performance.

Customer Advocacy & Cross‑Functional Leadership

Value Expansion & Account Growth
Experience identifying opportunities for upsell, cross‑sell, and expanded adoption based on customer goals, usage patterns, and industry trends. Able to contribute to long‑term account planning and align solutions to evolving commercial sector needs.

Comfortable tracking and interpreting customer KPIs, adoption metrics, and health indicators. Able to deliver enablement, training, and best‑practice guidance that drives sustained success and ROI. Maintains current knowledge of relevant tools, technologies, and workflows.

Thought Leadership & Continuous Improvement
Engaged learner who stays informed on commercial industry trends, regulatory changes, and operational challenges. Willing to share expertise through customer education, internal collaboration, and external forums such as webinars, events, or customer stories. Contributes ideas that improve processes, experiences, and outcomes.

Perks and Benefits – How We Take Care of Our Team

About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position Summary:

We are looking for a proactive L1 System Administrator to support enterprise endpoint operations, including Windows devices, device enrollment, software deployment and endpoint management. The role is responsible for monitoring, initial troubleshooting, routine device checks, incident logging and escalation to L2/L3 teams to maintain endpoint availability and meet operational SLAs.

Key Responsibilities:

Endpoint & Device Management

  • Provide first-level support for Windows endpoint incidents and service requests.
  • Perform basic checks on device health, availability, connectivity and configuration.
  • Support routine device enrollment and provisioning activities using approved procedures.
  • Perform initial checks for Intune/SCCM policy synchronization and device compliance issues.
  • Assist with Windows Autopilot enrollment and device lifecycle activities.

OS Patching & Application Management

  • Monitor endpoint patching status and report failed or pending updates.
  • Perform approved software installation, deployment validation and basic troubleshooting.
  • Support routine Windows update checks and post-patching validation.
  • Identify application installation failures and escalate unresolved issues to L2.
  • Assist with approved driver, firmware and configuration update activities.

Endpoint Configuration & Compliance

  • Perform basic checks on device compliance, encryption status and configuration policies.
  • Identify issues related to BitLocker, device configuration and policy application.
  • Collect relevant diagnostic information and escalate compliance failures to L2.
  • Coordinate with the dedicated Defender/Security team through established procedures for security-related incidents.
  • Follow approved endpoint management and security policies.

Operations & Service Management

  • Log, categorize, prioritize and track incidents and service requests in ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting using approved runbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Escalate unresolved issues within defined SLAs and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate ticket updates, operational checklists and shift handover documentation.
  • Coordinate with L2/L3, Service Desk, Identity, Security and Application teams.
  • Follow ITIL Incident, Change and Request Management processes.
  • Ensure effective APAC–EMEA–NLAM shift handovers and uninterrupted 24x7 operational support.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems and endpoint troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Windows updates, software installation, device connectivity and system settings.
  • Basic understanding of Microsoft Intune and/or SCCM/MECM.
  • Knowledge of device enrollment, configuration policies and endpoint compliance fundamentals.
  • Basic understanding of BitLocker, encryption and Windows security configurations.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools.
  • Understanding of incident management, SLA compliance and escalation procedures.
  • Good communication, documentation and shift handover skills.
  • Willingness to work in rotational shifts in a 24x7 production support environment.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

  • Basic PowerShell knowledge.
  • Exposure to Windows Autopilot and endpoint provisioning.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID and device registration.
  • Basic understanding of application deployment and patch management.
  • Microsoft MD-102 fundamentals or equivalent endpoint management training.
  • Exposure to enterprise monitoring and endpoint management tools.

Key Competencies

Windows Endpoint Support | Intune | SCCM/MECM | Device Provisioning | Patch Monitoring | Software Deployment | Endpoint Configuration | Device Compliance | BitLocker Fundamentals | Incident Logging | Runbook Execution | SLA Compliance | Escalation Management | Global 24x7 Operations

Role boundary: L1 focuses on endpoint monitoring, routine checks, basic troubleshooting and incident escalation. L2 handles technical administration, patching, application deployment and compliance remediation. Defender operations remain with the dedicated Defender team, while complex endpoint platform issues are escalated to L3 SMEs.

Why Gruve

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFinance teams at B2B companies lose cash the same way every month: an invoice ages past 45 days, someone sends an email, no reply, someone calls, voicemail, they call again next week, still nothing.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Finance teams at B2B companies lose cash the same way every month: an invoice ages past 45 days, someone sends an email, no reply, someone calls, voicemail, they call again next week, still nothing. AR teams spend 60–70% of their week on manual follow-up instead of posting cash, closing disputes, or analyzing aging. Adding headcount doesn't fix it; manual follow-up simply doesn't scale, and every ERP hits the same wall.

Problem and solution validation are complete. Live pilots are running with early design partners and entering production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, and scalability. The teams that ship credible AI workers into finance-sensitive functions in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

Argentl delivers an AI collections agent that handles outbound debtor follow-up automatically — trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, Argentl is evaluated on outcomes: DSO reduction, hours returned to the AR team, and cash commitments captured — not configuration effort.

Give us a list of overdue accounts and our voice agent calls each debtor, confirms invoice awareness, and captures exactly what they say — a payment commitment, a dispute, a request to split, or silence. The AR team gets a clean morning report: who's committed, who's disputing, who's gone silent, and what to do next. No ERP migration, no system credentials, no workflow overhaul — we're calling within a week of receiving the data. The roadmap expands from collections follow-up into adjacent AI finance-ops roles, all delivered through the same managed model.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Architecture & Reliability — Harden the voice and workflow systems for in-production reliability. Establish core architecture, observability, and audit-trail standards for a product that speaks to customers' debtors on their behalf.

  • Delivery Layer — Build the internal infrastructure that lets the team configure, monitor, and optimize agent performance without scaling engineering headcount. Mature the workflow engine so every call, intent classification, and next-action flows through reliably.

  • Integrations & Distribution — Own the accounting and ERP integration layer (QuickBooks, Xero, and beyond) that turns Argentl from a CSV upload into an embedded part of the finance stack — the primary distribution unlock.

  • Unit Economics — Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within a productized monthly pricing model.

  • Customer & Market — Represent the company in front of finance leaders, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the venture.

  • Roadmap — Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond collections, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where data-privacy and financial-compliance requirements demand it.

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Shipped LLM-powered and voice systems into production environments where incorrect outputs carried real consequences

  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, real-time voice and conversational AI, telephony, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

  • Well-formed convictions about reliability engineering, edge-case management, and the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call

  • Experience building managed and service-heavy platforms, with the discipline to scale delivery without scaling engineering headcount

  • Prepared to operate as a principal — including saying "this won't scale" or "this isn't ready" when the integrity of the product requires it

  • A hands-on builder — you still write code and ship, and you're happiest close to the product

Great to Have:

  • Finance, accounting, or FinOps background — you understand AR, DSO, aging, disputes, and how finance teams actually work

  • Based in Los Angeles or the San Francisco Bay Area (or ready to be)

  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there

  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

  • Capable and willing to help in finding and closing early customer partnerships

  • An active social media presence you can put to work for founder-led distribution

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

MinIO is looking for a hands-on technologist who likes building things and explaining how they work. You don't need a curriculum background; we'll teach you that. You will'll turn AIStor, across objects, tables, files, and agent memory, into labs, videos, and self-paced courses for a wide range of technical audiences: data engineers, developers building agents, AI infrastructure engineers accelerating performance with MemKV, storage administrators, and the partner and internal solution architects who support them. Most of your teaching will be recorded, with live sessions about once a month.

This role has real variety. On any given week, you might be building a hands-on lab, standing up an agent memory demo, recording a training video, turning engineering documentation into a teachable module for partners, or adapting a core course for a specific customer deployment. You enjoy that variety. You're as comfortable in front of a camera as you are at a command line.

You will collaborate closely with engineering and product marketing. You welcome the freedom and opportunity of being part of a startup and have the self-discipline to identify needs and get things done without waiting to be asked. You will be encouraged to help shape the strategy that the MinIO team executes.

Experience in a solutions architect or other customer-facing technical role is a strong plus — it helps you understand how customers deploy and operate storage in production and how to make training land in that context. Experience with competitive software-defined storage platforms is also a plus. Strong oral and written communication skills are essential.

What You Will Do

  • Build and maintain courses for AIStor administrators and operators, covering installation, configuration, management, and troubleshooting, and keep them current as the product changes
  • Build curriculum for AIStor Memory and agentic AI use cases, turning orchestration and memory concepts (context assembly, agent state, retrieval) into practical, hands-on training
  • Turn engineering documentation and demos into training modules for partners
  • Adapt core courses for specific customer deployments and industries
  • Build hands-on lab environments with Terraform, Ansible, and Docker, and test them end to end before release
  • Write course content as code: Markdown in git and GitHub, with branches and pull request review
  • Record and edit short demo and training videos for MinIO Academy, YouTube, and LinkedIn
  • Deliver live and recorded training sessions for internal teams and partners
  • Use approved AI tools such as Claude Code to speed up authoring, testing, and review

Your Skills and Experience

  • Working proficiency in Linux
  • Demonstrated ability to turn engineering material (documentation, specs, demos) into teachable content
  • 5+ years in a solutions architect or equivalent customer-facing technical role
  • 3+ years of experience with software-defined storage, cloud storage, or Kubernetes; hands-on experience with MinIO or competitive platforms (Vast, Cloudian, Weka) is a plus
  • 1+ years of experience with agentic AI infrastructure (e.g., agent memory/orchestration platforms such as LangChain/LangGraph, Mem0, Letta, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Memory Bank) or memory/vector infrastructure (Pinecone, Weaviate, Redis)
  • Experience teaching live and on camera
  • Comfort with Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Python, and related tooling
  • 1+ years building and maintaining workflows in git and GitHub
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code
  • Previous experience with curriculum development or formal training delivery

  • Pre-IPO Stock Options
  • At least 12 Public Holidays
  • Flexible Time Off

Pricing and Profitability

Build and maintain financial models to support pricing decisions, NPI business cases, and large RFPs. Partner with suppliers and internal teams to improve margin performance, cost competitiveness, and overall portfolio profitability while increasing margins.

Market Intelligence and Customer Engagement

Engage directly with customers, channel partners, and industry participants to understand application needs, buying behavior, market drivers, and forecasted trends. Represent Integra Optics and the ACS Business Unit at customer meetings, trade shows, media opportunities, and industry events as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with sales and business development teams to support strategic opportunities, shape win strategies and provide product and solutions expertise. Collaborate with marketing to develop effective product and solutions messaging, datasheets, application content, and campaign assets. Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for the product line by providing guidance and training to channel partners, customers, collaborating with engineering, developing marketing content, and supporting media relations opportunities. Partner with operations, procurement, marketing, and sales to ensure launch readiness, supply continuity, and fulfillment performance. Work collaboratively with other product line leaders to develop integrated, system-level solutions across the broader Infinite Electronics portfolio.

Qualifications

Master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred. 15+ years of experience in product management, with earlier responsibilities in business development, sales, or applications engineering for fiber optic products across multiple markets and applications. Established relationships with key industry leaders, governing agencies, and industry organizations in the market. Demonstrated success developing and executing product strategies, roadmaps, and new product launches. Proven ability to develop and present complex business cases to internal and external stakeholders to gain alignment. Track record of commercial success in both portfolio growth and new product introduction. Ability to translate complex technical knowledge into digestible information to support sales and marketing. Strong interpersonal skills, sound business judgment, a customer-focused mindset, and a proven track record of delivering revenue growth. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and professionally in English. Strong proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Ex, Excel, Word, & PowerPoint), CRM, and ERP. Experience working successfully in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

Performance Goals

Launch 4 to 6 new products annually to generate more than $5 million in annual revenue through innovative, differentiated, value-driven solutions. First 30 Days

Develop an understanding of the current product portfolio, customer base, and target markets within the business unit. Gain familiarity with the business unit’s capabilities, solutions, and cross-functional resources. Develop an initial product roadmap aligned to growth markets, applications, and customer demand. Identify the partners, suppliers, and engineering resources needed to support roadmap execution.

First 60 Days

Complete at least three voice-of-customer discussions to validate product priorities and roadmap direction. Finalize a 6-month product roadmap with timelines and execution priorities for presentation to leadership.

First 90 Days

Engage key telecom and data center customers to gather voice-of-customer insights, understand current network architectures, and identify future solution opportunities. Finalize a 12-month product roadmap with timelines and execution priorities for presentation to leadership.

Preferred Leadership and Professional Attributes

Successful candidates are solution-oriented, collaborative, and accountable for results while exhibiting ownership and urgency. Dependable, accountable, and consistent in follow-through. Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills. Demonstrates professionalism, reliability, and sound judgment. Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a dynamic environment. Able to perform effectively under deadlines and changing business needs. Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and commercial teams. Maintains a professional presence and represents the organization effectively in internal and external settings. Demonstrates ownership, urgency, collaboration, accountability, and a solutions-oriented approach.

Physical/Environmental Requirements

Frequently remains in a stationary position and occasionally moves about the office or worksite to access files, supplies, or attend meetings. Frequently uses hands and fingers to operate office equipment such as a keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other standard office tools. Must be able to visually assess information on screens, documents, and reports. Frequently reads, interprets, and analyzes written and visual information. Occasionally lifts or moves items up to [10–15] pounds (e.g., files, laptop, meeting materials). Must be able to effectively communicate information and ideas in person, via video conference, and through written communication. Works primarily in an office or remote office environment with standard business equipment. May require extended periods of screen time. May occasionally be required to attend meetings or events outside of normal workspace or business hours.

Work Environment This role may be either remote or at an office location. Employees may work from their home office and regularly collaborate with colleagues across various company sites during normal or extended business hours, as needed. Office-based work depends on an employee's proximity to an Infinite facility and may be determined by management. Travel is part of this role’s responsibilities, including customer visits, supplier meetings, industry conferences, and internal gatherings. jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This role is a remote position open to candidates residing in Germany. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

Will require travel to customer sites in Germany, The Netherlands and the United Kingdom, for up to 20% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether a customer achieves their sustainability goals, or whether power gets restored quickly after an incident
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
  • Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Fluency in German required

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Manager, Accounts Receivable to provide accounting leadership within our shared services accounting including credit, customer on-boarding, order processing and invoicing, accounts receivable (A/R), cash collections, cash application, bad debt and other related month end accounting activities.
The role is responsible for the process and performance outcomes of the Accounts Receivable Team, ensuring the compliance with business unit service level agreements (SLAs), developing, distributing, and monitoring KPIs, leading and motivating teams, ensuring continuous improvement of processes, providing excellent customer service to business units and driving effectiveness through the shared service.
This position will work closely with the Financial Accounting, Finance, Accounts Payable, Master Data, Wholesale Sales, and Retail Operations Teams as well as other corporate finance, accounting, and business leadership.

Why TerrAscend?

    Join a growing, fast-paced organization where your work makes an impact. At TerrAscend, you'll have opportunities to grow your career, collaborate with talented teams, and help shape what's next as our business continues to evolve.

Remote Work Location Eligibility:

    TerrAscend currently hires remote employees in CT, DE, FL, GA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, and WV. Candidates must reside and work in an approved state. Eligibility varies by role and is subject to change.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and help oversee the processes in the Accounts Receivable workstream: design, build and continue to improve processes.
  • Responsible for the overall wholesale accounts receivable collections performance (DSO) for the business and partnership with leadership to drive strong credit and collections processes and procedures.
  • Drive the daily operations of wholesale accounts receivable, transactional activity, and its team. Delegates, supervises, and participates in daily accounting department tasks. Prepares and/or reviews appropriate ledger entries and accruals.
  • Responsible for the consolidated accounts receivable balances and ledgers for the company, accuracy of subledgers, and understanding of fluctuations over time in partnership with collections team.
  • Ensures completeness and accuracy of all assigned accounts, including the completion and review of monthly balance sheet reconciliations.

Maintains effective Internal Controls and ensures Standard Operating Procedures are current and being utilized throughout assigned areas.

  • Responds timely to inquiries from external and internal customers.
  • Work closely with the various heads of accounting, external auditors, and tax accountants during quarter and year end close to support reporting & regulatory requirements and provide financial commentary and supporting schedules as requested.
  • Become a Change Agent as a part of the Shared Service project team, acting as a liaison between the project and end users, assisting with user adoption of new system and processes.
  • Monitor KPIs and address any inefficiency and performance issues in a timely fashion to ensure performance is maintained and develop and track KPIs for signs of risk to cash collections/ aged debt early, ensuring appropriate actions are taken to mitigate.
  • Assist and help lead special projects as applicable including the integration of new business acquisitions.
  • Perform ad hoc analysis and projects as requested.
  • Participates in quarterly audits with external auditors ensuring documentation is supported and deadlines are met.
  • Responsible for managing internal Accounts Receivable deficiencies, creating resolutions and meeting deadlines.
  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality.
  • Perform other duties as required to support Accounting Department.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree with a concentration in business or accounting.
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience. Corporate accounting experience preferred.
  • Three years supervisory experience preferred, effectively managing and growing a team of professionals.
  • Intermediate knowledge of U.S. GAAP, internal control, and Sarbanes Oxley compliance
  • Manufacturing and/or Retail experience preferred.
  • Experience or exposure to all areas of accounting including but not limited to, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash/revenue, accruals and reserves. Understanding of the principles of inventory manufacturing processes, retail sales processes, sales and use tax, and public company audit and Sarbanes Oxley compliance.
  • Provide support and training to the staff and other team leaders; provide guidance to accounting staff to optimize performance including assisting in monitoring workloads to ensure timely completion of assigned activities. Provide guidance to Operational and Procurement staff as it relates to cash handling/reconciliation, procurement, and inventory management.
  • Experience working in a highly computerized environment and processing financial transactions using an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and/or accounting software. Epicor experience preferred.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Accurate, self-starter, with the ability to prioritize and complete tasks with competing deadlines.
  • Professional written and verbal communication with multiple levels and departments.

jobs.description:
Content Writer – SEO, Blog Writing & Marketing Content | Remote

Position Type: Remote
Department: Marketing / Content Creation
Function: Content Writing / SEO / Digital Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a talented and detail-oriented Content Writer to create engaging, well-researched, and SEO-optimized content that supports its marketing initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys researching new topics, translating complex information into clear and compelling writing, and producing high-quality content across multiple formats.

You’ll be responsible for developing blog posts, website copy, case studies, and marketing collateral while ensuring every piece aligns with the client’s brand voice, positioning, and marketing objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strong writing skills, SEO knowledge, research capabilities, and editorial judgment with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a remote marketing team.

What You’ll Own

Content Writing & Creation

  • Write clear, engaging, and well-researched content for the client’s marketing initiatives.
  • Develop content across multiple formats, including:
    • SEO blog posts and articles
    • Website and landing page copy
    • Case studies
    • Marketing collateral
    • Campaign-related content
  • Translate complex industry topics into accessible, compelling content.
  • Adapt writing style and tone to different audiences and marketing objectives.
  • Ensure content accurately reflects the client’s positioning and messaging.
  • Deliver polished drafts that meet established quality standards.

Research & Content Ideation

  • Research industry trends, relevant topics, and audience interests.
  • Analyze competitor content to identify opportunities and content gaps.
  • Generate relevant content ideas aligned with marketing goals.
  • Gather accurate information from credible sources.
  • Develop content angles that resonate with target audiences.
  • Quickly understand unfamiliar subjects and turn research into useful content.
  • Support the marketing team with content ideas for campaigns and initiatives.

SEO Content Writing & Optimization

  • Apply on-page SEO best practices to written content.
  • Integrate relevant keywords naturally without compromising readability.
  • Develop SEO-friendly titles, headings, and subheadings.
  • Write compelling meta descriptions.
  • Structure articles for readability and organic search visibility.
  • Ensure content aligns with relevant search intent.
  • Balance SEO requirements with strong editorial quality and audience value.

Editing & Editorial Consistency

  • Review and refine drafts for clarity, accuracy, grammar, and readability.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing content.
  • Follow established editorial guidelines and content standards.
  • Ensure content is logically structured and easy to understand.
  • Incorporate feedback from the marketing team.
  • Identify and correct issues before content is submitted for publication.
  • Maintain high editorial standards across all deliverables.

Marketing Team Collaboration

  • Collaborate with the marketing team on content priorities and deadlines.
  • Support marketing campaigns and product launches with written content.
  • Review content briefs and clarify requirements before starting assignments.
  • Deliver drafts and revisions according to agreed timelines.
  • Communicate progress and potential blockers proactively.
  • Participate in occasional team check-ins to align on priorities.
  • Work efficiently through shared documents and remote collaboration tools.

Requirements

  • Proven professional experience as a Content Writer, SEO Content Writer, Marketing Content Writer, Copywriter, or similar role.
  • Previous writing experience in a marketing, agency, or professional business environment.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating writing quality, versatility, and consistency.
  • Excellent written English, including grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, and clarity.
  • Ability to adapt tone and writing style for different audiences and content formats.
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and on-page optimization.
  • Experience writing blog posts, website copy, or other marketing content.
  • Strong research skills and ability to understand unfamiliar topics quickly.
  • Ability to produce accurate, readable content with minimal supervision.
  • Strong editing and proofreading capabilities.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage deadlines and incorporate feedback efficiently.
  • Strong written communication and remote collaboration skills.
  • Comfortable using digital tools for communication, document sharing, and feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing SEO-focused blog posts and website content.
  • Experience developing B2B marketing content.
  • Familiarity with content marketing and digital marketing campaigns.
  • Experience researching technical or complex industry topics.
  • Experience writing case studies and marketing collateral.
  • Understanding of keyword research and search intent.
  • Familiarity with editorial guidelines and brand voice development.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed marketing teams.

Tools & Skills

SEO Writing | Content Research | Blog Writing | Website Copywriting | Case Study Writing | Keyword Integration | Meta Descriptions | Content Editing | Proofreading | Digital Collaboration Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy researching unfamiliar topics and turning them into compelling content.
  • Can explain complex ideas in clear, accessible language.
  • Understand how to balance SEO requirements with engaging writing.
  • Take ownership of assignments and deadlines.
  • Communicate proactively rather than waiting for follow-ups.
  • Ask thoughtful questions before beginning a project.
  • Can independently identify weaknesses in a draft and improve them.
  • Pay close attention to grammar, structure, accuracy, and tone.
  • Incorporate editorial feedback professionally and efficiently.
  • Maintain consistent writing quality across different content formats.
  • Are comfortable working asynchronously with a remote marketing team.
  • Take pride in producing content that is genuinely useful to readers.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing a content brief for an upcoming blog post, researching the topic, and outlining the article.

You’ll then develop a clear, engaging draft that incorporates relevant SEO keywords, appropriate headings, and accurate supporting information.

Later, you might revise an existing article based on feedback, update website copy, or develop ideas for an upcoming marketing campaign.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate with the marketing team through shared documents and written communication, ensuring deliverables remain on schedule.

Most work will be asynchronous, with occasional check-ins to align on priorities and deadlines.

In short: You’ll research, write, edit, and optimize content that strengthens the client’s marketing efforts and communicates its value to the right audiences.

Key Metrics for Success

Content Quality

  • Clarity, accuracy, and readability of written content
  • Consistency with brand voice and editorial guidelines
  • Quality of research and supporting information
  • Number of revisions required before approval

SEO & Content Optimization

  • Effective keyword integration
  • SEO-friendly content structure
  • Quality of titles, headings, and meta descriptions
  • Alignment with relevant search intent
  • Organic search visibility of published content

Productivity & Collaboration

  • Timely delivery of assigned content
  • Ability to manage multiple writing assignments
  • Responsiveness to feedback
  • Proactive communication with the marketing team
  • Consistency of content output
  • Ability to work independently

Why This Role Stands Out

This opportunity allows you to contribute directly to a client’s marketing and content initiatives while developing content across multiple formats.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Create engaging blog posts, website copy, and case studies.
  • Research new topics and develop relevant content ideas.
  • Apply SEO best practices to improve content visibility.
  • Collaborate with a marketing team on campaigns and launches.
  • Strengthen your experience in professional and B2B content writing.
  • Take ownership of content quality and execution.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys combining research, storytelling, SEO, and editorial precision.

  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Content Writer, SEO Writer, Copywriter, or Marketing Content Specialist with strong research skills, excellent written English, and a portfolio demonstrating high-quality content, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a growing marketing team and help create engaging, informative, and search-optimized content that supports brand visibility and business growth.

Candidates with strong writing portfolios and experience producing SEO-focused marketing content are encouraged to apply.

This person will own the process, performance, and people responsible for delivering those results.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a proven sales leader who knows how to build, manage, and scale a high-volume inside sales team. You're equally comfortable developing a repeatable sales process, managing performance through data, and rolling up your sleeves to coach agents and work alongside the team. You're an owner who sets clear expectations, holds people accountable, and isn't afraid to make changes when the results aren't there.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

  • Sales Playbook: Build and continuously improve the member acquisition process, including call scripts, objection handling, follow-up cadences, and lead routing from first contact through move-in.
  • Speed to Lead: Establish response-time expectations and lead coverage strategies that ensure prospective members receive timely outreach across the hours and time zones we serve.
  • Team Performance: Establish daily and weekly activity and booking targets, maintain a transparent performance scoreboard, and hold agents accountable for delivering results.
  • Sales Coaching: Review call recordings, provide actionable feedback, coach agents on specific behaviors, and step in to demonstrate effective selling when needed.
  • Conversion Optimization: Analyze lead quality, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking to identify opportunities and continuously improve sales performance.
  • Data & Reporting: Establish reliable reporting and attribution across lead sources, agent performance, and bookings while identifying opportunities to automate manual processes.
  • Team Development: Hire, train, develop, and manage a high-performing sales team, making timely performance decisions and determining when additional headcount is justified.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Ops, Product, Marketing, Member Experience

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

  • Sales Leadership: 5+ years of experience in inside sales, high-volume outbound sales, or contact center leadership, including at least 2 years managing a team of 15 or more.
  • Proven Results: A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets through team performance, with measurable results you can speak to.
  • Process Building: Experience building or rebuilding sales cadences, lead routing models, service-level agreements (SLAs), and incentive structures.
  • Remote Leadership: Experience managing, developing, and holding distributed, remote, or offshore sales teams accountable.
  • Funnel Analytics: Strong understanding of sales funnel metrics, including time to contact, connection rates, conversion rates, and cost per booking, with the ability to translate data into action.
  • Coaching Expertise: Experience coaching sales representatives using call recordings, performance data, and specific behavioral feedback.
  • Sales Technology: Comfort working with CRMs and sales or support platforms such as HubSpot, Zendesk, or Intercom, building reports, and leveraging tools such as power dialers and sales engagement platforms.
  • Ownership & Adaptability: A hands-on, data-driven leadership style, strong communication skills, and the ability to operate in an evolving environment, make decisions quickly, and adjust strategies based on results.

Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Revenue Ops Lead for 45 minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Sales for one (1) hour.
  • If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours.
  • The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a sales assessment where you will showcase your manager skills to the panel for discussion.
  • If warranted, then we move to offer!

THE ROLE

The Senior Software Engineer sits at the intersection of exchange connectivity, execution and market data for 3iQ’s trading technology team. You will own the trading core, including order and execution management, exchange integrations and market data pipelines, which risk, the ledger and our client apps all build on. You will be a hands-on builder and an owner: designing, building, deploying and operating what you ship, sharing in the on-call rotation for systems that trade 24/7, and helping set the technical standard for how we build as we scale.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

  • Design and evolve the core trading architecture for throughput, latency and failure isolation
  • Build and maintain venue gateways over REST, WebSocket and FIX: order entry, cancels, amendments and drop copy
  • Own order and execution management: one order per client, client order IDs aligned with the venue, no missed or hidden trades
  • Run market data ingestion and normalization across 10,000+ instruments, with redundancy and failover between feeds and gateways
  • Automate the instrument lifecycle: listing, delisting, expiries and option rotations
  • Onboard new venues and instrument types, and absorb their quirks so clients never see them
  • Be the technical reference for the engineers building risk, ledger and client apps on top of the core
  • Lead incident response on the trading path, and write the runbooks so others can too

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • 7+ years building production backend systems, with at least 3 in trading, market infrastructure or exchange connectivity
  • Deep experience with exchange or broker APIs (REST, WebSocket, FIX), order lifecycles and market data
  • Strong command of a systems or backend language used in production trading, such as C++, Rust, Java or Go
  • Solid distributed systems fundamentals: concurrency, idempotency, back-pressure, failover and consistency
  • Experience designing for high message rates (tens of thousands per second and up) at millisecond latency
  • A track record of owning a production system end to end, including on-call for a 24/7 market
  • Clear written and spoken English

NICE TO HAVE

  • Crypto derivatives: perpetuals, funding, options lifecycle, margin and liquidation on Binance, Deribit or similar
  • OMS/EMS or smart order routing experience
  • Functional programming or JVM experience (Clojure, Scala, Kotlin)
  • Experience leading architecture decisions across several teams

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of an innovative, fast-growing industry
  • Remote-first team with a flexible work environment focused on results
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with a strong execution mindset
  • Annual company offsites to connect, collaborate, and recharge

jobs.description:
Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare?

Sound like you? Keep reading.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:
Impact - We do work that matters.
Collaboration - We are in it together.
Human touch - We care deeply.

We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and FR (with occasional travel to our London or Paris offices) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

The Platform team exists to make the whole engineering organisation more effective. We’re guided by one core question: how do we help our colleagues reduce cognitive load and get more done? We’re looking for a Platform Product Manager to own the shared layer that internal engineering teams build on, and to lead our push into agentic development on top of that foundation. You’ll treat internal product engineering teams as your customers, build a platform strategy, and success will be evaluated on how much faster and more reliably other teams can ship.

What you will be doing

  • Platform as a Product: Co-own the platform strategy and roadmap with our Head of Platform.
    - Define and communicate the vision for our internal developer platform and agentic development harness. Prioritise investments based on adoption impact, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make the trade-offs between near-term and long-term value clear. Connect platform investment to company objectives.
    - Treat internal teams as customers. Proactively conduct research with other teams to surface implicit platform needs and turn cross-cutting requirements into platform priorities before they become blockers.
    - Conduct user research with engineers, observing development workflows and combining qualitative feedback with usage data to identify friction, unmet needs and opportunities for self-service.
    - Build the shared layer other teams reuse. Work with the engineering team to convert one-off solutions into shared, easy-to-use services, establishing the platform standards, interfaces, and reusable components that let teams stop rebuilding the same thing.
    - Enable agentic development on the platform. Own the capabilities that let internal teams build, deploy, and operate AI agents safely and at scale.
    - Establish agent governance and assurance. Define product requirements for the guardrails that make agentic capabilities trustworthy in production. Own the evaluation framework that measures agent task completion, failure recovery, output quality, and human override rates, and use it to catch regressions before they reach other teams.
    - Drive scalability and reliability. Partner with engineering on the non-functional requirements that make shared services trustworthy at scale: reliability, performance, security, observability, and graceful behaviour under load. Understand what breaks when a service others depend on runs unattended.
    - Use data to decide. Define adoption, reliability, and developer-experience metrics for the platform and agent-specific metrics like time to value, task completion rate, and human override rate. Pull and interpret data yourself, form a point of view, and use it to prioritise.

What we are looking for

This is a senior, high-trust role: you’ll champion a platform-as-a-product vision and represent the Platform team’s priorities in cross-functional conversations, all while keeping empathy for the end-user at the centre of what you build.

Must-haves

  • 5+ years in product management, with meaningful time on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing tooling, or backend/API products
    -Technical fluency: you’re credible with senior engineers, can reason about distributed systems and architecture trade-offs, and are comfortable where the non-functional requirements *are* the product
    - A track record of owning a platform or internal tool end-to-end, setting direction and shipping without someone else defining the “what”

jobs.title: Solutions Marketing Manager - Software & Cloud
jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

SHI’s Solution Marketers are storytellers who simplify complex concepts, craft compelling narratives, and highlight customer outcomes to drive go-to-market success.

The Solution Marketing Manager, Software & Cloud drives the positioning and go-to-market activation of SHI’s software and cloud portfolio. This role translates complex licensing, cloud platform, professional services, managed services, and partner capabilities into compelling customer outcomes, differentiated narratives, and sales-ready solutions that accelerate pipeline growth, adoption, and revenue.

This role partners with Software & Cloud business leaders, hyperscaler and strategic software teams, technical experts, sales, and cross-functional marketing teams to develop solution offerings. The Solution Marketing Manager shapes market-facing messaging, activates launches, and uses customer and market insights to keep SHI’s portfolio relevant, competitive, and aligned with buyer needs.

The role requires demonstrated experience marketing hyperscaler solutions and services, particularly Microsoft, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Role Description


Go-to-Market Leadership

  • Translate executive business goals, including pipeline, growth, customer acquisition, adoption, renewal, and expansion, into performance-focused go-to-market plans.
  • Develop marketing strategies for business and technical decision-makers, including CIOs, CTOs, cloud leaders, IT operations, application and data leaders, procurement, finance, architects, and partner sellers.
  • Partner with Software & Cloud leadership stakeholders to understand portfolio strategy, roadmaps, partner priorities, funding and co-sell motions, and market opportunities.
  • Own capability mapping, offering development support, solution positioning, and first-level strategy alignment for the pillar.
  • Coordinate the Software & Cloud pillar pod, connecting solution marketing, hyperscaler partner marketing, campaigns, content, events, creative, sales enablement, and business stakeholders around shared priorities and measurable outcomes.

Positioning and Messaging

  • Define clear, customer-friendly narratives across the strategic software advisory and hyperscaler portfolio, including licensing, professional services, and managed services.
  • Differentiate SHI by developing a unified software and cloud customer story focused on business value that resonates with target audiences.
  • Create targeted solution playbooks and persona-specific content for economic buyers, technical buyers, procurement leaders, partner sellers, and SHI sales and overlay teams.
  • Translate hyperscaler and software partner priorities and funding opportunities into consistent SHI positioning while maintaining SHI’s differentiated point of view.

Portfolio and Solution Development

  • Partner with practice and technical teams to map capabilities, identify portfolio gaps, prioritize repeatable offerings, and support solution packaging and lifecycle management.
  • Turn approved solution descriptions into market-ready foundations, including catalog listings, one-pagers, overview presentations, marketplace and co-sell content, and internal launch communications.
  • Clarify the customer problem, outcomes, target audience, differentiation, proof points, delivery approach, and partner alignment for each prioritized offering.
  • Support cross-platform and multi-cloud stories spanning Azure, AWS, and GCP while accurately reflecting internally delivered, managed, and partner-delivered capabilities.
  • Maintain alignment between SHI’s internal solution catalog and external hyperscaler marketplaces or co-sell listings, where applicable.

Market Analysis

  • Conduct market, competitive, partner, and customer research to monitor cloud adoption, software buying models, hyperscaler developments, AI and data platform shifts, marketplaces, consumption, commitments, renewals, and emerging customer needs.
  • Translate market insights and analyst information into actionable recommendations for portfolio development, messaging, campaigns, sales readiness, and partner activation.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to inform solution packaging, partner strategy, roadmap priorities, and go-to-market decisions.
  • Monitor competitor positioning and ecosystem changes to identify whitespace and sharpen SHI’s differentiation.

Sales Enablement, Solution Launches, and Adoption

  • Work with creative and content teams to develop high-impact marketing and sales assets, including messaging frameworks, customer journey maps, ROI stories, solution briefs, overview decks, battlecards, marketplace copy, and partner-facing materials.
  • Equip SHI sales, specialist and overlay teams, pre-sales resources, and partner sellers with messaging, use cases, plays, and customer conversation guides.
  • Support solution and service launches with clear handoffs, internal communications, catalog readiness, campaign inputs, partner activation, and success measurement.
  • Support advocacy programs through case studies, customer success stories, win narratives, references, and proof points that demonstrate adoption and measurable value.
  • Help sellers connect licensing and cloud transactions to advisory, professional, managed, and optimization services that expand customer outcomes and lifetime value.

Content and Demand Generation

  • Help achieve demand generation goals by shaping integrated campaigns that create qualified pipeline for priority software, cloud, and hyperscaler solutions.
  • Partner with hyperscaler marketing, campaign, content, editorial, field, and event teams to translate pillar priorities into coordinated activation across SHI-owned and partner channels.
  • Develop content that resonates with IT, cloud, data, application, procurement, finance, and business leaders and guides them through the buying journey.
  • Leverage major ecosystem moments, including Microsoft Ignite, AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next, executive briefings, webinars, and partner field programs, to amplify differentiated SHI stories and accelerate opportunity creation.

Thought Leadership and Analyst Relations

  • Support software and cloud thought leadership through owned and earned media initiatives that establish SHI as a practical, outcome-focused guide across complex partner ecosystems.
  • Support analyst relations and market education that strengthen SHI’s software, cloud, and hyperscaler credibility.
  • Identify opportunities to connect cloud, AI, security, data, modern workplace, and spend optimization narratives into a cohesive SHI point of view.

Performance Metrics

  • Define and track KPIs for positioning, content, campaigns, launches, partner activation, pipeline influence, adoption, marketplace engagement, and sales readiness.
  • Use performance data, customer feedback, partner insights, and field input to continuously optimize strategies and investment priorities.
  • Provide concise updates to senior leadership on key initiatives, dependencies, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Analytical Thinking: Synthesizes complex market, portfolio, customer, partner, and performance data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Business Acumen: Connects marketing strategy to revenue growth, pipeline, adoption, renewals, customer value, and partner objectives.
  • Communication: Simplifies software, licensing, cloud, and technical concepts for diverse internal, customer, and partner audiences.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Uses customer needs, buying dynamics, and feedback to guide positioning, packaging, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Develops and executes integrated initiatives across multiple platforms, stakeholders, and routes to market.
  • Collaboration: Builds alignment across business leaders, technical experts, sales, partner teams, and marketing functions to drive decisions and action.
  • Project and Goal Focus: Manages multiple priorities, dependencies, and launches with clear ownership and disciplined follow-through.
  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: Maintains fluency in rapidly evolving hyperscaler platforms, partner programs, AI, cloud economics, and software buying models.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Excellent copywriting and messaging ability – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to understand audiences and adapt communications for executive, technical, sales, customer, and partner stakeholders – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to create compelling messages that differentiate SHI across software, cloud, and services – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to build go-to-market plans, messaging frameworks, solution briefs, presentations, playbooks, and campaign inputs – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft, AWS, and GCP ecosystems, partner motions, marketplaces, and cloud services – Intermediate.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft 365 suite – Intermediate.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, project management, time management, and organizational skills – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume role and multiple concurrent initiatives in a large, distributed organization – Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Strong technical literacy, particularly in cloud and AI, with the ability to simplify complex concepts without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Metrics-driven approach with the ability to connect marketing activity to incremental business results.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and navigate changing priorities, dependencies, and stakeholder needs.
  • Natural curiosity and empathy for customers, sellers, technical teams, and partners.

Other Requirements

  • Completed bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required.
  • 3–5 years of product, services, or solutions marketing experience.
  • Demonstrated experience marketing solutions or services aligned with hyperscalers such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Familiarity with strategic software partners and adjacent platforms such as ServiceNow, Adobe, data platforms, or cloud management technologies.
  • Experience translating cloud platforms, licensing and consumption models, marketplaces, commitments, renewals, partner funding, and co-sell motions into customer and seller value propositions.
  • Proven ability to develop comprehensive go-to-market plans and execute launches that drive awareness, partner engagement, sales readiness, and qualified pipeline.
  • Position may require up to 25% travel.

Preferred

  • Product, services, or solutions marketing experience within B2B technology, IT services, consulting, or solution provider environments.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $100,000 - $130,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.
