Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

Your Role and Impact:

  • Onboarding Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.

  • Success Planning: Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.

  • Value Articulation: Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.

  • Proactive Engagement: Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.

  • Technical Credibility: Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.

  • Renewal and Expansion: Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.

  • Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

This Role is a Fit for You If:

  • Proven Post-Sales Experience: You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers.

  • Technical Credibility: You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources.

  • Stakeholder Range: You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction.

  • Structured and Proactive: You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it.

  • Commercial Awareness: You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report.

  • Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector -- where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions.

  • Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem.

  • Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Own PII handling, GDPR and CCPA compliance, encryption at rest and in transit, and user-scoped access boundaries at the systems level. You treat AI safety as a first-class engineering concern rather than a review-stage checklist.   • Command of agent orchestration frameworks including LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph, and of evaluation frameworks that measure LLM output quality, relevance, and safety in production
  • Data privacy depth at the infrastructure level, including PII handling, GDPR, USPSAD and CCPA compliance, and encryption at rest and in transit
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, Bedrock), Docker, Kubernetes, and GitLab

Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. jobs.excerpt: Voir la version française ci-dessousAbout Flinks 🚀Flinks is the embedded finance platform that brings together connectivity, intelligence, and payments — giving businesses the infrastructure they need to build and deliver seamless financial experiences at scale.
jobs.description:
Voir la version française ci-dessous

About Flinks 🚀

Flinks is the embedded finance platform that brings together connectivity, intelligence, and payments — giving businesses the infrastructure they need to build and deliver seamless financial experiences at scale.

As a leader in Open Finance in Canada, we’ve grown since 2016 into one of North America’s most trusted platforms for financial data access, enrichment, and money movement. We work with innovators across many industries, including lending, fintech, banking, insurance, and wealth management.

Today, our platform connects to 15,000+ financial institutions across North America and powers over 1M monthly connections. We also give our customers unprecedented visibility into 4,500+ real-time financial insights to support smarter decisioning. Companies rely on Flinks to streamline onboarding, verify income, assess credit risk, and power faster payment experiences.

We’re on a mission to drive financial innovation and help businesses build financial experiences that feel effortless, connected, and customer-first. That’s where you come in.

What You'll Be Doing 🔥

  • Shape how AI agents and assistants work in our SDLC: where they operate, what they can touch, and how their output is reviewed, traced, and approved. You will partner with Security and Compliance to make this work in a regulated environment.
  • Encode standards as code: quality gates, security scanning, and policy checks live in templates and pipelines, not review checklists.
  • Build and own our internal developer platform: a Backstage-based portal and service catalog with software templates that scaffold a production-ready service (repo, pipeline, infrastructure, dashboards, alerts, ownership) in minutes.
  • Build agent-facing interfaces, such as MCP servers, that expose the catalog, pipelines, and infrastructure to AI agents safely. Track agent-assisted changes with the same DORA and quality metrics as human ones.
  • Evolve our cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure and extend self-service (Terraform, declarative APIs, PRs) so teams provision what they need with guardrails instead of tickets.
  • Cut developer toil: local development, preview environments, test feedback time, and pipeline duration.
  • Treat developers as your customers: gather feedback, document, drive adoption, and keep platform code tested, versioned, and maintainable.

Who You Are

  • At least 8 to 10 years in platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, with real software development along the way. Any language works (we use C#, Go, and Python); you write and maintain production code, not only configuration.
  • Hands-on Backstage experience (catalog, software templates, TechDocs, plugins), or you have built an equivalent internal developer portal and can walk us through it.
  • Kubernetes, GitOps (Argo CD or Flux), and Terraform in a major cloud. GCP or Azure is a plus.
  • CI/CD and release engineering: pipeline templates, environment promotion, safe rollouts and rollbacks.
  • You use AI coding tools daily and have a point of view on where they fit in a team's SDLC.
  • Working knowledge of observability: traces, metrics, logs, SLOs.
  • A practitioner, not a strategist: senior enough to drive initiatives and build from scratch with minimal direction. You do the hands-on work.

Great to haves

  • Custom Backstage plugin development, or running Backstage at scale
  • Building MCP servers or agent tooling, or integrating LLMs into CI/CD and developer workflows
  • Defining governance for AI-generated code: review standards, permission boundaries, audit trails
  • Policy-as-code and supply chain security (OPA, Kyverno, SBOM, artifact signing)
  • DORA metrics, developer satisfaction measurement, ephemeral environments
  • Regulated or financial-services delivery experience

Why This Role Matters at Flinks 💡

  • Greenfield: you define the golden path rather than inherit it.
  • Everything you build is used by every engineering team at Flinks.
  • High visibility: AI-enabled delivery is a top company priority.
  • You help decide how AI agents build and ship software in a regulated environment, in a strong learning environment with plenty already in place to build on.

The Interview Process 🏗

  • Introductory call with our Head of People
  • Hiring manager conversation
  • One-hour technical interview

À propos de Flinks 🚀

Flinks est une plateforme de finance embarquée qui réunit connectivité, intelligence et paiements. Elle offre aux entreprises l’infrastructure dont elles ont besoin pour créer et proposer des expériences financières fluides à grande échelle.

Chef de file de la finance ouverte au Canada, nous avons connu une croissance soutenue depuis 2016 et sommes devenus l’une des plateformes les plus fiables en Amérique du Nord pour l’accès aux données financières, leur enrichissement et les transferts de fonds. Nous collaborons avec des entreprises innovantes de nombreux secteurs, notamment le prêt, les technologies financières, les services bancaires, l’assurance et la gestion de patrimoine.

Aujourd’hui, notre plateforme se connecte à plus de 15 000 institutions financières en Amérique du Nord et permet plus d’un million de connexions par mois. Nous offrons également à nos clients une visibilité sans précédent sur plus de 4 500 indicateurs financiers en temps réel afin de favoriser une prise de décision éclairée. Les entreprises comptent sur Flinks pour simplifier l’intégration de leurs clients, vérifier les revenus, évaluer le risque de crédit et accélérer les paiements.

Notre mission est de stimuler l’innovation financière et d’aider les entreprises à créer des expériences financières simples, connectées et centrées sur le client. C’est là que vous entrez en jeu.

Ce que vous ferez 🔥

  • Concevoir et prendre en charge notre plateforme de développement interne : un portail et un catalogue de services basés sur Backstage, avec des modèles logiciels permettant de générer en quelques minutes un service prêt pour la production (dépôt de code, pipeline, infrastructure, tableaux de bord, alertes et responsabilités).
  • Intégrer les standards directement aux outils : contrôles de qualité, analyses de sécurité et vérifications de conformité aux politiques dans les modèles et les pipelines, plutôt que de s’appuyer sur des listes de vérification manuelles.
  • Définir la façon dont les agents et les assistants d’IA interviennent dans notre cycle de développement logiciel : leurs environnements d’exécution, leurs niveaux d’accès et les mécanismes de révision, de traçabilité et d’approbation de leurs contributions. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes Sécurité et Conformité pour mettre en place ces pratiques dans un environnement réglementé.
  • Créer des interfaces destinées aux agents, comme des serveurs MCP, qui donnent aux agents d’IA un accès sécurisé au catalogue, aux pipelines et à l’infrastructure. Mesurer les changements réalisés avec l’aide de l’IA à l’aide des mêmes indicateurs DORA et de qualité que ceux utilisés pour évaluer le travail des développeurs.
  • Faire évoluer notre infrastructure infonuagique et Kubernetes, et étendre les capacités de libre-service (Terraform, API déclaratives et demandes de fusion) afin que les équipes puissent accéder aux ressources dont elles ont besoin avec des garde-fous intégrés, plutôt que de devoir soumettre des billets.
  • Réduire les tâches répétitives des développeurs en améliorant le développement local, les environnements de prévisualisation, les délais de rétroaction des tests et la durée des pipelines.
  • Considérer les développeurs comme vos clients : recueillir leurs commentaires, documenter les solutions, favoriser leur adoption et maintenir une plateforme dont le code est testé, versionné et facile à maintenir.

Votre profil

  • Vous avez au moins 8 à 10 ans d’expérience en ingénierie de plateforme, en DevOps ou en infrastructure, ainsi qu’une solide expérience en développement logiciel. Nous utilisons notamment C#, Go et Python, mais toute expérience pertinente en programmation est considérée. Vous savez écrire et maintenir du code en production, et pas seulement de la configuration.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique de Backstage (catalogue, modèles logiciels, TechDocs et plugiciels), ou vous avez conçu un portail de développement interne équivalent et êtes en mesure de nous présenter votre expérience en détail.
  • Vous maîtrisez Kubernetes, GitOps (Argo CD ou Flux) et Terraform sur une plateforme infonuagique d’envergure. Une expérience avec GCP ou Azure est un atout.
  • Vous avez de l’expérience en CI/CD et en ingénierie des mises en production : modèles de pipelines, promotion entre les environnements, déploiements et retours en arrière sécuritaires.
  • Vous utilisez régulièrement des outils de codage assistés par l’IA et avez une opinion réfléchie sur la place qu’ils devraient occuper dans le cycle de développement d’une équipe.
  • Vous avez une connaissance pratique de l’observabilité : traces, métriques, journaux et objectifs de niveau de service (SLO).
  • Vous êtes une personne de terrain, et non uniquement une personne de stratégie. Vous avez suffisamment d’expérience pour mener des initiatives et bâtir des solutions à partir de zéro avec peu de supervision. Vous aimez mettre la main à la pâte.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans le développement de plugiciels Backstage personnalisés ou dans l’exploitation de Backstage à grande échelle.
  • Expérience dans la création de serveurs MCP ou d’outils pour agents, ou dans l’intégration de grands modèles de langage (LLM) aux pipelines CI/CD et aux flux de travail des développeurs.
  • Expérience dans la définition de règles de gouvernance pour le code généré par l’IA : normes de révision, limites d’autorisation et pistes d’audit.
  • Connaissance des politiques en tant que code et de la sécurité de la chaîne d’approvisionnement logicielle (OPA, Kyverno, SBOM et signature d’artefacts).
  • Expérience avec les indicateurs DORA, la mesure de la satisfaction des développeurs et les environnements éphémères.
  • Expérience en livraison de solutions dans un environnement réglementé ou dans le secteur des services financiers.

Pourquoi ce poste est important chez Flinks 💡

  • Un terrain à bâtir : vous définirez le parcours de référence plutôt que de simplement reprendre un modèle existant.
  • Un impact à grande échelle : les solutions que vous développerez seront utilisées par toutes les équipes d’ingénierie de Flinks.
  • Une grande visibilité : la livraison assistée par l’IA est l’une des principales priorités de l’entreprise.
  • Un rôle qui façonne l’avenir : vous contribuerez à définir la façon dont les agents d’IA conçoivent et livrent des logiciels dans un environnement réglementé, tout en évoluant dans un milieu stimulant où plusieurs fondations sont déjà en place.

Le processus d’entrevue 🏗

  • Appel d’introduction avec notre responsable des ressources humaines.
  • Rencontre avec le gestionnaire d’embauche.
  • Entrevue technique d’une heure.

Job Summary:

Scope of the Role

The Software Engineer II is a mid-level technical contributor in the organization who is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions. They are developing and building the applications and systems that run the company. This could be the backend systems, the frontend user experience, the products, or the tools to keep the business running. They may work independently or as part of a team and contribute to the technical direction of the software engineering department. The impact they should have on the company is to deliver high-quality software products that meet the needs of customers and stakeholders, while also continuing to develop their technical skills and knowledge. They should have a keen focus on learning and professional development, as well as a willingness to collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders. A Software Engineer II is also expected to demonstrate proficiency with agentic AI coding tools, using them to independently accelerate feature delivery while applying strong judgment to validate every line of AI-generated output.

Responsibilities:

Performance Outcomes

Performance Outcome: Development of Products or Systems

A Software Engineer II will have a deeper understanding of the development processes and tools, including a stronger focus on quality, thanmore juniorengineers.Initiallythe SoftwareEngineer II might write code according to a specification or ticket written by someone else, using an architecture and/or design created by others. However, as they advance, they will contribute increasingly more to defining the requirements, architecture, and design of what they are building. They are more capable of working independently and not being blocked byothers, andwill have developed someexpertisein their area of focus, which may include several different approaches to solving problems with their area.The SoftwareEngineer II will begin to work on components that span a product and potentially a system and will also understand the components of other immediate team members and how their system interacts with these components. While still focused on tasks and tickets, they will begin to see beyond the current ticket and solve problems outside of the task at hand – they will see beyond an individual sprint, with an understanding of work that ishappeningseveral sprints out.

Individual tasks include:

jobs.description:
Do you want to combine hands-on software engineering, cutting-edge data platforms, and international collaboration across the EMEA region?

At Axiomatics, we develop world-leading Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) solutions that protect critical data for banks, government agencies, and global enterprises. Here, you will work with cutting-edge technology and complex security architectures.

Founded in 2006, Axiomatics is a leading provider of dynamic authorization and fine-grained access control. As a subsidiary of Leonardo S.p.a. — a global leader in Aerospace, Defense, and Cyber Security — we combine the agility of a technology frontrunner with the robust backing and governance of a major international group.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer / Developer based in Greece to join our distributed EMEA Engineering organization and play a key role in our continued international growth. This is a hands-on technical role focused on designing, developing, and continuously improving integrations between our ABAC authorization platform and modern enterprise data systems.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Axiomatics, you will play a central role in building and scaling productized integrations with leading third-party data platforms, with an initial focus on Databricks, as well as Snowflake and other enterprise data systems. You will contribute as a hands-on senior individual contributor, collaborating closely with product managers, software engineers, UX, QA, and security specialists across Europe to protect sensitive enterprise data.

This role offers a blend of software architecture, hands-on integration engineering, API/SDK evaluation, and CI/CD pipelines, providing substantial autonomy to shape our integration ecosystem and engineering best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain robust, productized integrations with third-party data platforms, with an initial priority on Databricks.
  • Ensure all integrations fulfill strict enterprise requirements for security, scalability, performance, maintainability, testability, and operational resilience.
  • Master how integrated third-party platforms store, process, and govern access to sensitive data.
  • Evaluate relevant APIs, SDKs, integration patterns, and platform capabilities to support sustainable product development.
  • Work actively within a cross-functional Engineering team, contributing to sprint planning, architectural design discussions, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD delivery.
  • Deliver production-ready integration components, automated tests, prototypes, technical documentation, and reference implementations.
  • Drive the continuous evolution of our integration capabilities, engineering practices, developer tooling, and reusable libraries.

Knowledge & Experience

To succeed in this role, you bring deep technical judgment in information systems combined with practical experience in third-party data platforms and access control mechanisms. You are motivated by being a senior individual contributor within an international, cross-functional engineering team: you actively share knowledge and support teammates, while the role remains focused on hands-on technical excellence rather than people management.

Your profil

  • At least 7 years of software engineering experience in enterprise-grade integration environments or closely related domains.
  • Solid programming proficiency in one or more relevant languages: Java (strongly preferred), C#, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript. Front-end experience with React is an advantage.
  • Experience integrating with third-party enterprise data systems: Snowflake, RDBMS, NoSQL, BigData, or comparable architectures.
  • Practical "Data Steward" experience configuring, enforcing, and maintaining data access policies within enterprise platforms.
  • In-depth understanding of data storage/processing engines, access control mechanisms, and data catalog solutions.
  • Track record of navigating complex enterprise environments with multi-system integrations, strict security constraints, and diverse stakeholders.
  • Hands-on mastery of the following frameworks and standards:
    • Java Spring Boot or EE
    • Gradle / Maven
    • JPA / Hibernate

Ciklum is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our team full-time in Brazil.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Platform Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Our client is building a platform engineering function from the ground up and this role is at the center of it. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will be a founding team member with a clear, three-part mission: fully rearchitect and codify our cloud estate on AWS and Azure, stand up a world-class SRE and observability practice, and build an Internal Developer Platform with golden paths that make shipping software fast, safe, and self-service. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You will work directly with the Platform Engineering Manager to translate strategy into production infrastructure, drive adoption across engineering teams, and set the technical bar for how the platform is built and operated.

Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Modernization — Rearchitect & Codify:
    • Migrate all existing AWS and Azure infrastructure to OpenTofu/Terraform and Ansible; establish module standards, remote state, and GitOps-based plan/apply pipelines — no unmanaged resources
    • Audit the cloud estate against the AWS and Azure Well-Architected Frameworks; produce a remediation backlog and drive it to completion across networking, IAM, landing zones, account structure, and cost governance
    • Implement policy-as-code (OPA/Conftest, AWS SCPs, Azure Policy) to enforce security, tagging, and compliance guardrails at the platform layer — governance embedded, not bolted on
    • Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules for compute (EKS, AKS, EC2), networking, storage, databases, and identity as shared building blocks for all engineering teams
    • Define FinOps standards: tagging taxonomy, cost allocation dashboards, rightsizing recommendations, and reserved capacity planning across both clouds
  • SRE & Observability:
    • Design and implement the full observability stack: metrics (Prometheus/Datadog), logs (Loki/OpenSearch), traces (Tempo/Datadog APM), and dashboards (Grafana) — instrumented end-to-end via OpenTelemetry
    • Define SLIs and SLOs for all platform shared services and critical applications; build error budget dashboards and burn-rate alerting — alert on symptoms, not raw metrics
    • Establish the SRE practice from scratch: incident runbooks, post-incident review templates, and at least one chaos engineering exercise (AWS FIS or equivalent)
    • Partner with engineering teams to instrument their services, define meaningful alerts, and build operational dashboards — reliability is a shared responsibility, not a platform team tax
    • Build capacity planning models for compute and storage so engineering leadership can make data-driven scaling decisions
  • Internal Developer Platform & Golden Paths:
    • Deploy and operate a developer portal (Backstage, GitHub or equivalent) as the single front door: service catalog, scaffolding templates, runbooks, API docs, and on-call ownership all in one place
    • Build and maintain golden paths for the highest-frequency developer workflows: new service creation, Kubernetes deployment, database provisioning, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline setup - opinionated defaults with escape hatches for legitimate edge cases
    • Own the CI/CD platform layer: standardized pipeline templates (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), reusable workflow libraries, container image build and scan pipelines, and environment promotion workflows with security scanning (SAST, Snyk) built in by default
    • Own Kubernetes platform operations: EKS and/or AKS cluster lifecycle, Helm chart standards, admission controllers, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh (Istio or Linkerd)
    • Build the self-service provisioning layer — Backstage scaffolder actions and Terraform automation so developers can provision approved resources without raising a ticket
    • Measure adoption and run regular feedback sessions with engineering teams; iterate on golden paths based on real friction, not assumptions
  • Cross-Cutting Responsibilities:
    • Partner with peer managers and teams to plan and support migration of existing workloads onto the platform; provide hands-on migration support, not just documentation
    • Embed security by default across all platform work: IaC scanning (Checkov, tfsec), secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), RBAC, and container image hardening
    • Write clear technical documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and runbooks; raise the documentation bar for the whole team
    • Mentor and support more junior platform engineers; contribute to architecture reviews and build-vs-buy decisions alongside the Platform Engineering Manager

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering with direct production ownership on AWS and/or Azure
  • IaC: Deep OpenTofu/Terraform proficiency: module authoring, state management, workspace strategy, remote backends, and CI/CD integration; Terramate a plus
  • Kubernetes: Strong Kubernetes operations: EKS and/or AKS cluster lifecycle, Helm, admission controllers, RBAC, network policies, and autoscaling
  • Observability & SRE: Hands-on observability experience with two or more of: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry — including SLI/SLO definition and alert engineering
  • CI/CD: CI/CD platform experience: GitHub Actions pipeline authoring, reusable workflow design, and container build/scan pipeline ownership
  • GitOps: GitOps: ArgoCD or Flux for Kubernetes continuous delivery; progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue-green) a strong plus
  • IDP: IDP experience: Backstage or equivalent developer portal, GitHub, scaffolding templates, service catalog design, or self-service provisioning tooling
  • Security: Security-first mindset: policy-as-code, IaC scanning, secrets management, container hardening, and shift- left security practices
  • Strong communication and documentation skills; comfortable presenting architecture decisions to engineering peers and leadership

Desirable:

  • SRE background: chaos engineering (AWS FIS, Chaos Monkey), error budget management, incident command, and capacity planning
  • Service mesh depth: Istio or Linkerd — mTLS, traffic management, and observability integration
  • FinOps tooling (Kubecost, CloudHealth) and reserved capacity planning experience
  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure basics: LLM API integration or model serving, as the platform will need to support these workloads
  • Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator/Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Terraform Associate
  • Python or Go for platform tooling and CLI development

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year

  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications

  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential

  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients

  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

jobs.description:
"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."

— Ada Lovelace, 1843

What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.

The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury's product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.
  • Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.
  • Develop a design system that's as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.
  • Invest in the design system's prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.
  • Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.

The ideal candidate for the role:

We're looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who's eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:

  • 7+ years of frontend development, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library.
  • A thorough command of modern frontend tooling: build systems, CI/CD, and testing.
  • High agency, and comfort creating clarity in ambiguous spaces. You take ownership and move without waiting for a defined path.
  • First-principles systems thinking that stays oriented to outcomes. You make clear decisions that drive toward results instead of getting stuck in open questions.
  • Strong product taste, and an instinct for leverage: the change that makes many teams better, not the one component polished in isolation.
  • Hands-on fluency at the intersection of AI and software development: a real command of how emerging AI paradigms are changing the way software gets built, and the ability to turn that into practical leverage, both for the design system itself and for the people who build on it.

jobs.excerpt: No Grupo Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração.
jobs.description:
No Grupo Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Sobre a posição

Como Analytics Engineer Sênior, você liderará a refatoração e padronização da nossa camada de transformação no GCP. Sua missão é erradicar consultas SQL monolíticas ("código espaguete") e lógicas duplicadas, implementando engenharia de software aplicada ao SQL (Dataform/dbt), testes de qualidade embutidos e templates que servirão de base para nossa aceleração via IA (Antigravity).

Responsabilidades

  • Modularidade de Desenvolvimento: Definir e implementar os padrões de engenharia SQL no BigQuery utilizando Dataform (com desenvolvimento de pacotes/macros em JavaScript/TypeScript) e/ou dbt (Jinja/Python), estruturando camadas claras de transformação, reuso de código, modelagem dimensional/denormalizada eficiente (uso estratégico de STRUCT e ARRAY) e padrões estritos de cargas incrementais (incremental tables com merge/insert-overwrite por partição), evitando full-refreshes desnecessários e garantindo idempotência nos reprocessamentos.
  • Qualidade de Dados Automatizada: Implementar frameworks de Data Quality (assertions no Dataform / Dataplex Auto Data Quality) e o padrão arquitetural Write-Audit-Publish (WAP) no BigQuery, garantindo que dados recém-processados sejam auditados e que anomalias, quebras de chave ou atrasos de SLA acionem Circuit Breakers e bloqueiem a propagação de dados corrompidos antes de serem expostos às views de consumo final.
  • Padrões para Geração via IA: Estruturar os modelos e templates de transformação de excelência, mantendo um repositório de "Few-Shot Examples" (exemplos canônicos de Staging, Intermediate e Marts) perfeitamente documentados que servirão de contexto para o Antigravity gerar novos modelos de dados de forma padronizada.
  • Camada Semântica e Self-Service: Trabalhar próximo às áreas consumidoras para desenhar camadas semânticas e Data Marts otimizados no BigQuery (via Views Autorizadas, Tabelas Agregadas e Materialized Views aceleradas pelo BI Engine) para ferramentas de visualização (especialmente Looker Studio), garantindo alta performance, baixo custo de leitura e consistência absoluta de KPIs mesmo em ferramentas que não possuem camada de modelagem centralizada nativa.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio absoluto de SQL avançado no BigQuery (Window Functions / QUALIFY, manipulação avançada de UNNEST / ARRAY_AGG, scripting procedural) e ferramentas modernas de transformação modular: Dataform (incluindo JavaScript para geração dinâmica de SQL) e/ou dbt (Jinja).
  • Experiência profunda em modelagem de dados para Cloud Data Warehouses (Kimball adaptado para bancos colunares, One Big Table com campos aninhados RECORD/REPEATED, modelagem histórica Slowly Changing Dimensions - SCD Tipo 2, técnicas de Partition Pruning, Clustering em chaves de alta cardinalidade e modelagem incremental para redução de bytes escaneados e consumo de slots).
  • Experiência com integração, catalogação e otimização de fontes de dados para ferramentas de BI, com destaque para Looker Studio e BI Engine (uso de Materialized Views, pré-agregações, gerenciamento de concorrência e prevenção de queries full-scan disparadas por filtros mal configurados no Looker Studio).
  • Vivência comprovada na criação de testes automatizados de dados (schema tests, testes de integridade referencial, detecção de anomalias de volume e atualização).

Competências comportamentais

  • Ponte entre Negócio e Engenharia: Você possui excelente articulação verbal e visual para traduzir regras de negócio complexas em modelos de dados limpos — e sabe explicar essa estrutura tanto para um diretor comercial quanto para um engenheiro de dados.
  • Rigor Técnico com Pragmatismo: Você tem uma obsessão saudável por código limpo, modular e bem documentado, sabendo evangelizar boas práticas de Analytics Engineering de forma consultiva e colaborativa.
  • Mentalidade de Produto (Data-as-a-Product): Você enxerga tabelas e camadas semânticas como produtos que precisam de SLA, documentação clara e confiança do usuário final.
  • Pensamento Analítico e Investigativo: Capacidade de realizar análises de causa raiz (RCA) rápidas quando divergências de números surgem entre sistemas legados e a nova camada semântica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na migração de pipelines legados (Stored Procedures monolíticas ou queries agendadas no BigQuery) para arquiteturas modulares no Dataform/dbt.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de camada semântica dedicada (LookML / Looker, Cube, dbt Semantic Layer) ou design de métricas padronizadas.
  • Experiência em análise de grafo de linhagem (DAG) para identificação de gargalos críticos de SLA e refatoração de dependências circulares ou excessivamente profundas.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Many of our customers use patents to make business decisions: comparing their portfolio with competitors', spotting acquisition or licensing targets, deciding what to keep or drop, or tracking where a technology is heading. Increasingly, they ask an AI assistant to help. We're looking for someone who knows what good answers to these questions look like, to help make sure our products, and the AI inside them, give them.

About the role:


"How does our portfolio compare with our three closest competitors?" "Which companies would strengthen our position in power electronics?" "What does this patent actually claim?" Answering questions like these well takes judgment: which companies to group together, how to count, which time window to use, how to read a claim, and what the numbers can and cannot support. AI can now produce a polished answer in seconds, which makes that judgment more important, because a convincing answer can still be a wrong one.


In this role, you will represent the people who ask these questions, and you will be forward deployed: working closely with the product and engineering teams building specific end-user experiences, rather than advising from a distance. You will define what a genuinely useful answer looks like across different use cases, contexts, and data scenarios, and encode that judgment in artefacts and other mechanisms, including AI agents, so it can scale. You will test our analytics and AI against it and help shape what we build next.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Be the voice, alongside the product and engineering teams building our end-user experiences, of the various types of end users who use patent analytics for business decisions: IP and portfolio managers, competitive-intelligence analysts, corporate development and M&A teams, R&D strategists and investors, by deeply understanding their needs, aspirations and the jobs they need to get done.
  • Define what good looks like across a broad range of AI-assisted uses, such as portfolio exploration and comparison, competitor benchmarking, technology and sector trends, acquisition and licensing target identification, portfolio optimisation, and patent summaries and claim interpretation.
  • Capture that definition in governed, versioned question sets, graded example answers, scoring rubrics, and acceptance criteria that teams build closed-loop evaluations on, and work closely with engineering teams to guide them as they build evaluation frameworks on these.
  • Perform structured human-in-the-loop evaluations and drive the eyes-on evaluation layer for our AI assistant and analytics features: design and carry out expert reviews, judge whether results meet the bar, and feed what you learn back into the standards.
  • Collaborate closely with other patent experts in the team to develop methods that scale eyes-on human evaluation.
  • Help engineering teams troubleshoot issues by working backwards from AI outputs to the underlying data sources, to identify root causes.
  • Help shape new AI use cases and features: spot questions customers cannot easily answer today, and test ideas with customers and our user research colleagues.
  • Scope and lead your own projects independently, from defining the problem to sharing recommendations with senior stakeholders.
  • Track how competitors and new AI tools serve these users, and flag opportunities and risks.
  • Help capture your judgment in tools and AI assistants that let others apply it at scale and evaluate those tools over time to detect drift and develop ways to recalibrate them.

Requirements:


  • Experience using patent data to answer business questions, for example in patent analytics, IP or innovation consulting, competitive intelligence, portfolio management, IP due diligence, or technology scouting.
  • A strong technical background, enough to read patents critically and interpret what their claims cover.
  • A solid understanding of patent data and its pitfalls for analysis, such as family counting, ownership roll-ups, legal status, citations, classification, and time effects
  • The ability to explain clearly why an analysis is or is not trustworthy, and what would make it better.
  • Hands-on analytical skills, for example with analytics platforms, Excel, SQL, or Python
  • Practical use of AI tools in your own analytical work beyond basic chat, including effective prompting, and a clear view of where they help and where they mislead.
  • Confidence working independently and presenting recommendations to senior, non-specialist audiences.
  • Curiosity about technology, industries and how decision-makers actually use what you give them.

Experience and education.


  • Typically, 3 or more years in patent analytics, competitive intelligence, IP consulting, portfolio management, or related roles; we will also consider candidates earlier in their careers who show strong promise.
  • A degree in a scientific, engineering, or technical subject, or equivalent practical experience; a further degree is a plus.


It would be great if you also have.


  • Hands-on experience with patent analytics platforms
  • Experience with AI evaluation, for example rubric-based scoring, LLM-as-a-judge, or human-in-the-loop review
  • Experience with M&A, IP due diligence, licensing, or portfolio valuation
  • Experience with prior-art or freedom-to-operate work.
  • A background in a technology-intensive industry or R&D
  • Experience working with product teams or user researchers.

You do not need to have worked for a data or software company before. We will help you learn how our products are built; you bring the analytical judgment and the customer's perspective.


This role is probably not for you if you'd rather produce analyses for clients than shape the products and AI that produce them, or if you're not keen to use AI tools in your work.


Why Join Us?


You'll help decide what good patent-based insight looks like for many different kinds of users worldwide, with the backing of a global group that has been building data, analytics and AI products for many years, and with colleagues who care about getting answers right.


In your application


Please tell us briefly about one of the following:


  • A time a patent-based analysis of a portfolio, competitor or technology, whether your own, a colleague's or AI-generated, gave a misleading picture: how you noticed, and what you would change in the method or the tool so it doesn't happen again.
  • A patent-based analysis you did that influenced a business decision, such as an R&D, acquisition, licensing or competitive-strategy choice: the question, your approach, and how you knew your answer could be trusted. What AI tools and workflows would you use if you were doing it today?

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.


· Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working for you


We know that your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


  • Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy additional days.
  • Health screening, eye care vouchers, and private medical benefits
  • Wellbeing programs
  • Life assurance
  • Access to a competitive contributory pension scheme
  • Save As You Earn share option scheme.
  • Maternity, paternity, and shared parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer.
  • Access to extensive learning and development resources
  • Access to employee discounts scheme via Perks at Work

About the business -


At LexisNexis Intellectual Property (LNIP), we believe that whenever a person works on a patent and understands the future trajectory of a specific technology, that person has the potential to fundamentally change how society operates. We are proud to directly support and serve these innovators in their endeavors to better humankind. We enable innovators to accomplish more by helping them make informed decisions, be more productive, comply with regulations, and ultimately achieve superior results. By harnessing the latest advances in machine learning combined with expert analysis, LexisNexis Intellectual Property is disrupting how actionable insight is extracted from patent data. Information can now be accessed with efficiency, accuracy and at a speed that is just not possible by traditional methods. Our overall success is measured by how well we deliver these results.
